*Wannan Labarin Ƙirƙirarren labari ne kamar yanda kukaji tun a Book One,banyi shi dan cin zarafin wani ba, wanda yai dai dai da rayuwar shi aimin afuwa akasine🙏* 



Episode 1&2

Previous on Bayima Ya'yane book one. 


Jaruman Sarauniya Zulaiƙa suka gama shiri kowa ya hau saman dawakan su tace. 

"Daga nan kufara bin hanyar Masarautar Raifasu bance ku ɓata lokacin kuba." 

"Angama ranki shidade haka suka kama hanyar  neman Yarima Malik...... 


Contious of Book two👇🏻


Koda suka fita Masarautar Daborah ba abinda suke shekawa sai gudu saman dawakan su kamar zasu bar ƙasar  baki ɗayan ta, basu da buri da ya wuce su dakatar da Yarima MalikusSaif kamar yanda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta umurce su.... 

 
Itako Bahijja koda aka rufe mata idanu sai ihu takeyi amman a banza basu da niyar sakin ta ganin dagske suke zasu tafi da ita batasan sadda tasa hakoran taba ta gallama wanda ya riketa cizo ba shiri ya saketa da gudu ta runtuma ana kare, aiko suka rufe mata baya, cikin daji tayi batasan inda zata dosa ba duk tsoro yagama cika mata zuciya... 

Suko bayin da Yarima Haishir ya turo dan duba masu masaukin da zasu zauna kafin ya shiga cikin Masarautar Raifasu cikin dare, haka suka dawo agajiye, da kallan tuhuma ya bisu ganin damuwa a fuskokin su, tambaya ya jefo masu yace. 

"Lafiya naganku haka ya kuka samu Masarautar."? ɗaya daga cikin sune yai karfin hali yace. "Ranka shidade ba damar da zamuyi wani zagaye a cikin Masarautar nan saboda dagani akwai babban al'amari daya faru a cikin ta yanda mukaga bayin Masarautar da dogarawa kowa yana cikin alhini da jimama dagani akwai abinda suke nema mai mahimmanci atare dasu wannan dalilin yasa muka dawo sai komai ya lafa sannan musake komawa, tuba muke ranka shidade." 


Wani ƙayataccen murmushi yayi wanda ba abinda ke cikin shi sai tsantsar zalinci da mugun ta ga mugun kuduri iri iri yana saƙawa sannan yace. "Badamuwa mujira zuwa anjiman ba abinda zamu fasa sai munba Sarki Baidulƙais mamaki.!"


Komawa sukayi wajen wani icce inda hadimai suka gyarama Yarima Haishir, ya zauna ba abinda yake tinanin sai yanda zai cimma Sarki Baidulƙais, ya rusa mashi duk wani farin ciki daya tanada na rayuwa.... 

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

 wajen su MalikusSaif sunyi tafiya mai nisan gaske har sun fara hangen garin Zanbi inda suka tunkari Masarautar Raifasu sai murmushi Yarima Malik keyi yana karajin karfi a jikin shi ba wanda idan shi keson gani sai Bahijja. 

 A wajen Sarkin Yaƙi kuwa suma sunyi nisan gaske, ba inda suka tsaya sai wata magamar hanya wadda ta kasu kashi ukku, duk da wadda suka fito ɗaya tayi gabas biyu kuma sunyi hannun haggo da dama, sai wadda suka fito tayi yamma, Sarkin yaƙi ne ya kalli wani Jarumin su Lurwan yace. 
"Kunga munzo magamar hanya ta wace hanya kuke ganin yakama ta mubi dan mu isa da wuri."?

"Ranka shidade inaga mubi ta gabas din nan kodan samun nasara kasan dakatar da Yarima Malik ba karamin abu bane a wajen mu." cewar Lurwan da yagama maganar kanshi na kallan kasa, cikin gamsuwa Sarkin yaƙi yace. "Kwarai kuwa haka za'ayi dan haka mutafi watakil mu taddasu a hanya da alama tanan sukabi duba da yanda sahun dawakai, suka wuce ta wannan hanyar."da haka suka ci gaba daba dawakan su wuta..... 


Itako Bahijja tayi gudu harta fara sikewa suma basu fasa binta ba, har suka fara hangen wani karamin kauye a gaban su, koda ta fara hangen gari bakaramin gudu ta karaba addu'a takeyi Allah yasa ta samu wajen ɓoyo dan daganin waɗan nan mutanen so suke su kasheta, tana cikin gudu taji ta banki mutun baya baya tayi zata faɗi taji an rikota da karfi sadda hankalin ta zai dawo taji an kifa mata mari a kunci, a gigice ta ɗago kai ta aza idanun ta kan wani murgujejen bakin mutun sannan ya shaƙe mata wuya da karfin tsiya haki tafara duk idanun ta sunyi waje kamar zata mutu, dai dai nan wa'anda suka biyota suka taddata zubewa sukayi ɗaya daga cikin su yace. "Gurfanai yakara girma ranka shidade kwace mana tayi da muka ɗauko ta harma cizona saida tayi kabamu ita nan mu farke ta kowa yasha daɗi dan daganin ta zatayi daɗi da yawa Oga."
sakin Bahijja yayi ranshi ɓace ya kifama shi mari cikin ɓacin rai yace. "Uwarka ce zatayi daɗi dan taɓewa har yarinya karama ta tsere maku dan kuna dakiƙai inda ta gudu fa? 
ya kuke so mugaya mata shikenan aikin da tasaka mu ya tashi a banza a wofi kenan? kana maganar hutawa da yarinya ni ban fiko san hutun ba, ba ace mu taɓata ba kawai so ake mu kasheta!"

koda Bahijja taji ance so ake a kasheta ai take ido ya sake raina fata dan tsoro baki ɗaya ko haɗe yawu takasa gadan gadan sukayo kanta,ta zille ta sake kwasa a guje wannan karon cewa abita adawo da gawar ta, kota wane hali, Baiwar Allah Bahijja harji take ganin ta na neman ɗaukewa dai dai wata bishiya ta faɗi kasa ta bige kai batasan sadda ta suma ba, suko basuji basu gani so suke su kama Bahijja. 

Shiko Yarima Haishir ji yayi yana bukatar zagayawa tashi yayi ya tafi wajen wani icce dake bayan su,  ya duƙa kenan zaiyi fitsari yaji daf daf anyo kanshi juyawar da zaiyi sai yaga maza guda ukku sunyo kan wata yarinya dake kwance magashiyan kamar marar rai da sauri ya isa wajen yana kallan fuskar ta wani irin faɗuwar gaba yaji ya riske shi ganin Bahijja a sume duk jini ya wanke mata fuska, ɗauko ta yayi yaji ance.

"Kai ɗan saurayi ina zaka kaita miya haɗaka da ita."? Shiko bai fasa tafiya ba, binshi sukayi saidai ya kusa isa inda suka yadda zango wani kato ne ya shako wuyan Yarima Haishir yakai mashi wani wawan bugu a baki take bakin shi ya fashe da jini sannan suka fara dukan shi jin yanda sukai mashi taro yasa shi aje Bahijja wadda batasan inda kanta yake ba, nan suka fara artaba da Yarima Haishir, koda hadiman shi sukaji shiru hanya sukabi suka iske ana artaba da uban gidan su take suka afka akaci gaba da fafatawa, dai dai nan Ogan su shima ya iso ya iske ana dokuwa da yaran shi ga Bahijja kwance ba rai, shima kukan kura yayi ya afka, akaci gaba da artaba da yake ance Sarkin yawa yafi Sarki haka Yarima Haishir da mutanen shi sukai masu ligib yasa aka ɗaure su akatan icce sannan ya koma wajen Bahijja yafara sa mata ruwa bayan ƴan mintoci ta farfaɗo a hankali take binsu da kallo suna ido hudu da Yarima Haishir ta ingije shi zata gudu ya riko ta duk ta ruɗe zuwa yayi yasa aka fara gana masu azaba sannan yafara tambayar s, yace.  "Miya haɗaku da Bahijja?" yanda sukaji ya kira sunan ta saida sukayi mamki shiru sukayi haka yasa akaita zanar su sannan Ogan su yace.

"Ance mu satota kuma mukasheta.!"
mamaki ya ishe zuciyar Yarima Haishir yace. "Waya saku miye hadin ku da Bahijja."?

Cikin sarkewar murya yace. "Gimbiya Yazira.!"


Koda kunnuwan Bahijja suka jiyo mata sunan gimbiya Yazira bakaramin mamaki tayi ba, cikin zuciyar ta ko cewa tayi. "Ohni Bahijja na shiga ukku n, ina ganin kaddara mina tsarema gimbiya Yazira da batasan taga ina numfashi mi nayi mata ta tsaneni har haka."? Tana cikin sakar zuci taji Yarima Haishir yace. "Duk akashe su baki ɗaya tunda basu da mutunci kafin su kashe Bahijja."

cikin sune ya ɗuri ruwa, suka fara ahi ita kanta Bahijjar bakaramin tsoro ya kamata ba, tana mamakin yanda kisan ɗan Adam ba komai bane a wajen mutanen nan, bata ida tunanin da takeyi ba taga kan wani ƙasa a ruɗe ta rushe da kuka mai tsuma zuciya saida yasa aka kashe guda biyu. 


Sannan yace abar babban dan yakaima gimbiya Yazira labari Bahijja bata mutu ba, sannan yasa akai mashi dukan mutuwa ko ɗaga hannun shi bai iyawa sannan suka koma inda suka yadda zango, itadai Bahijja a ɗarare take duk takasa sakin jikin ta dasu duk da ta taɓa ganin Yarima Haishir, shi kanshi yaga yanda Bahijja takasa sakin jikin ta sai kallan ta yakeyi, itako taki bari su haɗa ido, hutawa sukayi, Yarima Haishir ne yace "kowa yahau doki mu koma gida."

tafiya tayi riba tunda mun samu abin da mukazo nema gashi yazo hannun mu cikin sauki batareda mun sha wahala ba." koda Bahijja taji abinda Yarima Haishir yace taji guiwowin ta sunkara sarewa ashe gudun gara tayi ta faɗa gidan zago shiko Haishir isowa yayi gaban Bahijja ya mika mata ruwa a wata silka yace ta wanke fuskar ta, ansa tayi a ɗarare ta wanke fuska, murmushi ya sakar mata sannan ya nuna mata wani doki yace ta hau su tafi, girgiza mashi kai tayi sannan tace. "Nagode da kuka kwatoni hannun waɗan nan mutanen dan haka zankoma Masarauta ta inda suka ɗaukoni dan inci gaba da hidima ga uban gidana."

Wani irin bakin ciki ne ya kama Yarima Haishir cikin sanyin murya da zai ribbace ta yace. "Da kunnenki kikaji sunce gimbiya Yazira tasa akasheki ke baki tsoron kisa ne."? 

Murmushi Bahijja tayi wanda yafi kuka ciwo a cikin ranta tace, aitini aka kasheni aka rabani da iyaye na da Ya Malik dina da duk wani masoyana tuni na mutu dan ba irin azabar da Bahijja bata sani ba. 

A zahiri ko cewa tayi. "Inma kasheni tayi bakomai akan hidima na mutu karka kamanta ni baiwa ce ko bakaga kayan dake jikina ba?" Shiko ya kafeta da mayun idanun sh,ko ƙeftawa baiyi ji yake kamar yagan ta jikin shi karfin hali yayi yace. "Bakiso in maidaki Masarautar ku wajen iyayen ki."
Da sauri Bahijja tace."Eh inaso dan Allah."
yanda yaji ta anbaci sunan ubangijin ta, sai yaji wani iri saidai duk daba addinin su ɗaya ba sai yasa takoma nashi addinin, a zahiri ko cewa yayi. "Yawwa ko kefa kibiyoni muje inkai ki Wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kinasan zuwa Daborah."?  Wani irin mummunan faɗuwar gaba taji ga baki ɗaya jikin ta yai sanyi tabbas duk inda tasan sunan Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tasan shi saidai ba shakka sunan Masarautar su kenan shiru tayi daka ganta kasan tana nazari, jin antaɓta yasa taja baya ta wurga mashi wani fitinannan kallo, sai ya tsinci kanshi tai mashi kwarjini sosai, murmushi yayi yace. 

"Tunanin me kikeyi."? 
Ajiyar zuciya ta sauke a hankali sannan tace. 
"Shikenan ka tabbatar zaka taimakeni ka maidani wajen iyayena."?  Da sauri ya ɗaga mata kai alamar eh, batasan sadda tasaki wani ƙayataccen murmushi ba mai karamata kyau da kwarjini, shiko sakin baki yai  yana kallan ta, yanda yaga masifar kyawun ta yakara bayyana itako zuwa tayi wajen dokin da ya gwada mata wani bawa ya iso da sauri ya rike mata sirdi ta hau saijin dadi takeyi zata koma Masarautar su......


Haka suka kama hanya shiko saijin dadi yakeyi cikin sauki ya samu Bahijja zai kaita Masarautar su ya cika burin shi a kanta. 
itako anata ɓangaren tanajin dadi ashe Yarima Haishir yasan Masarautar su tana godema Allah da ya kawo shi ya ceceta da haka suka cigaba da tafiya cikin daji hankalin ta kwance.... 

 _Masarautar Raifasu_ 

A wajen Sarki Baidulƙais kuwa haka dogarawa suka gama zagaye kewayen Masarautar Raifasu basu ga Bahijja ba haka suka koma suka sanar dashi ba labarin Bahijj, bakaramin tashin hankali ya shiga ba, baisan sadda kwalla suka fara sintiri a saman fuskar shiba yanaji yana gani zai rasa abin hutawar shi, wadda ya dade yana mafarki tazama mamora a gareshi. 

wani irin wawan duka yakaima iska yana fidda huci tashi yayi ya shige bedroom din shi ya rufo kofa da karfin gaske a zuciyar shi kuwa wani irin wutar shi'awar Bahijja ce ta dinga azazzalar shi jiyake kamar yai tsuntsu ko yasamu Bahijja ta dawo gareshi, magana yakeyi a zuci wanda baisan tana fita ba a zahiri yace.
"Na rantse da girman takobin kakana Sarki Gursu sainayi ajalin duk wanda nakama shi da Bahijja musamman idan zargin da nikeyi ya tabbata gaskia, tabbas saina ga bayan kowaye a cikin su."
faɗawa yayi saman gado kamar karamin yaro yafara kwalla....



Suko su Bahijja tafiya tai nisa itadai batasan inda ake dosa ba saidai tasan dagani Masarautar su tana da nisan gaske, wani wajene aka tsaya dancin abinci da hutawa, itako ruwa ta bukata tayi alwalla sai kallan ta Yarima Haishir yakeyi yaga ta kabbara sallah, wani bawan shine yayi kanta da takobi zai sareta, Yarima Haishir ya banka mashi wani matsiyacin kallo, baisan sadda ya komaba, itako haka tagama sallar ta ko ajikin ta dan basuyi ba sannan yasa aka kawo mata abinci, da takici saitaji wata irin yunwa tafara addabar ta batasan sadda tafara ciba, duk da batajin dadin komai a bakin nata.... 

 _Masarautar Daborah_ 

Itako Sarauniya Zulaiƙa takai gauro takai mari tarasa yanda zatayi da ranta fatan ta Allah yasa MalikusSaif din ta,ba neman baiwa ya tafi inko har haka takasan ce tabbas ya zubda mata da girma da daraja ace ɗanta Yariman ta magajin ta ace ya ɓata lokacin shi kan neman baiwa. 
da haka taji sallamar mijin ta ya shigo amsawa tayi, wanda ya kafeta da idanu yana nazarin ta tabbas yasan matar shi tana cikin damuwa wucewa yayi ya zauna kusa da ita.  



Koda su MalikusSaif suka iso cikin garin, ba inda suka tunkara sai Masarautar Raifasu, 
ba inda suka tsaya sai wata kofa ta baya, aje dawakan su sukayi Yarima Malik ne ya kalli Huzaifa yace......

بسم الله الرحمن الر حيم



 *Wannan labarin ƙirƙirarren labari ne kamar yanda kukaji tun a Book One, banyi shi dan cin zarafin wani ba, wanda yai dai dai da rayuwar shi aimin afuwa akasine🙏* 



Episode 3&4



"Bai kamata mu shiga wannan Masarautar a sirrince ba yakama mu shiga kai tsaye girman Masarautar mu da karfin ikon mu, ya girmi ace kamar mu munaima waɗan nan kaskantattun boye ba, dan haka mukoma ta babar kofar Masarautar sai mu shiga cikin ta dan ni nan ko airai ko a mutu da haka nazo dan in fanshi Bahijja.!"

kallan shi Huzaifa yayi yana girgiza kai cikin kulawa yace.
"Yarima kenan bai kamata ace mun shiga kanmu tsaye ba karfa kamanta makiyan mune basu son mu, muma bamu son su!
mikake zatan zai faru idan muka shiga kanmu tsaye? Saidai wani hanzari ba gudu ba mi zai hana mu ɓadda kama sannan mu shiga ta babbar kofar Masarautar sannan musa ai mana iso zuwa wajen Sarki Baidulƙais kai tsaye." 


cikeda mamaki Yarima Malik yace. "Ranka shidade Huzaifa Sarkin iya bada shawara mi zamucema wannan daƙiƙin Sarkin."? Murmushi Huzaifa yayi yace. "Au lamarin ma harda zolaya, naji dai kabar komai hannuna wlh har masauki sai an bamu a cikin Raifasu daga baya sai mu ɗauko Bahijja."
shima murmushin yayi sannan yace. "Shikan Huzaifa yanda kace, haka za'ayi,saidai ka tsaya a cikin shirin kota kwana."
haka suka koma a babbar kofar Masarautar sannan suka shiga Sarkin kofa ne ya taresu yafara yimasu tambayoyi yace. "Ƴan samari daga ina harhaka."? Wani kallo MalikusSaif yai mashi ganin hakan yasa Huzaifa yai saurin cewa. "Kaimu wajen Sarkin ku."
cikeda mamaki Sarkin kofa ke kallan su tunawa yayi da gargaɗin da Sarki Baidulƙais yai mashi.  zaiyi magana kenan suka haɗa ido da Yarima Malik ba shiri ya sauke idon shi dan ba karamin kwarjini yai mashi ba,ko magana ya kasa dan ya tsorata da irin kallon da Malik yai mashi sawa yayi Sarkin gida yai masu iso, har cikin fa'da lokacin Sarki Baidulƙais yayi nisa cikin tunani ɗaga kanshi sama ko keftawa baiyi tunanin Bahijja ya cika mashi zuciya. 
Koda Sarki gida ya shigo  zubewa yayi yakai gaisuwa, wajen Sarki Baidulƙais suko su Yarima Malik suna tsaye, baki ɗaya kallo ya koma kansu ana mamakin yanda akai su basu duka ba a gaban Sarki. 
Sarkin zagi ne zai fara magana sai Baidulƙais ya ɗaga mashi hannu alamun yai shiru, sake kallan su yayi tsaf, sanye suke cikin kayan saki na alfarma dan dai kowa da kalar nashi Huzaifa  ne sanye da ash din kaya sai ya Yarima Malik yasa kaya milk and golden bakaramin kyau sukai masu ba saidai kansu kowa yasa farin rawani sun rufe rabin fuskar su saidai ana iya ganin fuskar amman ba sosai ba rabin fuskar su duk rufe yake, koda ya gama kallan su cikin gadara yace.
"Mike tafe daku kyawawan samari."?  Huzaifa ne yace. "Ranka shidade mu baki ne hanya ce ta biyo damu ta wannan gari shine muka biyo tanan dan abamu masauki mu huta kafin muci gaba da tafiya." Sake kallan su Sarki Baidulƙais yayi sannan yace. "Daga ina kuke har haka."? "Huzaifa ne ya sake magana yace."daman daga immm...da sauri Yarima Malik yace. "Daga Masarautar Ƙairu muke kannen Sarki Danwar ne mu hanya ta biyo damu nan shine mukazo dan musamu masauki." cikin gamsuwa Sarki Baidulƙais y kira Sarkin gida,  yace. "Akai su sashen Yarima Husbarulƙais dan su huta sannan a tabbatar da ankai masu duk abinda suke bukata."

Huzaifa ne yaima Sarki Baidulƙais godiya sannan suka tafi shima tashi yayi su suka wuce da Sarkin gida masaukin su, shi kuma ya tafi sashen....... 


➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A Wajen Sarkin yaƙi kuwa har sun iso wani kauye da ake kira da Tsaure inda suka yada zango suka zauna dan hutawa, baki ɗaya komai ya caɓema Sarkin yaƙi ganin duk tafiyar da sukayi basu iske Yarima Malik ba, bakaramin tashin hankali sukayi ba, a haka kowa ya zauna cikin jimami a ransu...



Washe gari da safe su Yarima Malik ne suka tash, wanka sukayi suka shirya,sunan zaune Yarima Malik ya kalli Huzaifa yace.
"Huzaifa yakamata mufita mudan mike ƙafa kilan Allah zaisa musamu damar shiga gidan kaso wajen Bahijja." 

Dan fidda iska Huzaifa yayi sannan yace. "hakane saidai bai kamata tun yanzun mufita ba za'a samana alamar tambaya, mubari sai rana ta kara dagawa......
Jin antaɓa kofa alamun an shigo yasa sukayi shiru, wai gawa Huzaifa yayi yaga. 

Jakadiya ta shigo ɗauke da kulolin abinci ita da wasu bayi, aje abinci sukayi sannan suka gaida s, suka amsa ba yabo ba fallasa.
har Jakadiya zata fita Huzaifa ya kirata zuwa tayi ta duka sannan yace. 
"Yana ga dogarawa suna ta yawo a cikin Masarautar nan meke faruwa? ko ba tsaro a cikin Masarautar nan."? 

Shiru Jakadiya tayi dan batai niyar fadan abin da ke faruwa ba, ganin Sarki Baidulƙais ya aminta dasu shiyasa tace. 

"Ranka shidade, tabbas shekaran jiya mun tashi da alhini a zukatan mu, an sace amana amintattar Baiwar mu.!"
Da sauri Yarima Malik yace. "Kamarya ansace baiwa garin ya hakan tafaru."?

Wasu kwalla ne masu zafi suka samu damar wanke ma Jakadiya fuska cikin rawar murya tace. "Suna wasa aka samu damar dauketa." hakanan yaji gaban shi ya faɗi sake cewa yayi. 

"Wasa kuma yarinya ce kenan, saidai ke daganin ke Jakadiya ce miya haɗa ki da ita."? 

Murmushi tayi ta kalli MalikusSaif sannan tace. "Ranka shidade haihuwar tane kawai banba amman kamar ƴar cikina nikejinta baiwa ce mai shiga rai da kwarjini." cikin tausayawa Malik yace "Haka abin yake babu dadi kam."
Huzaifa ne yace. "Mene sunan Baiwar kuma wane matsayi gareta da har za'a sace baiwa."? 

Shiru tayi tana tunanin ko ta fada masu ko kuma tayi shiru wata zuciyar ce tace ta fadama su ce tayi.

"Bahijja Ƴace mai karamci ga sanin yakama ta, sannan hadimar Sarki Baidulƙais ce." 

da sauri Yarima MalikusSaif ya yunkara zai mike Huzaifa ya rike mashi hannu sannan ya girgiza mashi kai, ita kanta Jakadiya kallan su kawai tayi ko ba'a ce mata komai ba taga damuwa a fuskokin su, ƙaƙaro murmushin karfin hali Malik yayi sannan yace.

"Kina ganin ba uban gidan ta yasa a ɗauke taba."
da sauri Jakadiya tace. "Aaa gaskia baida sa hann, saboda shi kanshi yana cikin tashin hankali tun ranar da aka dauketa yasa aka fara neman Bahijja saidai har yanzun ba'a ganta ba kuma ba labarin ta."da sauri Malik yace.

"Shikenan Jakadiya zamu karya kije kada uban gidan ki ya nemeki." da toh ta amsa sannan ta fita....

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A wajen Yarima Haishir kuwa har sun isa cikin Masarautar Waisu suna isa bayi da hadimai suka taro su ba inda aka wuce da Bahijja sai sashen Sarki Lahazu ita da Yarima. 
itadai Bahijja da kallo tabi mutanen dake ta dawai niya dasu, kallan Yarima Haishir tayi tanai mashi kallan tuhuma tana son tayi magana amman tana shakka, a cikin zuciyar ta kuwa sai sake sake takeyi, tace nidai gani baiwa miyasa ba za'a barni inje wajen Umma ba, shi Haishir daman yasan kowa.... 
jitayi Yarima Haishir yace. "Bahijja kici abinci sannan ki kwanta ki huta." kallan shi tayi tace. "Ranka shidade ina baiwa ina hutu, inasan inje wajen Umma ta." murmushi yayi sannan yace. "Ki bari zuwa anjima sai akira maki ita ki ganta daga baya sai ku wuce wajen ta." wani irin sanyin dadine ya kama Bahijja haka tafara cin abinci hankalin ta kwance, ba abinda ke damunta yau zataga Umman ta, koda tagama komawa tayi gefe ta zauna bacci ne ya kwashe ta, koda Yarima Haishir ya shigo cikin ɗakin da Bahijja ke bacci, zama yayi gefen ta, yana ta kallan ta kamar ya haɗeta haka yakeji ko kaftawa baiyi, gyaran muryar da  yaji ne yasa shi waigawa ganin mahaifiyar shi, tana mashi wani irin kallo a sheke, cikeda gadara tace.
"Kawani tsareta da kallo mine abin kallo wajen wannan yarinyar mai kama da aljana.?"
shidai baice komai ba, ya cigaba da kallan Bahijja, itako gimbiya Ƙamariya ta gama kulewa da karfi takaima Bahijja duka tace.
"Tashi munafuka kina baiwa zakizo ki samu waje ki kwanta tashi daga yau sashena zaki koma kinai mani hidima." a firgice ta mike tana murtsika ido ganin gimbiya Ƙamariya,yasa ta dukawa tana gaida ta, dan a tunanin ta itace Sarauniya Zulaiƙa duk da taga ta canza mata kaman ni, wani mugun kallo ta kara watsama Bahijja sannan tace. "Kika wani tsareni da mugayen idanun ki kamar na mage tashi ki fita." da sauri Bahijja ta fita falo har tuntuɓe takeyi a cikin zuciyar ta ko cewa tayi wannan wace irin kaddara ce, ina zanga Ummana!. 
wata baiwa ce tagani zata wuce da sauri taje tace. "Dan Allah inane Turakar bayi."? Mamaki ne bayyane a fuskar baiwar a fusace tace. "Kinji wata banzar magana ni zaki cema haka, nan bamu da turakar bayi, saidai sansanin bayi in nan ne muje inkai ki, a ɗarare tabi bayan ta, jin ankira sunan ta. 
hakan ya tabbatar mata mai kiran ta tasan bai wuce Yarima Haishir, tana zuwa ta zube gaban shi, tace. "Ranka shidade, kataimaka kasa akaini Wajen Umma ta, kaga nan cikin gidan Sarauta ne kada Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tasake kamani a wannan wajen."
tausayin ta yaji yace. "nan ba Masarautar Daborah bace, sannan Umman ki bata nan, dan haka kiyi hakuri ki zauna a matsayin ki na baiwar mahaifiya ta kamar yanda ta bukata, saidai ki sani na kawoki nan Masarautar dan wani buri nawa dan haka nan da wani lokaci zakisan komi."
Wani irin matsanancin faɗuwar gaba ta dirar ma Bahijja lokaci guda. 

Shiko tafiya ya fara ko a jikin shi, ji yayi tarike mashi kafa a kiɗime tace.
"Ka rufaman asiri dan Allah kada ka cutar dani ba haka mukayi da kaiba."
dukawa yayi yace.
"Ki rike addinin ki, kinga wannan Masarautar ba addinin mu ɗaya dake ba dafatan kin fahimta."? Sake fashewa da kuka tayi, ji tayi andaka mata tsawa da sauri ta mike a ruɗe gimbiya Ƙamariya ce tace.
"Ki sameni a sashen na zakiyi mani aiki." 
wucewar tayi itako Bahijja sake fashewa da kukan tayi, shima haka ya tafi yanajin dadi yau gashi ga Bahijja a cikin Masarautar Waisu.......


 *Masarautar Raifasu* 
Da marece Sarki Baidulƙais ne yazo wajen su Yarima Malik dan duba yanda suka kwana koda ya shigo iskesu yayi zaune, shima zama yayi suka gaisa sannan yace. "Bakina ya kuka kwana inafatan  baku da wata damuwa dai."?
 Lfy lau muka kwana ba abinda ke damum mu mungode da kulawa."

ɗan jinjina kai Sarki Baidulƙais yayi alamun gamsuwa sannan ya kalli Yarima Malik yayi yace. "Dan saurayi bakasan magana ne."?
Shiru Malik yayi yaki magana sai kallan shi yakeyi saida Huzaifa ya taɓo shi sannan yace. "Eh bansan hayaniya ne."
Murmushi Badulƙais yayi irin na manya har zaiyi magana sai ga Jakadiya ta shigo.
Dukawa tayi tace."Ranka shidade, Sarkin yaƙi na san ganin ka." gyaɗa mata kai yayi hakan yasa ta shigo dashi yana zuwa ya gaida su sannan yace. "Ranka shidade kaf Jaruman mu sun bin cika baki ɗaya kewayen Raifasu basu ga Bahijja ba kuma ba alamun ta." da sauri Baidulƙais ya mike duk zufa tagama wanke shi, sai zagaye yakeyi sannan yacema Sarkin yaƙi "kaje kasa Jarumai su shirya aje duk inda za'a dubo Bahijja a nemo mani ita,  kasan wacece Bahijja a wajena? na rantse da gurfanai zan iya rasa komai dan inga Bahijja ta dawo a kalkashin ikona.!"

Angama Sarki mai dole sannan ya juya da sauri ya fita, dan cika umurnin Sarki Baidulƙais , shiko Yarima Malik mamaki yakama shi yanda yaga Sarki Baidulƙais ya damu, kuma mike tsakanin shi da Bahijja? da har zai ɗaga hankalin shi dan ta ɓata! 
ban kwana Sarki Baidulƙais yai masu sannan ya fita rai ɓace.  shiko Malik magana yafara yima Huzaifa cikin fushi yace.....

Episode 5&6




"Huzaifa ya kamata mu fitoma Baidulƙais a yanda muke, mu yake shi saboda rashin kulawa a ce har ya bari aka ɗauke Bahijja.!"

"Haba Yarima bai kamata ace mun yaki Baidulƙais ba duba da shima baisan inda Bahijja take ba duk da akwai ganganci saidai kasani yakar Baidulƙais zai maida hannun agogo baya musamman a wajen Sarauniya, sannan hakan zai kara saka Bahijja cikin uƙuba da tashin hankali karfa kamanta Bahijja bata da ƴanci, abin da ya kamata shine zuwa gobe mukama hanya mutafi tunda mun tabbatar da Bahijja bata cikin wannan Masarautar,ba anfanin zaman mu daga nan sai mutafi neman Bahijja shine mafita amman kai mi kace."? 


Cikeda gamsuwa Yarima Malik yace. "nima nayi wannan tunanin dalilin da yasa kaga nikeson mu yaki Baidulƙais dan in ɗanɗana mashi kuɗar shi akan wahalar da Bahijja da yayi saidai kasani wlh kuwa inhar na cika MalikusSaif saina dawo da Bahijja hannuna a duk inda ta shiga cikin faɗin kasar Gambia, sannan da hannuna zan dirkake Baidulƙais da duk wani abun da yake taƙama dashi.!" cikeda ƙwarin guiwa Huzaifa yace. "Kwarai kuwa kayi gaskia hakan ma yayi ina goyon bayan ka ɗari bisa ɗari."


Juyowa MalikusSaif yayi yana kallan huzaifa cikeda takaici yace.  "saidai banga anfanin tafiyar muba gobe mizai hana mubar Masarautar nan yau din nan."?
"Bayin mu da aka garƙameta a cikin gidan yari fa su ba zamu  taimake suba."? Cewar Huzaifa. 
da wata irin kakkausar murya Malik yace. "Kodan su tabbas zan dawo Masarautar Raifasu in fanshe su, yanzun dai nafison inga Bahijja ta dawo a kalkashin ikona, kafin intafi zanso in sake ganawa da Jakadiya na fahimci ba abinda batasani ba akan Bahijja." 

"hakane bari insa aimaka kiranta." fitowa Huzaifa yayi wani makimancin falo ya hangi wata baiwa tana aiki, kiranta yayi sannan yasa ta kira mashi Jakadiya, tashi tayi daga dukiyar da tayi sannan ta tafi, shima komawa yayi wajen Yarima suka cigaba da shawara dan nemawa kansu mafita



Masarautar Waisu....



Bahijja ce kwance saman simintin dakin da aka bata ita da wasu bayi guda ukku, ba abinda takeyi sai tsantsar tunani da ya addabi rayuwar ta, tambayoyi tafara jefo ma, kanta tana sakar zuci, tace
Yanzun ni Bahijja daman ba wajen iyayena za'a kaini ba? Ashe wannan mugun yariman daman zalintata zaiyi? Minene ribar kawoni nan? Kuma mi zan mashi? Nashiga ukk ga uwar nan tashi wai ni zan dinga yimata hidima, yanzun shikenan ni a aikin bauta zan karata bani, nan bani can kamar wata ranwa, ya zanyi  da raina nasan ba yanda zanyi in gudu daga wannan Masarautar tabbas dana gudu....haka ta dinga sake saken zuci tana hawaye, jitayi anda fata a  firgice tadawo daga dogon tunanin da ta ninkaya, ɗago jajjayen idanun ta tayi ta aza a saman fuskar wata matashiyar baiwa, jitayi tace taje Yarima Haishir na neman ta a sashen shi, jitayi baki lakkarta ta tsinke jikinta yai masifar sanyi batasan dalili ba, tashi tayi ta fita saidai tsayawa tayi tana tunanin ta ina zata fara neman sashen Azzalumin Yarima haka taimashi laƙabi, waige waige tafara gashi ba kowa baki ɗaya wajen kuma part ukku ne tarasa wanda zata shiga, rufe ido tayi tafara addu'a sannan ta shiga Part din dake kallan ta, tafiya ta dinga yi kamar wadda kwai ya fashema wa a cikin ciki a ɗarare take koda ta shigo wani makimanci falo wanda yagaji da haduwa da kayan Sarauta, nan ta tsaya tana sakar zuci nan zata tsaya ko kuwa shiga zatayi rasa mafita tayi hakan yasa Bahijja tabi wani ɗaki da yake gefen haggun ta tana shiga taji shiru, hakan yasa ta ɗan karasa daga ciki tana magana taga Gimbiya Ƙamariyya wani mugun kallo tabi Bahijja dashi ba shiri tayi baya kiranta Gimbiya Ƙamariyya tayi sannan ta fara jefama Bahijja tambayoyi. "Mikikazo yinan? Da haka zaki fara yiman aikin? Ko kuwa harkin samu damar shigo mani ɗaki kina baiwa marar ƴanci, da gani baki da hankali.!"


A tsorace Bahijja tafara kame kame sannan ta duka kasa tace. "Ranki shidade kimin aikin afuwa, bansan nan ne ɗakin kiba, kirana akayi shiyasa nazo nan."?
Cike da gadara Gimbiya Ƙamariyya tace.
"Waya kiraki ko ance maki Gimbiya Ƙamariyya ce ta aiko akiraki ne."? Da sauri ta girgiza kai sannan tace. "Aaa ance mani Yarima ke kirana." da sauri Gimbiya Ƙamariyya ta mike jikinta na rawa tace. "Wato daga zuwanki harkin fara bibiyar rayuwar ɗana ko."? Baki ɗaya mamaki yagama kama Bahijja a zuciyarta ko cewa tayi  kamar ya bibiyar sa nike, buɗe baki tayi zatayi magana, taji Gimbiya Ƙamariyya ta wanka mata mari tace.
"Wato harma kinada ikon da zaki yiman gardama k? toh kashinki  ne zai bushe sha sha sha." itadai hawaye kawai takeyi sannan taji Gimbiya Ƙamariyya tace. "Tashi kibani waje kidawo anjima dan jin irin aikin da zaki dinga yimani.


Itako Bahijja fita tayi ta sake tsayawa farfajiyar parts  din saidai ta rasa inda zata shiga ga tsoro duk ya kamata tai zatan zata sake haduwa da wata kuma daban dan taga ƴan gidan Sarauta basu da imani da wannan tunanin ta tafi tana cewa, rana zafi inuwa ƙuna tafara tafiya kenan taji ance. "Ke ina kuma zakije da bakiyi niyar shigowa ba." tsayawa tayi taji jikinta nai mata wani irin zafi shikenan tasan ta shiga halin ha'ula'i a hankali ta juyo dan ganin mai kiranta.....


Yarima Haishir ne ya haɗe hannuwa ya kafeta da wani shu'umin kallo, maida kanta tayi ƙasa sannan ta iso wajen shi tsayawa tayi tarasa me zatace mashi, a hankali tace. "Bansan inda zan shiga bane.....katseta yayi yace. "biyoni." tsaye tayi tana bin shi da kallan tsana, waigowa yayi ya sake kallan, wani kallo ta aika mashi sannan tabi bayan shi wani ɗaki ya shiga, ita kuma ta tsaya bakin kofa yana shiga ya zaune gefen gado yana jiran shigowar ta shiru har ya fara gajiya, hakan yasa ya shiga bathroom dan watsa ruwa, har yagama ya fito, itako Bahijja da tagaji da jira juyawa tayi zata tafiyar ta.
shiko daga ya kara duba dakin bai ganta ba hakan yasa ya leka ya hango Bahijja harta kusa fita daga falon da take, wata baiwa ce yasa ta kira mashi ita, sannan ya koma cikin ɗakin shi yana tsane ruwan dake kanshi bada jimawa ba saiga Bahijja ta shigo  tsaya wa tayi bata bata da niyar zama ko dukawa, wani murmushi yayi mai ɗauke da ma'anoni iri iri sannan yace. "Ke baiwa zoki shafa mani mai." yitayi kamar bata jishi, jin yanda tayi shiru yasa shi sake yimata magana. "Bakiji me nace maki ba."? Karasowa tayi duk tsoro ya addabe ta a cikin  zuciya, muryar ta na breaking tace. "Banjiba gani." wani kallo ya bita dashi hakanan taji gabanta ya faɗi, mikomata kwallabar mai yayi yace. "Shafamani a jikina." itako kin amsa tayi tana mashi kallan tuhuma tace. "Waimi kake nufi dani kace zaka kaini wajen iyeyena, mi zaisa kasani aiki, a wane matsayi nike ciki a wannan Masarautar mikake nufi dani."?
Kallan mamki yake mata yanda take mashi magana son ranta sai kace ba baiwa ba mikewa yayi yana zagaye ta itako suman tsaye kawai tayi, bata gama tunanin da take ba taji ya salgafo mata wuya, da sauri ta banke shi ta koma baya tace.
"Kada kasake taɓamani jiki." murmushi yasa keyi  sannan yace. "Kina baiwar kuma baiwa ta ko kinsan dalilin dayasa na kwatoki daga hannun mugayen mutanen nan."? Girgiza kai tayi alamar aa, cikin jin dadi yace. "Saboda ina sonki, tunran da nafara ganin ki wajen  Sarki Baidulƙais naji na kwaɗata dake naji inason ki sance a kalkashin inuwata in ɗanɗani zumarki." wani mugun  kallo tai mashi, shi kanshi saida yaji gaban shi yafaɗi amman ya dake, cikeda karfin hali Bahijja tace. "Ina neman tsarin Allah daga kaidin ka Yarima ba abinda zaka iya yimin sannan kasani ni ban sonka dan haka ni ba baiwar ka bace ka maidani wajen iyayena ko ka maida a salin inda ka ɗauko ni, sannan na tsane ka koda hakan yana nufin ajalina.....wanka mata mari yayi cikin fushi yace. "Kina baiwa zaki gayaman waɗan nan maganganun baza ni Yarima Haishir zaki cema haka tunda nike ko gardama baiwa bata taɓa yimin ba saike! 
Dan haka kisani saina ɗanɗani zumarki, duka duka nawa kike da zaki mani gardama, in har kina son inbiki ta lalama ki tabbatar kin amince ki aureni shikenan kinga kinzama ƴantatta kuma Gimbiyar Waisu, ya kika gani baiwa ta."? 



Wasu zazzafan hawaye sukai nasarar wankema Bahijja fuska ta rasa mizata ce ma Yarima dan bata shakkar gaya mashi bakaken maganganu a cikin zuciyar ta, dan data rayu ko ta mutu duk dayane a wajen ta, tasan dai kaddara ce ta raba ta da iyayen ta da Ya Malik dinta, saidai tagaji da yawan Masarautu da takeyi a matsayin ta na baiwa marar ƴanci, tanata sake saken zuci taji Yarima Haishir ya sake rungume ta jikin shi da karfi ta ingije shi saidai duk yanda taso ta kwace kanta ta kasa, jitayi yana neman fara shafar mata jiki da karfi ta sake tureshi go gezau daman ba kaya a jikin shi, baki ɗaya jikin Bahijja ne ya ɗauki mazari ta rasa yanda zatayi da Haishir batasan ta saki wata uwar karaba shi kanshi saida ya tsorata hakan yasa ya saketa da sauri tayi waje tana kuka tarasa yanda zatayi da rayuwar ta, Jakadiya ce ta faɗo mata arai da irin huɗubar da take mata a zahiri ko cewa tayi. "Wayyo Baba Jamra inama ace kina kusa dani ina bukatarki ya zanyi miyasa duka yan Sarauta suke azzalumai masu cin zarafin mata? Miyasa Bahijja batada sa'a a rayuwa! tabbas inama ace mutuwa nayi da na huta, inama ace banzo wannan duniyar ba, wayyo Allah na kakawo mani ɗauki, tabbas Babata kin faɗi gaskia da kika fayyace mani komi akan mutunci na, shine daraja ta!
Jitayi wata baiwa ta taɓata da sauri ta waiga murmushi taimata tace. "Nabaki tsoro ko? Kije Gimbiya Ƙamariyya tana kiranki a sashen ta."
tana gama faɗa mata sakon ta tafi,itako Bahijja tsaye tayi harta manta da ta haɗu da Gimbiya Ƙamariyya goge fuskar ta tayi sannan ta kama hanyar tafiya wajen Gimbiya Ƙamariyya..... 


 *Raifasu* 
Koda kiran, bakin Sarki Baidulƙais ya riski Jakadiya, tahowa tayita samesu zaune a falo dukawa tayi ta gaishe su, Yarima Malik ne ya amsa mata a taƙaice sannan yace."Jakadiya bani labarin Bahijja da abinda kikasani dangane da Bahijja da kalar alaƙarki da ita."?
Kallan shi tayi tana nazari kuma tana bukatar ganin fuskar shi amman ba damar hakan buda baki tayi tace.....

Episode 7&8




"Bahijja haifar tane kawai banba na ɗauketa 'ya' itama ta ɗaukeni Uwa saidai baiwa ce  ga Sarki Baidulƙais, sannan kuma yarinya ce mai tarin ilimin Addinin ta duk da tana baiwa hakan baisa ta fasa gabatar da ibadun taba, takanyi a boye tun inajin haushin ta ni kaina kasancewar ba addinin mu ɗaya ba, saidai zaman da Bahijja tayi cikin wannan Masarautar har zuwa yanzun da tabarta batai zaman jin dadi ba ko kadan  kullin cikin azaba take da kalubale hakan yasa nike tausaya mata yarinya ce mai karancin shekaru bata wuce sha ukku zuwa sha huɗu amman tana da girman jiki hakan kesa anai mata kallan cikakkiyar budurwa, har mutuncin ta naimata barazana dan ma kariyar ubangiji da kulawar da Allah yasa nike mata da tuni labari ya canza, kaji labarin Bahijja."


Ajiyar zuciya Yarima Malik ya sauke ya naima Allah godiya da yakare Bahijja daga kaidin azzalumai jin yanda kowa yai shiru yana binta da kallo yasa Jakadiya ta kalli Yarima tace. "Minene haɗin ka da Bahijja?Allah yasa ba cutar da ita zakayi ba dan har nafara dana sanin gaya maka abin da nasani dangane da Bahijja.!"

 kallam kyakkyawar fuskar Malik Jakadiya takeyi ko kaftawa batayi ta rasa inda ta taɓa ganin shi bata san tace ba "tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah wanda ya tsara halittar wannan  kyakkyawan saurayi waye kai mutun ko aljan?  miyasa kadamu da tambayar Bahijja na rokeka ka fiddani cikin kokwontan da nike ciki a halin yanzun.! "
hakanan yasamu kanshi da murmusawa wanda hakan yasa Jakadiya takara gayama ubangiji tana al'ajabin irin kyawun saurayin dake gabanta 

Dan sauke sanyayyar ajiyar zuciya yayi cikin kamala yace. 
"ni mutun ne kuma nazo nan ne dan in ɗauki Bahijja, nine wanda naturo bawan da Sarkin ku, ke nema har aka kama mani sauran bayi da Bahijja suna ansar horo, a cikin gidan kaso! a takaice sunana Yarima MalikusSaif ɗa ga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa uban gidan Bahijja." suma ne kawai Jakadiya batai ba, tasan makiyin Sarki Baidulƙais ne tabbas tasan anbar baya da ƙura saidai bata da tacewa tunda tagaya mashi komai karfin hali tayi tace.

"Ranka shidade na rokeka kada ka bayyana kanka a wajen Sarki Baidulƙais akwai damuwa zai iya sawa a halaka bayin ku dake cikin Masarautar  nan.!" 

Huzaifa ne yace. "Kada kidamu Jakadiya baki cancanci haka ba a wajen Yarima Malik ba, bai zo nan bane dan niyar ɗaukar fansa ga Sarki  Baidulƙais ba, yazo dan ya dauki Bahijja, saidai hakan bazai samu ba, duba da baida masaniya akan ɓacewar ta." 


Wasu hawaye masu ɗumi sukayi nasarar saukowa a saman fuskar Jakadiya gogewa tayi  sannan taji dadin abinda Huzaifa yace,Yarima Malik ne yace.

"Naji kina ambatan addinin Bahijja minene dan gantakarki dashi."?  

Sake share kwalla tayi sannan tace. "Eh na karɓi addinin Bahijja tun tana gidan Yari, saidai kusani nabarranta  akan addinin  da uban gidana Baidulƙais keyi, kaji hadina da addinin musulunci."
wani irin tausayin Jakadiya ne yakama Malik cewa yayi. "Ki kwantar da hankalin ki Jakadiya kisani zan dawo kema kuma bazan barki ba cikin wannan kazamar Masarautar fatana ki boye addinin ki kodan tseratar da ranki da kuma darajar ki, dan haka kici gaba da addu'a yau dinnan zamu tafi domin neman Bahijja."


Cike da jindadi Jakadiya tai masu Yarima Malik godiya sannan ta tafi tana karajin kewar Bahijja a cikin zuciyar ta.... 


A wajen Jaruman Daborah kuwa sunci neman Yarima Malik har sun gaji hakan yasa Sarkin yaki yacema Lurwan zai turashi da wani bawa su shiga cikin Masarautar Raifasu kilan adace ko su Yarima Malik na nan, haka kuwa akayi tafiya sukayi dan ganema idanun su abinda suke bukatar tabbtar wa, bazasu so ace sun koma ma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ba babu wani labari mai dadi ba.

 _Masarautar Waisu_ 

Koda Bahijja ta isa wajen gimbiya Ƙamariyya isketa tayi tasha ado ta tisa kayan marmari a gaba tanaci kamar bata bukata, tana isa ta duƙa takai gaisuwa, wani irin kallon tsana ta banka ma Bahijja sannan ta watsar tace.
"Ke baiwa minene ma sunan ki."? A sanyaye tace. "Bahijja"
Cikeda gadara tace.  "koma yaya kike wannan damuwar kice, ance kinje dakin Yarima daga yau kijini da kyau  karki kuskura inkarajin anga wulgin ki a sashen Yarima kina ji dafatan kin fahimta."?
Da sauri Bahijja tace eh.  tana jin wani irin bakin ciki  a kasan zuciyar ta bata gama tunani ba, taji gimbiya Ƙamariyya nacewa akaita lambu zasuyi aiki sannan zasu wuce madafa domin aikin Abinci daga yau shine aikin ki fatan kin fahimta ko baiwa."? 

Kai ta iya ɗagawa, itako gimbiya Ƙamariyya wata irin tsawa ta da kama a. Bahijja tace. "Bakiji mi nace maki ba?"
A hankali tace."Naji ranki shidade."
A wulakance tace. 
"Kika kafe da mayun idanun ki zaki tashi kibita ko kuwa ni zan kaiki da kaina?"
Girgiza kai Bahijja tayi sannan tace. "Aaa, tuba nike!"
haka Bahijja tabi mai kula da sashen gimbiya Ƙamariyya, haka taba Bahijja aikin da Gimbiya   Ƙamariyya ta umurce ta.

〰️〰️〰️〰️

 ~DABORAH~ 

 Itako Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuwa bata da aikin daya wuce galla zama su Binta ukuba kullin saitasa an dukesu anci zarafin su,yauma haka tasa Sarkin horo yasa wani karfe ya ɗaurema Abdulmajid hannuwa  sannan aka azama shi wani katon dutsi a saman kirji, haka akaita dukan su, wai dan Yarima Malik yatafi neman Bahijja acewar ta tsafi sukai mashi  shiyasa harya tafi neman baiwa! 

ranar haka aka wuni ana ganama Abdulmajid azaba kala kala kamar ba ɗan Adam, itako Binta harta kasa ko kuka dan ba karamin jin azabar da  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tasa ake masu ba, sai gab da magariba a kasa Binta  ta koma turakar bayi, shi kuma Abdulmajid cigaba da bashi horo akayi na musamman wani matsanancin kuka ne Binta ta fashe dashi maicin rai tana ganin yanda ake wulakanta mata miji hakan yasa taji bazata iya jurewa ba, ta tafi sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa iske ta tayi zaune anata yimata fiffita, tana zuwa ta zube kasa guiwowi bibbiyu tafara bawa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa hakuri tace.

"Ranki shidade tuba muke Allah ya huci zuciyar ki, kiyafe mamu abinda mukayi maki dan Allah kimana aikin gafara wlh bamu da masaniya akan tafiyar Yarima kimana aikin rai dan Allah ki sassauta ma mijina, akan wannan hukuncin kar inrasa shi shikadai ke gareni na rokeki uwar marayu Allah yakara girma da ɗaukaka."
koda Binta tagama neman afuwa wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ka kace bada ita take ba ko kallan inda take batai ba kamar ba mutun ba haka ta watsar da Binta takai minti talatin bata ce mata komai ba, haka taita dukiya tana jiran taji abinda uwar dakin tata zatace amman shiru, kuma tanasan ta tashi saidai tana shakkun abinda zatace mata tasan hakan na iya zama laifi haka dai Binta taita tsugunno daga karshe haka Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta mike ta ƙurɓi ruwa a bakin ta, ta watsa ma Binta a saman fuskar ta, 
baiwar Allah Binta, godiya taima Sarauniya Zulaiƙa. 
Itako cikeda izza tasa kafa ta ingije Binta, ta wuce a binta tayi cikin dakin ta, itako Binta murmushi tayi maiciwo ta fita jiki sanyaye tana gayama Allah SWT kukan ta kamar yanda ta saba tana kwalla masu zafin gaske, haka ta koma turakar bayi tanaji tana gani tabar mijin ta a wulakance an ɗaure shi 

 ~RAIFASU~ 

Washe gari da safe Sarki Baidulƙais ne yazo wajen su Yarima Malik suka gaisa bayan sun gama gaisawa, Huzaifa ne yace ma Sarki Baidulƙais.  "Ranka shidade ya batun baiwar kane, an ganta."? 

Kallan shi Baidulƙais yayi yana girgiza kai sannan yace.
"Tayaya kake zatan za'aga Bahijja na tabbata ko shakka babu Sarauniya Zulaiƙa zatasa a ɗauke Bahijja tabbas na turamata sakona akan ɓatan Bahijja dan sai inda karfina ya kare akan Bahijja dan ta saɓa alkawari! ta manta da cewa  Bahijja a kalkashin ikona take, ba a kalkashin ikon taba!  dan haka yazama dole in yaki Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kodan kwato baiwata.!"


Wani matsiyacin kallo Yarima Malik ya aikama Sarki Baidulƙais, Huzaifa ne yace.
"Ni a nawa tunanin babu yanda za'ayi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta sace Bahijja kodai kanada wasu makiyan na daban ne."?


Murmushi Baidulƙais yayi, cikeda da gadara  yace. "Karshen kiyayya itace gaba dake tsakanina da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa dan haka na rantse da girman gurfanai saina shafe tarihin ta musamman ɗan ta MalikusSaif na tsane sh, ban kaunar shi da ace yanzun zanyi ido hudu dashi bako shakka saina sauke kanshi kasa.!" 

Kallan kallo aka shiga yi tsakanin Yarima Malik da Huzaifa, kowa yai shiru yana mamakin irin kalaman da Sarki Baidulƙais ke faɗa, ga tarin kiyayya nan kwance a kan fuskar shi.

Huzaifa yace. "Kaga ko na manta in gaya maka muna godiya da masauki da aka bamu yau dinnan zamu wuce,

Ba karamin mamaki Baidulƙais yayi ba, jin sunce yau zasu tafi saida ya nuna rashin jin dadin tafiyar su a zahiri.
Murmushi karfin hali yayi yace.
"Ya kamata  ko satine kuyi mani gaskia."
"karka damu zamu sake kawo maka ziyara akwai wani fatauci da zamuyi shiyasa." cewar Huzaifa, fuska sake ba yabo ba fallasa, Baidulƙais yace. 

"Bakomai saidai ina san inbaku sako ku kaima yayan ku Sarki Danwar, sannan ku gaida gida naji dadin wannan ziyara da kuka kawo mani."

"Ba komai." cewar Huzaifa. jinjina kai Sarki Baidulƙais yayi, alamun gamsuwa sannan ya fita. 
suma ida haɗa kayan su sukayi bada jimawa suka  fito dan tafiya, Sarki Baidulƙais ya aiko Jakadiya ta basu wata takarda tace Sarki yace a kaima Sarki Danwar, amsa Huzaifa yayi nan suka kara ban kwana da Jakadiya tana masu fatan alkhairi da samun nasara.
haka suka hau dawakan su suka tafi kowa da abunda yake sakawa a cikin zuciyar shi. 


Haka sukayi tafiya mai ɗanyi nisan gaske, Yarima Malik ne yace. "Ina kake tunanin zamu soma neman Bahijja."?Shiru Huzaifa yayi, yana ɗan nazari sannan yace. "Allah yataimaki magajin gobe a ganina mufara dubawa ta yankin Ƙaisu kilan a dace, tunda kaga sunfi kusa da wannan Masarautar."
haka suka dinga tafiya ba tareda Yarima Malik yace komai ba.



 Masarautar Waisu kuwa Bahijja ce suka gama aikin da gimbiya Ƙamariyya ta saka ta, tana gamawa ta tafi sansanin bayi masaukin da aka bata ita da wasu bayi zama tayi tana ta nazari, ta saka wannan ta kwance wancan ba abinda takeso irin taga ta samu damar guduwa dan bata yarda da Yarima Haishir ba ko kadan, rasa mafitar da tayi,  hakan yasa ta kwanta ta rasa mike mata dadi a rayuwar ta, bacci ne ya soma ɗibarta tana cikin bacci tayi mafarkin gata a cikin wata sahara ba kowa a wajen da alama mutanen wajen sun mutu, itama taimako take nema saiga wani saurayi saman doki da takobi a hannun shi, mika mashi hannu tayi tana cewa kataimaka mani, zuwa yayi ya kamo hannun ta ya ɗagota a bayan su kuma wasu ne saman dawakai da kibiyoyi sunata halbo masu dan dai basu samesu ba haka sukaita gudu saman doki cikin kankanin lokaci a kaimasu rina aka zagaye ko ina, can sukaji wani mutun nacewa ina zaka kaita, daga gefen su wani ya zare wuka zai kashe wannan saurayin da ya ceceta!
da sauri ta mike zaune tana karanta adduo'i a bakinta sai zufa takeyi tana yan kalle kalle bata amince da mafarki takeyi ba saida taji wata baiwa tace mata, tafito ta anshi abincin ta a madafa inda bayi ke ansar anbinci sannan ta mike jikin ta duk yai sanyi dan tsoro duk ya gama addabar  zuciyar ta. 



Yarima Haishir ne zaune a wajen mahaifin shi yana mashi maganar Bahijja, cikin kosawa Sarki Lahazu yace.
"Kaga Haishir kabar zancen wannan yarinyar karfa kaman ta baiwa ce nasa ka ɗaukota kawai dan in muzguna ma Sarki Baidulƙais badan komai ba, dan haka kabar ta tayi aikin bautar ta danshi yafi dacewa da ita"
wani irin haushin mahaifin shine ya kama shi daurewa kawai yayi yace. "Baba kaikace zaka ƴanta mani Bahijja sannan ka auramani ita, yanzun so kake inyi abinda zai kara taɓa martabar ka data wannan Masarautar."? 

Karamin tsaki Sarki Lahazu yayi yana maijin haushin maganar da danshi yaima shi,marar dadin sauraro daji a fusace yace....

Episode 9&10



"Kaje kayi abinda kake tunanin zakayi Haishir ni kuma bazan ƴanta Bahijja a halin yanzun ba sai naga yana yin tafiyar, ni nasan abinda nikeyi dan haka zaɓi ya rage gareka ko kabar Bahijja zuwa wani lokaci muga abinda zai buyo baya ko kuma kayi abinda kake tunani zakayi, saidai tabbas zaka haɗu da fushina.!"

A gadaran ce Yarima Haishir yace ma mahafin nashi.

"Nidai nagama faɗamaka abinda ke zuciya ta, ko kaɗauki mata ki ko kuma duk abinda ya faru kar kaga laifina namayi juriya dan haka kaga tafiyata."

Bai jira cewar shi ba ya kama gaban shi, wani irin bakin ciki ne ya mamaye  zuciyar Sarki Lahazu ba,  ganin yanda ɗan shi ke kumfar baki akan baiwa, girgiza kai yayi yana sake sake a cikin zuciyar shi yanda zai ɓullowa lamarin Haishir. 



A wajen gimbiya Yazira kuwa tana zaune a sashen ta tana shan lemun kankana wani bawa ne yazo yana sanar da ita zuwan wani mutun, tunda aka sanar ma gimbiya Yazira jikin ta yayi liqis alamun damuwa  a fuskar ta cikin sanyin jiki tasa aka shigo dashi kallan bayin wajen tayi kowa yabar wajen baki ɗaya ta maida kallan ta a wajen mutumin  cewa yayi. "Tuba nike uwar ɗakina tabbas rana ta ɓacewa ƴan maza an kwace Bahijja daga hannun mu sannan kuma an kashe mutane na nima saura kadan a halakani tsoro da shakka suka hana in sanar maki faruwar lamarin, tuba nike kimin aikin gafara.!"

mikewa gimbiya Yazira tayi a kiɗime ta rasa inda zata saka kanta taji dadi batasan sadda  wanke shi da mari mai raɗaɗi ba, cikin ɗaga murya tace . "harka isa ka gaya mani haka in saku aikin ku gaza ai daman sun kashe ka da kowa ya huta.!"
tana cikin magana sukaji Sarki Baidulƙais yayi gyaran murya kowa saida cikin shi  ya ɗuri ruwa tsoro ya addabi kowa,  shiru sukayi suji mi, Sarki Baidulƙais zaice masu, a hankali ya karaso zuwa inda suke yana zagaye su hannun shi goye a saman baya, danko gimbiya Yazira take tayi jiɓi fatan ta kardai ace Sarki Baidulƙais yaji abinda suke cewa yanda yaga rashin gaskia atattare dasu hakan yasa shi yin wani shu'umin murmushi sannan yace.
"Waya ɗauke Bahijja."? Daburcewa kowa yayi cikin su da sauri gimbiya Yazira tace. "Daman na aike su daji dan su sama mani maganin shawara suka haɗo da wasu samari sun ɗauko Bahijja garin taimakon ta aka kashe mashi abokai shima da kyal yasha shine yazo yana sanar mani yanzun nike cewa zanje in faɗa maka dan kaɗauki mataki.!"


Cike da rashin yarda Sarki Baidulƙais yace ma mutumin 
"katabbata sannan kasan su waye suka sace Bahijja."? 

Muryar shi na rawa alamun rashin gaskia yace. 
"Aaa saidai da ganin su sunyi kama da ƴan gidan sarauta ko shakka babu! ."


Murmushi yayi a ranshi kuwa yana cewa bakowa bane face Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuma ina zatan Yarima Malik ne ya aiko aka ɗauke Bahijja dan haka nan da kwana biyu zan haɗa gangami aje a yaki Masarautar Daborah. 


A zahiri ko bai amince da gimbiya Yazira ba, duk da baiji abinda suke cewa ba saidai yaji tace aikin da tasa su..... 
 koda yake da sannu komai zai bayyana nuna su yayi da yatsa yace. "Minene sunan ka."? Da sauri yace. "Sunana  Wadir."yace da Sarki Baidulƙais jinjina kai yayi sannan yace.
"Kasa a ranka muddin nasa meku da karya ko cin amanata na rantse da gurfanai saina halaka ka, ke kuma Yazira kinsan abinda zan iya kinsan abinda bazan iyaba kiyi fatan baki da hannu akan lamarin Bahijja duk wanda nakama da hannun shi a ciki tabbas nikaina bansan kalar hukuncin da zamma shiba kikiyaye gaba." 

Jikin ta na ɓari tace to. 

A fusace ya fita ba inda ya wuce sai fa'da yasa aka haɗa mashi taron gaggawa da yan fa'dar sa, tun kan a hallara ya kasa tsaye ya gaza zaune,  sai zagaye yakeyi ya rasa mike mashi dadi tunda Bahijja ta ɓace Baidulƙais ke cikin damuwa kullin sai yasa anje anemo Bahijja amman ba amo ba labarin ta......

➰➰➰➰➰➰➰➰➰➰➰

Suko su MalikusSaif da Huzaifa ba inda suka tsaya sai wajen wata bishiya nan  suka zauna dan hutawa  Yarima ne yace. "Huzaifa kana ganin zamu iya gano Bahijja daga nan zuwa jibi."?
"Eh insha Allahu za'a ganta ni nafi zargin ta da Masarautar Ƙaisu." shiru MalikusSaif yayi yana nazari ɗauko wasikar da Sarki Baidulƙais ya basu sukai ma Sarki Danwar yayi ya buɗe ya fara karanta ta kamar haka. 


 _Daga Sarki Baidulƙais zuwa ga Sarki Danwar ina san inyi haɗin guiwa da Masarautar ka da tawa ina fatan zaka bani aron mayaka kamar yanda muka saba a tsakanin mu dan in fuskan ci Sarauniya Zulaiƙa da jama'ar ta ina sauraran ka daga Masarautar Raifasu_


Rufe takardar Yarima Malik yayi yana yaga takardar bayan ya faɗawa Huzaifa abinda ta kunsa sannan yace. "Huzaifa tabbas koda Bahijja ta dawo garemu Ummu bazata taɓa raga mata ba, musamman yanzun da tasan natafi neman Bahijja." 

Wani irin tausayin Yarima ne ga kama Huzaifa, cikin sanyin murya yace. "kwarai kuwa Yarima ni  kaina nasan muna cikin damuwa marar iyaka fata dai Allah yasa muganta dan mu koma  da wuri kafin Sarki Baidulƙais ya ɗauki mataki akan Masarautar mu dan ahalin yanzun ita yake zargi a zahiri, kana ganin zuwan mu Masarautar Ƙaisu zai mana anfani."? 

Ajiyar zuciya mai karfi Huzaifa ya sauke yace. 
"Baida wani anfani wannan wasikar kadai ya isa ya wanke Masarautar Ƙaisu daga zargin ɗaukar Bahijja saidai mutafi Masarautar Waisu raina na bani Bahijja nacan."


"Ko miyasa?."cewar Huzaifa, murmushi Yarima yayi yace. "Ka manta da Yarima Haishir a kayi yaƙi kuma muka kama su yaga Bahijja zai iya riketa kodan ɗaukar fansa, ko kuma cima wani buri nashi na daban nasan waye Haishir shida Husbarul halin su ɗaya wannan dalilin yasa nace Bahijja tana Masarautar Waisu inaji a raina."


Cikedangamsuwa Huzaifa yace. "Nima naji na aminta da hakan saidai kana ganin zuwa Masarautar Waisu zai kaimu tsawon kwana nawa.?"
tashi Yarima Malik yayi batare da yaba Huzaifa amsaba suka hau dawakan su saida sukai tafiya mai nisa sannan ya kalli Huzaifa yace. "Idan ka ɗebe mani daga inda kai mani wannan tambayar zuwa nan zamu iya ɗaukar kwana biyu zuwa na ukku zamu isa Masarautar Waisu fata dai indace da Bahijja dan zuwa yanzun narasa gane wane irin tausayin Bahijja nikeyi minene matsayin Bahijja a gareni baiwa ta ko kuwa kanwata kuma ƴar uwata saidai na baka wannan damar da ka sama mani wannan amsar koda ba yanzun ba abokina." dariyar shakiyanci Huzaifa yaima Yarima Malik yace. "Nifa ina ganin kamar son Bahijja kakeyi." wani mugun kallo yaima Huzaifa na karaina ni baice komai ba sukaci gaba da tafiya shima Huzaifa murmushi kawai yayi ya basar yasan halin mutumin nashi komai kaɗo mashi yakeyi yanzun kuma yan miskilanci ne akanshi a kowa da abinda yake tunani da haka dai suka nemi hanyar da zata sada su da Masarautar Waisu...... 



 _Masarautar Daborah_



A wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuwa ba abinda ya sauya kullin bata da  ƙuduri daya wuce taga ta halaka Abdulmajid dan ita a ganin ta wannan gazawa ne ace kamar ita Sarauniya Zulaiƙa! ace ɗanta kuma magajin ta yaje neman baiwa, yau din ma sawa tayi a kaima Abdulmajid bugun mutuwa ko ɗaga hannun shi bai iyawa itako Binta aikin wahala tasa ta  ga zazzaɓi mai zafin gaske tanayi hakan yasa tafara amai saidai hakan baisa an ɗagama Binta ba duk tsufanta,
a wajen Ashir kuwa kullin sai ya zubda kwalla gashi duk lokacin da yai yunkurin gayama Sarauniya Zulaiƙa shine yaje Masarautar Raifasu sai ta  hana shi yin  magana yau dai  ya ɗaukar ma  kanshi alqawali koda zai rasa ranshi sai ya fidda Sarkin bayi Abdulmajid daga cikin ukubar da yake ciki shida Uwar bayi Binta da haka ya tashi ya tafi fa'da dan ganin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa inda take tattaunawa da ƴan fadar ta kan sakon da Sarki Baidulƙais ya aiko mata na artba dashi a watan gobe dan fuskan tar a bokan gaba wanda wannan  a wajen ta ba komai bane.

 _Masarautar Waisu_ 

Shiko Yarima Haishir koda ya koma dakin shi zama kawai yayi yana tunanin inda zai ɓullowa mahaifin shi wani ɓangaren na zuciyar shi na ganin  ya farma Bahijja dan biyan bukatar shi, wani kuma nace mashi kwara ka kara hakuri ka aureta zaifi saidai abinda ya sani  duk rintsi saiya biya bukatar shi akan Bahijja da wannan tunanin ya kwanta kamar mai bacci yana sake sake a cikin ranshi iri iri masu wuyar fassar. 

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿
A gidan yarin Raifasu kuwa su Tasi'u ne suke ta  karbar azaba marar kyaun gani wani waje ne  aka ware su na musamman ana gana masu azaba, tun suna ganin zasu iya ɗaukar azabar da ake masu har suka  fara saduda, ba arziki suka amsa laifin da ake tuhumar su, duk da hakan abanza a wofi ba abinda aka fasa dan gane  da azabtar dasu, danko Uwani Uwar bayi kullin sai Sarki Baidulƙais yasa an mata bulala ashirin sau biyar a rana, kullin saita ɗauki bulala ɗari kamar jakka tun ana bugun ta tana gaza wani bima har zawo take saki kuma a saka ta kwashe shi da hannun ta tanaji tana gani ta zama kaskantattar baiwa marar ƴanci a cikin bayin Masarautar Raifasu idanko ta dawo ɗakin da aka ajeta wata tsohuwar ƴar duniyar baiwace ta hana Uwani sakat ko kuka hana ta take, wani lokacin ma, haka zata zauna Uwani ta murza san ranta tanaji tana gani bata iya cewa uffan dan tsoro tagama karɓar ukuba gun Sarkin horon da Sarki Baidulƙais ya naɗa sannan inta koma makwancin katuwa ta kiɓa wani bima da Uwani take fillo in dare  yayi ta hanata bacci saidai tayi ɓarawo batare da tasani ba haka rayuwa tai tayima Uwani juyin kwaɗo daya faɗa ruwan cikin  zafi..... 


 *Daman haka duniya take in zakayi  ramin mugunta gina shi gajere gudun wata rana kaine a ciki! wannan ya tunaman makircin Galadima Hamza da yanda ta kasan ce dasu a cikin Izzah Ko Mulki masoyan Izzah Ko Mulki recall this😁lol anayi munajin nice🤣......Muje zuwa my fans yaudai tsokana nikeji 😂*


Shiko Sarki Baidulƙais har ya gama  zama da Jaruman shi yasa sunfara haɗa gan gamin yaki ba kama hannun yaro yanzun sakon Sarki Danwar yake sauraro yasan shi kadai zai iya taimaka mashi tunda Sarki Lahazu sun samu saɓanin ra'ayi da shi, yasan haushin shi yake ji dan ya hana ɗanshi Yarima Haishir, auren Baiwar shi Bahijja. 



Danko Sarkin Yaƙi ba inda sukaci burki sai wajen bishiyar dasu Huzaifa suka yada zango, zama suma sukayi dan hutawa kasancewar inuwar nada sanyi sosai shiyasa matafiya ke yada zango kafin suci gaba da tafiya, suna cikin magana Sarkin Yaƙi yaga takardar ƙasa da alama yaga ta  akayi sawa yayi aka tattaro ta aka haɗata sannan suka karanta duk da bakomai suka gane ba saidai sunga ansa hadin guiwa dan yaƙar Sarauniya Zulaiƙa a watan gobe hakan ba karamin ɗaga masu Lurwan hankali yaiba, sake duba takardar Sarkin Yaƙi yayi yaga ansa zuwa ga Masarautar Ƙaisu, tashi yayi yace. 
"Inasa ran Yarima Malik yana Masarautar Ƙaisu dan ɗauko Bahijja tunda kunga bata Masarautar Raifasu dan hka kungama alamun sahun dawakan su nan ku tashi bayan su, amman mubi kudu ita zata sa damu da Masarautar Ƙaisu daga nan sai mucimma Yarima Malik ko ya kuka gani."
kowa ya gamsu da maganar Sarkin Yaƙi haka suka kama hanyar zuwa Masarautar Ƙaisu sun san kilan su dace a wannan karon..... 

 ```Nikam da nace iska na wahalar da mai kayan kara ko za'a hade tsakanin su Yarima Malik da Sarkin Yaƙi?``` 

A wajen Bahijja kuwa tana wajen gimbiya Ƙamariyya tanai mata aiki, shara da gyaran daki sai sanwa da take zuwa madafa anayi da ita saidai kullin fatan ta samu hanyar da zata bar  Masarautar Waisu takeyi saidai Yarima Haishir ya saka mata ido ko motsi tayi akan idan shi takeyin shi.

 *Masarautar Daborah* 

Koda Ashir ya isa fa'da dukawa yayi yakai gaisuwa wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, Sarkin Zagi ne yace an gaisheka amintaccen bawa duk da ba a fiye yarda daku ba amman kai din ba laifi,  Ashir mike tafe da kai  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta amsa."


Dukar da kai yayi ya rasa ta ina zai fara ga shi zuciyar shi tafara halbawa da sauri da sauri yasan muddin ya faɗi shine yaje Masarautar Raifasu ya tabbata Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tana iya sawa a kashe shi  sai dai baida wani zaɓi daya wuce ya faɗi gaskia koda kuwa zai rasa ranshi, yasan kin faɗar zai kwashi hakkin a'lumma da yawa, gashi ya baro su Tasi'u a Raifasu suna karɓar a zaba da ukuba, duk a sanadiyar zuwan shi, nan kum ya jefa iyayen Bahijja cikin tashin hankali.....bai ida tunanin da yake ba yaji Sarkin Zagi ya sake daka mashi tsawa yace. "Kai bawa idan baka da abin cewa zaka iya tafiya wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ba wajen wasan yaro bane jaruman ma sai wanda ya shirya!"


Dakewa Ashir yayi ya kalli Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yaga sai kaɗa kafa takeyi ko kallon  shi batayi ga fuskanta ba alamun wasa ko sassauci a tattare da ita, sake sadda kanshi yayi yace. "Tuba nike aimin aikin gafara Allah yataimaki Sarauniya, tabbas ba wanda yaje ɗauko Bahijja a Masarautar Raifasu  face ni, nine naje da kaina  ɗauko ta.!"
duk wanda ke cikin fa'da sai da  ya tsorata da jin kalaman Ashir, cikin damuwa Sarkin Zagi yace. "Kai Ashiru ka duba da kyau karka bari tausayin bawa Abdulmajid yasa kasa kanka cikin damuwada bala'i, ka tabbata kasan abinda kake faɗa? nan fa fa'da ce kuma a gaban Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kake.?" 

Murmushi mai ciwo Ashir yayi yace. 
"tabbas ni Ashir nine naje da kaina Masarautar Raifasu dan ganin in Bahijja....... bai karasa sauran maganar shi ba yaji an sharara mashi mari har saida bakin shi ya fashe da jini take ya faɗi kasa ɗago kanshi yayi a firgice ya aza idanun shi akan wanda ya mareshi duk tsoro ya gama cika mashi zuciya  cikin tashin hankali jikin shi na kyarma yace.....

Episode 11&12

"Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce ranta duk yagama ɓaci jin abinda Ashir ke cewa cikin fushi tace.

"Banyi zaton haka daga gareka ba, banyi tsammanin dakai za'aci amana taba, kaine kabada gudun muwa wajen saka ɗana ya tafi neman baiwa, gantalalla marar ƴanci to kasani yau sai kaga ne kuran ka saika ɗanɗani kudar ka tunda bakada tunani!  Sarkin gida kiramani Sarkin horo yanzun nan.!" 

"Angama ranki shidade Allah ya baki nasara."
da sauri Sarkin gida ya tafi aiken da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tai mashi, bai jimaba suka shigo atare da Sarkin horo, baki ɗayan su suka zube ƙasa suka kai gaisuwa wajen  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa. 

Mikewa tayi tana zagaye su, sai dukan hannun ta takeyi takasa ko zama tsabar bacin rai da bakin ciki, da wat irin kakkau sar murya tace.
"Minene hukuncin bawan da yaci amanar Masarautar su."? Muryar shi na rawa yace. "Kisa shine yadace dashi ranki shidade." Murmushi tayi cikeda zalinci tace. "Kaje kaita dukansa har saiya wulakan ta ya gama shan ukubar duniya daga baya saika halaka shi kaga koba komai zai tafi  ƙiyama cikin bakin ciki da tarin nadama a cikin zuciyar shi, wannan shine saka makom bayi azzalumai mararsa imani kuma maciya amana.!"

Angama ranki shidade haka Sarkin horo,  ya tisa keyar Ashir suka fita, zuwa wajen bada horo, shiko Ashir  sai kwalla yakeyi yana neman ɗauki wajen Allah, ita ko ajikin ta antsikari ƙaƙƙausa, har sun kusa fita fa'da ta kira Sarkin horo da gudu ya karaso, ya duka ta sake cewa ka kai shi cikin turakar bayi ka wulakanta shi na tsawon satin ɗaya sannan ka kai shi cikin gidan kaso na tsawon wata ɗaya kana gana mashi azaba, daga karshe a soke zuciyar ja'iri da mashi sannan kaimashi gunduwa gunduwa a gaban iyayen shi, kaga ko ahaka ya tafi tabbas zai tafi da bakin ciki a cikin zuciyar shi tareda tarin nadama daga baya bakin cikine zaiyi ajalin iyayen shi natsani bayi ban kaunar su ban tausayin su, kuma ba ragi ko raguwa a tsakanina dasu saboda mayaudara ne kuma maciya amana ne yau gashi anwayi gari ɗana mafi soyuwa a cikin zuciyata ya tafi ɗauko baiwa wulakantatta marar ƴanci yana magaji na ya tabbata dole Abdulmajid da Binta sai sun ɗandani kudar su inama su aka kama da wannan laifin, kash duk da haka sai naga karshen duk wani azzalumai kuma maciya amana a cikin bayin Daborah, wuce dashi kasa Sarkin bulala na gidan yarin Fatur da sauran mahukunta suita dukan shi shida Abdulmajid inasan kafin nan da faɗuwar rana a nakasa shi.!"
waziri ne ya girgiza kai yana mai mamakin yanda kiyayyar bayi ke ɗawainiya da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa zuwa yanzun ya tabbatar da kara nun kuwa  a cikin zuciyar ta, Sarkin horo ne yace. "Angama ranki shidade tun a fa'da ya fara halba Ashir yana dukan shi yana cin zarafin shi har suka isa cikin turakar bayi yafara hukunta Ashir.......



Akwana atashi a sarar mai rai, tafiya tai masu Malik nisan gaske dan suna sa rai gobe da marece zasu isa cikin Masarautar Waisu haka sukaci gaba da tafiya cikin dajin Allah.... 


Itako Bahijja tun da gari ya waye take aiki har marece data gama wannan ake kara mata wani tana cikin aiki kiran Yarima Haishir ya sameta a gajiye ta mike ta tafi lambu inda yake shaka tawa tana zuwa ta iske shi sai cika yake yana batsewa ganin yanda bayi ke ta ɗawainiya da uban gidan nasu abin ne ya bata mamaki aranta ko cewa tayi Allah ya tsareni inma wannan wawan Yariman wannan wahalar na tsaneka ashe kaima azzalumi ne kuma mayaudari, wasu kwalla masu dumi sukayi nasarar wankema ta fuska. 
Batayi aune ba jita ana gogemata fuskar da hankicif da sauri ta buge hannun shi duk bayin dake wajen nan saida suka tsorata.
Kallan daYarima Haishir yai masu yasa  kowa barin wajen, gaban Bahijja ne ya shiga dukan goma goma tasan ba mutucin ya cika ba Allah yasa kada yai yunkurin taɓata bata gama addu'ar zuci ba taji ya cafkota ta faɗo jikin shi yana kokarin yaga mata sutura kwarara ihu tayi taga ba wanda ya damu daya kawo mata taimako da karfi ta ingije Yarima Haishir amman kamar wani dutse take ban kewa, saka kuka tayi mai tsuma zuciya tana kiran Umma ki taimaka mani ganin yafara sunsinar wuyanta yana san cafke libs dinta, ta bugar mashi gefen kunne da karfi bai san sadda ya saketa ba.  zata gudu ya taɗeta ta faɗi cikin fushi ya mike ya fara dukan ta yana cewa. 
Wacece ke, kina baiwa ƴar bayi ki nemi wulakanta ni." itako duk ta ruɗe batasan tafara maida mashi bakaken maganganu ba.
"Ni bakowa bace face baiwar Allah ni ba baiwar kaba ce, kuma kasani insha Allah bazaka taɓa narasa akaina ba, kasani akan mutucina saidai ka kasheni, kuma naji ni baiwace ƴar bayi kabari ɗan bayi irina ya nemi ƴar uwar sa baiwa! kai ɗan Sarki jikan Sarki magajin Sarki kaje kanemi ƴar Sarki jikar Sarki irinka badai Bahijja ba wlh nafi karfin ka,  Yarima kazalince ni kaci amanata wlh na tsaneka.!"
baki ɗaya ran Yarima Haishir ya gama ɓaci tunda yake yarinya nawa ya lalata har dadi sukeji idan ya haɗa jiki dasu sai wannan banzar baiwar zata gaya mashi ban zayen maganganu koda take takamar ba ainahin baiwar Masarautar su bace ai yanada iko akanta inda shiya ɗaukota da kanshi, cikin zafi yasa hannu ya wanke ta da mummunan mari saida ta faɗi kasa dan azaba amman takiyin kuka, sawa yayi aka kira mashi Sarkin bulala yasa shi ya duke Bahijja haka aka fara dukan ta kamar jaka, shiko sakai yayi ya tafiyar shi ranshi nai mashi kuna ba abinda yake so yakasan ce da shi sama d Bahijja ga wani shi'awar ta yanaji kuma ya ɗaukarma ranshi saiya zama namiji na farko da zai fara saninta a duniya dan da gani tanada kamun kai, da wannan tunanin ya shiga cikin bathroom yafara wanka yana huci kamar zuciyar shi zata faɗo ga magan ganun Bahijja nai mashi yawo a kwakwalwa ba kamar yanda take cewa ta tsane shi bata kaunar shi, tsabar bacin rai baisan ya fara buga kanshi a bango ba faɗuwa yayi kasa sai ya fashe da kuka mai cin rai wai shi mace zata sosama rai ta wulakanta kamar haka!?  shikuma yanzun yafara sa kafar bakan tama Bahijja a cikin Masarautar Waisu.... 


 ```Niko dai nace ikon Allah wannan wane irin bala'i ne gaskia Bahijja kinga takanki ga abinda Yarima Haishir ya faɗa bari muga zai iya cimma burin shi akan ki kuwa?Allah masani, muje zuwa my fans inayin kufa🤝🏻```


Shiko Sarkin bulala yana cikin dukan Bahijja taga dukan yai mata yawa daman gata Sarkin tsoron duka batasan sadda ta mike ba ta rike bulala ba cikin fushi tace.
''Dakata karka sake dukana minai maku ne waiku wa'anne kalar azzalumai ne baku da imani ne, ka kara dukana wlh saina baka mamaki sakarai dakai kaje gun uban gidan naka kace shi miya hanashi hukunta Bahijja da kanshi saikai wahalalle kai kanka baka wuce a wulakanta kaba amman kakecin zarafin wani."
Galala tabar Sarkin bulala tsaye yana mamakin kalar taurin zuciya irin tata, dan zuwa yanzun zuciyar Bahijja tagama bushewa bataki ta mutu ba ko kuma ta rayu tayi alkawali duk wanda yake neman kasara mata rayuwa tabbas zata wulakanta shi koma waye a cikin Masarautar Waisu ta fahimci basu da imani, lokacin da Sarkin bulala mamaki ya gama kashe shi na wannan baiwa mai masifar tsiya ya dubata dan cigaba da dukanta yaga bata nan baisan ya bita ba, da gudu dan ya iske ta dai dai wajen sashen gimbiya Ƙamariyya ya isketa tana tafiya,  jitayi an zabga mata bulala har cikin kanta taji dukan ta tana waigowa taga mai dukan ta, batasan ta duka ba, warto katon dutsi tayi ta ɓaurama shi a saman kai take kan Sarkin bulala ya fashe dai dai nan gimbiya Ƙamariyya ta fito daga sashen ta zataje wajen Yarima, dandazon mutane tagani kiran wata baiwa tayi ta tambayeta ba'asi ta fada mata abinda ke faruwa. 
isa tayi wajen itako Bahijja ganin jini na zuba a fuskar Sarkin bulala take ta ruɗe tasan shikenan kwanan ta yakare ba tareda ta kara kallan Umman taba, Jakadiya ce tafado mata arai inda take cemata Bahijja kefa baiwa ce dole zaki ɗauki hakuri wajen bauta a duk inda kika samu kanki baki da wani zaɓi....gani tayi duk bayin dake wajen sun zube kasa suna ƙarɓar gaisuwa itako takasa ko dukawa dan tsoro, itako gimbiya Ƙamariyya  idanunta ne suka sauka kan Sarkin bulala sannan ta kalli Bahijja, cikeda mamaki tace. "Ke baiwa kece kika aikata wannan aikin."?
Cikin dakewa Bahijja tace. "Ranki shidade bansan sadda na aikata hakan akan shi ba."sawa tayi kowa yabar wajen sannan ta kirasu zuwa sashen Yarima Haishir a falo ta zauna nan Bahijja ta duka cikin fushi gimbiya Ƙamariyya ta mari Bahijja tace. "Kina baiwa zakima Sarkin bulala haka ko kinsan ba karamin musiba kisa saka kanki a ciki ba."? jin abinda gimbiya Ƙamariyya tace ya karama Bahijja kwarin guiwa tace. "Ranki shidade Bahijja baiwa ce wadda take kalkashin ikon wata Masarautar dan haka a halin yanzun Bahijja ba tada zaɓi tsakanin rayuwa da mutuwa! rabon Bahijja da farin ciki kilan tun ban wuce ƴar shekara biyar ba karfa ki manta ni baiwa ce ina baiwa inani ina jin dadi.?"
jitayi kanta yai mugun saramta, a zuciyar gimbiya Ƙamariyya kuwa cewa tayi, anya wannan yarinyar ba aljana bace ganin ko ajikin ta, sawa tayi aka kira mata wawan Sarki tasa yafara dukan Bahijja jin ihu yasa Yarima Haishir fitowa ganin abinda ke faruwa yasan saida yasa kowa ya bar part din shi, isowa yai wajen mahaifiyar tashi ganin tafara tambayar ta dalilin fasama Sarkin bulala kai, da sauri yace.
"Ninasa ya duketa, kibar komai hannuna Umma, kallan wawan Sarki yayi yace ya tafi, zama yayi ya  kalli Bahijja ganin yanda idanunta suka sauya ita kallan kaskanci tai mashi taki sauke idanta akan shi, shine ya kauda nashi idon, sannan  yace ma Sarkin bulala ya tafi zai neme shi, sannan kuma da kanshi zai hukunta Bahijja, haka Sarkin bulala ya tafi jiki ba kwari yana shakkar Bahijja a zuciyar shi, yana cewa kodai aljana ce wannan yarinya daman kyaunta yayi yawa kilama gamo nayi a lambu ba ainahin baiwa bace. 
itako gimbiya Ƙamariyya sawa tayi Bahijja ta tafi sai anmeta haka ta tafi duk jikin ta nai mata zafi.........


Washe gari da safe mutanen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ne suka isa Masarautar Ƙaisu, haka Sarkin yaki da Lurwan suka yi basaja suka shiga cikin Masarautar suna neman Yarima Malik da Huzaifa saida suka yini cur ba alamun su hakan yasa suka tafi suma dan kaima ƴan uwan su sako, koda suka koma zama sukayi suka huta har marece, Sarkin Yaƙi ne yace masu Lurwan su shirya su koma Daborah dan sanarma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, sungaza wajen nemo Yarima Malik haka akayi kuwa washe gari da asuba sunayin sallah suka kama gaban su dan komawa Masarautar su.... 

*************************

Itako Bahijja baccinta kawai take kwas, uwar bayin Masarautar ce tazo ta kirata binta tayi har sashen Sarki Lahazu, karon farko kenan d Bahijja taga Sarki gab da ita a cikin Masarautar Waisu, dukawa tayi ta gaida  shi kallan ta yake yana aiyana abubuwa a zuciyar shi cewa yayi. "Baiwa a garin yaya kika jima Sarkin bulala ciwon irin wannan."?
Muryar Bahijja na rawa tace. "Ranka shidade so yake ya kasheni kuma ba abinda nayi tuba nike." 
Juyawa yayi ya kalli Sarkin bulala yace.  "hakan.?" da eh ya amsa yace. "Yarima ne ya bani izini."shiru Sarki yayi sannan yace ma Sarkin bulala ya basu waje, godiya yayi sannan ya fita.
Sake kallan Bahijja yayi yace"agarin yaya''!?sadda kanta tayi kasa sannan tace. "Tabbas kalamai na girmi bakin Bahijja a matsayina na baiwa indan gata Yarima da wannan maganar saidai ba yanda na iya."
Cikeda  kwarin guiwa yace. "Faɗi koma mene."
cewa tayi.
 L"Ranka shidade so yake yaketa mani haddi shiyasa ni kuma naki yarda wannan shine dalili." 
Murmushi kawai yayi yace a zuciyar shi wato ni Yarima zai cima  mutunci kenan ni zai wulakanta ashe da gaske  yake nida shi muzuba mugani! 
A zahiri kuwa kallan ta yayi yace. "Baiwa da ace zamu biyema kyaun ki da son zuciya, nikaina uban Haishir zan iya neman ki, sannan idan aka biyema Masarautar da kika fito ko dan Sarauniyar ki zamu iya halaka ki, saidai a halin yanxun nafison ki rayu ko dan wani dalili saidai ban hanaki kare mutucin kiba, zaki iya tafiya."
magana Bahijja zatayi  Sarki Lahazu ya hanata ta hanyar ɗaga mata hannu sannan ya nuna mata hanya tanaji tana gani ta tafi, a bakin hanya ta iske Sarkin bulala kallan banza tai mashi sannan ta tafi shima yana ganin hakan ya tafi ranshi ba dadi tana zuwa dakin su kwantawa tayi ta saki kuka mai sosa rai tana mamakin irin halin Masarautar ta da Sarauniyar su, kumi Daborah ta kunsa da yasa ba'a ganin bayin Masarautar da kima share kwalla tayi ta tashi tafara sallah tana kai kukan ta wajen Allah

Episode 13&14




 ~_Masarautar Daborah_~


Binta ce a  sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tana aikacen aikacen ta kamar yanda ta saba shekara da shekaru yauma haka tai mata komai sannn ta koma gefe tana jiran isowar uwar ɗakin tata, takai minti talatin sannan Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta fito daga cikin ɗakin ta, tana fitowa da sauri Binta ta kwanta flat haka Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tabi ta kanta ta wuce har ta isa mazaunin ta, haka Binta ta sake tashi ta iske Sarauniya Zulaiƙa inda take zaune, gaban ta tasake dukawa tayi zaman rakuma haka Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta ɗaura kafufuwan a saman kafaɗar Binta, a sheke ta kalleta tace. "Baiwa uwar bayi ko mijin naki ya mutu."?
Wani irin faɗuwar faba ya kama Binta dan rabon da abar mijin ta ya kwana gida harta manta karfin hali tayi tace. "Aaa ranki shidade saidai banda wannan masaniyar, ina rokon ki da kitaimaka mani, kisa abar Abdulmajid yana kwana gida ko sau ɗayane a sati in kikaiman hakan zan rage raɗadin da zuciyata kemani, na rokeki uwar gijiya ta.!"


Murmushin jin dadi tayi dan tai zatan, hakan tanasan duk wani farin ciki ya rabu da rayuwar Binta harta mutu dan ta tsani zuri'arsu musamman ƴarsu, kuma yanzun ta huta da ƙuda fatan ta kada MalikusSaif yasamu nasarar karɓo Bahijja, sake kallan Binta tayi cikin mugun ta tace. 

"Hakan ba abin damuwa bane Baiwa ɗiyar bayi jikar bayi uwar bayi, gaskia kin yi sa'a ku kuma haka zaku karata a bauta kenan? ɗan karamin tsoki taja sannan tace. Zaki iya zuwa madafa dan kawo mani abinci na fatan dai kinsa anyi mai dadi." da eh Binta ta amsa haka ta tafi madafa bata jima ba ta dawo da abinci a hannun ta ita da wasu bayi duk suka aje gaida Sarauniya sukayi sannan suka fita, haka Binta ta zauna gefen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta zuba mata abinci ji take kamar ta faɗa a cikin abincin raban da taci abinci yau kwana ukku kenan saidai ruwa su Mairo ke sammata a abinci idan sun anso a madafa shima ɗan kadan wani bima saidai ta kaima Abdulmajid ita kuma ta kwana da yunwa, tunda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta ɗauki cokali yawun ta ke gudawa itako Binta ta gama shagala da kallan abincin , Sarauniya Zulaiƙa na ankare da Binta kuma tasan tana bala'in shi'awar abincin saida tabari tayi nisa akan kallan abincin duk da shi Binta ke kallo amman hankalin ta nakan mijin ta tasan tabbas yafita bukatar abincin. 
 bata gama tunanin da takeyi ba taji ansheka mata wani abu mai zafi a jikin ta da sauri Binta ta mike tsaye sai kyarma takeyi baki ɗaya abincin da tazuba ma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ne ta watsa mata ajiki har saida hannun ta ya ƙone gashi harda miya a cikin abincin sake dukawa Binta tayi ta sadda kanta ƙasa tana hawaye masu ciwo ga zafi ya isheta duk ta ƙone amman haka ta dinga ba Sarauniya Zulaiƙa hakuri kamar wata uwar ta cewa tayi.
"Yiman shiru mayya ƴar mayu kinzo kin tsareni da mugayen idanun ki so kike in kware kenan ko."?  girgiza kai Binta ta shigayi cikin sarkewar murya tace. "Aaaa bahaka bane bansan ina kallanki ba ranki shidade tuba nikeyi uwar marayu ki taimaka ki ƴan tani a cikin amintattun bayin ki zuwa yanzun kimin aikin gafara na tuba."
Sake daka mata tsawa tayi tace. "Keda samun ƴanci sai a lahira idan anayi ke harkin isa ki zama amintattar baiwa bayan kunyi gadon cin amana, ɓaceman dagani, kuma nan da minti talatin ki maida hankali ki dawo aikin ki kwashe kwanukan kije ki cinye mayya kawai jikar mayu."haka Binta tagama gyara wajen sannan ta fita da kwanukan madafa taje takai su, uwar tuwo ce takira Binta tace tasamu leda ta juye ta tafi dasu, da tace aaa bata so haka ta matsa mata sabida bala'in tausan Binta takeji haka ta tafi ba inda ta wuce sai wajen mijin ta, ta bashi abinci yaci kamar mayunwaci yake cin shi itadai ta ɗaukar ma ranta koda yunwa zatayi ajalin ta bazata ci wannan girkin ba sabida akan shine akaci mutuncin ta kuma tasan idan ta gayama Abdulmajid abinda ya faru ya fita zuciya, shima bazai ciba, amma batasan yunwa ta nakasa mata miji daman kullin cikin ukuba yake da haka tai mashi sallama ta koma wajen ƴan uwanta bayi ta kwanta kafin ta koma aiki tana kwance tafara tunani zuwa can Bacci ya kwashe Binta, koda Mairo ta shigo da ɗaurin fanke da aka raba masu zama tayi tana jiran Binta ta shi dan suci tasan bataci abinci ba gani tayi Binta ta tashi a firgice alamun tsoro atare da ita riketa Mairo tayi cikin tsoro tafara tambayar ta ko lafiya.?


Sai fidda jiɓi takeyi a hankali tafara gane Mairo numfasawa tayi sannan tace. "Mairo wani ne zai ketama ƴata Bahijja haddi sai cewa takeyi intai maka mata dan Allah Mairo kisama  mani hanyar da zan gudu dan inceci rayuwar ƴata Bahijja.!"
"haba kefa uwace ga kowa kuma kinsan mafarki kinsan zahiri dan Allah kada kisaka kanki a damuwa mana." hawaye ta goge ta kalli Mairo tace. "Kayya kayya Mairo tunda na rabu da Bahijja banta ɓata mafarkin taba sai wannan lokaci inajin tsoro." duk da itama a tsorace take sai tayi tunanin kwantarma da ƴar uwarta da hankali tace. " kibar faɗar haka Allah natare da Bahijja duk runtsi kuma ba abnda zai taɓa mutuncin ta sannan karki manta mufa bayi ba taimakon da zamu iya yima Bahijja face addua." cikin gamsuwa tace hakane Mairo saidai ki sani mutuncin Bahijja shikadai ne gatanta kuma shine ya rage a tare da ita ga zafin bauta kuma ga ba daraja dukan zaima Bahijja yawa fata dai Allah ya tsareta daga kowane sharri" da Ameen Mairo ta amsa sannan ta tisata sukaci fanke da kunu ji sukayi ana buga karaurawa alamun akoma bakin bauta, gaban tane ya faɗi tasan Allah ne kadai xai fidda ta wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa saboda ta makara sosai haka ta mike kowa yatafi wajen aikin shi......

A wajen su Yarima MalikusSaif kuwa har sun shigo yankin Waisu yanzun Masarautar suka tunkara sai jin dadi yakeyi yanaji ajikin shi tabbas zai dace da Bahijja, itako Bahijja zuwa yanzun tazama ƴar gari a cikin Waisu kusan kwanan ta goma duk wanda yai mata saita rama daga Sarki sai gimbiya Ƙamariyya ne kadai batai mawa danko Yarima Haishir tunda ta fahimci manufar shi akanta bata ganin girman shi ko kadan haka take mashi rashin kunya iya son ranta tareda da barazana zuwa yanzun ya daina neman keta mata haddi saidai ya mameta ya rugumeta ta baya haka yake mata idan ta zille ta wurga mashi harara da tsoki tace mayaudari, yau tagama gyaran dakin gimbiya Ƙamariyya kamar yanda tasaba, taji mutun ya bankata saman gado yabi yaimata ruf da ciki yana neman fara lalubarta aida sauri da zille tace. "Waikai wane kalar wawane baka da hankali ne bakasan ciwon kanka dagani ko a cikin addinin naku kai jahiline....
Baisan ya wanketa da maruka ba har ukku saida ta fasa kara dai dai gimbiya Ƙamariyya ta shigo, ta dawo daga wajen mijinta da sauri ta karaso yana shirin kwaɓe kaya zai keta Bahijja yaga ta rashin kunya ya nuna mata karshen jahilci da sauri gimbiya Ƙamariyya ta iso tafara mashi faɗa tana cewa. "Bakada hankali a dakin uwar taka zakayi zina da Baiwa koma mi taimaka saika hukun tata." a fusace yace. "Na rantse da gamji ko agabanki ne ba abnda bazan iya aikatawa balle a dakin ki dan haka nasan abnda zan mata haka yaja Bahijja da kanshi yai mata dukan kawo wuka har saida  ta daina motsi sannan yasa aka kaita wani ɗaki a sashen shi yasa mai kula da wajen yace sai tayi  kwana ukku sannan kuma kullin ka fiddota ta gyaraman sashena ita kadai haka kuwa akayi aka rufe Bahijja a cikin shi batama sani ba saida ta falko ta ganta a cikin shi itako tasa kama ranta saita ɗauki fansa wajen Yarima Haishir


~_Masarautar Raifasu_~


Jakadiya ce a dakinta tagama ibada iyakar abinda taga Bahijja nayi wata baiwa ce tazo kirant, tsayawa tayi tana mamakin abinda taga Jakadiya nayi duk da bata gama yarda d hakan ba koda tayi gyaran murya, saida ta shafa sannan ta mike tace. "Lafiya yan mata."? Cikin daburcewar murya tace. "Sarki ke nemanki ranki shidade"tare suka isa zuwa wajen Sarki Baidulƙais tana isa ta duka cikin kulawa yace. "Jamra mikeke boyewa a ranki naga kin sauya ba kamar daba kinzama sabuwa agreni kina kamewa daga komai namu harma da al'adun mu, anya Jamra baki tareda da lamari mai girman gaske.?"
da aaa ta amsa mashi sai cewa tayi batajin dadi ne kwana biyu, bai matsa mata daman shi bai cika san takura ba akan sanin abinda mutun ke ciki da toh ya bita sannan ya sata kawo mashi abinci....wannan kenan. 

 _Daborah_ 

Yauma kamar kullin Abdulmajid ne a kema azaba tafi ta kullin ga ƙishi yana ji amman an hanashi ruwa, hakan yasa Binta tazo ganin mijinta, taga yafara kakkafewa ai batasan taba mijin nata ruwa ba, ranar saida Binta tasha duka kamar ganga ranar itama a ɗaure ta kwana suna shan uban sanyi ga azaba, shiko Ashir azaba tasa harya fara sauya kamanni dan wahala kullun sai an duke shi banda wahalhalu nabdaban da ake mashi 


 ~Allah Sarkin dadi duniya kenan zalinci dai ba abun yibane Allah yasa mudace~


Yarima Haishir ne yasa aka fiddo mashi da Bahijja a cikin ɗakin da yasa aka rufeta,fiddo mashi ita akayi yasa aka bugeta sannan aka maidata cikin ɗakin nan itako bata fasa gaya mashi abinda taga damaba,ran shine yakara ɓaci, musamman da takara cema shi jahili.  A fusace yace ma mai kula da Bahijja karya kara bata abinci a halin yanzun,  wani irin bakin ciki ne ya takore Bahijja a ƙahon zuciya batasan tafara kwallan bakin ciki ba....
