''gurfanai ya kara maka girma duk abinda ya kamata za'ayi fata dai  mu samu nasara akan abokan gaba." haka yasa sallami Sarkin Yaki ya tafi dan isar da sakon Sarki Baidulƙais..... 



A wajen Sarkin Yaki kuwa sungaji da neman su Yarima Malik hakan yasa suka kama hanyar da zata sadasu da Masarautar Daborah

Yarima Haishir ne wajen mahaifin shi yasake yimashi maganar Bahijja, yau ma, kamar kullin Sarki Lahazu bai bashi kwarin guiwa ba musamman da yaji abinda ɗan nashi ke bukatar yi akan Bahijja, haka suka rabu da tareda wata mafita ba wannan karanma haka Yarima Haishir ta tafi ranshi ba dadi, ya ɗaukar ma  kanshi  bazai kuma zuwa  wajen mahaifin shi akan batun Bahijja ba, da haka ya koma sashen shi da kanshi ya fiddo ta an ɗaure mata hannu yace. "Ke baiwa kin canza ra'ayi ko kuwa kina kan bakarki."? 
Wani kallo tai mashi na tsana sannan tace. "Na tsane ka kuma bazan taɓa zama mallakin kaba koda kuwa aurena zakayi, dan haka kasa a kasheni  in huta ban kaunar ka, kai azzalumi ne kuma maci amana."


Rufe idan shi yayi ya bude a hankali duk sun sauya kala baisan sadda ya shake mata wuya ba yace. "Ko kinso ko kinki saikin zama mallakina koda ta karfin tsiyane ƙaƙari Bahijja tafara da kyal ya anshe kanta tafara kwalla sake sawa yayi aka rufe ta cikin dakin wanda ba abinda ke ɗawainiya dashi sai uban soro fa zafi, duk da haka Bahijja batayi sanyi ba ko ta sauko akan taurin kan da ta ɗaura ma kanta akan muguwar manufar da Yarima Haishir kesan cimmawa akanta, koda aka maida ta cikin ɗakin batasan ta rushe da kuka ba dan takaici..... 



A kwana a tashi ba wuya wajen lillahi yau su Yarima Malik suka iso Masarautar Waisu sake sauya kamanni sukayi sannan suka shiga cikin Masarautar sarkin kofa ne ya tsaida su  yafara bin cike sukace wajen Yarima Haishir sukazo, batare da  ɓata lokaci ba a kaima  su Yarima Malik iso zuwa sashen Haishir koda aka sanar mashi da zuwan su haka ya fito ya same su zaune  a falon shi, shima  zama yayi ya kafesu da kallo cikin mamaki yace.....

yanda ya furta maganar kamar an mashi dole sai kuma ta kara mashi kyau shi kanshi Haishir duk da bazai iya shaida fuskokin su sosai ba amman yaga kyawun MalikusSaif, bayan sun aje kayan su ya turo  masu wata baiwa ta hada masu ruwan wanka MalikusSaif ne yafara shiga yana fitowa Huzaifa ya shiga shiryawa sukayi kowa ya maida wani farin kyalle da suke boye fuskar su dashi suna gama shiri bada jimawa Yarima Haishir ya shigo shima ya sake  sabon shiri nan yai masu  iso suka dawo falon shi, bada jimawa ba aka fara gabato masu da kayan abinci iri iri,  sawa yayi  aka zuba masu sannan yace suci abinci, da kamar bazasu ciba gudun kar yayi zatan wani abu yasa suka fara cin abincin shima ci yayi suna ƴar fira har suka gama suna cikin magana ne saiga mai kula da Bahijja ya shigo zubewa yayi ya kwashi gaisuwa sannan yace.
"Ranka shidade yaune wa'adin da kaɗibar ma wannan baiwar ya cika za'a iya sakin ta daga rufewar da akai mata."?  Tunda MalikusSaif yaji ance Baiwa baisan yanda a kaiba yaji gaban shi yana bugu kamar wanda wani abu ke shirin faruwa dashi take yanayin shi ya sauya har sai da  Huzaifa ya fahimci hakan a fuskar abokin nashi, daurewa kawai yayi amsar da Yarima Haishir yaba wannan bawan shi ya dawo da MalikusSaif a nutsuwar shi yace.

 wayan cewa MalikusSaif yayi yace. "Ya bayan rabuwa abokina tun a Masarautar Ƙaisu ranar da akayi bikin gamji wajen bauta."
kallan sakarai Yarima Malik yai ma Haishir, shiru yayi yana nazari saidai ya kasa  tuna komai nuna MalikusSaif yayi da yatsa yace. "Kwarai kuwa,Yarima Ƙamar ko."?  Koda MalikusSaif yaga Haishir ya bashi  sani da wuri hakan yasa yace. "Kwarai kuwa." rungume Malik yayi yana murna yace. 


"Ɗan Sarkin buzaye shi yasa  ka boye mani kanka dan insha wahalar ganeka kenan gashi na gane da wuri."
Dariya sukayi baki dayan su sannan MalikusSaif yace.

ba karamin mamaki ya kama Haishir a iya sanin shi Ƙamar baida dan uwa amman sai yace kilan ɗan uwan mahaifin shine haka suka taɓa fira kowa yana jin  dadin ganin ɗan uwan sa musamman Haishir da yake ganin Yarima Ƙamar ne ya kawo mashi ziyarar bangirma,

A Masarautar Daborah kuwa ba abinda ya sauya komai sai kara ƙamari yakeyi yana tsananta musamman a wajen Binta yauma tana komawa ba abinda tafara yi  sai share share da gyara ma  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ɗakin ta, tana gamawa taje tafara ma Sarauniya tausar kafarta kamar yanda ta saba, zaune suke kowa yai shiru da alama akwai abinda suke saƙawa a cikin zuciyar su, itadai Binta mafarkin da tayi na ƴarta ne ya addabi zuciyar ta, ita ko  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa a duk lokacin da taga Binta sai taji  mugun haushin ta sai taga  akan ƴarta ne ɗanta ya tafi yabar ta  wai neman Baiwa hakan kesa taga kamar zubda martaba ne da daraja a idon duniya ace Yarima kamar MalikusSaif yatafi neman baiwa kuma ƴar bayi lallai kam dole hakan ya taɓa darajar Masarautar Daborah, jin shirun yai yawa hakan yasa Binta ta ɗago ta saci kallan Sarauniya ganin kallan kiyayyar da take ai kamata kadai tasan ta tsaneta fiye da tunanin ta, sadda kanta tayi dan tagama tsorata tace.
"Ranki shidade ina neman  alfarma a wajenki."? 
Kallan ta tayi alamun inajinki, "daman ina san kimin izini zan kaima Abdulmajid ziyara." ɗauko gwaiba tayi ta faraci cikin izza da gadara kamar bada ita ake magana ba saida Binta ta fidda rai, sannan tace. "Zaki iya zuwa bance ki jimaba sannan da marece ki samo bayin da zasu gyarama Saifulislam lambu."

Wajen Sarki Baidulƙais kuwa ya gama duk wani shiri da yake  tunanin zaiyi wani ɗaki ya shiga a cikin sashen shi ba wanda ke shigar shi sai shi, yana zuwa ba inda yaje sai wajen wata kwalba ya ɗauko ya fara wasu maganganu marassa dadin saurare, wani irin hayaki ke fita a cikin kwalbar cikin kankanin lokaci wani mutun ya bayyana ba kyaun gani da fasali, Sarki Baidulƙais ne yace. "Ina san  taimakon ku da aljanu a wannan lokacin inasan in dirkake Masarautar Daborah da abinda suke takama dashi."
dariya ce ta kaure kaf dakin ankai minti ukku ana yinta  sannan akayi shiru magana aka fara mai ratsa kunne a kace. "Yanzun ne zaka nemi taimakon mu bayan komai ya kure maka ai inda ka kasa cimma burinka akan Bahijja komai ya lalace dan haka bamu da abinda zamu iya yimaka saida kaga karasa ta, sannan zaka nememu dan haka Sarrilƙus yace a gargaɗeka kada kasake neman wani taimako daga garemu in kunne  yaji."
wata dariyar ce aka kara saki zaiyi magana kenan ya ɓace, dafe kanshi yayi ya rasa mike mashi dadi shikan shi ya san rashin cimma burin shi da baiyi ba akan Bahijja tamkar naka su  ne akan mulkin shi, da dajin GAMKI baki dayan shi wannan dalilin yasa Sarrilƙus kejin haushin shi dama Masarautar Raifasu baki ɗayan ta!

Haka ya gama  yan surkullen shi ba wani aljanni daya kara zuwa har zoben dake hannun shi saida ya murza ammn aljani ɗan tsitu bai fito ba  daya gaji haka ya fito ji yake kamar ya kurma ihu gidan yari ya wuce yasa akaci gaba da ganama su Tasi'u azaba dan baki ɗaya laifin su yake gani a dalilin sune aka ɗauke Bahijja batare da  ya cika burin shi akan ta ba, haka ya koma fa'da wannan karan da kanshi yasa aka rubuta wasika zuwa ga Sarkin Ƙaisu jin shiru baice komai ba ya kara yimashi tuni akan abinda  yake nema a gareshi. 

 ```Daborah``` 

Koda Binta ta isa wajen mijin nata yau ba laifi ta same shi da ɗan ƙwari ba kamar koda yaushe ba, tana zuwa ta ɗauko wata leda ta bashi  abinci ansa yayi yana kallan ta cikin so da tsabar tausayin ta yace. "Ummu Bahijja ina kika samu   wannan abincin da har kika kawo mani shi"? Murmushi tayi tace. "Mijina kenan wanda ake ragewa ne a madafi nike kalato maka dan kasamu abinda zaka saka ma bakin salati."
ansa yayi yaci yana gamawa yafara yimata addu'a harda ƴar kwallar shi, itama jin dadi tayi ganin yanda mijin ta ke saka albarka da ameen ta amsa ɗan shiru ne ya biyo baya cewa tayi. "Abban Bahijja daman wlh inaji a jikina Bahijja na cikin mawuyacin hali dan abinda nagani ya masifar ɗaga mani hankali da ace akwai yanda zanyi da nasamu nabi hanya ko ganin zan dace in gudo da 'ya'ta."

Murmushin girma Abdulmajid yayi yana ganin gangancin matar tashi yace. "In banda  abinki waya gaya maki mafarki gaskia ne baki tunanin idan ki kace  zaki bita kema aka maki  kije wata Masarautar kici gaba da bauta a banza a wofi ai kwara nan zaki dinga ganin dangin ki  kinajin dadi, yafi ace an kamaki garin neman ƴarki ga rashin sa'a na ganin yar taki ga kin rabu  da kowa naki." hawaye ne sukayi nasarar wanke ma  Binta fuskar ta goge cikeda gamsuwa tace. "Hakane minene mafita"? "Kiyi hakuri inda rai  da rabo ki saka  wannan  aranki sannan daga yanzun kisaka aranki mafarki karya ne  daga yau karki kara saka damuwa a cikin zuciyar ki  kinji matata."?
Aza kanta tayi saman kafaɗar shi tana jin dadi tace. "Shikenan daga nan  bazan kuma yim wannan maganar ba."
canza wata firar sukayi suna cikin magana, mai kula da Abdulmajid yace lokaci yayi haka Binta ta tafi sai murna takeyi ji take  kamar anbata gaggarumar kauta, tana komawa taskar bayi haka ta ɗibi bayi sukaje lambu dan yin aikin da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta saka ta....

Shiko Ashir kullun cikin gana mashi ukuba akeyi ga duka wanda harya fara zame mashi jinin jikin shi yau ma Sarkin horo ne ya gama dukan shi sannan yasa wawan Sarki ya zuba mashi gishiri ga ciwon jikin shi, jiyayi kamar ya mutu dan azaba duk ya gama fita hayyacin shi, haka aka ɗauke shi aka shanya shi cikin rana kamar ba dan Adam ba. 


Cikin Raifasu kuwa Jakadiya ce taje wajen gimbiya Yazira takai mata bayi sunai mata aiki, har Jakadiya ta fito gimbiya Yazira tasa aka kira mata Jakadiya cikin dakin ta ta sameta zama tayi ta gaidata kallan tayi cikin kulawa tace. "Gani ranki shidade." "Jamra ina labarin Bahijja mi kikaji  uban gidan ki na cewa  a kanta ."? shiru Jakadiya tayi tasan manufar gimbiya Yazira akan Bahijja bamai kyau bace cewa tayi. "Ranki shidade banda wani labari akan Bahijja abinda nasani ba'a ganta ba, wasu ne suka sace ta suka gudu sa ita." haka nan  taji gaban ta ya fadi da sauri tace. "Ko kinsan su waye."? Kallan mamaki Jakadiya taimata. "Ina zan sansu ranki shidade."?
"Ina nufin ko kinji maimarta ba, na zargin wasu."? "Eh to bazan iya ganewa ba saidai da gani bai wuce cikin amintattun Sarki ne zasu ha'in ce shi su sace Bahijja wannan shine gaskia."
kallan gimbiya Yazira tayi taga take ta raina gaskiar ta daman tana sane tace haka dan taga yanda zatayi, da kyal tace. "Kibar wannan maganar Jamra ban tunanin hakan zata kasance inda rabo za'a ganta ai,  zaki iya tafiya Jamra in kinji  wani labarin ina sauraranki." da toh Jakadiya ta amsa ta dan bata yarda da yana yin  gimbiya Yazira ba, tana zatan kamar itace ta sace Bahijja dan cimma wani buri nata koma mine ta ɗaukar ma kanta saita tona ma gimbiya Yazira asiri da haka ta isa sashen Sarki Baidulƙais, itako Uwani duniya ta koya mata hankali zuwa yanzun ba karamin dukuwa takeyi ba, har kamannin ta sun fara canzawa ga uwar yunwa na addabar rayuwar ta danko tunda aka rufeta bata kara ganin keyar gimbiya Yazira ba bare tasa ran taimako daga gareta koda abincin da zata cima cikin tane, rushewa da kuka tayi mai sosa zuciya, wata muguwar baiwa ce tafara zagin Uwani tana kwasa mata mari kamar ta samu jaka tun Uwani na ihu har saida tayi shiru cikin kankanin lokaci ta kumbura mata fuska jiniko sai zuba yakeyi a bakin ta.... 


 *Niko nace tun yanzun kinfara ganin sakayyar Allah bakiga komai ba indai duniya ce ta isheki riga da wando😁*

Episode 17&18


 _Masarautar Waisu_ 


Washe gari da safe Bahijja ce ta gama  shirin ta tsaf zataje wajen aiki kamar yanda mai kula da sashen Yarima Haishir ya faɗa mata  tunda ta tashi baki daya jikinta ke mata ciwo ga tana fama da matsanancin ciwon kai da, tayi niyar baza taje ba, amman gudun kada tayi wani laifin, shi yasa  ta tafi koda ta fita sansanin bayi ba inda ta wuce sai bangaren Yarima Haishir tana zuwa ta fara gyaran falo hankalin ta kwance take aikin ta cikin nutsuwa har ta ida sharar da takeyi, tana gamawa tayi bayan gida tafara gyarawa,cikin kankanin lokaci ta gama aikin ta zama tayi tana hutawa jin kirjin ta na dukan ukku ukku tarasa yanda a kayi  taji yana yinta  ya sauya, shiko Yarima Haishir yana fitowa daga dakin shi yaga angyara falo tsaf kiran wata baiwa yayi ya tambaye ta  ko Bahijja ta zo, "Eh itace ta gyara komai."
wani irin dadi yaji dan baiyi tsammanin zata zo ba ya santa da taurin kai kuma bata da tsoro, da haka ya nufi dakin su Yarima Malik, yana zuwa ya kwan kwasa  masu kofa bada jimawa ba Huzaifa ya buɗe mashi kofa shiga yayi ya zauna gefen gado, sannan suka gaisa, Yarima Haishir ne yace. "Ya kamata ku fito falo, azo a gyara maku dakin ku."
hakan kuwa akayi suna gama shirin su suka fito falo, zama sukayi shiko Haishir sai dube dube yakeyi ko zai ga Bahijja jin shirun yai yawa hakan yasa  ya kira  wata baiwa yace ta shiga ta gyarama bakin shi dakin su, fira suka fara,  awajen Bahijja kuwa gyangyaɗi ne ya fara ɗaukar ta,jitayi an ta ɓata da sauri ta farka ganin mai magana yasa ta  mikewa, mai kula sashen Yarima Haishir ne yace ta tashi taci gaba da aikin ta, baki ɗaya ji tayi  jikin ta ya mutu ba yanda zatayi haka ta mike ta shiga cikin falon, ta rasa inda zatay, wata zuciyar ce tace mata tafara gyara dakin Yarima, ji tayi  kuma wata tace anya wannan sakaran Yariman ma yatashi, ɗan karamin tsoki tayi ta kama hanyar tafiya dakin Yarima, tana wucewa su Yarima Malik su kuma suka taho zasuje wajen mai martaba, tunda ya hangi bayan baiwar dake gaban su yaji faɗuwar gaba har suka fita haka nan  yaji ya rasa  sukuni a cikin zuciyar shi, itako Bahijja tana shiga ta iske ɗakin a yamutse  komai ya ɓaci a cikin ranta ko cewa tayi wannan ai kazanta ce, haka nan  yake nuna ma mutane isa ashema kazami ne, tana aiki tana sababi harta gama gyara mashi dakin, ta rufo shi tayi ta koma falo ta zauna, jitayi kanta yafara yimata ciwo kishin giɗawa tayi bacci ne yafara ɗaukar ta.

Koda Yarima Haishir suka isa wajen Sarki Lahazu iske shi sukayi cikin sashen shi suna zuwa Yarima Haishir ya rungume mahaifin shi suko su Malik gaida Sarki sukayi,  baki dayan su suka zauna sake gaisawa sukayi Sarki Lahazu ne yace. "Ɗana baki kayi daga ina."?  Cikeda zumuɗi yace "Ƙamar ne Yariman Ƙaisu ya kawo  mani ziyara."
kallan tsaf Sarki Lahazu yaima su Malik sannan yace. "Aikuwa sun kyauta kaidin ne baka da kirki ba inda kake zuwa tunda Yarima HusbarulƘais ya mutu baka kuma zuwa ko ina ba ."
sosa keya yayi yace. "Ranka shidade ina kewar abokina har yanzun." girgiza kai Sarki Lahazu yayi yace. "Tabbas ɗana basai kafaɗa ba har gobe ina tir da halin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa Yakin nan ya taɓaman zuciya yanda baka zato fata dai  Gurfanai  ya kara ɗaura mu akan makiyan mu." sudai su Malik basu ce  komai ba, sai kallon juna sukeyi basu jima sosai sukai ma  Sarki Lahazu sallama suka tafi ba inda suka wuce sai wajen gimbiya Ƙamariyya suna zuwa bayin dake wajen ne suka zube kowa ya kawo gaisuwa tashi tayi daga kishin giɗar da tayi tana kallan ɗan nata cikin kulawa tace. "Yarima baki kayi ne."?  Zama yayi gefen ta yace. "Eh Umma Yarima Ƙamar kenan da kanin shi Nurda sun kawo  mani ziyara ne zuwa gobe zasu tafi." fuskar ta sake tace. "Sannun ku  da hanya gaskia kun kyauta haka akeso zumunci nada dadi saidai ya kamata kuba abokin naku shawara yayi aure haka nan." ɗan gyaran murya Yarima Malik yayi sannan yace. "Badamuwa zamu bashi ai dagani  ma kamar ya samu  wadda yake so." numfasawa gimbiya Ƙamariyya tayi tace "bawa fa yace yana so ina shi  ina baiwa kuma."? take Yarima Haishir ya sauya fuska yace. "Haba Umma zan ƴanta, tafa miye daga ciki dan naso baiwa."? tsaki tayi bata kuma cewa komai ba suma su Yarima Malik basu ce  komai ba kowa da abinda yake aiya nawa a cikin zuciyar, da haka sukayi mata bankwana suka tafi masaukin su..... 


Suna isa sashen su zama sukayi a falo Yarima Malik ne yace. "Huzaifa nifa harna fara gajiya har yanzun ace ba muga  wani abu dan gane  da Bahijja ba yau fa kwanan mu biyu da zuwa gobe zamu wuce Daborah anya Bahijja naraye."?
Cikin tausayawa Huzaifa  yace.
"Haba Yarima insha Allah Bahijja na raye bata mutu ba."
murmushin karfin hali Malik yayi mai kama da kuka yace. "Gaskia ne Huzaifa ni kaina  inaji a raina  Bahijja na raye, kaga Huzaifa indai yau ta kare  ba muga Bahijja ba,  bai kamata  muci gaba da zama cikin wannan kaskantattar Masarautar ba, jibi yanda nakoma a ƴan kwana kin  da mukayi a wannan Masarautar haba Huzaifa ya zamuyi yanzun nasan mahaifan ta suna cikin tsananin kewar ta sosai, ji sukayi ana koɗa Yarima Haishir alamun gab yake da shigowa a cikin falon da suke zaune shima zama yayi gefen su, yace. "Kuyi hakuri abokai na  na tsaya  wajen Umma wai ba zanso  baiwa ba kuji minene aibun baiwa."? 
Huzaifa ne yace. "Bata da  wata matsala ko kadan." 
Cikin jin dadi Haishir yace. "yawwa nima dai haka nagani Nurda." suna ta zancen auren baiwa sukaji tari daga bayan su, ba ƙaƙƙautawa, a fusace Yarima Haishir yace. "Wake mana tari anan wajen."?
Ba'a bashi ansa ba,shiko Yarima Malik sadda kanshi yayi kasa yana nazari, baki ɗaya tunanin shi yayi kan Bahijja dan bai san a kowane hali take ba a halin yanzun, shiko Haishir a fusace ya tashi ya tafi inda ake tarin ya iske Bahijja kwance a saman kujera tana bacci ta kware, daka mata tsawa yayi yace. "Ke Bahijja tashi waya baki ikon kwan tawa  a falon nan."
yanda sukaji ya kira sunan *Bahijja* baki ɗaya su Yarima Malik suka mike jikin shine ya ɗauki kyarma a hankali suka tako zuwa wajen Yarima Haishir, itako Bahijja ta makale jikin ta duk tsoro ya gama  dirar mata a cikin zuciya jin yanda ya kwaɗa mata tsawa dan ba tayi  mamakin yanda bai kai mata duka ba, shiko Yarima Malik tunda ya aza razanannun idanun shi masu rikata mai kallo akan kyakkyawa fuskar Bahijja,kaftawa baiyi baki ɗaya yai mutuwar tsaye ganin Bahijja a gaban shi kamar a mafarki, itako a hankali ta fara buɗe idanun ta harta buɗesu tangaram ta azasu saman fuskokin su ɗaya bayan ɗaya take kallan su har idanun ta suka sauka saman fuskar Malik, batasan gaban ta  ya faɗi ba, da mugun karfi, duk da ba taga fuskar shi sosai ba, sake daka mata tsawa Yarima Haishir yayi yace. "Bazaki mike ba kika kafe mutane da waɗan nan idanun naki masu kama dana aljanu.!"
kallan banza Bahijja ta watsama Yarima Haishir taso tayi mashi rashin kunya hakanan taji Yarima Malik yai mata kwarjini ta kasa cewa uffan, tashi tayi jiki sanyaye ta gaida su Yarima Malik sannan ta tafi, ta kusa fita taji yace. "Bahijja zonan."?
Yanda yai mata maganar saida yasa zuciyar Malik ta tsinke, komawa sukayi kowa ya zauna sannan ta iso dukawa tayi tace. "Gani ranka shidade." shiru yayi kamar bai san da zuwa taba sai kaɗa kafa yakeyi yana jiji dakai dan yaga yau tayi laushi acewar shi dan ya hukun ta tane, yasa tayi sanyi da yawa taji jiki, itako sai satar kallan su Malik takeyi da ta ɗago ido sai taga  sun haɗa ido sai tayi  saurin maida nata kasa shiko Yarima Malik yana mamakin girman Bahijja har haka sai sake sake ya keyi a ranshi ya rasa  murna ya keyi  ko kuma bakin ciki yake ji  a cikin zuciyar shi. maganar Yarima Haishir ne ya dawo dasu kogin tunanin da suka ninkaya cewa yayi. "Waike wace irin baiwa ce baki san kiba uban gidan ki, hakuri ba shine kika kwashi kafafu kika tafi  ko a jinki ga sa'anki naimaki faɗa."? 
Kafeta da idanu MalikusSaif yayi yaji me zata ce, cikin rawar murya tace.
"Kayi hakuri banjin dadine shiyasa Bahijja na tuba." tsaki yayi yace "baiwa kinajin dadi fa anjima kidawo ki gyarama  bakina ɗakin su kinji."?  "to nagode." nuna mata hanya yayi mikewa tayi ta tafi tana al'ajabin mutanen da tagani wajen Yarima Haishir sun mata kwarjinu shine har yake  gaya mata maganganu san ranshi da tunani iri iri Bahijja ta tafi sansanin bayi  abinta.....

*******************************

Suko Jaruman Daborah yau Allah yasa suka iso Masarautar Daborah ba inda suka sauka sai fa'da suna zuwa kowa yakai gaisuwa wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, haka Sarkin zagi yace dasu Sarauniya ta amsa, shiru ne ya biyo baya hakan yasa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta kalli Sarkin Yaƙi da tambayoyi iri iri a fuskar ta ce mata yayi. "Ranki shidade mungaza muna neman afuwarki bamu samu Yarima Malik ba, ba irin neman da bamuyi mashi ba amman yayi ruwa yai tsaki, kimana aikin gafara." ya idasa maganar kanshi kasa, mikewa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi tana zagaye fa'da tana isowa wajen Sarkin Yaƙi dukowa tayi gefen fuskar shi tace. "Dagaske kun gaza baku dawo da MalikusSaif ba akan aikin dana sanin da yake shirin yiba?"  Bakasan kin hana Yarima Malik zuwa neman Bahijja ba kamar zubda kima da darajar Masarautar Daborah bane? Shin kanaso kace mani Sarkin Yaƙi na ya gaza  dawowa da Yariman Daborah gida ba? Mikake so  in kiraka dashi wawa? Ko kuwa sakarai? Marar hankali? Ko kuwa marar tunani."? 

Shidai Sarkin Yaƙi ya kasa cewa komai dan mamaki da al'ajabi ganin yanda suka sha wahalar neman Yarima amman Sarauniya Zulaiƙa takasa yimasu uzuri, bai gama tunanin da yake yiba yaji ta wanke shi da mari tace. "Ni sa'ar kace ina magana kayi shiru kafara haukane."?
Jikinshi na kyarma yace. "Ina neman afuwarki ranki shidade, bakina ya girmi kalaman da zanyi anfani dasu wajen baki hakuri." cikin fushi tace. "Sarkin gida kiramani Sarkin Yari aje a garƙame mani su, sai sunyi sati ɗaya a ɗaure badan kada makiya suyi mani dariya ba da saina sauke keka akan wannan matsayin nak! dan dai za'ace Sarkin Yaƙin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ya gaza yaji kunya, ku ɓacemani dagani sakarkaru daku mararsa kishin zuci.!"


Haka sukai ta ba Sarauniya Zulaiƙa hakuri amman kamar bada ita suke ba , haka aka tafi dasu gidan Yari abin gwanin ban tausayi.


➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Yarima Malik kuwa yana komawa, cikin ɗakin su yafara dukan hannu yaje ya dawo yaje ya dawo, ya rasa inda zaisa kansa cikin ɓacin rai yace. 
"Huzaifa jibi Bahijja yadda tazama baiwa marar ƴanci yanda ake juyata kamar ba mutun ba, jibi yanda Bahijja ke yawo da kayan da suka kama mata jiki, gaskia idan ina ganin Bahijja haka zuciya ta zata iya fashewa, Huzaifa kasan yanda na ɗauki Bahijja"?
Mamakin MalikusSaif ya gama kama Huzaifa, ganin yanda yake zance kamar zararre. 
Shiko MalikusSaif ganin yanda Huzaifa ke mashi kallan tuhuma, yasa ya kule yace. "Ina maka magana kayi shiru."
Murmushi yayi yace. 
"Aaa Yarima saika faɗa." " Ina jin Bahijja tamkar jinin jikina mai gudana kuma hantata ƴar uwata tamkar mun kwanta ciki ɗaya da Bahijja haka nikejin ta Huzaifa, ta yaya zanga ana wulakantata tana yawo da waɗan nan wulakantattun kayan kafurai na gane mata surar jiki yarinya karama amman ana bata aiki mai wahala,Huzaifa yau dinnan zan ɗauki Bahijja mubar wannan Masarautar.!"
Ya ida maganar yana fidda huci mai zafin gaske. 
dafashi Huzaifa yayi yace. "Yau da gobe duk daya ne a wajen Allah  kabari sai zuwa gobe intazo aiki wajen mu sai mu bayyana  mata kanmu tana iya yuyuwa ta manta mu saboda ba wayon kirki ne da itaba sosai sadda aka raba ta da iyayen ta ba, dan ni nasan bata sanni ba, amman kwara kai saboda kasa ba  da ita,kilan ta iya tunawa da kai, kuma ya kamata tasan kudurin mu ta shaidamu, sannan sai mu dauke ta."cikeda gamsuwa MalikusSaif  yace.
"Tabbas kafadi gaskia abokina tarayya ta da kai  akwai dinbin ilimi a ciki kana bani shawara mai kyau Huzaifa Allah ya kaimu goben lafiya." da ameen Huzaifa ya amsa, sannan sukayi alwalla kowa yai sallah suka kwanta sai dai  cikin su bamai bacci kowa da abinda yake ai yanawa a cikin zuciyar shi......


Ita kanta Bahijja tana gama abinda zatayi ta kwanta saman ƴar tabarmar ta ba abinda ke mata yawo sai saurayin da tagani tareda Yarima Haishir ta rasa inda tasan kaman nin shi, ɗan guntun tsaki tayi tace. "Kedai Bahijja kin cika  shirme ke dama  baki ga fuskar shi ba inake ina tunanin inda kika sanshi, kibar wannan zancen ma, can kuma ta cukune fuska tace.
"wannan shegen Yariman sai nayi  maganin sakarai, can kuma ta sake yin murmushi tace Allah Sarki Baba Jamra koya take a halin yanzun koya addinin ta yanzun, shikenan bani ba Baba Jamra, na rabu  da ita kenan? Nan zan zauna inta aikin bauta? Allah Sarki kawaye na Indo da Zainab shikenan narabu da Baba Saude nidai gaskia saina koma wajen su Baba Jamra, duk da Sarki Baidulƙais azzalumine so yake ya kasheni  amman ai Babata bazata bari ba, can kuma taji hawaye na zarya a kumatunta tace Allah Sarki Umma ta da Abbana ina kewar ku, wayyo Ya Malik dina nasan ya manta da kanwar shi, ni yanzun, koma zan iya gane Ya Malik kuwa, murmushi tayi tace keko Bahijja kin cika zakewa ina baiwa inayin Yaya da Yarima hmm yanzun fa kinsan banbancin ƴayan sarauta da bayi, kwara dai kisan abinda kikeyi sai dai ya zama uban gidan ki Yariman ki kamar kowa.
haka dai Bahijja ta kama sake saken ta na shirme bata san sadda bacci ɓarawo yai awon gaba da ita......

Episode 19&20



 _Masarautar Raifasu_



Wajen Sarki Baidulƙais kuwa lamarin duniya ne yai mashi  tsaye yana mamakin yanda Sarrilƙus yake fushi dashi akan Bahijja shi kan  shi yaso ya kusance da ita kodan kashe kishirwar da ta addabe shi akan Bahijja, shawara ya fara ko yaje dajin Gamki wajen shi susan abinyi wata zuciyar ce tace kaima kasan bazai saurareka ba, amman inko haka ta kasance ai zan shiga cikin damuwa mai yawan gaske, amman bari in saurari sakon Sarki Danwar inji dan nakosa inje intaho da Bahijja kona yi abinda aka umurceni da ita, haka dai Sarki Baidulƙais yai tayin sake saken banza dana wofi harya, gama shirin shi tsaf ya tafi fa'da danjin inda Jaruman shi suka tsaya da abinda ake bukata na kayan yaki.....


Koda ya isa cikin fa'da baki daya Jarumai ne zaune ke saman jiran shigowar shi, yana shigowa kowq ya kike, bayan ya zauna kowa yakai gaisuwa wajen Maimarta ba,sannan suka zauna, shiru ne ya biyo baya, kowa ya kashe kunne yaji abinda Sarki zaice. 
shiko baki ɗaya ya shagala da tunani dan kana ganin shi kaga mai damuwa a zahiri, Sarkin Yaki ne yace. "Ranka shidade mungama shirya komai yanzun abinda ya rage mana shine fuskantar abokan gaba sai dai  muna da bukatar ma'suna da takubba sun mana karanci."
cikeda gamsuwa Sarki Baidulƙais yace ma Sarkin Yaki su anshi kudi wajen Sarkin taska,duk abinda suke bukata a siya sannan acigaba daba Jarumai gwaji na musamma."
suna cikin fa'danci wata tsohuwa ta shigo, Sarkin fa'da ne yai mata iso wajen Sarki a tare suka gaida Sarki, sannan yace. "Ranka shidade wannan matar tana son ta ganka duk yanda nayi da ita, akan ta faɗi damuwar ta amman tace kai takeson gani."
wani irin kallo yaima ta  dan yanda yake jin shi bazai iya sauraron wata karaba a wajen mutanen shi ba dan baida lokacin ɓatawa a halin yanzun, amman gudun karya karya mata  guiwa yasa ya bata umurnin magana cewa tayi. 
"Ranka Shidade nakawo karar wani ɗan uwana daya anshe mani dukiya ta kuma yahani ni, gashi banda kudi ko hanyar da zanci abinci kuma bai bani komai ba bare insai abinci shine nakawo karar shi ka ansar mani dukiya ranka Shidade."


Idanun Baidulƙais rufe kamar mai bacci nan ko abubuwane sukai mashi tsaye ya rasa  inda zaisa kanshi yaji dadi, shiru ne ya biyo baya daga bisani yace 
"Minene sunanki."? "Ranka Shidade sunana Lami."
"toh naji abinda kikace saidai kisani a halin yanzun abubuwa sunyima fa'da yawa akwai muhimman abubuwa dake gaban mu, amman yanzun zan baki  kudin da zakiyi anfani dasu, kafin wani lokacin sannan kisani nan da mako biyu kizo keda dan uwan naki danyi maku shari'a in fa'da tasamu sukuni, magatarda ka anshi sunan ta da wanda take kara nan da mako ɗaya ki sake dawowa sannan a bada kudin da zasu isheta har zuwa wani makon."
dukawa tayi ta sadda kanta kasa sai godiya takeyi haka aka ɗauki sunan ta dana ɗan uwanta sannan aka bata kudi tayi godiya ta tafi cike da farin ciki a zuciyar ta......


*Daborah*


A wajen Abdulmajid yau ya tashi da matsanancin ciwon ciki kamar bazai kaiba tsabar azaba da ta gama addabar rayuwar shi, amaine yaita kwarawa sekace zai fiddo da ƴan hanjin shi haka yake ji  ga ba abinda yaci dan raban da yaci abinci tunjiya da marece, Ladidi da Binta sai Mairo sune sukazo ganin Abdulmajid daga kullewar da akai mashi suna zuwa, suke iskeshi cikin mawuyacin hali, rai hannu ga Allah a kiɗime Binta tayi kan mijin ta,ta rungumo shi jikin ta batasan sadda ta fara  kuka ba mai tsuma zuciya ba, gwanin ban tausayi, tana kuka tana cewa. "Abban Bahijja  dan Allah katashi kada katafi ka barni katashi dan Allah kai kadai ke gareni mijina, Mairo dan Allah kuce Abdulmajid yatashi karya tafi ya barni katashi dan Allah." haka ta karasa maganar tana kuka mai tsuma zuciya. 
su kansu su Mairo sun kasa ko motsin kirki baki ɗaya jikin su rawa yake musamman da suka ga yanda jikin Abdulmajid ya saki ko motsi baiyi itako Binta tagama fita hayyacin ta, tana cikin kuka ta ɗaura kanta saman kafadar shi, batayi aune ba taji saukar duka na ratsata sake kankame shi tayi tana kuka kamar ranta zai fita suma su Mairo ji sukai anata dukan su, Sarkin bulala ne keta dukan su, basu san  hawa ba basu san sauka ba, cikin faɗa yace. "Uban wa yaba ku damar zuwa wannan wajen ko mutuwa zaiyi kubar shi wato ku sarakan tausayi kenan." Mairo ce ta rike kafar shi tafara bashi hakuri dan baki ɗaya ta gama  tsorata da lamarin Sarkin bulala haka yai masu korar kare, da kyal suka ɓanɓare Binta jikin Abdulmajid haka suka barshi a yashe kamar ba ɗan Adam, suka tafi sunaji suna gani, shiko Abdulmajid rai hannu ga Allah, koda suka isa turakar bayi haka Binta ta zube kasa sai kuka takeyi ta rasa abinda ke mata dadi a duniya, jitake ina ma  ta mutu ta huta, suma su Ladidi gefe ɗaya ta koma suna kuka ba karamin tausayin halin dasu Binta suke ciki su keyi ba, suna cikin alhinin abinda yafaru dasu sai ga wata baiwa tazo tana kiran Binta, ko kallanta Binta bataiba, Mairo ce tace.
"Wake kiranta." amsa ta bata da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce, Mairo ce tace gatanan zuwa. 
haka wannan baiwa ta tafi, Mairo ce tace. "Kiyi hakuri  Binta haka Allah yaso komi makaddari ne daga Allah ki saka  dangana a ranki insha Allah Abdulmajid bazai mutu ba, kibar wannan kukan dan Allah."
haka sukai taba Binta hakuri sai ajiyar zuciya takeyi ta kasa cewa komai baki ɗaya ji takeyi kamar zuciyar ta zata fashe, Mairo ce ta kara  cewa. "Binta ki daure kije kiran da Sarauniya ke maki karki samu wata matsalar." kallan da Binta taima Mairo kadai saida yasa ta hadiye sauran maganar ta da kyal ta mike ta shiga dakin ta kwantawa tayi jitake kamar zuciyar ta zata fashe, addu'a takama karantowa iri iri ta kama wannan ta saki,wannan haka tai tayi har tafara ji zuciya tafara yimata sauki.
itako Sarauniya  Zulaiƙa baiwar na komawa tace mata ina Binta.?" dukawa tayi tace. "Ranki Shidade tana zuwa." ranta ɓace tace. "Banace ki taho kafarta kafarki ba."? A daburce tace. "Ranki Shidade nabarota cikin fushi saidai Mairo tace ince maki tana nan zuwa yanzun."? batakara cewa komai ba, komawa tayi ta zauna tana jiran Binta ta iso taji dalilin dayasa ta aika tazo taki zuwa akan lokaci.......


*****************************

Washe gari da safe Bahijja ce ta tashi daga bacci ta shirya ba inda ta nufa sai ɓangaren Yarima Haishir tana zuwa tafara gyaran falo kamar yanda ya umurceta sannan taje bakin kofar dakin su Malik da zata kwankwasa masu kofa sai kuma ta fasa, hakan yasa takoma falo ta zauna wata zuciyar ce tace mata ai kwara ta ida aikin ta, wannan shine hutun jaki da kaya, wannan karan dakin Yarima Haishir ta shiga kwance ta iskeshi yayi ruf da ciki sai bacci yakeyi ɗan gutun tsoki taja tace. "Hakadai za'a kare ba sallah ba salati sai bacci kawai akasaka agaba inama anfani." shiga tayi cikin kewayen dakin ta cigaba da wankewa tagama sannan ta share tsakar dakin ta rufe kofa ta koma falo, ɗakin su Malik ta wuce tana isa ta kwankwasa kofar tsaye take tanajira taji anbude mata kofa wata zuciyar ce tace kodai basu tashi daga bacci ba, sai kuma tace aiba abin mamaki bane tunda ba wani sahihin addini ne dasu ba banda na bacci, bata ida sakar zucin da take ba sai ta ɗan jingina da kofar dakin kafin abuɗe mata ta riga shagala a tunani, ji tayi anbude kofar gashi ta gama sakin jikin ta a jikin kofar baya baya tayi zata faɗi bakaramin tsoro bane ya mamaye mata zuciya ba harta fidda rai tasan inta faɗi zatayi rauni marar kyau, ji tayi an tarota ta faɗa saman mutun, wani irin sanyayyen kamshi ne ya ziyarci illahirin hancin ta har cikin kwakwalwarta, rufe idanun ta tayi ta kasa ko motsin kirki, shiko Yarima Malik ya kafeta da razanannun idanun shi, yana mamkin kalar kyau da girman da Bahijja tayi har haka, jin shirun yai yawa hakan yasa ta bude idanun ta ta azasu asamn fuskar shi wani irin mummunan faɗuwar gaba taji ya da baibayeta da kyal ta iya zamewa a hannun Malik, da sauri ta duka kasa tace. "Tuba nike ranka shidade banyi zatan kuna kusa ba kuma bansan na saki jikina ba a kofar kaimin aikin rai."?  Murmurshi ya sakar mata wanda ya tafi da imanin Bahijja ganin kyau da irin halittar da Allah yaima Malik wanda tai mashi kallan tsoro sai yanzun take kara ganin kyaun shi, saidai baki ɗaya kanta ya kulle tarasa gane inda tasan wannan fuskar koma a inane tasan wannan kamanni, shima kallan ta yakeyi yasan nazari takeyi inda ta sanshi, shiru yayi ya nasan  yaga kota gano wani abu dangne dashi ganin yanda ta shagala da kallan shi sai dai  da alama bata tuna komai ba, a hankali kamar wanda baisan yin magana yace. "Bakomai karki damu, mi zakiyi nan."?
duk daburce tarasa abin cewa tace. "Aiki aiki ne Yarima Haishir yasani ingyara maku masaukin ku." jitayi yace. "Toh bissimillah."
jitayi kirjinta na dukan tara tara cewa tayi daman wannan mutanen sunsan kalamar bissimillah kenan?
Ai nasan wannan addinin mune damn a wannan Masarautar akwai wanda yasan bissimillah a zuciya take maganar ta batasan ta fita filiba, shiko Malik dariya tabashi kunshewa yayi ya kalleta yace. "Ko bakiyi niyar farawa bane."? 
Da sauri tace"aaa zanyi gaba yayi ta bishi baya, sai satar kallan shi takeyi tana shiga tafara gyaran gadon dakin Huzaifa ne ya fito daga kewaye da alama alwallah yayi cewa yayi. "Yarima ina littafin nan bani zanyi sallah.....ganin Bahijja yasa bai ida sauran zancen suka makale mashi a baki ba, gaidashi tayi, saidai bai amsa ba itako ko ajikin ta ba abinda ke damunta irin ganin wannan saurayin da tagani ta rasa inda tasan fuskar shi, ganin yanda kowa yai shiru hakan yasa MalikusSaif yace. "Duba waccen jikar yana ciki, haka kuwa akayi ɗaukowa yayi taga ya kabbara sallar shi yana tayi  sai ya zamar ma Bahijja hoto haka ta shagala tana kallanshi taga harya fita iya sallar ma saida ya gama  sannan tafara shara, har tagama gyara ko ina, dukawa tayi taimasu sallama zata tafi. 
tsaida ta Malik yayi ya bata  abincin da aka kawo masu kalaci dan shi koci baiba daman Huzaifa ne yadanci shima ba sosai ba, cewa tayi ta gode, wani irin kallo yaimata hakanan taji yaimata kwarjini kuma bazata iya musu dashi, batasan ta ƙarɓa ba, godiya taimashi ta tafi, tana mamkin irin mutuncin shi a zuciyar ta gashi mutun mai daraja da arziki wanda ya gaji mulki ga kyau saidai yasan darajar dan Adam koda yake ba abin mamaki bane kasancewar shi musulmi, karo na farko kenan da mutum mai daraja a cikin jerin mutanen da ta haɗu dasu yai mata mutunci wani irin dadi taji yana ratsa mata cikin zuciya komawa tayi falo ta faracin abincin ta cikin jin dadi danko ba abinda dake mata yawo a idanun ta sai Kyakkyawan Saurayi sunan da taba Yarima Malik kenan a zuciyarta......


tana cikin cin  abincin ta rabi, ba komai take tunani ba sai Yarima Malik jitake kamar akwai wani abu a tareda shi, musamman da taga ba kalar addinin Masarautar Waisu sukeyi ba, tambaya tafara yima kanta miyasa suke boye fuskar su idan suna cikin mutane, jitayi tace kema dai Bahijja miye abin mamaki baki ganin kalar kyaun shi, sai kuma tace Aa anya kodai akwai abinda sukazo nema a wannan Masarautar ne? Kai kuma aida Yarima Haishir bai basu masaukiba a cikin sashen shiba, kuma yace abokan shine, wata zuciyar ce tace mata keko ina ruwanki da damuwa da wadan nan bakin karfa ki ajama kanki halin da baki dashi na saka ido akan rayuwar wasu, tana ta tunani taji an hankaɗar da abincin dake hannun ta afusace Yarima Haishir yace. "Wato raini ya shiga tsakanina dake ko abincin bakin nawa zaki zauna kinaci sannan uban wa kika bari zai gyara maki gadan ɗakin nawa."
baki daya jitayi jikinta yai sanyi cewa tayi. "Nice zan gyara daman jira nayi kagama bacci tukunna sannan kuma sune suka bani.....kifa mata mari yayi yace. "Suka baki ubanki, yau saina ɗebe rainin daya shiga tsakanina dake."
fara dukanta yayi wani mugun zafi taji ya ratsata batasan ta kurma ihu ba shi kanshi Yarima Haishir saidai yai mamaki yasan taurin kanta bazai bari tayi kuka, tundaga dakin su Malik suka jiyo karar ihu, da sauri ya mike yace wannan wane zalinci ne kowace Masarauta dai bayi basu da ƴanci, bari inga wa'akema wannan bugun har haka." rikeshi Huzaifa yayi yace. "Karkaje Yarima kaga dai ba Masarautar mu bace kuma ya kamata ka rufe fuskar ka, dawowa yayi ya rufe fuskar shi har ya zauna ya kuma jin wani ihun kukan hakan yaji zuciyar shi na duka, baisan yakara mikewa ba yace.
"Anya kamar Bahijja bazan mance da wannan muryar ba Huzaifa baijira cewar shiba ya fita da sauri shima maye mashi baya yayi yana zuwa ya iske Yarima Haishir yana dukan Bahijja har kwallo yakeyi da ita wani irin bacin raine ya dabaibaye zuciyar MalikusSaif baisan sadda yai kukan kuraba ya ingije Haishir ba har saida ya kusan kifewa kas, a tsorace ya kalli Yarima Malik wanda tuni idanun shi sun sauya kala tsabar bacin rai, itako Bahijja da sauri ta koma bayan Malik duk jikinta ya kama  kyarma kamar zata faɗi, shiko Haishir mamaki yakeyi miya haɗa Yarima Ƙamar da Bahijja harya nuna fushi dan anbigeta buɗa baki yayi yace.......

Episode 21&22




"Zaki fito daga bayan shi ko kuwa saina canza maki kaman ni."?
Juyawa Yarima Malik yayi yaga yanda jikin Bahijja ke kyarma duk tsoro ya gama addabar rayuwar ta, ta gama tsurewa.
kallan Yarima Haishir yayi yace. "Kai ko miya ja maka dukan mace?kake ta kumfar baki sai dai kace ka haɗu da Jarumi irin ka!? waima mi tayi maka har haka."?
Ya karasa maganar da siffar zolaya, ajiyar zuciya Yarima Haishir ya sauke sannan yace. "Miya haɗa ta da abincin ku, ku sa'annin tane daman wannan yarinyar ba kunyar kirki tasani ba da kabarni na ɓallata tunda bata hankali."
dafa kafardar Haishir yayi da karfi saida ya kalli Malik dan ba kadan yaji cafkar da MalikusSaif  yaima shi  ba, cikeda da ƙaƙƙausar murya Yarima MalikusSaif yace.
"Haba abokina maida wukar nine nace taci kuma ma miye a ciki dan na bata abinci? ba hadimar ka bace."?
Yaso yaima Bahijja kaca kaca saidai kwarjinin da Malik yaima shi  bazai barshi ba ya ida abinda yai niya ba, saiya samu kanshi da cewa. "Shikenan badamuwa tunda kaine ka bata, ke kuma daga yau idan kikazo aiki kiyi abinda ya kamace ki, inafatan kin fahimta, yanzun kije ki gyaraman ɗakina."
Jiki sanyaye Bahijja tayi hanyar dakin shi da ido suka bita  shiko Yarima Malik cigaba yayi da tunani kamar ba abinda ya faru kowa yana sakar zuci wanda tambayoyi iri iri suka addabi Yarima Haishir saidai baida amsar su, ba abinda yafi ɗaga mashi hankali yanda Yarima Ƙamar ya nuna fushi dan ya bugi baiwa ko shima dai ya kamu da son Bahijjar ne, kai daga ganin ta, ban tunanin zai sota, wanda a zahiri yake zancen duk da baisan ya fita, Huzaifa ne ya kalli Malik, jin abinda Yarima Haishir ke cewa itako Bahijja tana gyaran gado tana kwalla ta tsani Yarima Haishir mugune dan taci abinci shine yake neman illata ta gaskia baida imani, badan Kyakkyawan Yarima yazo ba da shikenan yau saiya lahanata haka ta ida aikin ta sannan ta fito ta tafi masaukin su, ta kwanta kafin ta koma aikin marece......

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce wajen Saifulislam kowa yayi shiru da alama ransu ne a ɓace, saboda fuskokin sune suka bayyana hakan, ganin yanda Saifulislam ya nuna bacin rai a fili hakan yasa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace.
 "Haba Abu Malik banyi tsamma nin wannan abun zai ɓata maka raiba, narasa dalilin dayasa akan bayin nan kake nuna damuwarka a zahiri, bayan duk abinda ke faruwa sune sila kai kuma baka ganin laifin su."
baisan sadda ya daka mata tsawa ba da karfi yace. "Yimin shiru Zulaiƙa karki saka raina ya ɓaci a banza a wofi abinda kikeyi a cikin Masarautar nan ya wuce gona da iri yanzun jibi yanda kikasa ana azabtar da bayin Allah, ina ruwan Abdulmajid dan MalikusSaif  yatafi neman Bahijja ai basu suka aike suba, shine zakita yimasu azaba wlh ina gaya maki ki guji sakayyar ubangiji wannan dalilin yasa ko kusa ban shiga cikin sabgar mulkin ki gudun ɓacin rai dan haka kada insake jin bakin ki kije kiyi duk abinda kikaga dama damuwar kice, kada kisaki tunkarata da kalar wannan maganar aikin banza aikin wofi.!"


Baki ɗaya idanun Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sun sauya dan ɓacin rai tarasa mi zatace ma Saifulislam ganin yanda ranshi yai mugun ɓaci hakan yasa ta fita daga sashen shi ta tafi nata, tana zuwa ta iske Binta na share share tunda taga yanda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta shigo takara kama kanta gaidata tayi wani wulakantaccen kallo ta azama Binta batasan ta sadda kanta kasa ba, shiga tayi dakinta ta rufo kofa saman gado ta faɗa ta rasa abinyi sai tunanin maganganun Mijinta takeyi wani ɓagaren na zuciyar ta kuwa cike take da jin haushin Yarima MalikusSaif tasan shine ya jaza mata duk abinda ke faruwa..... 

A gidan yarin Daborah kuwa ba abinda ya sauya tunda ciwon ciki ya turnike Abdulmajid haka aka barshi wanwar sanyin marece ne ya busashi hakan yasa ya tashi jiki ba kwari duk ya mutu, kallan mutanen wajen ya dingayi Sarkin bulala ne ya bashi aikin gyaran wajen dawakai, haka ya dinga kwasar kashin dawakai shida Ashir, shima ba wani ragi da yake samu saima abinda yayi gaba kullin sai anmashi bulala sama da hamsin, duk yabi ya lalace ya susuce idan ba sanin kirki kaima Ashir ba bazaka iya gane shi ba. 


Koda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta fito daga dakin ta kiran Binta tayi tana zuwa ta duƙa ta gaidata kanta a kasa, shiru tayi tana jiran taji mi uwar dakin tata zatace mata.
"Ke baiwa ƴar bayi ta taɓa kunnan bayi uwa ga bayi, ubanwa yabaki damar da zan aika kiranki kiki zuwa sai yanzun da kika ga dama."?
Rasa abin cewa Binta tayi duk da tasaba jin wukakancin da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ke mata, cikin rawar murya tace. "Ranki shidade banda lafiya a lokacin shiyasa.....kifamata mari tayi har ukku sannan tasa ƙafa ta halbata har saida ta faɗi kasa kanta ya bugi kasa jinine ya fara zuba, kwalla kara tayi ko motsin kirki batayi, haka Sarauniya Zulaiƙa taci gaba da yimata masifa ganin bata motsi,kiran wata baiwa tayi tasa aka ɗauketa kamar marar rai sawa tayi aka fidda  Binta waje sai kace dabba su kansu bayin da sukayi jifa da Binta saida sukayi kwalla, wata baiwa ce Hansa'u taga abinda akaima Binta haka ta ruga ta kira Mairo a sashen Saifulislam  ta gaya mata halin da Binta ke ciki, da gudu suka iso dukawa tayi ta riko hannun Binta jin bata motsi taji gaban ta yayi mummunan faɗuwa, da sauri tasa aka ɗebo ruwa aka yayyafa mata farfaɗowa tayi, kamata sukayi suka maida ta turakar bayi, sukai tayi mata fiffita ko magana Binta ta kasa yi saidai kwalla da suketa sunturi a saman fuskarta sai ƙarƙaɗa kai takeyi tana kwalla tana san tayi magana, amman jitake zuciyar ta zata iya fashewa, Mairo ce ke goge mata kwalla tana bata hakuri, da sauri Ladidi ta faɗo itama kukan ne ta fashe dashi tace. "Binta miyasa meki kanki ke jini?
Mairo  miyasa mu Ummu Bahijja dan Allah kuyi mani magana." ranar haka sukaita kuka kowa ji yake zuciyar shi ba dadi, musamman Binta da takasa furta ko kalma ɗaya dan ɓacin rai daya addabi zuciyar ta......

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A Masarautar Raifasu kuwa Baidulƙais ne kwance saman gadon shi cikin mawuyacin hali wani irin shi'awar Bahijja ne ya addabi rayuwar shi ko motsin kirki ya kasa ga zufa na tsastsago mashi yayi sharkaf sai juyi yakeyi ya rike marar shi sai murɗama shi takeyi tun yana saman gado har saida ya faɗo kasa, numfashin shine yafara ɗaukewa kamar zai mutu, da kyal ya rarrafa ya isa banɗaki ruwa ya ɗiba ya dinga shekama kanshi ruwa ko yaji sanyi amman feeling ke kara addabar shi hakan yasa ya diɓe kayan shi yafara wasa dick dinshi kamar karama kanshi bala'i yakeyi fashewa yayi da kuka mai cinrai yana kiran sunan Bahijja tun yanayi a zuciya harya fara kiran sunan ta da karfi, samun wani tsumma yayi yai mashi rami yasa dick dinshi yana dukan wajen amman a banza ranar haka Baidulƙais ya yini cikin daki yana kwasar azaba da bala'in da baitaɓa jin irin shiba baisan sadda ya shiɗe wajen ba wanwar kasa a sume cikin bathroom haihuwar uwar shi a wulkance.... 



 *Niko ƴar mutan kankia nace ai Allah ba azzalumin bawa bane duk abinda mutun zai aikata karshe kanshi ke karewa*


Itako Jakadiyya shigowa tayi falon Sarki Baidulƙais tasa bayi aka fara gyara shi, jin shiru bai fito ba hakan yasa ta tashi ta shiga dakin shi ta fara  kwankwasa kofa takai minti goma bataji yayi magana ba,tana turo kofa taga ta buɗe, shiga tayi taga gadan duk ya ya mutse kamar anyi kokowa a saman shi bin dakin tayi da kallo ba taga komai ba, har zata fita taji kamar gurnani a ban daki, gabanta ne ya faɗi a hankali ta nufi ban dakin taga kofa a bude alamun ba kowa, a cikin kewayen harta juya sai tace bari ta rufo kewayen tasa baiwa ta gyara dakin taga duk yayi datti da yawa, tana shiga zataja kofa taji wani abu ya tokare kofar dubawar da zatayi taga Sarki Baidulƙais kwance haihuwar uwar shi, bata san sadda ta saki ihu ba rufe bakin ta tayi ta rufe idon ta bakaramin tashin hankali ta shiga ba, ko kallan shi takasayi, ganin alamun bai motsi yasa ta dibi ruwa ta zuba mashi ajiyar zuciya ya sauke, tai saurin barin kewayen, shi ko dukan kanshi ya fara a saman kofa yana cewa. "Bahijja kidawo gareni kizo ki ceci rayuwa ta bazan iya bake ba Bahijja kizo ki tallafeni, rashin samun ki zai lalata mani mulkina kinji abinda Sarrilƙus ya faɗa Bahijja ina shi'awarki Bahijja, duk da Jakadiyya tana cikin dakin wajen gado amman taji abinda Baidulƙais kecewa godiya taima Allah da yasa  Bahijja tabar Masarautar Raifasu tasan da zuwa yanzun Sarki Baidulƙais ya gama lalata Bahijja, shiko da kyal ya iya yunkurawa ya tashi daura mayafi yayi ya iso cikin dakin itako Jakadiyya dukawa tayi tafara gyaran dakin alamun mai aiki, yana kallan ta ya kauda kai kamar baisan da itaba, wata doguwar rigace ya ɗauko ya zira dawowa saman gado yayi ya zauna, itako Jakadiyya gaida shi tayi kamar bazaiyi magana ba sai kuma yace. "Jamra ina zanga Bahijja."?  Jitayi gabanta ya faɗi, cikin dakewa tace "ranka shidade sai inga gaskia Bahijja bata cikin wannan nahiyar tamu saidai ya kamata  kasa a nemota kodan lafiyar ta." ta gama maganar tana yin dariyar kasan makoshi, wani irin tsaki yaja yace.
"Nan da kwana ukku zanje da kaina ɗauko Bahijja ko in mutu ko in rayu Bahijja saita dawo kalkashin ikona a wannan Masarautar ta Raifasu sai dai in ban raye kisa wannan a ranki Jamra..... 

*****************************
Bayan isha'i Binta ce zaune ta buga uban tagumi ta rasa yanda zatayi da ranta, saibin su Mairo takeyi da idanu jitayi tace.
"Mairo kibani abinda zanci in mutu in huta da wannan rayuwar da nike ciki Mairo dan Allah ki tausaya mani." rike hannun Binta tayi tace. "Haba yaya miyasa zakice haka kidan gana da Allah yana sane da duk wani hali da muke ciki kin manta wanda yai niyar kashe kanshi ko ya kashe kanshi shin mizakice ma ubangijin ki, ki tuba zuwa ga Allah kibarma Allah komai, shi Abdulmajid yayi me da ake ninninka mashi azaba kowane lokaci kiyi hakri kibarma Allah lamarin ki a matsayinki na uwa dan Allah." cikin tausayawa Ladidi tace. "Haka maganar ki take Mairo nasan, kinada hakuri to kikara akai kuma ki jajirce ƴar uwata." batasan sadda tafara murmushi ba take ta nemi duk wata damuwarta ta yaye a cikin zuciyar ta, rungume Mairo tayi tana hawaye,  tarasa kona minene, itako bubbuga bayan ta ta dinga  yi da sigar lallashi.

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Masarautar Waisu kuwa, Bahijja ce keta aikin ta kamar yanda ta saba, wannan lokacin a dakin Yarima Haishir take tana ta gyara gadon shi, shi kuma yana banɗaki yana wanka, sauri kawai takeyi taga ta gama aikin ta taje ta huta, tana cikin shinfiɗa zanin gado taji an riko mata kugu mutuwar tsaye tayi, taji gabanta yafara dukan tara tara juyowa tayi ta banka shi da karfin tsiya, amman ko gezau baiyi ba, hakan yasa ya banka ta saman gado yayi kanta, zillewa taji ya rike mata hannu da karfin tsiya, a wajen MalikusSaif kuwa yana zaune sai duba agogo yake yana jiran yaga Bahijja ta shigo dakin su amman ya jita shiru, tashi yayi yafara zarya yaje ya dawo yaje ya dawo, ya rasa yanda zaiyi, shiko Huzaifa kallan Malik kawai yakeyi ganin yanda ya damu kanshi akan Bahijja a cikin ranshi kuwa cewa yayi Allah yasa dai  abokina ba son yarinyar nan ne ya shige shiba, inko hakan ta kasance gaskia akwai damuwa sosai, yana cikin sakar zuci yaji MalikusSaif ya taɓa shi yace. "Huzaifa inaji araina akwai abinda ke faruwa da Bahijja shiyasa bata zo dakin nan aikin taba gaskia so nike yau din nan mubar Masarautar nan." cikin kulawa Huzaifa yace. "Gaskia ne nima ina bukatar mubar Masarautar nan a yau nima nagaji da zama cikin ta,sannan karka ce  haka lafiya lau Bahijja take....yana ida magana saiga wata baiwa ta shigo ta kawo masu abinci ajewa tayi ta gaida su, harzata tafi taji Yarima Malik yace. "Ke ina yarinyar dake gyara dakin nan."?
A daburce tace "ranka shidade tun dazun tazo inaji tana cikin dakin Yarima Haishir dan tajima da shiga saidai....daga mata hannu yayi ji yayi zuciyar shi na dukan tara tara, baisan sadda ya fita ba, yayi dakin Yarima Haishir, da har zai shiga sai kuma ya tsaya kasa kasa yaji kamar maganar Bahijja tana cewa "kasakeni kai azzalumi ne  baka isa kaci zarafi naba." da karfi yasa kafa ya halba kofar dakin ya shiga iske shi yayi ya matse Bahijja a kirjin shi yana sinsinar wuyanta, itako ta makale bakin ta sannan tana dukan shi iyakar karfin ta, shiko MalikusSaif take idanun ta suka kaɗa sukayi jajir kamar garwashi baisan sadda ya isa ba yasa hannu ya fisgo Bahijja jikin shi kamar ƴar baby, cikin ɓacin rai baisan sadda, ya cillata gefe guda ba, sai a lokacin Yarima Haishir ya dawo tunanin shi jin yanda Yarima Malik ya shaki wuyan shi yakai mashi duka har ukku take bakin shi ya fashe da jini, a rude Yarima Haishir yace "haba Ƙamar miye laifi na dan na huta da baiwa ta."dai dai nan Huzaifa ya iso ya anshe Haishir hannun Malik ya fara  tattausar Malik fisgewa yayi ya fita ya koma dakin su, shiko Huzaifa hakuri ya fara ba Haishir yace.
"Kayi hakri abokina kasan halin Ƙamar bai yarda aci zarafin mace ba daman yau zamu tafi sai kayi yanda kake so da ita kayi hakuri abokina." cikeda gamsuwa yace. "Bakomai nasan bacin raine ya kawo hakan ba komai." shima tafiya yayi ya koma masaukin su, koda MalikusSaif ya isa dakin ya gama hada komai sawa yayi aka kira mashi Bahijja koda sakon Malik ya iske ta, jitayi kamar tai fitsari dan tsoro ta rasa dalilin da yasa take jin tsoron kyakkyawan Yarima, dan haka take kiran shi, jiki sage ta iso dakin dukawa yayi tace gani, wani mugun kallo yajefa mata, fuskar shi ba alamun annuri a cikin ta yace......

kamar bazai kuma cewa komai ba sai kuma yace. "Zaki iya gane iyayenki a halin yanzun."? Da eh ta amsa saidai tace. " da na  manta suna Masarautar da aka ɗaukoni amman daga baya Yarima Haishir shine ya ansoni hannun wasu mutane daga Masarautar Raifasu shine yace zai kaini wajen iyayena a Masarautar Daborah sannan zai maidani wajen Ya Malik dina." ta karasa maganar tana kuka mai tsuma zuciya, shi kanshi yai mamaki dan baiyi tsammanin zata iya tuna sunan shi ba, duk da yasan da wahala idan bata manta da kamannin shiba, tausayinta ne yakara kama shi cikin zuciyar shi, cewa yayi ki daina kuka Bahijja Ya Malik dinki ya dawo gareki kuma sai ya mai daki wajen iyayenki da izinin Allah, a zahiri cewa yayi.  *Toh masoyan MalikusSaif da Bahijja yaudai gasu sun hadu a zahiri bari muga taya za'ayi MalikusSaif ya iya fita da Bahijja a cikin Masarautar Waisu😁 nidai nayi 🏃🏻‍♀️Daborah inga wainar da ake toyawa.....*


A wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuwa zuwa tayi wajen Mijinta iskeshi tayi yana nafila zama tayi gefen shi ya gama abinda yakeyi yana gamawa ya waigo ya kalleta ya ɗauke kanshi gefe daya, cikin damuwa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta kama haɓar shi ta juyo da shi suna facing juna cikin sanyin murya tace. "Haba Mijina dame zanji tafiyar MalikusSaif ko kuwa  fushin da kakeyi dani koda abokan gaba kasan kaine ke kwantar mani da hankali a lokacin da nike cikin damuwa."cewa yayi "naji magana ta wuce saidai kisani kama Jaruman ki da kikayi bakaramin tsautsayi bane ko wane lokaci za'a iya kawo maki hari daga makiya."

 _Masarautar Waisu_ 


A wajen  su Yarima MalikusSaif kuwa, koda Yarima Haishir ya shigo yaji abinda suke cewa sannan ga kamannin MalikusSaif nan sun bayyana cikin fushi ya nuna MalikusSaif da ɗan yatsa yace.
"MalikusSaif ashe kaine kazo dan ka ha'inceni kaci amana ta ashe daman da biyu kazo cikin Masarautar Waisu, kana nufin kazo ne dan ka ɗauki baiwa ta Bahijja shine kahanani ɗanɗanar zumarta data dade tana addabata sama da shekaru masu yawa dan haka yau dinnan basai gobe ba saina cimma burina akan Bahijja, sannan baza kabar Masarautar Waisu ba da kafarka saidai kanka ya rigaka isa Daborah!  kaida wannan sakaran Huzaifan nan dan haka yau din nan zan koya maka hankali kuma yanzun a gaban idanka zan ɓare Bahijja a cikin ledar ta."

Kaman nin MalikusSaif  sun gama sauyawa ba karamin ɓacin rai bane ya kamashi ba jin kalaman da Yarima Haishir ke jefo mashi marassa dadin sauraro, naɗe hannuwan shi yayi ɗaya bisa ɗaya yaima Yarima Haishir nuni alamar karya fasa, ganin yayi tsaye hakan yasa Yarima MalikusSaif ya fisgo Bahijja dake tsaye bayan Huzaifa ta gama tsorata da abinda Yarima Haishir yace, yana riko hannun ta ya wurgama Haishir yace. "Gatanan inka cika Yariman Waisu hannun ka ya taɓa Bahijja." daya tsaya sai kuma yaga inbaita ɓataba tamkar ya tsorata ne baisan sadda yakai hannu zai taɓa jikin Bahijja ba, wani irin tsalla Yarima Malik yayi ya rike hannun Yarima Haishir ya murɗe saida sukayi kara wani uban ihu ya saki ji yake kamar zai mutu, dan azaba kiciniyar anshe hannun shi ya farayi ya rasa yanda zaiyi da Malik baisan sadda ya kara sakin wata azababbar kara ba shiko Yarima Malik juyo da Haishir yayi ya wanke shi da lafiyayyun maruka har hudu take jini ya balle har hakoran shi guda hudu suka fita sama da kasa, sannan yasa ƙafa ya halba shi ya fadi kasa duk jini, shiko sai kwalla ihu yakeyi hakan yasa mai kula da sashen shi yaji karar ihun Yarima baisan sadda ya shigo da gudu ba suko su Malik fiddo takubban suka fiddo da kibiyoyi suna jiran koda ta kwana sannan ya rike hannun Bahijja sarke da nashi, fitowa sukayi cikin falon Yarima Haishir nan sukayi karo da wannan bawan mai kula da sashen Haishir, wuce su yayi ya shiga dakin da suka fito Haishir ne kwance sai gunza yakeyi dan azaba, cema shi yayi ya bisu zasu gudu da Bahijja Yarima MalikusSaif ne, ai da sauri ya tashi yabisu da gudu yafara hura usur cikin kankanin lokaci jarumai sun fara hawan dawakai, da takubba sunbi su Yarima Malik, suko sai gudu suke kasa cikin Masarautar Waisu, suna cikin gudu sukaNga Jarumai sunkai ashirin sunsha gaban su aiko MalikusSaif  ya ɗauko kibiya yafara halbinsu shida Huzaifa suka fara kisar su, haka sukaita ratse Jarumai har suka kai wajen dawakan su suka hau a gaba ya aza Bahijja sannan suk fara doka uban gudu cikin kankanin lokaci labari ya karade Masarautar Waisu Yarima MalikusSaif yazo ya ɗauki Bahijja haka Jarumai sukaita binsu da takubba suko sai ruwan kibiyoyi suke ma Jaruman Waisu, koda sukazo kofar fita Masarautar nan ma sama da mutun goma suka iske sun kewaye kofar tundaga nesa Huzaifa ya dinga yimasu ruwan kibiya shi kuma Malik yana kula da Bahijja koda yaga Huzaifa ya karar dasu sai Sarkin kofa wani mashine Yarima Malik ya zaro a bayan shi ya ɗana ma Sarkin kofa a saman makoshi take ya mutu, Huzaifa ne ya sauka ya bude masu kofa suka fita sai gudun mutuwa sukeyi. 
Koda labari ya isa wajen Sarki Lahazu cikin fushi  yace.


"Ina son Jarumai guda talatin kubi su insan ku kawo mani gawar Yarima MalikusSaif, kubisu komai rintsi komai wuya." 
haka kuwa akayi, sawa yayi aka dinga kwaso gawar wakin Jaruman da aka kashe sunkai talatin cikin ranshi ko cewa yayi lallai MalikusSaif inka gaji Sarki Jabbar ba abinda baza kai ba kuma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ba raguwa bace mace mai kamar maza kwari ke babu amman wannan karan saina yi ajalin ka, cikin fushi yayi sashen Yarima Haishir ya iske shi fuska kumbure bugun bango yayi ya kalli Haishir yace. "Wawa dakai sakarai a wannan lokacin so kake ka nuna mani cewa Yarima MalikusSaif zaiyi galaba akanka kamar yanda yayi ga Yarima Husbarulƙais lallai da baka da anfani agareni yau gashi wani banza yazo har cikin Masarauta ta ya cima ɗana mutunci, jibi yanda ya cire maka hakora kabani kunya Haishir baka san komai ba sai bin mata kayi asara, dan haka yau basai gobe ba nikeson kaf Jarumai na su haɗa gangamin Yaki zuwa Masarautar Daborah dan haka ni da uwar sa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa zanyi Sarkin Yaki maza kasa a hadaman gangamin yakin da bantaɓa haɗa irin shiba a cikin rayuwata ba.!" haka akayi kuwa dan da nan Sarkin Yaki ya fara yin abinda Sarki Lahazu ya umurce shi.


Suko su Yarima Malik basu fasa gudu ba haka sukaita kisar Jaruman da suke binsu da yake su Jaruman Waisu takubba ke garesu, suko su MalikusSaif suna da kibiyoyi haka sukai tafiya mai nisan gaske har suka isa wani waje Bahijja ce ta kwantar da kanta saman kirjin Yarima MalikusSaif ji take mararta na katsa mata cewa tayi. "Ya Malik kishir ruwa nikeji zan mutu." a rude yace. "Kiyi hakuri yanzun zamu tsaya." Huzaifa ne yaga sun tsaya shima tsayawa yayi yace. "Yarima muna cikin wannan halin ina mu ina tsaywa."? "Huzaifa Bahijja kejin kishi hannun ka akwai ruwa."?  Zuwa yayi wajen dokin shi ya dauki silkar ruwa ya mikama Malik, ansa yayi yaba Bahijja ruwa,  tana cikin sha sukaji mutane sun, zagaye su......kardai ku manta👇

 _Best of 2k21_


بسم الله الرحمن الر حيم



 *Wannan labarin ƙirƙirarren labari ne kamar yanda kukaji tun a Book One, banyi shi dan cin zarafin wani ba, wanda yai dai dai da rayuwar shi aimin afuwa akasine🙏* 



Episode 25&26




Ware idanu Bahijja tayi take taji cikin ta ya sake  murɗawa bata san sadda ta rike hannun Malik ba, kallanta yayi da kagan ta kasan tana cikin matsanancin tsoro a cikin zuciyar ta, a dake Yarima Malik ya kalle su ɗaya bayan ɗaya shida Huzaifa a kalla zasu kai su goma saidai kowa da takobi a hannun su, shiru ne ya biyo baya, da sauri wani katan Jarumi ya fisgo Bahijja a hannun Malik ya ɗaura mata wuka a wuya ita ko  baiwar Allah baki ɗaya tagama tsurewa zawone kawai batayi ba dan tsoro daya gama addabar rayuwar ta, dukawa sukayi shida Huzaifa kamar zasu aje takubban su alamun sun mika wuya.
damko kasa sukayi a hannun su, suka mike tisa keyarsu akayi gaba Yarima Malik ne ya kafe alamun bai tafiya, wani ne ya kwada mashi tsawa yace. " zann kashe ta muddin baka tafi ba." jin haka yasa Yarima Malik ya watsa kasar hannun shi cikin idanuwan su shima  Huzaifa watsa masu ta hannun shi yayi da sauri suka ɗauki takubban su suka sauke masu kai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, saida suka kusan karar dasu, suka ga wasu mutanen sun biyo su, haka yasa suka haye saman dawakan su, sukaci gaba da bada wuta iya wuta sai kace masu gudun barin kasar baki dayan ta saida sukai masu fintin kau ko hangen su basuyi tsabar gudu...... 


 _Raifasu_ 


Yau kam  ba laifi ciwon cikin daya addabi rayuwar Sarki Baidulƙais ya ɗan saki tunda harya iya zuwa fa'da dan cigaba da fa'danci sai dai kana ganin shi zakasan ya rame ba kadan ba yai baki, Sarkin Yaki ne yakawo mashi taswirar Masarautar Daborah aka bajeta a cikin fa'da ana duba yanda tsarin garin yake da cikin Masarautar baki ɗaya dan so yake wannan karon ya wargaza tarihin Masarautar Daborah harma da Sarauniyar ta baki ɗaya, haka suka haɗu shida Jaruman shi sukaci gaba da yan kulle kullen da dubarun yaki dan cimma burin su.... 


A gidan yari  kuwa zuwa yanzun su Tasi'u sun gama fita kamannin su da ka gansu kasan yunwa kadai ma ta gama yimusu illa balle kuma kullin da kalar ukubar da ake gana masu na gobe daban ba jibi daban tun suna saka ran taimako daga wajen Yariman su har sun fara fidda rai sun gama saduda dan da yawan  su sunaji inama sun mutu da sun huta da azabar da zasu dinga fuskanta ta yau da gobe.
Itako Uwani yau uwar dakin ta gimbiya Yazira takai mata ziyara sai dai  badan ta duba lafiyar ta bane, taje ne dan ta gayama ta  inda ta aje layar da bokan ta ya bata ta sa'a, koda Uwani taji dalilin zuwan uwar ɗakin ta, bakaramin bakin ciki bane ya takore mata kahon zuciya ba, da batai niyar gaya mata inda layar take ba,  saidai gudun abinda zaije ya yadawo yasa Uwani ta faɗi inda ta aje layar tanaji tana gani gimbiya Yazira ta tafi ta barta ko tausanta ba taji ba duk irin wahalar da taimata abanza a wofi kenan ta  tashi a banza ko arzikin ruwa bata da  shi a wajen gimbiya Yazira bare tasa ran zata kawo mata kwanon abinci wani irin bakin cikine ya turnike Uwani batansan sadda tab rushe da kuka ba, itako gimbiya Yazira cikin ɓacin rai tace ma Sarkin horo daga zuwan ta Uwani ta cika mata kunne da kuka dan haka ya ladabtar mata da ita haka ya kama Uwani saida ya sauke mata bulala hamsin, ya cika umurnin gimbiya Yazira, sannan yai mata talatin da yamma, kafin zuwa dare yaimata wata talatin din ta bacci, haka rayuwa ta dinga zuwa ma Uwani da salo iri iri na ganin sakayya tun a gidan duniya, danko ba abinda yakara sosa mata rai kamar yanda gimbiya Yazira tasa aka duketa, tana komawa dakin da ake rufe su ta cigaba  da kuka mai sosa zuciya, wata baiwa ce mai mulkin wajen takama Uwani takara naɗa mata dan karan duka, ranar da zazzabi Uwani ta kwana.


 _Ayyah Uwani miye a ciki aiba kiga  komai daman ance alhaki kuikwiyone kuma meshi yake bi haka duniya take_ 

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A Masarautar Ƙaisu kuwa Sarki Danwar ne a fa'da ya haɗa mutanen shi yace. "A kallah yau kwana ukku da aiko mani da sako daga Masarautar Raifasu ya kamata  ace munba Sarki Baidulƙais hadin kai akan wannan kudirin nashi na da gargaza karfin iko na Sarauniya Zulaiƙa dan haka inaso nan da kwana ukku kuci gaba da hada gangamin Yaki sannan zamu haɗu da Jaruman Masarautar Raifasu dan yakar Jaruman Masarautar Daborah  dan haka inasan kowa ya dag, kunsan dai suwa muke niyar tunkara wannan karon so nike inga kun kawo mani kan Yarima MalikusSaif shine kadai abinda za'ayi ana kasa  rayuwar Sarauniya Zulaiƙa." cikeda gamsuwa Sarkin Yaki da Jama'ar shi suka tafi dan fara shirin zuwa Masarautar Daborah......

 ~Masarautar Waisu~ 

A wajen Yarima Haishir kuwa cikin kankanin lokaci kamanin shi sun sauya gimbiya Ƙamariyya ce ta tsaya tana ba ɗan nata kulawa ba karamin takaici ne ya kamata  ba, danko Sarki Lahazu baida lokacin ɓatawa kullin yana wajen Jaruman shi dan ganin suna karbar horo na musamman wani bima har dashi  ake gwajin dan ya ɗauki alwashin saiya kashe Yarima MalikusSaif da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sune kadai matsalar shi a duniya musamman da yazo  ya nakasa mashi rayuwar ɗa ya sauya mashi kamanni, wannan dalilin yasa kullin cikin shiri yake ba dare ba rana abu guda kawai sukeyi a cikin Masarautar Waisu....... 

 ```Masarautar Daborah``` 


A wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuwa zaune take tare da Waziri Dammur mahaifin Yarima Huzaifa suna shawarar yanda zasu fiddo da Sarkin Yakin ta duk kunya da dana sani sun addabi rayuwar Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, shima kanshi yarasa mafita, cewa yayi. "Ya kamata  mukai masu ziyara sai mu bukaci zaman sulhu ko shawara da Sarkin Yakin shi kadai in yaso daga baya sai a fddo dasu Lurwan inaga hakan zaifi kinga cikin ruwan sanyi mungyara wannan kuskuren ba tareda Sarkin Yaki ya gane komai ba, kinsan halin shi akwai saurin fushi."
kaɗa kai tayi alamun ba damuwa, tashi sukayi sukaje filin da ake ba Jaruman ta kulawa ta musamman dan ba laifi ta hada Jaruman dan dai ba duka ta saka ba sun ɗauki kashi daya a cikin hudu, wannan karon kuwa Yazid ne dan Sarkin fa'da ke bada gwaji na musamman dan aikin su kenan sallah kadai ke ta dasu, danko koda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa taje itama cigaba daba Jaruman ta gwaji tayi haka suka wuni sunayi daga karshe ta wuce sashen ta dan hutawa kafin gobe taje wajen Sarkin Yaki kamar yanda Wazirin ta yabata shawara. 


A turakar bayi kuwa Binta ce ke jifgar uban wankin ta dan tajima bata samu lokacin kanta ba bare ta wanke kayan dattin ta ita dana mai gidan ta Abdulmajid haka tayi tagama sannan tai sallah ta samu abin sakama bakin salati taci, sannan ta fita ta cigaba da rabama sauran bayi aikin su, itama tafiya tayi nata aikin kamar yanda tasaba.

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Suko sunci uban gudu har sungode ma Allah har Allah yasa suka bar yankin Masarautar Waisu baki ɗayan ta yanzun sun iso magamar hanya, inda suka hau wadda zata sadasu da Masarautar Daborah wadda tayi gabas kenan wannan karon tafiya suka dinga yi cikin sassarfa itako Bahijja sai murna takeyi zata ga Umman ta da Abban ta, shiko MalikusSaif wani irin farin ciki yakeji yau gashi ya dawo da Bahijja zataci gaba dayi mashi hidima kamar yanda aka alkawalta mashi tun tana ƴar jaririyar ta.


 *Nikodai Jameey nace anya MalikusSaif  wannan alqawalin baisha karaba? Amman muje zuwa muga yanda zata kaya a cikin Masarautar Daborar......*


Koda masu bibiyar su MalikusSaif suka ga  sun ɓace masu bat hakan yasa suka juya dan gayama Sarki Lahazu halin da ake ciki.

A wajen Abdulmajid kuwa yaudai da sauki dan anrage dukan su kasancewr batasu akeba a halin yanzun ta shirin Yaki Masarautar Daborah takeyi tanajiran isowar abokan gabarta a kowane lokaci, a wajen gimbiya Zahara'u kuwa wato kanwar Yarima Huzaifa ƴa ga Wazirin Daborah zaune take a cikin kayataccen dakin ta sai kwalliya takeyi tanasan taje takai ma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ziyarar ban girma haka baiwar ta ta gama taya ta shiryawa sannan suka tafi sai wannan ɗaukar kai takeyi tanajin ta  kamar wata Sarauniya Zulaiƙa  baki daya haka taita yauki harta isa sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tana isa ta iske Binta nata aiki, doɗe hancin ta tayi ta watsar da miyau cikin kyama ta raɓa Binta ta wuce wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tana zuwa ta rungume ta sannan suka gaisa cikin so da kauna, cikin kilbibi gimbiya Zahara'u tace.
"Ummu wai har yanzun Yarima na baidawo ba gaskia Ummu dana tuna baiwa yaje ɗaukowa sai naji natsani komai, inashi ina ɗauko baiwa." takarasa maganar a shagwabe itako Sarauniya Zulaiƙa cikin kulewa tace. "Kedai bari  Ƴata ni kaina  ina da nasanin wannan baiwar da uwarta kin gani ni kadai  nasan abinda zan masu idan suka dawo."sake marere cewa tayi tace. "Ummu kafana yaimani tsami inaso adanna mani ita."
wani kallo Sarauniya Zulaiƙa  taima Binta ba shiri ta aje aikinta tazo haka gimbiya Zahara'u ta aza kafarta saman cinyar Binta da gayya ita kuma taci gaba da danna mata kafar, suna ci gaba da tsinema Bahijja albarka a gaban ta  sai cimasu fuska akeyi amman a haka ta cigaba da danna ma gimbiya Zahara'u kafarta har saida ta ɗauke dan kanta, cikin yanga ta mike sai yaƙuna takeyi tace. "Ummu zan tafi in huta bacci nikeji." cikin so da kauna Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace. "Kiyi bacci mai dadi ƴar albarka, kikula da kanki kyakkyawar ƴata." haka ta tafi sai yauki takeyi.... 


Da marece likis gari yai sanyi bakaji komai sai kaɗawar iska wajen yayi kyau yana fidda sanyi ba mai cutar waba Bahijja ce zaune saman wani dutsi a cikin daji gefen ruwa tana jefa dutse a hankali cikin nutsuwa baki daya ta shige duniyar tunanin abubuwan da suka dinga faruwa da ita, tana ta alajabi wai itace zata koma cikin Masarautar su wajen iyayen ta, jibtake kamar tai tsuntsuwa taganta jikin Umman ta, tana cikin tunani taji zazzaƙar muryar MalikusSaif ta daki dodon kunnen ta batasan  sadda ta ɗan rufe ido ba sannan ta bude su a hankali ta azasu saman kyakkyawar fuskar shi mai shagaltar da ita daga kallan shi, duk da ba wani murmushi yaiba sai taga yakara mata kyau fiye da zatan ta wata leda ce ya mikama ta yace. "Tunanin mi kikeyi ne haka, ga abinci kici kada yunwa ta kamaki."
yanda yai maganar yasa ta ɗan saki murmushi har saida hakoran ta suka bayyana, shima mayar mata da martani yayi, ya rasa dalilin da yasa  farin cikin Bahijja ke saka  shi nishadi da jin dadi tun tana ƴar kankanuwar ta, itako mamaki lamarin Ya Malik dinta ke bata, wai kar yunwa takama ni  ai tuni aikin gama ya gama Ya Malik tunda na kasance  a baiwa saidai in godema  Allah, duk da a zuci take maganar ta saidai duk sunji abinda tace, Huzaifa ne ya kalli Malik take yaga tsantsar tausayin Bahijja a cikin kwayar idanun shi, shima ƙada kai yayi alamar tausaya wa , itako cigaba dacin abincin ta tayi har lumshe ido takeyi dan ba kadan takejin dadin shi ba, har ta karasa ta wanke hannun ta, sake mikomata ruwa yayi ta ansa a ranta ko cewa tayi ohni Bahijja kaga inacin abinci dan danan nacinye ba sabanba, Allah dai yasaka maka da alkhairy amintaccen Yarima kaceci rayuwa ta da yanzun bansan a wane hali zan shiga ba, haka tagama shan ruwan ta sannan suka gabatar da sallah, sukaci gaba da tafiyar su, dan gab suke da su karasa cikin Masarautar Daborar tunda suna hange ganuwar garin nesa dasu sosai, haka sukaci gaba da sassarfa da dawakan su kowa da abinda yake sakawa a cikin zuciyar shi.


A cikin taskar bayi kuwa wata baiwa ce ke zaɓo bayi mata, zata kaisu wajen Jakadiyya tana cikin zaɓen su ta ɗauko harda Zainab saida tagama tsintar bayin sannan suka tafi sashen Sarki Baidulƙais suna isa Jakadiyya ta kwashe su sai madafa suka fara aikin abinci  dan tarbar baki daga Masarautar Ƙaisu, haka sukai ta shiri kai kace biki za'ayi danko wajen Sarki Baidulƙais ya gama  duk wani shirin da zaiyi dan tafiya Masarautar Daborah daman jiran isowar Sarki Danwar yakeyi dan su ida haɗa mayakan su a tuta ɗaya Masarauta ɗaya dan cimma wani buri nasu wanda kowa ya addana shi a cikin zuciyar shi batare da  ya sanar ma ɗan uwan shi abinda ke cikin zuciyar shi ba, abinda suka sani suna san su wargaza mulkin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa dama Masarautar Daborah baki ɗayan ta, haka kowa ya gama  kimtsawa itama Jamra tana cikin sashen Baidulƙais da bayi angama gyara komai antsara shi da marece aka fara shelar isowar Sarki Danwar da tawagar shi ba karamin  dadi bane ya ratsa zuciyar Baidulƙais dan baiyi tunanin zai ansa goron gayyatar shi ba  duk da kasancewr suna da kyakkyawar mu'amala da juna, cikin farin ciki Sarki Baidulƙais ya taro Sarki Danwar har cikin sashen shi aka kaishi suka zauna da manyan Jaruman shi da yazo tare dasu cikin kankanin lokaci aka fara gabatar masu da kayan abinci, haka sukai liyafar ban girma sannan aka fidda sauran Jaruman da Sarki Danwar yazo dasu kowa yaci ya sha, aka basu masauki domin su huta kafin  a ida basu kulawar da gwajin da ya dace  kafin zuwa jibi su ɗauki hanyar tafiya Masarautar Daborah, suko su Sarki Baidulƙais haka sukai ta shawarar yanda zasu shafe babin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa da duk wani abu da take takama dashi......

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Su Bahijja kuwa tafiya tai riba tunda har sun shigo cikin ganuwar garin Daborah yanzun ba inda suka tunkara sai kofar shiga cikin Masarautar Daborar koda Yarima MalikusSaif suka tun karo kofar shiga cikin Masarautar su, take yaji gaban shi ya faɗi ya rasa dalil, kallan Bahijja yayi yaga sai washe baki takeyi tanajin dadi yau ta dawo Masarautar su zata huta da aikin bauta tasan nan zatafi samun yanci tunda Masarautar da aka haifeta ce,  shiko tsoron shi kada mahaifiyar shi ta gallazama Bahijja azaba, take ya tuna ranar da aka haifi Bahijja da yanda Sarauniya taso akashe ta  tun a ranar tuna irin artabar da suka sha har Allah yasa a kabar  Bahijja, ji yayi jikin shi yai sanyi, kallan Huzaifa yayi wanda shima hakan take wajen shi, koda bai gaya  maka ba da kagan shi kasan yana cikin fargaba addu'a yafara yi  iri iri sannan suka bubbuga kofar Masarautar Daborah, Sarkin kofa ne ya rugo da sauri dan ganin masu buga kofar, yana budewa yaga Yarima Malik ne, take ya tuna da gargadin da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa taima shi da sauri ya maida kofa zai rufe, Yarima Malik ne yasa hannu ya banka ta, da sauri Sarkin kofa ya zube kasa yana neman afuwa, koda Sarkin gida yaga su Yarima Malik da sauri ya koma cikin Masarauta ya sanar ma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa dawowar Yarima Malik, a kiɗime ta mike rai ɓace itada Waziri  Dammur suka fito,
itako Binta dake aiki tanajin haka sumar tsaye tayi ko motsin kirki takasa yi , koda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa suka isa bakin kofa idanun ta suka sauka kan Bahijja da Yarima Malik cikin fushi ta nuna su da yatsa tace.
