 *Wannan labarin ƙirƙirarren labari ne kamar yanda kukaji tun a Book One, banyi shi dan cin zarafin wani ba, wanda yai dai dai da rayuwar shi aimin afuwa akasine🙏* 



Episode 27&28



"MalikusSaif maza ka ɓace mani da wannan shegiyar yarinyar a cikin Masarauta ta ko baka da labarin tuni ka zama ɓarrare a cikin Masarautar nan, dan haka ku koma inda kuka fito yanzun.!"
a sanyaye Yarima MalikusSaif ya duro saman doki ya duka kasa agaban Mahaifiyar shi ya kawo hannu, zai rike hannun ta da sauri taja da baya tace.
"Karka kuskara ka taɓa ni  Malik na yafe ka na barma Binta." koda Huzaifa yaga ran Sarauniya ya mugun ɓaci da sauri shima ya sauko ya duka kasa suka fara bata hakuri Malik ne yace. "Ummu dan Allah ki yafemani karfa kiman ta, Bahijja ce na ceto da yanzun rayuwar ta yabgama tarwatsewa dan Allah ki fahimceni." itako tagama fusata saidai bata iya cin fuskar Malik gaban fadawan ta cikin fushi tace. "Ke baiwa zaki sauko saman dokin nan ko saina sare kanki yanzun nan.!" ai jikin Bahijja na rawa batasan sadda ta duro ba, itako aranta cewa take na shiga ukku Bahijja wannan wace irin mata ce anya ba ɓatan kai mukayi ba mike shirin faruwa dani ne? 
Itama da sauri ta duka a gaban  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, jikinta ya fara ɓari, ta kowa  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi tazo gaban Bahijja tana zagaye ta, duk da ta rabu da ganin Bahijja ita kanta tasan yarinyar ta girma ta haɗa duk abinda akeso wata ƴa mace ta kasance  dasu, saidai kawai ta tsaneta kuma bata kaunar zuri'ar Jafar har abada, a yamutse da tofa ma Bahijja miyau ajiki, sai a idon Malik, rufe idanshi yayi yasan tabbas rayuwar Bahijja na cikin garari dan dai nan bazata dinga samun kalubale ba wajen yunkurin lalata ba, ba kamar sauran Masarautun ba,bai gama sakar zucin da yake ba yaji wata irin kara ashe Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce ta wanke Bahijja da mari har huɗu take ta zube kasa abinka ga farar fata har jini ya kwanta da sauri Malik ya iso wajen Bahijja zai ɗaga ta  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce ta daka mashi tsawa tace. "Ka kuskara hannun ka ya taɓa jikin wannan ƙasƙan tattar Baiwar wlh  sai na tsine maka MalikusSaif."
take ya tsaya baisan kwalla sun fara suntiri a saman fuskar shiba, itako Bahijja addu'a kawai takeyi a zuciyar ta, a kiɗime ta tashi daga faduwar da tayi tace. "Tuba nike ya shuga bata  Bahijja na tuba kiyafemani, Allah ya huci zuciyarki."
itako maganar da Bahijja taimata sake fusata ta tayi take ta kalli Sarkin horo tace. "Kama mani ita ka kaita cikin turkar bayi yanda uwarta Binta zata gani  kaita dukan ta  har saita mutu kanaji na."? 
Da sauri Yarima Malik ya rike kafar Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yace. "Ummu kiyi hakuri  ni ya kamata  ki hukun ta ba Bahijja ba bata san komai ba dan Allah kiyafe mata, kada ki ɗaura mata laifi." itako Bahijja bata san  tafara kuka ba, tana ba Sarauniya Zulaiƙa hakuri amman a banza  a wofi, haka Sarkin horo ya kama Bahijja kamar jaka ya tafi da ita dan cika umurnin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa. 
Koda Yarima MalikusSaif yaga anja Bahijja antafi da ita take yaji jikin shi ya mutu, a ranshi ko cewa yayi Ummu badan ke kika haifeni ba da saina dakile duk wani zalincin ki akan Bahijja, jiyayi tace ma  Huzaifa.
"Kai Huzaifa akaf cikin Masarauta ta na aminta dakai shi yasa  baka da shamaki akan hudda da ɗana, ashe kaima munafuntanta kakeyi kana cin amana ta  ni nasan abinda zan maku da sannu zan maganin duk wani maha'inci." hakuri Huzaifa yafara ba Sarauniya Zulaiƙa bata jira jin ta bakin su haka ta wuce cikin gadara tabar su Yarima MalikusSaif a duke ya kasa ko motsin kirki, baisan ya fara kwalla ba  sai sunturi suke a fuskar shi, dan baki ɗaya hankalin shi ya koma kan Bahijja gashi takai hukuncin da za'aima ta a cikin turakar bayi kuma dokar Masarautar Daborah,  jinin Sarauta bai shiga cikin turakar bayi bare ya kaima Bahijja ɗauki koda a fakaice ne, kaɗa kai ya dinga yi yana cewa"aaa Ummu ki rabu da Bahijja ni yakama ta ki hukunta ba itaba, mikewa yayi yaji  juwa na niyar kada shi  da sauri Huzaifa ya taroshi jikin shi suka wuce sashen  Yarima MalikusSaif.


Koda Sarkin horo ya kama Bahijja ba inda ya tsaya da ita sai cikin turakar bayi duk yanda Bahijja ke cikin tashin hankali hakan bai hanata mamakin Masarautar Daborah musamman fasalin ginin ta tunda take bata taɓa ganin kalar shiba, gata da masifar yawa ga fadi komai a tsare yake, koda aka shigo da ita turakar bayi batai tunanin gun bayi bane dan wajen ya haɗu kuma ya tsaru gashi da girma kamar wani karamin gari amman duk a cikin Masarautar Daborah yake koda taga yanayin mutanen wajen hakan ya tabbatar mata da turakar bayin ne aka kawo ta bata san tafara kuka ba ganin ya kaita wajen wani icce zai ɗaure ta, gani tayi anata kallan ta kamar wata munafuka wasu taga sun ruga suna kuka wasu kuma taga sun wuce a sanyaye jitayi wasu nacewa kai ji wata budurwa can tayi laifi za'a hukunta ta nidai bantaɓa ganin taba, sai taji wata mata shiyar mata tace. "Aiko wannan daga ninta duk inda ta fito Bahijja ce ɗiyar Sarkin bayi Abdulmajid mijin Binta uwar bayi, ai tun tana ƴar shekara shidda zuwa bakwai tabar hannun iyayenta ta tafi aikin bauta wata Masarautar gaskia bako shakka wannan kyawun sai tsatsan Abdulmajid Bahijja."
aiko take ido ya raina fata tasan kashin ta ya bushe tabbas zargin da takeyi ya tabbata nan ne dai Masarautar su da take ikirarin ankaita wajen Umman ta dan ta huta da aikin bauta d azaba ashe yanzun zatansan tana aikin bauta da wahala a matsayin ta na baiwa marar ƴanci, aibata gama sakar zucin da take ba taji bulalai na ɗawainiya ga illahirin jikinta tunda take duniya bata taɓajin duka irin wannan ba mai masifar zafi gata da tsoron duka kuma an ɗaureta da igiya, kwalla ihu tayi ta fara kuka mai sosa zuciya cikin kankanin lokaci anfara taruwa dan ganin wanda ake hukunta wa da sauri su Mairo da Ladidi suka iso wajen ɗan jigum sukayi suna kallan kyakyawar budurwar da ake duka ita ko sai kuka take tana gayama Allah yakawo mata ɗauki, Mairo ce ta taɓa Ladidi tace. "Ke Ladidi wannan ba Bahijja bace kiduba da kyau ƴar muce ake duka, aiko cikin rudewa tace, itace Mairo mun shiga  ukku ina ma  Bahijja bata dawo wannan Masarautar ba a matsayin baiwa ba kilan da tafi samun sauki a rayuwar ta." kuka suka rushe dashi..... A wajen Binta kuwa da kyal ta ida abinda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tasa ta  ji take baki ɗaya batajin dadi zuwa tayi wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta duka tace "Allah yataimaki uwar dakina, nagama abinda kika sakani saimi zanyi yanzun."
shu'umin murmushi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi tana kaɗa kafa ta kalli Binta tace. "Ayya Binta karki damu kinga ma komai yanzun kije gida ki huta da marece kin ida aikin ki kinji uwar bayi." mamaki ya gama kama Binta itadai ba taga  Malik a shigo ba bare tasa ran ganin Bahijja gashi yau uwar dakin nata tanajin tausanta cikin jin dadi ta mike tace. "Nagode uwar dakina Allah yasaka da alkhairy." da murmushi takara bin Binta, itako jikinta na kyarma ta tashi zata tafi dan zumudi, ji tayi ta kirata wani kwano ne tace ta ɗauka taje taci abinci takara samun kwarin jikin ta, itako Binta dan dadi batsan takara zubewa ba tayi godya a ranta ko cewa tayi inhar Bahijja ta dawo  ita zanba  wannan abincin taci, Allah Sark ƴata, umurni ta bata tace taje, haka ta kama hanya ta tafi turakar bayi saijin dadi takeyi tunda Binta ta shigo cikin turakar bayi taga mutane zagaye, ta gani tasan ba wanda ake wulakantawa sai Abdulmajid ya fado mata arai jitayi gaban ta ya faɗi haka ta dinga kutsawa dan ganin irin azabar da ake ga nama mijin ta, har ta isa wajen da ake dukan, dasu Mairo tayi karo sai garzar kuka sukayi tambayar su ba'asi tafara bin hannun Ladidi tayi taga wadda ake duka batasan tasaki kwanon abincin hannun taba, karar yasa kowa hankalin shi yadawo gare ta harda Bahijja da tafara laushi haka ta aza idanun ta saman fuskar Binta, itama Binta kallan ta takeyi wani mummunan faɗuwar gaba ce ta ziyar su lokaci ɗaya musamman Binta data kwalla mata kira tace. "Ƴata Bahijjaa!!!" a sume ta fadi, itako Bahijja tunda taga Binta ta kasa ɗauke idanta akanta tana ganin ta tasan Mahaifiyar tace, tana ganin ta faɗi kasa sume tace. "Ummaa!! Dan Allah kitashi kada ki mutu kibarni dan Allah Umma." suko su Ladidi sukayi kan Binta suka dinga sama ta ruwa harta farfado, danko Sarkin horo ko aijikin shi haka ya dinga dukan Bahijja kamar ba gobe Binta na farfadowa ta tashi kamar mahaukaciya ta ruga ta kankame Bahijja a jikinta sai garzar kuka sukeyi su dukan su, baki ɗayan su Sarkin horo yaci gaba  da dukan su rabi da kwatar bayin dake wajen suka dinga kuka dan tausan su Binta itako Bahijja ta rike hannun Mahaifiyar ta tana kuka mai tsuma zuciya.



```Allah Sarki rayuwa wasu insuna abu kamar baza'a mutu ba, shidai zalinci dodone wayyo Bahijja Allah ya fiddaku cikin wannan halin rayuwar da kuke ciki, fans Bahijja ku kara hakuri komai zai zama tarihi bi'izinillah🙏```

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A Masarautar Raifasu kuwa koda gari ya waye haka Sarki Baidulƙais d Sarki Danwar suka tashi ba inda suka wuce sai wani katon fili, inda ake ba Jaruman Masarautar gwaji na musamman, a haka Sarakunan yakin Masarautun suka haɗu da Jaruman su sukaci gaba da basu gwaji suna naɗa commender na Yaki kowa sai iyakar kokari yakeyi yaga sunci galaba a wajen yakin da zasu tunkara, shiko Sarki Baidulƙais haka ya kwashe labarin kannen shi ya faɗa mashi da sakon da yabasu, murmushi Sarki Danwar yayi yace. "Ba wani sako da nagani sai na bayan nan da ka aiko mani sannan kanina baya kasar yaje fatauci tun watanni ukku da suka gabata."
bakaramin mamaki bane ya kama Sarki Baidulƙais ba, yasan koma su waye da biyu sukazo Masarautar shi sai dai  koma minene wannan ba abin damuwa bane fatan shi yaga bayan Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, a zahiri cewa yayi. "Yanzun dai ba abinda nike sai inga wannan yakin da zamuje mun dagargaza daular Daborah da komai nata." shima Sarki Danwar murmushin mugunta yayi yace. "Nima mafarki na kenan ina labarin Sarki Lahazu inace ka aika mashi da sakon gayyata kamar yanda muka saba."? Dan karamin tsoki yayi yace. ''Rabu da batun Lahazu fushi yakeyi dani dan na hanasu Bahijja, sai gashi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tasa an ɗauke ta  ina mamakin yanda ya ɗauki fushi dani." Sarki Danwar ne zaiyi magana saiga Jamra da wasu bayi sun kawo masu kayan marmari zama sukayi saman shimfidar da akai masu suka fara cin kayan itacen da aka kawo masu suna kallan Jaruman su na training..... 

*************************************

Shiko Yarima MalikusSaif ya kasa zaune ya kasa tsaye ga wani irin makoko ya tare mashi kahon zuciya, baisan sadda ya fita ba  ba inda ya tsaya sai sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, isketa yayi falo ta harde kafa daya saman daya tana kallanshi ta ɗauke kai ta watsar kamar bata gan shi yana shigowa ba bada jimawa ba Huzaifa ya  maye mashi baya, shima kallan banza ta jefa mashi, da sauri MalikusSaif ya iso wajen Sarauniya yace. "Ummu ki taimaka  mani kisa a saki Bahijja kada aimata lahani na rokeki Ummu." mikewa tayi tsaye tana ma Yarima kallan sakarai marar wayau tace.
"Intai makeka fa kace? Minene hadin ka da Bahijja? Ince baiwa ce kaskantatta marar ƴanci da bata wuce in saida  taba."? Baki  ɗaya jikin Malik ne yai sanyi murya a sarke yace. "Ummu kada ki manta  sama da shekara sha hudu kinyi mani  alkawali Bahijja zatayi mani hidima a dalilin haka kika bar mani ita, kinga kenan Bahijja baiwa tace kuma hadima ta....dai dai nan Yazid ya shigo dan ansar makullin store zasu ɗibi kayan Yaki turus yayi ganin abokan nashi sun dawo ga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ranta ya gama ɓaci dajin kalaman Malik baigama al'ajabin dawowar abokan shiba, sukaji karar mari tas tas har sau biyu, danko Huzaifa ji yayi  kamar ya ruga dan tsoro, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce ta wanke MalikusSaif  da kyawawan maruka har sau biyu shiko ya rike kunci, yayi mamaki sosai, shi kanshi yasan komai Mahaifiyar shi zata iya ai. katawa dan ba karamin ɓacin rai bane ya tabata ba, dukar da kanshi yayi zuciyar shi na tafasa ya daure cikin girmamawa yace. "Ummu kiyi hakuri  ki yafema ɗanki, ki saka mani albarka dan Allah kada kiga laifin Bahijja ko Huzaifa nine silar komai, ba kowa ba." a tsawace tace. "Harka isa ka dinga dan ganta  Bahijja dakai inna yi  alkawali yanzun na fasa baza tai maka hidima ba, inama ace na kashe jaririyar nan da hannuna, inama ace ban aminta da kaiba da har ka saka mata suna da kanka, kaicona ni Zulaiƙa jinin Sarauniya Yahanazu Jika Sarauniya Maimoon uwa ga Sarki Khamil ɗa ga Sarki Jabbar ɗan Sarki Abdulhamid ni Zulaiƙa yau ɗana MalikusSaif kejin tausayin bayi makiyan mu maciya amana tabbas zan iya wulakan taka Malik akan wannan baiwar Bahijja dan haka ba kai ba Bahijja.!"
shiko ya kasa Komai kanshi ya kulle, su Yazid ko kamar anda sasu cikin ƙaƙƙausar murya tasa Yazid ya kirama ta Fusab wani ba fada ne wanda ke kula da wani wuri wanda ake kai ya'yan sarakai wato jinin Sarauta  a cikin wani gida ne ana adana su dan ɓata masu rai, a ganin su duk wanda aka kai wajen kamar anketa mashi rigar mutunci, haka kuwa akayi yana zuwa tace, akaima ta  MalikusSaif da Huzaifa ba tasan  ganin su a halin yanzun, haka su Malik suka tafi ko magana bai karayi ba dan bacin rai da ya gama kama Malik, Shiko Fusab hakuri yafara ba su Malik  a hanya shidai baice komai dan ƴan Masarautar Daborah suna bala'in kaunar Yarima Malik har suke mashi laqabi da Yarima mai adalci, uban marayu mai jinkai, haka ya kaisu cikin wani daki ba abinda babu harda gado, saidai ga jinin sarauta hakan cin fuskane haka ya rufosu ya tafi kamar yanda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta umurce shi...

Episode 29&30



Koda Fusab ya koma wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa zubewa yayi yace. "Allah yakara maki yawan rai Fusab ya cika umurnin ki cikin gaggawa kamar yanda kika bukata." a dakile tace. "Ka kyauta saidai kalubale gareka duk abin da ɗana ke bukata ka tabbata ya samu, nayi hakan ne a gare shi dan innuna mashi so ba hauka bane kwara ya dawo cikin hayyacin shi yasan waye shi ya banbace tsakanin bawa da mai ƴanci kuma Sarkin wannan Masarautar na gobe da yardar Allah." cikin girmamawa yace. "Kwarai kuwa zan kiyaye ba abin da zai nema yarasa ranki shidade ki huta lafiya."
haka ya fita yana mamakin karfin hali irin na Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ya tabbata ba wanda baza ta iya hukuntawa ba a duniya duk yanda take kaunar Yarima MalikusSaif amman zata iya yi mashi hukunci ba tareda ta damuba ko kadan, shi kanshi Yazid ya gama shan mamaki kallan da tai mashi ne yasa shi karasowa ya duka ya gaida Sarauniya sannan yace. "Allah ya huci zuciyarki Ummu, Allah yakara maki nisan kwana nazo ansar mabudi zamu dauki kayan Yaki munakan bada gwaji ne na musamman."wani irin murmushi ta saki shi kanshi yayi mamaki sai  kace ba ita bace tagama hukunta gudan jininta ba, bai gama tunani ba kuma yaga ta sake ta haɗe rai sai kace mai jinni a murtuke ta kalle shi tace. "Angaishe ka Yazid a cikin ku kaf yan uwana tundaga ɗana Malik har Huzaifa kafi su kishi na dan haka na jinjina maka ga mabudi kaje kuyi duk abinda ya dace." cikin jin dadi ya karɓi mabudin yayi godiya har zai tashi ya koma ya zauna yace. "Ummu sai dai kisani barin manyan Jaruman mu a cikin gidan kaso tamkar naka sane ga wannan Masarautar tamu, sannan kiyafema su Malik ki fiddosu suma gwarkuwa ne a cikin Masarautar Daborah fiye da tunanin kowa." du kowa tayi kusa da Yazid tace. "Ina ganin girman ka, sai dai korafin ka bai karbu ba amman zan iya fiddo da Sarkin Yaki na dasu Lurwan suko su Huzaifa kabar su ba yanzun ba kaman ta da sunan me muke bata lokacin mu mai mahimmanci muna gwaji duk fa akan wannan dakikiyar baiwar ce Bahijja akan ɗauketa da marar kishin nan yayi ne yasa Sarki Baidulƙais ya aiko mani da wasikar ya  kata duk saboda baiwa haba Yazid tunda ka tashi cikin Masarautar nan kataɓa ganin inda akayi yaki irin wannan duk saboda baiwa yar wahala akan Bahijja zan fita cikin mazan fama dan kare martabar Masarauta ta, kaga dole inkara tsanar Bahijja musamman duk wani tsatsan ta, ya zan bari ɗana kamar Malik ya dinga daga darajar baiwa wadda itace silar faruwar komai sannan uwa uba akanta za'a Yaki Masarauta ta kilan akashe mutane masu daraja duk a dalilin BAIWA haba Yazid kasan yanda nikeji a cikin zuciya ta dan haka kata shi kuje kuci gaba da gwajin yakin dake tunkarar ku mai taken *YAƘI AKAN BAIWA!!!."*


Jiki mace Yazid ya tashi yaima Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sallama yatafi dan cigaba abinda yake gaban su cikeda mamaki a ranshi. 
Ita ko Bahijja harta daina kuka dan azaba, danko  Binta ta gama galabaita danko tun bayi na kallo har sun watse daga su Mairo saifa Bahijja da take ɗaure ko ɗaga hannun ta takasa dan azaba da bala'i......a cikin gidan kaso kuwa Abdulmajid ne labari ya same shi ƴarsa Bahijja tadawo ba karamin murna yakeyi ba yasan zuwa gobe zai iya ganin ta yasan tabbas sai Binta tazo mashi da ƴar lelen ƴarshi yagani dan ba kadan yake jin kewar ta na ratsa mashi dukan illahirin jikin shi ba,  hakanan yaji farin ciki ya mamaye mashi zuciya yau zaiga Bahijja a wani sashena zuciyar shi kuwa wani irin kaunar MalikusSaif yaji tana kara ratsa shi lallai maganar Binta ta tabbata MalikusSaif ya zama amintacce ga Bahijja godema Allah yaitayi da Allah ya maido mashi su cikin aminci da walwala, a zahiri ko cewa yake. "Allah gagara misali Sarkin Sarakai mai ansama kowa bukatar shi daman ance mahakurci mawadaci yau ga ƴarmu Bahijja ta sake dawowa a garemu  karo na biyu a cikin Masarautar Daborah Allah ka kara tsare mana ita da kariyar ka, Allah nagode maka da wannan ni'imar dakai mana." ranar haka ya yini cikin farin ciki marar misaltuwa.

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Masarautar Waisu kuwa zuwa yanzun Yarima Haishir jiki yai sauki sosai har ya fara zuwa gwaji da ake ba Jaruman su duk da sun gama hada komai zuwa gobe zasu tafi Masarautar Daborah kamar yanda Sarki Lahazu ya umurta, yauma kamar marar lakka haka ya dinga sanyin training saidai rabi da kwata ba wanda yake tunawa sai Bahijja yanajin inama ya sake kama Bahijja akaro na biyu

******************************

Washe gari da safe a wajen su Malik kuwa tunda sukayi sallah yake addu'a dan ko bacci gagarar idanun shi sukayi ba wanda yake tausayi sai Bahijja  acikin ranshi ji yayi inama wani waje ya ajeta ba cikin Masarautar Daborah da bata shiga cikin wannan fitinar da take ciki ba, a zahiri ko cewa yayi. "Huzaifa kaga yanda Ummu ta ɓata ranta kuwa."? Murmushin yake Huzaifa yayi yace. "Nagani uzuri zamu cigaba dayi mata ranta ne ya sosu sosai." ganin yanda Huzaifa bai nuna damuwar shiba, akan zancen hakan yasa MalikusSaif ya girgiza kai  bai sake furta uffan ba dan yaga maganar bata da anfani shi yasa yaci gaba da tunanin shi yana nema ma Bahijja mafita dan ganin ta kubuta daga azabar da take ciki. 


Yauma Yazid ne zai tafi wajen bawa Jarumai gwaji harya wuce ya dawo baya, shiga yayi sashen Saifulislam iske shi yayi zaune yana karatun alqur'ani, zama yayi harya hama, yana gamawa ya kalli Yazid yace. "Dana kai kadai ko har yanzun abokan ka basu dawo ba insha Allah zasu dawo bada jimawa ba."
murmushi yayi yace."Abbuh sannu da karatu ai sundawo tun jiya da marece saidai ansamu damuwa." mamaki ne ya gama kama Saifulislam a ranshi ko cewa yayi daman har Malik zai iya dawowa ba tareda ya nemeni ba har ya iya kwana bai ganni ba, a zahiri ko cewa yayi." wace matsala ce kodai ba suga Bahijjar ba, fadamani.?" a sanyaye yace. "Aaa Abbuh sun ganta saidai ran Ummu ya ɓaci yanzun haka tasa ankama Bahijja tana turakar bayi tasa anata dukanta tun jiya ake mata azaba har yau ba abari ba, sannan MalikusSaif yaje neman mata alfarma hakan yasa Sarauniya ta mare shi abin tashin hankalin ma yanda tasa aka kama Yarima Malik da Huzaifa aka rufe matasu gidan Huzu, yanzun haka suna tsare." da sauri Saifulislam ya mike yana mamakin irin halin da matar shi keda shi, a zuciyar shiko cewa yayi yanzun miye laifin Bahijja, kuma wannan cin fuskane ace ɗan shi za'a kama, a zahiri ko cewa yayi. "Shikenan Yazid naji da kaga yamani zan san abinyi." godiya yai mashi saidai a darare yace. "Abbuh inane man alfarma wajen ka."?  Cikin kara mashi kwarin guiwa yace. "Inajinka." a gaggauce yace. "Dan Allah kada kabari Ummu tasan ni nasar maka."kallon yaro man kaza yai ma Yazid a zahiri ko cewa yayi karka badamu ba zan fada mata zaka iya tafiya." godiya ya sake yi sannan ya tafi shiko Saifulislam yasa akira mashi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa koda mai kiran Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta tafi iskewa tayi bata nan tana fa'da, haka ta tafi ta gaya ma Saifulislam cewa tana fa'da, rai ɓace yace. "Ai kiranta nace kimani dan tana fa'da ni Kangiwa ba damuwa ta bane kije can ki kiramani ita."
bakaramin tsorata Mairo tayi ba da yake itake kula da sashen Saifulislam, daman tana cikin manyan bayi daga Binta sai ita sai Ladidi sune manya a cikin bayi, ita kuma Ladidi tana kula da sashen Waziri Dammur, hakan yasa Mairo ta tafi jiki sage har fa'da tana zuwa tai sallama Sarkin Zagi yafara cewa. "Ke baiwa mike tafe dake cikin wannan fa'dar mai alfarma? Fa'da ba wajen zuwan bawa bane saida dalili mai karfin gaske da fatan zaki kiyaye gaba." itako dukar da kanta tayi wanda takasa magana kanta a kasa tace. "Allah ya karama Sarauniya lafiya sakone daga Kadimulislam yace yana son ganinki a sashen shi yanzun, Allah yakara girma." 
ta gama fadar maganar kanta a kasa dan taki yarda da hada ido da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa wanda ba abinda take aika mata sai mugun kallo, gyaɗa kai kawai tayi ba tareda tace komai, hakan yasa Sarkin Zagi yace. "Sarauniya ta amsa baiwar Saifulislam tana zuwa, fa'da ta sallameki." haka ta tashi tana godema Allah harta isa wajen shi tagaya mashi sakon Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, sannan ta tafi lambun bayan sashen shi tafara aikin gyarawa, itako Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tana can fa'da suna shawara akan Yaki wanda wannan shine zaman karshe da zasuyi kan maganar Yakin dan a lissafin su zuwa jibine za'a kawo masu hari ko kuma zasu fara artaba akan abokan gaba, wani ɓari na zuciyar ta kuwa tana mamakin kiran da Saifulislam yake mata kasancewar yasan tana cikin yanayi bata da cikakken lokaci, wata takarda ce tasa kama hannu sannan ta mike zata tafi wajen Saifulislam saiga Waziri Dammur ya shigo a shitatan yanda tagan shi tabbas ta tsorata shiyasa ta tsaya tana tambayar shi ba'asi, warewa sukayi gefe sannan yace. "Sarauniya yakama ta kizo muje gidan kaso dan fiddo da mutanen mu bai kamata muwuce yau ba ba tareda anfiddo suba." dafe kanta tayi ta rasa mike mata dadi, batai mashi musu ba suka tafi gidan kaso dan fidda  su Lurwan, tana zuwa akaita kai gaisuwa wajen ta sannan aka rakata wajen Sarkin Yaki koda ya ganta, kallan ta kawai yayi ya kauda kai sannan ya gaisheta, itama amsawa tayi atakaice sannan tace"Sarkin Yakin Daborah bai kamata ace kunyi kwanaki a wannan wajen ba, yakama ta yaudin nan ku fita dan kusa mu hutu." ɗan murmushi yayi sannan ya kalleta ya kalli Waziri yace. "Hakane Allah yabaki yawan rai saidai ki bari zuwa gobe ko jibi zamu fito kamar yanda kika umurta, dan nan din nafi samun nutsuwa." Waziri ne zaiyi magana Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta ɗaga mashi hannu alamun yai shiru sake kalln shi tayi tace. "Haka kuke bukata."?  Da eh ya amsata, wani shu'umin murmushi tayi tace. "Girmanka ne Mas'ud lokacin da yai maku zaku iya fita saidai kasani fa'da ta sake ku."
tana gama faɗar haka tai tafiyar ta ba tareda taji abinda Sarkin Yaki zaice mata ba, Waziri Dammur ne yace. "Ya kama  ta yau kufito zaifi maku amman kayi tunani."shima binta yayi ya tafi, sun fita taima Waziri wani irin kallo tace. "Dammur kagani ko nazo wannan yaron yana neman gaya mani magana wlh koda Sarkin Yaki ko bashi ni Zulaiƙa zan iya kare martabar Masarauta ta, koda kuwa ba Yarima Malik, dan ma ɗana Jarumi ne." "hakane kam amma zasu fito Sarkin yawa shiyasa mukeso ace sun fito yanzun ga su Malik a tsare, bayan kinsan shike tsare mutucin Masarautar nan."
"hmm Waziri tunda nike Malik bai taba min rai kamar wannan lokacin ba amman ba damuwa zan fiddosu." da haka suka tafi, hankalin tane ya koma wajen Saifulislam da sauri take tafiya dan ta shafa'a abubuwa ne sukai mata cinkus, tana zuwa ta iske  bai nan hakan taji faruwar gaba, duk dakunan shi ta duba bai nan.
shiko Saifulislam ya gama kulewa hakan yasa ya tafi inda aka kai su Yarima MalikusSaif ya fiddo su, ya kai su har sashen Yarima, cikin damuwa Yarima yace. "Abbuh da kabarmu acan kaga Ummu bata bukatar ganin mu, sannan kuma Bahijja tana turakar bayi ana dukan ta Abbuh zasu iya kasheta."
dafa shi yayi yace. "Kada kadamu yau zansa a sakota." wani irin dadi yai mashi yawa, baisan ya rungume shiba yace. " Abbuh nagode Allah yakara girma da daukaka." tafiya yayi ba inda ya tsaya sai turakar bayi zai shiga kenan mai kula da wajen ya zube yace. "Ranka shidade Allah ya taimaki Kangiwa ba girman ka bane shiga cikin turakar bayi, amatsayin ka namai Sarauta kuma miji ga Sarauniya." wani wawan kallo yai mashi baice komai ba ya shige cikin turakar bayi har inda aka ɗaure Bahijja sadda yaje har angama dukanta duk jikin ta yayi sahun bugu koda Sarkin horo yaga Saifulislam zubewa yayi yana neman afuwa, ko kallo bai isheshi ba haka yasa aka kwance ta aka kaita gida, yasa su Binta suka fara bata kulawa sannan ya tafi yana mamakin irin zalinci na Zulaiƙa, yana komawa ya isketa tsaye taje ta dawo taje ta dawo da sauri  ta taro shi tace. "Abu Malik ina kaje ina ta neman ka."? Wani mugun kallo yai mata yace.

Episode 31&32



"Naje na biyama kaina bukata tunda nina damu da abin da zanyi dan haka kije kiyi uzurin gabanki.!"
ya gama maganar ya shigewa bedroom dinsa itama binshi tayi ta iske shi zaune a gafen gado, itama zama tayi gefen shi cikin sanyin murya tace.
"Haba mijina karkayi fushi mana, ina ta ujilar inzo gareka, abubuwa ne suka shamin kai shiyasa."
murmushin mugunta yayi yasan abin daya aikata mata kadai ya isheta hukunci! rausayar da kanshi yayi yace. "Hakane kam nima abubuwan suka shamin kai shiyasa na manta da nasa a kiramin ke ba damuwa zaki iya tafiya hidimomin gaban ki, dan haka ina bukatar hutu." sake marerecewa Zulaiƙa tayi cikin damuwa tace. "Ai nagama  daman naje gidan yari dan fiddo  Mas'ud dasu Lurwan sai dai sunce zuwa gobe zasu fito." shiru yayi yana ɗan nazari a zahiri ko cewa yayi. "Daman baki fiddasu ba sai yanzun?  anya kina aiki da tunani Zulaiƙa? wai miyasa ku mata kuke abu yanda kuka ga dama yanzun ko wane lokaci za'a iya kawo ma Masarautar ki hari har yaushe kika fiddo suka huta balle su tallafa maki da karfin su? Koda yake yanda kika gani haka zakiyi! ba wannan ba, nima naje na fiddo Ƴaƴana da kikasa aka kullemani su yanzun haka Yarima yana sashen shi." waro ido tayi tana kalan shi cike da  mamaki tace. "Ka fiddo sufa kace.?"
kallan rainin hankali yai mata yace.
"Mikike nufi sai in zuba maki ido ina kallan ɗana a kulle bayan ya gama shan wahalar nemo yarinyar nan maimakon ki jinjina mashi akan namijin kokarin da yayi kawai sai inji dana a kulle kema kinsan kan Malik zan iya komai shi kadai na mallaka a duniya dan haka bazan saka ido ba ina ganin ɗana cikin damuwa ba! dan haka  yana can nace su huta shida Huzaifa."
ya gama maganar yana kishingiɗawa saman gado, rasa mi zata cema Saifulislam tayi, dan  taso ta kara ɓatama Malik rai kamar yanda ya sosa mata nata ran, dakewa tayi tace.  "Yanzun har Malik yayi abin yabawa dan ya tafi ɗauko baiwa? Haba ai wannan abin kunya ne, bama gani kadai ba harda Masarauta ta baki ɗaya, kaga dole in hukunta shi."
ranshi ne ya gama ɓaci baisan ya zauna ba yace. "Kada kigaya mani ba dadi Zulaiƙa ina laifin wanda ya ceci naka ko kin manta iyayen yarinyar nan haka suka sadaukar da ƴarsu kan danmu?  suma ba mutane bane? ko an gaya maki tashi kawai sukayi suka tsince ta! ita haifata akayi kamar kowa! da anyi mgana sai kice baiwa baiwa itama mutunce kamar yanda kike ta kama kema mutun ce!  sannan MalikusSaif ya cancanci yabo tunda har yasan halacci kuma ya sakan ta ma mutanen da suka yi mashi aikin alkhairi, gaskia kin zama butulu Zulaiƙa."
da sauri ta mike tace. "Kana ta fadan munanan kalamu a kaina saboda baiwa! ɗan naka yayi abin kunyar shine kake goya mashi baya ko kamanta shi Yarima ne." dan karamin tsaki yayi yace. "Ita baiwar da kikasa aka ɗaure kina san kiga gawarta ne?  kasancewar ta mutun mai jini a jiki kamar kowa shiyasa naje da kaina har cikin turakar bayi nasa aka kwanceta na dan kama mahaifyar ta zata cigaba da bata kulawa ta musamman dan Bahijja bata cancanci wulakanci ba, amman in har kinsan halacci." 
Wani irin mummunan faɗuwar gaba ne ya riski Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ba tasan taja baya tana dafe kirjin ta dake dukan tara tara kamar zai faɗo kasa, jikin ta ne yafara rawa kamar mazari, hakan yasa ta duka kasa wasu kwalla masu ɗumi suka wanke mata fuska, muryar ta na rawa tace. "Saifulislam!!! da kanka kashiga turakar bayi kana mijina uban dana magajina, ka shiga turakar bayi ka kwance baiwa yar bayi."?
Take yaji wani irin sanyi aran shi yasan yasha da Zulaiƙa raban daya ga tayi kwalla har ya manta a rayuwar shi ta duniya mikewa yayi yace. "Kwarai kuwa da hannu na, nasa aka kwance Bahijja sannan dani aka kaita har masaukin iyayen ta, kuma na dawo ɗaki na, duk nine nayi wannan aikin saboda ɗan Adam ba abin wulakan tarwa bane ki saka wannan a ranki Ummu Malik."
bata san ta rushe da kuka ba mai cin rai tace. "Baiwa baiwa baiwa!!! Kaje ka kwanto kana mijin Sarauniya yau kaine kafarka ta taka turakar bayi lallai Abu Malik ka karya doka mai girman gaske ka watsa mani kasa a ido, ga idanun kuwa duniya za'a ce mijin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ua shiga turakar bayi ya kwanto baiwa! 
daman haka ɗanka ya gudu yaje ya ɗauko baiwa yau gashi an wayi gari Kangiwa uban MalikusSaif ya shiga turakar bayi ya kwanto baiwa! ina ace dukana kai tayi da yafi mani sauki akan wannan abin kunyar da kuka jefani kai da ɗanka! tabbas Saifulislam badan kana mijina ba kuma ina kalkashin ikon ka, wlh dako Malik ya aika ta mani irin wannan abin da ka aikata mani ni kaina basan kalar hukuncin da zan mashi ba saidai kaci darajar aure, amma ka zubda mani ƙima da daraja ta, tabbas Bahijja kinzo da kalubale iri iri tunda ga haihuwar ki har zuwa lokacin da ɗana yaje ɗauko ki! yau gashi a kan ki za'ayi Yaki kina baiwa za'ayi yaki kanki, gaskia Bahijja kin shiga cikin gona ta! wanda ba mahalukin da yata yima Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kutse saike, ke din ma baiwa ƴar bayi.!"
Haka ta karasa maganar tana rushewa da matsanan cin kuka mai taɓa zuciya. 
koda Saifulislam yaga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tana ta zance kamar wata zautatta baisan ya zauna ba yana kallan ta yasan tabbas ranta ya gama ɓaci dakewa yayi yace. "Tabbas Bahijja baiwa ce kuma baiwa ce wadda ta kafa tarihi a rayuwar Masarautar Daborah kuma baza'a taɓa mantawa da ita ba,  sai dai ina so ki kara sawa a cikin ranki BAYIMA 'YA'YANE! matat."
yana gama faɗa mata haka ya tashi ya shiga bathroom danyin wanka ita ko  saman kafat ta kwanta tana kwalla masu zafin gaske ji take kamar ta fiddo zuciyar ta ta huta da azabar da take ji a cikin kirjinta....... 

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A Masarautar Raifasu kuwa sun gama shirin su tsaf dan kowa ne Jarumi yagama duk wani abun da zaiyi kowa ya hau saman dawakan su sunbi layi suna jiran abada izinin tafiya kasancewar akwai tafiya tsakanin su da Masarautar Daborah, shi yasa  suka gama shirin su basu san sukai gobe ba tareda sun isa ba ko kuma su ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo, a cikin sashen Sarki Baidulƙais kuwa shida Jamra ne sai bayi  guda sha hudu da za'ayi tafiyar dasu dan ba Jarumai kulawa bakwai mata bakwai maza, sun gama shirywa tsaf da kayan guzuri a  hannun su, suka fito shima Sarki Baidulƙais fitowa yayi cikin shiga ta alfarm ta kayan Yaki ba inda ya nufa sai wajen Sarki Danwar shima ya gama shirin nashi shida Jakadiyar shi suka fito baki ɗayan su suka hau dawakan su, inda Sarki Baidulƙais yayi sallama da gimbiya Yazira sannan suka dunguma dan tafiya, Sarkin Kofa ne ya bude masu Kofa suka tafi, sannan suka ɗauki hanyar tafiya Masarautar Daborah 

 _DABORAH_ 

 wajen su Binta kuwa sai kulawa take ba yarta tanajin dadi yau gata ga Bahijja a tareda ita, itako Bahijja bacci takeyi da kagan ta kasan na wahala ne takeyi sai su Mairo sun kewaye ta sai kallan ta sukeyi kamar wata bakuwa haka ta koma masu.
Danko Sarauniya Zulaiƙa da kyal ta koma sashen ta tana zuwa wanka kawai ta iyayi baki daya hankalin ta yai matukar tashi inta tuna da Saifulislam ya shiga turakar bayi, sawa tayi akai mata kiran Binta zuwa yanzun kiyayyar ta kaf ta rataya akan Bahijja gani takeyi duk wani farin cikin ta Bahijja kemata barazana dashi, saman wata kujera ta zauna ta alfarma ta rufe idanta kamar mai bacci saidai kana ganin ta kasan tension ne yai mata yawa sai lula kujerar takeyi tana tunani iri iri a cikin zuciyar ta koda kiran Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ya iske Binta lokacin Bahijja ta farka daga bacci a hankali ta dinga bin mutanen dake wajen da kallo takai minti ukku tana aikin kallan su sannan ta kalli Binta bata san sadda ta faɗa saman ta ba bakin ta na kyarma tace. "Umma na dan Allah ki gudu dani wlh kasheni zasuyi duk inda naje basu kauna ta so suke su lahanani Umma na dan Allah kitaimaka mani." sake riketa tayi tace. "Ki kwantar da hankalin ki Bahijja ko kin manta kedin baiwa ce wuya bata kisa, karki manta tin kina kankanuwar ki nasha faɗa maki baiwa bata san gata ba ko jin dadi wahala kawai tasani miyasa zaki yaudari kanki inasan a duk inda kika kasance kisa aranki ke baiwa ce, sannan ki rike matsayin ki da darajar ki, Ƴata ki daina  faɗar wannan maganar daga yau kisani zakaran da Allah ya nufa da cara komai wuya sai yayi, kinji Ƴata kiyi hakuri haka Allah yaso ya ganki insha Allah zaki zama mai daraja koda bamu raye kinji yanzun ki kara hutawa zanje kiran da uwar dakina kemani."
Gyada mata kai tayi alamar to.
har zata tafi Bahijja ta sake rike hannun Binta tace. "Umma daman wannan matar itace Sarauniya Zulaiƙa."? Murmushi Binta tayi tace. "Eh ita ce  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuma mahaifiya ga Yarima MalikusSaif."
shiru tayi tana mamakin yanda ta kasance azzaluma, amman kuma ɗanta mutumin kirki ji tayi anta ɓata, da sauri ta kalli Mahaifiyar ta, tace. "Umma ina Abba." mikewa tayi tace. "yana wajen aikin shi, bari inje in dawo ƴata." ''toh Umma saikin dawo." haka Binta ta tafi wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tana isa ta iske ta kishingiɗe ta rufe idanun ta, koda ta isa isketa tayi idonta rufe dukawa tayi gaban ta tace.
"Ranki shidade gani kiranki ya riskeni." bude idanun ta tayi ta watsa su kan Binta, ita kanta saida ta tsorata yanda taga sun sauya sunyi jajir kamar garwashi, a  gadarance Zulaiƙa tace. "Binta mi kikayi ma  Saifulislam da har yasa aka kwace Bahijja? Ko kinje kin gaya mashi wani munafuncin naku na bayi."?
Rasa abin faɗa Binta tayi tana mamki ashe bada izinin ta bane aka saki Bahijja, a kiɗime tace. " Ranki shidade ni kaina  banda wata masaniya dan gane da hakan naga yasa an saki Bahijja amman ina neman afuwar ki." cikin tsawa tace. "Yimin shiru makira akwai wadan da suka kai bayi tsabar munafurci da tuggu da kunga, Kangiwa kun langaɓe shi kuma Sarkin tausayi yaji tausanku kun mallake min ɗa bai ganin kowa da ƙima sai ku kuma bai tausan kowa sai Bahijja wlh indai na cika ƴa ga Sarki Abdulhamid sai nayi maganin kaf zuri'ar Jafar da munafuncin ku na gadan gado da kuka saba, ɓace mani dagani sakarai kuma anjima kiyi maza ki hado mani bayin da zasu dinga kulawa da madafa idan za'ayi wannan kaddararran Yakin ki tabbatar da anba Jarumai na kulawa ta musamman kinanjina.!"da sauri tace "eh ranki shidade umurnin ki abun tunkaho a gareni  Binta na godiya."
da sauri ta tashi ta tafi har tuntube take rafkawa tana godema Allah da yasa  yau Sarauniya Zulaiƙa batasa anduke taba ko wani cin zarafin haka ta kama hanyar tafiya turakar bayi wajen wucewa ta gefen sashen Yarima MalikusSaif taga Ladidi da wasu bayi na aiki tareda Yazid da alama shi ya saka su aikin dukawa tayi ta gaida Yazid harta tafi taji wata baiwa ta risketa dukawa tayi har kasa ta gaida uwar bayi sannan tace. "Allah ya taimaki  uwar bayi Yarima Malik ne ke kiranki yana ta gefen lambun dake sashen shi" ita ko tsaye tayi tana mamaki domin ba taga  Malik ba sai dai taga Yazid yana sa bayi aiki, a wani bangaren na zuciyar ta kuwa tana shakka kada Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta kamata da danta, sai dai ba zata iya kin zuwa ba, haka takama hanyar tafiya wajen MalikusSaif. 

tana zuwa ta iske shi zaune saman shinfida gefen shi kuma Yazid ne cikin girma mawa Binta ta zauna ta gaida Yarima gani tayi ya ɗanyi mata duhu kadan, aranta ko cewa tayi Allah Sarki Yarima komu ba musan  taya zamu sa kanta  maka ba, gashi ka dawo  mana da ƴarmu, tabbas nasan kana fuskan tar  matsala a wajen mahaifiyar ka sai dai laifin mune mu muka jamaka hakan, karfin hali tayi tace.
"Allah ya taimaki Yarima kiran ka yasameni, inaimaka barka da dawowa Masarautar Daborah sai dai Binta ba tasan  taya zata fara godema ka ba, Allah ya saka maka da mafificin alkhairi."
Murmushi Yarima yayi yace. "Umman Bahijja basai kun gode mani ba nine zan godema ku  sannan Allah shine abin godiya da yadawo damu cikin aminci, ina Bahijja."?
Rausayar dakai Binta tayi tana mamakin karamci irin na MalikusSaif. 
Cikin jin dadi tace.
"Tana gida, dan Allah kai mana  godiya wajen Kadimulislam yasa an saki Bahijja.
Jinjina kai Malik yayi yace. 
"Yima kai ne  karki damu, ya jikin ta da sauki ko."? "Eh da sauki na barota tana bacci." haka nan  ya samu kanshi da murmusawa ya rasa dalilin da yasa  yake jin  dad, idan yaga Bahijja cikin aminci, a zahiri ko cewa yayi ki gaida mani ita." sannan ya bata wata leda cike da kayan marmari yace takai mata, sannan ta gaida mashi da Abban Bahijja, haka ta amsa tana godiya sannan ta tafi ranta fas tana sama MalikusSaif albarka.... 

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿
A wajen Sarki Lahazu kuwa shima ya gama shiryawa tsaf shida Jaruman shi da  sauran hadiman shi da zaiyi tafiyar dasu, sannan yayi sallama ga matar shi gimbiya Ƙamariyya, kowa ya hau saman dawakan su, Yarima Haishir ne kawai suke jira shima bada jimawa ba ya fito yai sallama sa Mahaifiyar shi, sannan suka kama hanyar tafiya Masarautar Daborah....... 

***********************************
Koda Binta ta koma haka ta iske Bahijja tayi wanka harta gyara masu mahallin su, tana zaune ita da Mairo dan suna ba Bahijja  kulawa ta musamman Binta na da wowa Bahijja ta ganta da  sannu da zuwa taima Umman ta sannan tace. "Umma amman kin dawo  da wuri, ko kunan Masarautar baku dadewa wajen aiki."? Murmushi tayi ma yar tata, tace. "Ƴata kenan ai Bacci kawai ke dawo damu gida, yaudin ba aiki sosai kinsan Masarautar tamu ba wani kwanciyar hankali ne da ita ba suna shirin Yaki ne."
da sauri Bahijja ta ware idanu tace. "Umma Yaki kuma miya jawo Yaki ana zaman lafiya.?" 
"Yata kenan saboda ke za'ayi wannan Yakin." cike da mamaki tace.  "Umma saboda ni fa ki kace niko minene nayi da za'ayi Yaki akaina bayan ba kowa yasan da zama na a cikin wannan Masarautar ba sai waɗan da suka jima a cikin ta." 
Murmushi Binta tayi tana kallan yr tata tace. 
"ta yaro kyau take bata ƙarko, akan ki  ne za'ayi  Yaki, uban gidan ki Baidulƙais ya aiko da sako ga Sarauniya Zukaiƙa yace, zai Yake ta saboda 
 ta karya alkawali ta ɗauke ki kinji dalili."
dafe baki Bahijja tayi tace. "Wlh Umma Ya Malik a Masarautar Waisu ya same ni saboda Yariman Masarautar ya kwaceni a hannun wasu ashe shima so yake ya lalatamani rayuwa shine fa Yarima da yaje Masarautar ya ganni ya amso ni har saida akayi kashe kashe sannan muka iso nan na bani ya zanyi, Umma inko har a kaina za'ayi  wannan Yakin zan shiga matsala." cikeda  tausayin ta tace."kiyi hakri Allah na tareda ke kinji ƴata kuma insha Allah mune da nasara a wannan Yakin." da Ameen ta amsa a ranta ko tausayin Yarima Malik takeyi taga daga dawowar su zasu afkama makiya, ji tayi Umman ta rike mata hannu ta ɗaura mata leda a hannun ta tace. "Yarima yace akawo maki kici yana gaidaki." wani irin dadi taji tace  "Umma Ya Malik aminci ne a gareni nagode ma  shi, Allah ya basu  nasara." ita da Mairo da Ameen suka amsa......

Suko su Sarki Baidulƙais tafiya tai riba tunda suna hangen ganuwar Masarautar Daborah duk da dare ya fara amman zasu iya isa kafin duhu ya gauraye garin haka sukaci gaba da sassarfa a saman dawakan su....

 ~Touching Heart Story💔😭~ 
      

 _BOOK TWO_ 

            _By_ 
 *Jameey Yar'mutan Kankia* 


*MANAZARTA WRITERS ASSOC*


 _Best of 2k21_


بسم الله الرحمن الر حيم




Episode 33&34



Koda suka isa bakin Masarautar Daborah tsaya wa sukayi suna tunanin ta inda zasu shiga cikin Masarautar saboda tsayin katangun dake kewaye da Masarautar ga kuma ganuwa ya zagaye garin, Sarki Baidulƙais ne yace ma Sarki Danwar. "Kaga waɗan nan mutanen yanda sukai ma Masarautar nan tasu? naso tunda ga yanzun su san da zuwan mu amman kubamu shawara taya zamu farma su ba tare da sun san da isowar muba."? Jinjina kai Sarki Danwar yayi yace.
"Kashi ɗaya zamu sa su tuntuɗa yan uwan su in yaso daga baya sai su bude mana kofar mu shiga, haka nike ganin kamar zaifi."
cikin jin dadi yace. "Kwarai hakan za'ayi  shiyasa nike san harka dakai, kana kawo mafita."
Commenders din Yaki ne suka dinga za gaye Jaruman su suna gyara masu sahu sahu iya ganin ka, dan ba karamin yawa ne dasu ba..... 

****************************
A cikin Masarautar Daborah kuwa Yarima Malik ne zaune ya kasa bacci, ya rasa mike mashi dadi a rayuwa duba agogo yayi yaga dare baiba ko takwas ba tayi  ba da yake yana yin  damuna ne da, marece yayi sai kaga kamar dare ne yayi, mahaifiyar shi ce ta faɗo mashi arai da sauri ya mike yace. "Kai bai kamata ace har yanzun banga Ummu ba nasan ba zata zoba tunda tana jin haushi na."
mikewa yayi ya ɗauki alqabbar shi  ya ɗaura a jikin shi sannan ya nufi sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yana shiga ya isketa dasu Yazid sun gama shirin yanda zasu bullowa makiyan su, gaisawa sukayi da Yazid ganin Malik yazo yasa shi tafiya, zama yayi gefen ta sannan ya gaida ta  kallo ɗaya tai mashi ta kauda kai,take yaji jikin shi yai sanyi sake matsowa yayi ya rike hannun ta sannan yace. "Ummu kiyi hakri akan abun da  ya faru nasan ni mai laifine gareki amman bazan iya jure fushin kiba akaina dan Allah, Ummu duk abinda ki kaga  ya dace kimani amman banda fushi dani." Kallan shi tayi a ranta ko cewa tayi, Malik kenan tuni karusa komai kaida ubanka ammn a zahiri ko cewa tayi. "Ya kamata  kaje ka huta karka damu  ai komai  ya wuce."shima kallan ta yayi yana nazarin ta, dan bai yarda da ta hakura ba yasan in ya matsa yanda take  cikin ɓacin rai komai zai iya faruwa,cewa yayi. "Nagode miki uwa mai alkhairi, mai tausayi kinfi kowa alkhairi Ummu Allah ya ɗauraki akan makiyan ki."
da ameen ta amsa masa a takaice, Binta ce ta shigo tai mata sallama zata tafi gida kallan ta  tayi tace. "Kije kice ma Sarkin horo ya kwan to  Abdulmajid sannan kice ma  Abdulmajid cikin daren nan a shirya mani bayi maza guda ashirin su zasu kulaman da lafiyar Jarumai na."
wani dadi ne  ya ziyarci Binta da sauri tace. "Shikenan Allah ya kara maki lfy angama." haka ta tafi cikin sauri ta isar da sakon Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, haka aka saki Abdulmajid  tare da  Binta suka wuce gida yana zuwa yaga Bahijja murna wajen Abdulmajid bayyana ta ɓata lokaci ne, hakama Bahijja sai murna takeyi harda kwallar ta dan murnar ganin mahaifin ta, ganin yanda ya shagala da ganin yar sa, hakan yasa Binta ta gaya mashi sakon da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta bata, yana jin abin da  tace bai kara  dadewa ba ya wuce ya fara shirya mata hadimai kamar yanda ta bukata...

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Wajen Sarki Lahazu kuwa shima ya iso bakin Masarautar Daborah tunda ga  nesa ya fara hangen dandazon mutane bakaramin mamaki yayi ba da ganin su, saida ya kusa isowa ya fahimci kayan jikin su kamar na Masarautar Raifasu, cikin kwarin guiwa ya iso, aiko suka fara kallan kallo da juna dan sunyi mamaki domin  ba wanda yai zatan zai iske ɗan uwanshi awajen musamman Sarki Baidulƙais da yake ma kanshi tambayoyi mi ya kawo Sarki Lahazu wajen Yaki, sai dai baida wannan ansar, shiko Sarki Lahazu yana ganin Sarki Baidulƙais yasan abunda ya kawo dan ya anshi Bahijja, kowa ya tsaya wajen jama'ar shi shiko Sarki Danwar cewa yayi daman Baidulƙais ya gayyaci Sarki Lahazu shine ya ɓoye mani bakomai ya munafurceni kenan?
haka kowa yai ta sake sake, a cikin zuciyar shi ganin sunki yima junan su  magana hakan yasa Sarki Danwar yace kowa da tafiyar shi kenan? zuwa yayi suka gaisa da Sarki Lahazu, sannan yace suyi hadin guiwa su Yaki Sarauniya Zulaiƙa  da yaki yarda ganin Sarki Baidulƙais nai mashi kallan hadarin kaji, amman daga baya sai ya  yarda dan cimma wani buri nashi cike da kudiri iri iri a cikin zuciyar shi, shima Sarki Baidulƙais yaji dadin tayin da Sarki Danwar yaima, Sarki Lahazu, shima zuciyar shi cike take da ɗaukar fansa, baki dayan su bamai alkhairi  a cikin zuciyar shi hatta Sarki Danwar shima ya haɗa kansu ne dan ya cimma wani buri nashi akan su, shiko Sarkin kofa tashi yayi daga kwanciyar da yayi jin hani niyar dawa kai dake tashi fiye da zaton shi bude yar kofa yayi yaga mayaƙa iya ganin shi da sauri ya koma yana rike kirji da kanshi ba ɗan aike ba ya tafi ya ga yama Sarauniya Zulaiƙa a can ya  iske Yarima Malik,koda suka ji sakon da Sarkin kofa ya fada masu  sai da kowa a cikin su ya mike da sauri.   

MalikusSaif ya fita yaje sashen shi,  ya fara shirin Yaki wasu kaya yasa na saƙi yasa wata hula sannan ya ɗauki kibiyoyi ya saga a kafadar shi ya saka takalman fatar damisa, da sauri ya nufi wajen su Yazid akan hanya suka hadu da Saifulislam shima labari yazo mashi na isowar abokan gabar su, a tare suka isa filin da Jaruman su suke kowa ya shirya iya ganin ka da makamai, MalikusSaif ne ya tura wani Jarumi ya sanar ma Huzaifa sa isowar abokan gaba, suna zaune da gimbiya Zahara'u tanata iyayi wai Yariman ta ya dawo, yana isa ya ya gayama Huzaifa da sauri ya mike  bai ɓata lokaci ba yafara shiri, cikin kankanin lokaci ya fita zuwa wajen su Malik, ita ko  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta gama shiri tsaf kamar da ita za'ay artabar haka ta shirya ta fito cikin jar alqabba da sharɓeɓiyar takobi a hannun ta, ita da wazirin ta suka isa wajen su Yarima Malik tayi mamakin ganin yanda Malik da Saifulislam suka shirya cikin kankanin lokaci dan ba tayi zatan Saifulislam  zai shiga cikin Yakin ba, Musamman yanda tasan yana fushi da ita, MalikusSaif ne yasa Jaruman su suka rabu kashi biyar kashe ɗaya yace  shi zai jasu kashe na biyu Waziri Dammur sai kashi na ukku yace Saifulislam, kashi na hudu kuma yace Yazid sai kuma kashi na biyar kuma yace Huzaifa zai zama Commender din su haka suka gama shirin su kowa hankalin shi ya koma kan Yakin da suke shirin yi.

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿
Wajen su Sarki Baidulƙais kuwa sun gama bin shawarar da Sarki Danwar ya basu, take suka fara haurawa saman katan gar Masarautar aiko suna shiga cikin Masarautar suka kashe Sarkin kofa sannan suka buɗe kofar, Jarumai ne iya ganin ka sukai ta  kutsawa cikin Masarautar Daborah kamar basu karewa cikin kankanin lokaci suka fara sarar mutane duk wanda suka haɗu dashi a hanya, take hayaniya duk ta gauraye kaf Masarautar, shiko MalikusSaif yana jin  an shigo  yaja tawa gar shi suka fito, suka tari makiya koda yaga tasasar mutanen da suka shigo saida ya tsorata, dakewa kawai yayi ya fiddo wata matsiyaciyar kibiyar shi lokaci guda idan ya saketa sama da hamsin suna iya fita haka Yarima Malik ya dinga kashe mutane  kamar ba gobe, suma abokan karawar tasu haka sukai ta kisar mutanen Yarima Malik, yaki akeyi marar kyaun fasali ga tasasar mutanen su Yarima Haishir sai kara shigowa sukeyi amman haka su Yarima Malik ke kara kutsa kai ciki yana sauke kan maza koda suka game janyo dalliyar takobin shi yayi da duka hannu biyu kan mai uwa da wabi ya dinga fille kan maza, kashi biyu daga cikin tawagar su Sarki Lahazu suka tunkari filin dasu Yazid ke tsaye saboda sun kasa mutanen su,kowa yasan lokacin da zai tunkari abokan gabar su, suna tahowa wajen su, tasasa guda take Huzaifa ya fiddo da kibiya saida ya buɗa ta sosai sannan ya saketa akau ya bazar da mutane masu yawan gaske,  yana farawa sauran Jaruman suma suka dinga halbama abokan gabar su kibiyoyi, ba abinda kake gani sai gawar waki birjik fululu kafin su karaso wajen sun kashe fiye da rabi sadda zasu iso kowa ya ɗauko wani faifai na silba mai kwari sukayi  kariya dashi, da sun taho saman dawakai sai suka kariyar hannun su, su bugi doki dashi ya faɗi susa mashi su kashe su, cikin kankanin lokaci su Yazid sun kusa karar da mutane masu yawan gaske.

Shiko Yarima MalikusSaif yana can tsakiyar mayaka anata fafatawa dashi wata kaca ce doguwa ya ɗauko ya wurgama wani Jarumin su ya rike ta da sun wullata sai su zabaro sama da mutun goma suja haka suka dinga ɗebe kawunan mutane, kaca kaca haka su Yarima Malik sukai ma mutanen su Sarki Lahazu, koda suka ga  cikin kashi haɗu na mutanen su ankusa karar da kashi biyu d sauri Sarkin Yakin su suka busa wani usur da gudu suka koma baya, dan sake shiri, danko Sarki Baidulƙais koda yaga yanda Yarima Malik ke wasa da rayuwar Jaruman su, ba karamin  tsorata yai ba shiyasa ya koma baya ko gigin shigowa baiba da yaga Yarima Malik sai ya tuno da kisan gillar da yaima ɗan shi Yarima HusbarulƘais shi yasa  bai san yana haye mashi fatan shi ya samu akashe shi a wannan Yakin, lokacin da Jaruman su suka koma cikin sahu yaki ya lafa lokacin karfe goman dare, komai ya kaure abubuwa sun rude a cikin Masarautar Daborah, suko su Huzaifa tawagar da suka faɗa masu sun gama karar dasu, ba inda suka motsa inda MalikusSaif yace su tsaya basu matsa ba suna wajen sai dai suma an kashe masu mutanen su, masu yawa, a wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuwa tana can wajen adana kayan Yaki tasa anata jido makamai iya ganin ka, tana zuwa takara ba maya kanta, kura ta lafa bakajin karar komai kowa yayi bakam yana dakon abokan gabar su, koda Yarima Malik yaga haka tattaro jama'ar shi yayi yasa suka rabu kashe biyu kashin farko suka tsaya ta gabas saura kuma suka tsaya tareda shi, wajen su Baidulƙais kuwa sun koma wani fili daga cikin Masarautar Daborah, suna tsayawa Yarima Haishir yace ma mutanen su,su kasu kashi ukku su kewaye cikin Masarautar haka kuwa sukayi, jin shirun yai yawa gashi har shaɗayan dare yayi basu jin  motsin mutanen Sarki Baidulƙais, Yarima Malik ne ya naɗa sabon Commender ya kwashi kashi ɗaya suka bi ta cikin  lambu suka kewaye su Yarima Haishir saida suka bari sun saki jikin su, suka farajin ruwan kibau tako ina dan MalikusSaif ya kware da iya halba kibiya, rasa ta inda ake halbin su sukayi, can suka hango su Yarima Malik akan dawakai suna halbin su, suma halbin su Malik din suka dingayi har ya isa cikin su ya ƙutsa kan dokin shi a cikin su, suka dinga ba juna wuta, kashi dayan da Yarima Malik ya bari sune suka rifa masu baya suka saka su Yarima Haishir  tsakiya ankashe mutane da yawan gaske, haka suma su Yarima Haishir sun kashe mutanen da Yarima Malik yazo dasu wajen su dan har sunfara murnar sun karar da Jaruman Daborah ranar haka haka suka kusa kai safe ana abu guda, danko duk inda ka wuce mutanene falala iya ganin ka an kashe kamar kiyashi, har asuba tayi ana artaba, ko sallah saidai suka dinga yinta a tsorace idan wasu sukayi sai wasu su koma cikin filin Yaki, sannan wasu su tafi suma suyi.

****************************

Koda gari ya waye Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce tasa Sarkin Shela ya fara shela yace. "Ance kowa ne Jarumi ya koma cikin tawagar shi za'a fara Yaki a filin *JINDAZ* a cikin wannan Masarautar  ta Daborah dan haka anaso cikin kankanin lokaci kowa yabi dokar da aka sanya dan fafatawa, aiko sauran Jaruman su Sarki Lahazu suka dinga shiga cikin wani katafaren fili mai girman gaske  iya ganin mai kallo haka suka dinga shiga sahu sahu, saboda yawan su kamar ba akashe kowa ba dan yawa, su kansu sunyi mamakin yawan makayan da Sarki Baidulƙais ya haɗa musamman Sarauniya Zulaiƙa saida taga sun gama wucewa daga karshe taga Sarki Baidulƙais  da Danwar sai Sarki Lahazu, cikeda mamki tace a ranta, miyasa mutanen keda zamba cikin aminci ashe ba Baidulƙais bane kadai, ina zamu kai waɗan nan mutanen har haka, lallai kam Allah ya dafa mana duk wadan nan mutanen da muka kashe ashe ko kwata bamuyi ba?akwai sauran rina a kaba kenan! suma su MalikusSaif sun sha mamakin ganin tsabagen yawan Jaruman da sukazo dasu, kallan kallo aka dinga yima juna tsakanin Yarima Haishir da MalikusSaif kowa nai ma ɗan uwan shi kallan hadarin kaji, suma su MalikusSaif sun gama tsara sahun Jaruman su, yanzun yakin ya zama na sulhu sai an buga  kugen Yaki sannan za'a fara ba kamar na farko ba, da sukayi masu dirar mikiya, amman su Malik kowa da tawagar  da yake ja,  tsakanin su Yarima Malik dasu Yarima Haishir akwai tazara sosai, kowa yana jiran yaga sun sake haɗuwa da juna, haka Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta bada izini aka buga kugen Yaki, aiko mutanen su Yarima Haishir suka tunkaro mutanen su MalikusSaif, gudu a saman dawakan su, Huzaifa ne da yan tawagar shi suka dinga sakin ruwan kibiyoyi suna kashe abokan hamayyar su, cikin kankanin lokaci suka game, aka ci gaba da fafatawa kowa nasan yaga yaci galaba akan makayan shi.




 _Ƴar Mutan Kankia ce❣️_

بسم الله الرحمن الر حيم




Episode 35&36



Suna gamewa aka cigaba da kisar juna da takubba bakajin karar komai sai karfe yana dokuwa da juna jini ba zuba kamar ruwa wannan karon kuwa Yarima Malik nw da Yazid ke artaba makiya su kuma Sarkin Yakin Raifasu da Yarima Haishir sune ke jan tawagar su, akwai wani basamudan bawa yana cikin mutanen Sarki Danwar shike ta kisar mutanen su Malik da ya shiga fili sai ya bazar da mutane birjik dayake lokacin gari ya waye kowa na ganin gaban shi, shiyasa Yakin yafi yima kowa dadi musamman Jaruman Baidulƙais wanda basu da burin da yawuce su ɗauki Bahijja hakama a wajen Yarima Haishir burin shi ya ɗauki Bahijja ko ana ga maza ha mata, koda Yarima Malik yaga wannan bawan nata kasar mutanen su kamar ba gobe da gudu ya sukwano akan dokin shi ya tunkare shi ya janyo wata kaca a bayan shi ya wulwulata ya sargaho kan wannan bawan ji kake ya faɗi tim saman doki ya dinga janshi kasa har saida ya kashe shi yana zuwa wajen wani icce ya bugashi take kanshi ya wargaje hakan ba karamin ɗagama Haishir hankali yaiba saidai Malik bata shi yake ba yamaida shi karamin kwaro a cikin filin da'gar duk abinda sukeyi akan idanun Sarakunan su akeyin shi kowa na cikin Jamaarsu hakama Sarauniya Zulaiƙa da take jifar Sarki Baidulƙais da shu'umin kallo, Yaki yai Yaki kura tai kura bak ganin komai sai tartsatsin wuta dake fita a jikin takubban su, kowa yana iya bakin kokarin shi dan ganin ya cimma burin shi akan ɗan uwan shi, abu kamar wasa Jaruman Baidulƙais sun kusa karar da tawagar Yazid da Malik gashi ansaka su tsakiya anata sarar su, bakaramin tashin hankali bane ya dira a cikin zuciyar Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ganin an zagaye su Malik anata sara da alama ankusa karar da mutanen da suke jagoran ta, shiko Malik yagama shagala baimasan anzagaye suba, yana waigawa yaga mutanen su saura kaɗan wani sabon karfi yaji yakara kamash lokaci wani uban tsalle yayi ya sargaho kan Sarkin Yakin Ƙaisu ya haye saman dokin shi ya wullo shi ƙasa, ya haye saman dokin wukake ya ɗauko ya dinga fille kan maza shima Yazid yana ganin Malik ya tunkaro su yai tsalle ya hau saman dokin shi, atare suke kasar mutane ga kawuna kasa burjik kamar ruwa, wani irin dadine ya sake dirarma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa a cikin zuciya, suna haɗa ido da Zulaiƙa ta cilloma Yazid kibiya yana caɓewa ya dire saman doki ya dira gefe ya cigaba ruwan kibau, cikin kankanin lokaci tsakanin Yazid da MalikusSaif sun kusan cin dunun  su Haishir suko Jaruman su Haishir  saura kadan su karar da tawagar su Malik, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce taje wajen su Huzaifa ta taso da tawaga biyu, suka shigo cikin tawagar su Malik a tsorace Sarki Danwar yacema Sarki Lahazu. "Kana ganin zamuyi nasara akan wannan matar kaga sunfimu dubarar Yaki, ashe ba dukan Jaruman subane gaskia munyi kuskure da muka shigo baki ɗayan mu, kaga mutanen mu sun kashe jama'arta da yawa dayake ba duka bane amman kamar bamu kashe suba, gaskia ya kmata musan yanda zamu dakile wannan yakin sai zuwa anjima."


Wani banza kallo Sarki Lahazu yaima Sarki Danwar yace. "Kabar wannan maganar ma ba wani Yakin da zamu yanke saidai yanzun so nike musamu,  akashe wannan shegen ɗan iskan yaron dan na fahimci kusan shi kejan ragamar wannan Yakin gaskia MalikusSaif ya cika Jarumin gaske."
Sarki Baidulƙais yazo yace. "Ku kwantar da hankalin ku yanzun haka munada kusan kashi ukku a cikin Jaruman mu, dan haka yanzun abinda nikeso daku kowa ya shirya zamunemi inda bayi suke dan ɗaukar Bahijja kunji abinda zamuyi." cikin gamsuwa kowa ya amince,wani kaskantaccen kallo Sarki Lahazu yaima Baidulƙais a zuciyar shi ko cewa yayi hmm yaro kenan kaɗauka zan tayaka ne ɗaukar Bahijja ai ina ganin Bahijja saida kaga bani ba Bahijjar dakake ikirari saidai koni ko kai.....


A wajen su Yarima Malik kuwa ana cikin gabzar Yaki, wani bakin Jarumi ya sari Huzaifa a hannu aiko take jini ya balle,koda Malik yaga an sari Huzaifa jini ya ɗibe gadan gadan yayi kanshi da takobi zai sauke kan Huzaifa shi kanshi ya fidda rai da angama sare mashi, aiko Malik yai kukan kura ya tsaga mutumin biyu rigijib ya faɗi kasa a mace, cikin sassarfa Malik yazo ya kama Huzaifa  jini na zuba yabi ta wata hanya ya shige dashi wani gini da alama wajen adana kayan tarihi ne ya zaunar da Huzaifa wani farin kyalle Malik ya ciro a aljihun shi ya ɗaurema Huzaifa hannun shi cikin tausayawa yace. "Sannu Huzaifa ka zauna nan zaifi tsaro kaga ba kowa yasan da nan din ba, sannan inna samu dama zan kawo maka Bahijja ka boyemani ita kaga mutanen nan sunfimu yawa daman Allah na dafamana munacin galaba akan su." dakyal Huzaifa yace. "Shikenan abokina ka kula da kyau inna samu sauki zan dawo filin Yaki." girgiza kai Malik yayi alamar Aa sannan yace. ''Kai zaman ka kacigaba da yimana addu'a rike wannan takobin bani kibiyar ka." yana ansa ya tafi yana maijin tausayin aminin nashi abinka da yasan ko ina dayake Masarautar suce ta wata hanya ya bullo ya dinga sakin kibau sai gawar mutane aka gani kasa birjik danko Yazid yasha mamaki duk da yayi tunanin Malik ne kamar aljani sukaji da diro tsakiyar su, daga wata katanga aiko ya zaro takobi yaci gaba da artaba da magauta, suna cikin Yaki kawai yaji sun haɗe da Yarima Haishir warewa sukayi kowa yacigaba da nuna bajin tarshi akan ɗan uwan shi baki ɗaya hankalin Sarakuna ya koma kan su Malik musamman Sarki Lahazu da gaban shi ke faɗuwa yana tsoron kada akashe mashi ɗa, haka aka dinga barin wukake ji kare karaf karaf tarwatsin wuta na fita tsakanin Malik  da Haishir kamar an dakatar da Yaki kallo ya koma wajen su MalikusSaif da sauri Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta iso ganin Yaki  ya dakata ta ɗauka ankarar mata da jama'a, saidai tayi mamakin ganin Malik da Haishir ana gabza uban Yaki, cikin gayya Malik ke ranwa da Haishir so yake yagama wahalar dashi, shiko harya fara sikewa dan yagama yarda MalikusSaif gwarzone kuma Jarumi wanda ya kware wajen iya sarrafa takobi musamman kibiya, yanda yaga yanata zukewa yakasa samun shi da takobi hakan yasa Haishir yai kamar zai faɗi aiko ya taɗe MalikusSaif y faɗi kasa da sauri Haishir yai kan Malik da har su Yazid zasu shiga aiko Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta ɗaga mashi hannu dan ta sadakar da ran ɗanta tunda yakai kasa shiko Malik ko ajikin shi yaƙi tashi saida ya bari Haishir ya iso ya daga takobi zai cakama Malik yasa kafa ya halbar da Haishir ya mike ya ɗauki takobi ya wurwurata ya cillama Haishir aiko Sarkin Yakin Lahazu yazo zai kare Haishir take ta sauke kanshi sai kasa ko shurawa baiba bakaramin tsorone ya kama Haishir taɓa wuyan shi yayi yaga bashi aka kashe ba cikin tsoro Jaruman su Baidulƙais suka koma saman layin da yaraba iyaka suka tsaya dasu Yazid zasu bisu Yarima Malik ya hanasu suma cikin jama'ar suka koma saidai suma anmasu asarar rayukan mutanen su.......


Hutu suka tafi tunda sunki dawowa filin da'ga wannan ya nuna ma su Malik sun tafi hutu suma zama sukayi cikin kankanin lokaci Binta da sauran bayi suka fara kawo masu abincin da zasuci da ruwa shi kuma Abdulmajid su suka shigo da bayi maza suna ɗauke masu ciwuka suna basu taimakom gaggawa kamar yanda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta umurta haka suka samu waje na musamman suna ajesu ana samu magani, haka suma wajen Sarki Baidulƙais Jamra ce da sauran bayi suka dinga kawo masu abinci sunaci da ruwa sunaba Jaruman su kulawa saidai tunda Allah yasa ta shigo Masarautar Daborah idanun ta kesan suga Bahijja saidai bata gantaba, can ta hango wata dattijuwar mata da alama uwar bayin Masarautar ce da kaganta kaga Bahijja hakan yasa taji cewa Mahaifiyar Bahijja ce tanaso tagan ta amman ba dama dan batasan Sarki Baidulƙais yai zatan akwai matsala tasan mutun ne shi mai basira da saurin gano abu, basarwa tayi taciga ba da abinda takeyi har akai la'asar, kowa ya huta.....



A wajen su Malik kuwa zaune suke suna shawarar yanda zasu bullowa abokan gabar su, wannan karan Saifulislam ne da Waziri Dammur zasu ga ragamar Yakin kallan su Yarima Haishir sukayi sukaga sun linkasu yawa sau biyu, Saifulislam ne yace. "Abinda ya bani mamaki ga mutanen nan yawan Jaruman su, dagani hadin guiwa ne." "Malik ne yace. "Abbuh harda ƴan Masarautar Waisu inda muka ɗauko Bahijja sai yan Masarautar Ƙaisu da alama sunyi hadin guiwa ne yana gama fadar haka yasha ruwa, cikin kulawa Yazid yace "wai ina Bahijjar dan bazamu yarda arabata da iyayen taba a karo na biyu ba."cikin jin ddin maganar Yazid, Malik yace. "Tana turakar bayi kasan basu san sirrin Masarautar nan ba, ba lallai su iya gane wajen ba, sun cikin magana saiga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace. "Yakamata ku sake gyara jama'ar mu nasan halin mutanen nan ba kirki suka cikaba zasu iya far mana munanan." haka kuwa akayi kowa ya tashi suka sake gyara sahu wannan karon kashe biyu aka bari aka tura ɗaya cikin tsakiyar Masarautar dan bada kulawa ta musamman...suma su Haishir sungama kimtsawa sunsa bayin su sun shiga cikin Masarautar Daborah cikin sirri sun nemomasu turakar bayi suka dawo suka shaidama Yarima Haishir, yanzun so suke sai Yaki ya nutsa sannan su tura tawaga ɗaya suje su ɗauke Bahijja su gudu da ita, da wannan shirin suka shiga cikin sahun Yaki, a wajen su sakin Yakin Daborah kuwa suna fitowa a gidan Yari suka fara shiri dasu Lurwan kowa ya shirya suka haɗa tawaga guda suka tsaya gab da fa'da suna jiran Yaki ya kamre kafin su shiga cikin filin da'ga, aikuwa wannan karon Sarki Baidulƙais shine yasa Sarkin busa ya buga kugen Yaki aka sake gamewa a karo na UKKU saibama juna wuta akeyi wannan karon kua Saifulislam ne cikin Jarumai da tawagar shi ana fafatawa sai fille kan maza yake kamar ruwa haka yake kisar su hakama Dammur ba'a basar su abaya ba, dan sun kashe mutane ba kadan ba suma ankashe nasu ba iyaka koda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa taga anata kisar jama'ar ta tahowa tayi zataba Wazirin ta kibiya dan tasan shima gwanine wajen iya halbi da kibiya ji tayi an buga mata gefen mashi a ciki dafe cikin ta tayi a fusace ta zaro takobi a jikin ta ta daɓama wanda ya sareta sai a jikin Sarki Baidulƙais, da sauri taja baya tana kafe takobin ta a saman kasa sannan suka dinga aikawa junan su da shu'umin kallo, wani irin tsawa Sarki Baidulƙais yayi ya afkama Zulaiƙa itako takobi tasa ta kare kanta sannan sukaci gaba da fafatawa, duk yanda yaso ya caka mata wuka taki yarda saita zille yayi mamakin kallar Jarumta ta Sarauniya Zulaiƙa bakaramin iya sarrafa takobi take ba, wani wawan sara takowa Baidulƙais ta same shi a kafaɗa jini ya fashe har tsurtuwa yakeyi, da sauri yai baya shiko Sarki Danwar na ganin haka ya shiga yacigaba da fafatawa da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa cikin kwarewa suke kaima juna sara, koda Yarima Malik ya waigo yaga Mahaifiyar shi na artaba da Sarki Danwar da sauri yabar abokin gabar shi yayo kansu, shiko Sarkin yakin Waisu biyo bayan shi yayi da takobi yana isowa ya shiga yai tsalle ya halbe takobin Danwar ta faɗi kasa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta yanke shi a hannu ya faɗi cikin gafin nama ta tafi zata kashe shi, sai taji na daɓama Malik wuka a hannu da sauri ya dafe wajen  ya anshe takobin hannun Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ya sauke kan Sarkin Yakin Waisu da kaushin rai yayi kan Sarki Danwar, Jaruman shi suka janye shi, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa cw takama Malik suka tafi, wata rigace ya yaga ya ɗaure hannun shi yaci gaba da fafatwa, fatan shi jama'ar su suci galaba akan makiya, koda Yaki yao Yaki komai ya hargitse haka Sarkin Yakin Daborah suia shigo ta kofar baya shida su Lurwan suka fara karo da kawunan maza dda takubba take sukaima mutanen su Haishir rina sukaira kasarsu, danko Lurwan shine na biyu a gwanayan iya halba kibiya a cikin Masarautar Daborah daga MalikusSaif sai shi, da yaja kibiya idan ya saki sama da talatin saita watse, sai ɓarar da maza yake, koda hankalin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ya dawo jikin ta can taga Lurwan da Sarkin Yaki na kashe maza wani irin dadi taji taga tananda sauran hazikai dan yanzun sukejin kwarin su, zuwa yanzun mutanen su sun zama dai dai da jama'ar Baidulƙais koda zasu fisu sa kaɗan ana cikin Yaki Yarima Haishir suka sabe shida wata tawagar sai idan Yarima Malik da Yazid binsu sukayi dan ganin inda zasu abin mamaki turakar bayi sukayi, itako Bahijja sallah kawai takeyi tana rokarma su Ya Malik dinta nasarar Yaki tana kuka tana addu'a gashi jin shiru Umman ta da Abban ta basu dawo ba yasa tafara kuka tana tsoron kar akashe su, tana cikin addu'a taji kamae tafiya hakan yasa ta tashi ta fita zata tafi wajen Yaki taga halin da ake ciki so take taga Umman ta, tana cikin tafiya taji ankamata anjanyeta kwalla ihu tayi abanza,fita akayi da ita ta kofar gaba a cikin turakar bayin  suna son su gudu da ita saiga su Malik aiko,MalikusSaif yaja wata bakar kibiya yacema babban Jarumin Sarki Lahazu yace. "Sakarta ko yanzun inkasheka." shiko ɗaura ma Bahijja wuka a wuya yayi yacema Malik ya aje makamin shi koya ksheta.....ai baibari ya karasa maganar ba ya saita kibiya ta saitin fuskar Bahijja ya kashe shi ta tsakiyar kwakwalwar shi, take yafaɗi mace ba rai, tsoro ne yakara kama su Haishir take suka sake kaurewa ture Bahijja Malik yayi a jikin shi sukaci gaba da artaba hankalin shi yayi kan makiya aiko Haishir ya sabe da Bahijja ta hanyar rufe mata baki yabi ra wata hanya shi niyar shi ya gudu bai saniba yagan shi tsakar filin Yaki, itako Bahijja tagama rudewa ganin kawuna kasa, danko wajen su Lurwan da Saifulislam baka ganin komai sai kawuna sun kashe kamar ba gobe, koda Bahijja taga sai nutswa da ita yake cikin filin Yaki batasan ta gartsa mashi cizo ba, aiko ta saki kara, kallone ya dawo wajen su musamman su Sarauniya Zulaiƙa dasu Sarki Baidulƙais, Wani irn dadi yaji yaga an amso mashi Bahijjar shi kafeta da mayun idanun shi yayi, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce tasa aka buga kuge komai ya lafa, kamar yanda sukayi sharadi idan har sukayi nasarar tafiya da Bahijja to Yaki zai tsaya sunci galaba, idan kuma har suka kasa fita da Bahijja a cikin Masarautar Daborah to ancisu Yaki kuma basu ba sake neman ansar Bahijja, Yaki na tsayawa alamar Yarima ya samu nasarar ɗauko Bahijja saura fita da ita cikin Masarautar Daborah, wani kululune ya tokare Sarki Baidulƙais baisan ya isoba ya nuna na Haishir hannu alamun ya bashi Bahijja, aiko Haishir ya bige hannun Baidulƙais cikin fushi yace. "Bahijja tawace kuma ni nai nasarar ɗauko ta dan haka zanyi anfani da karfina dan inga na tafi da ita Masarautar mu."wani mugun kallo Baidulƙais ya watsama Haishir a fusace yace.....

Sukaci gaba da artaba suke basu ji basu gani kowa yana da burin da ya keso ya cimmawa akan Bahijja danko rigima tai kamari , suko mutanen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sai dai suka koma yan kallo, cikin kankanin lokaci Sarki Lahazu yasa kaf Jaruman shi sun dawo kalkashin ikon shi, suma na Baidulƙais suka koma kalkashin ikon Sarkin su, shiko Danwar gefe ya koma da tashi jama'ar yace tunda rigima takoma ta gida ta aminnai ba wanda zai shigar mawa, awajen Malik ko suna gama karar da tawagar Haishir ya duba baiga Bahijja ba take ya bazama cikin Masarautar Daborah dan  neman Bahijja a rude, itako Bahijja duk ta rude, mamaki ne ya ishi zuciyar Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta rasa dalilin da yasa su  Baidulƙais ke yakar junan su akan baiwa, baiwar ma Bahijja kodai suna sonta suke dan kyawun ta kodai fasikanci suke da it? a wani ɓangaren zuciyar ta kowa tayi  baiwa ce fa, taya zasu so baiwa? mtsw taya haka/ma zata kasan ce. 
jin karar sarar da suke kaima juna  ya maida ta cikin hankalin t, Yarima Haishir ne ya kaima Baidulƙais sara nan ya daɓa mashi wuka akafa, shiko cikin jin zafin abinda Yarima Haishir yai mashi  baisan ya daɓa mashi wuka a ciki ba, take ya faɗi cikin jini face face, da gudu Sarki Lahazu ya zari takobi ya wurgoma Baidulƙais ya sameshi a gefen kafaɗa aiko jini ya fara zuba, sake zaro wata takobin yayi suka game, cikin karfi so yake ya kashe Baidulƙais cikin kankanin lokaci Yaki ya kaure tsakanin Jaruman su kowa yana kokari akan ganin ya kashe ɗan uwan shi sai kisar junan su sukeyi a banza a wofi, Koda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta shiga sashen ta, takai gwaro ta kai mari take haka ta dingayi ji take kirjin ta na bugawa da sauri da sauri ba inda ke mata yawo a kwakwalwa sai inda Yarima Malik ke cewa Bahijja ta wace ni kadai akan Bahijja zan iya halaka kowa kuma nafi kowa kaunar ta.....da sauri ta toshe kunnuwan ta cikin kankanin lokaci idanun ta suka sauya, shi gewa tayi cikin bedroom dinta sannan ta shiga bathroom wanka tayi tana wanke ciwon da Sarki Baidulƙais yai mata, tana cikin wanka taji muryar Saifulislam duk hankalin shi nakan matar shi yasan anjima ta ciwo so yake yaga yanda ciwon yake ita ko  tana cikin wanka ta zuba ma ciwon ruwan zafi bata san sanda tace Auhhh! jin yanda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa taja dogon ihu baisan sanda ya faɗa bathroom dinba jitayi an riketa, a tsorace ta waiga taga mijinta ne bata san  sadda ta rungume shiba tana kuka mai taɓa zuciya ba, bubbuga bayan ta yahau yi, sannan ya kama ciwon yaga yankan yana da girma fita yayi dakin ta cikin wata wadirofe ya ɗauko wani magani yazo ya wanke mata jikin ta daga karshe ya wanke mata ciwon dake hannun nata, itako sai kallan shi takeyi batai tsammanin zai sakko cikin sauki ba tasan halin Saifulislam mutun ne mai tsananin hakuri saidai bai iya fushi ba,wani zani ne ya dauko ya ɗaura mata sannan ya ɗauke ta  ya kwantar da ita saman gado da kanshi ya shirya ta sannan ya ɗauko wani magani ya zuba ciwon kara tayi ya fara bata hakuri cikin tausayawa sannan yasa farin kyalle ya ɗaure mata ciwon,bude wardrofe din ta yayi ya ɗauko Milk din alqabba ya saka mata, cigaba da rirritata yayi yace.  basarwa tayi tace. "Haba keko mi kike zargi aranki mata ta."? "Hmmm Abu Malik kenan wannan abun a bayyane yake kardai ace Malik son Bahijja yakeyi." da sauri yasa hannu ya rufe mata baki ya sake kwantar d ita a kirjin shi yana bubbuga bayan ta shi kanshi yana jin  yanda zuciyar ta ke duka da sauri da sauri, yasan zata iya samun matsala shi kuma yana son matar shi, cikin sanyin murya yace. "Haba Sarauniya ta ki daina tunanin haka a cikin kyakkyawar zuciyarki mai tsafta wadda bata saba da zargi ba, ina Malik ina baiwa, karfa ki manta Bahijja baiwar Malik ce ba abinda zatai mashi daya wuce hidima a matsayin ta na baiwa kuma hadimar shi." Kaɗa kai kawai ta iya yi alamun hakane kamar mai tuna wani abu ta tashi da sauri tace. "Bazan bar Bahijja ta kusanci ɗana ba amatsayin baiwar sa hadima asalina ma bansan tana fitowa cikin turakar bayi zuwa cikin Masarautar nan, na yafe mata duk wata hidima amatsayin baiwa na ƴan tata afagen bauta tai zaman cikin dangin ta bayi wannan shine hukuncin dana yanke mijina."
murmushin yake ya saki domin yaga tsantsar kiyayyar Bahijja a cikin kwayar idan Zulaiƙa baisan yai mata musu tana cikin wannan halin na ɓacin rai, cewa yayi. "Bablaifi saidai kibar wannan zancen sai kin kara samun nutsuwa ba'a yanke hukunci cikin fushi."zata sake magana ya ɗaura mata yatsan shi saman lips sannan ya tashi ya mikar da ita tsaye yace. "Muje falo najiyo sallamar Waziri kilan ruwan ya tsaya musan yanda za'ai da waɗannan mugayen a tare suka fito suka samu Waziri zaune falo suma zama sukayi sannan Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta kalle shi tace. "Miye labari Waziri miye abinyi a halin yanzun."? Cikin girmamawa yace. "Ranki shidade ina tsammanin waɗan nan mutanen sun gaza  yanzun tuggun su ya koma kansu wannan shi'ake kira da ƙaiƙayi koma kan mashe kiya saidai kisani a shirye muke da mu kara Yakar su matsawar sun nuna hakan a zahiri." cikeda gamsuwa tace. "Baka ganin munyi asarar Jaruman mu."? "Eh hakane kam amman kuma ai sunfimu asara tunda nasu sun lunka namu sau ukku saidai yanzun wa'anda suka rage bai wuce kashi ɗaya ba ya kike tunanin zuciyar su nai masu ƙuna, sannan sun rasa manmayan mutanen su mufa? daga karshe sun ɓuge da Yakar junan su ya kike gani labarin zai kaya bayan sun koma Masarautun su."?
Wani shu'umin murmushi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta saki wanda tunda aka fara Yaki shine karin farko da tayi murmushi mai ɗauke da ma'anoni iri iri tace. "Da kyau  Waziri shiyasa kake da mahimmanci sosai musamman a cikin Masarautar Daborah yanzun.....
ji sukayi anshigo da gudu kamar an halbo shi Lurwan ne rike da takobi wadda ta gaji da shan jinin ɗan Adam dukawa yayi yace. "Allah ya taimakeki wuta ta tashi a cikin tsohon gidan tarihi na *Surƙu* wannan  daga abokan gabarmu, saidai bami kasa a guiwa ba mutanen mu nacan suna kokarin kashe ta." da sauri suka mike suka fita wuta ce ta gama kera ilahirin gidan tarihi mai ɗimbin tarihi a cikin Masarautar Daborah da gudu su MalikusSaif  suka cigaba da kashe ta sa kyal ta mutu itako Sarauniya Zulaiƙa da sauri da bankaɗa kofar suka shiga saidai bataci kayan su masu daraja a wajen su ba, tana fitowa ta dafe kirjinta can kuma sukaga an wurgo wani abu cikin kwalba ya faɗa saman kwanon gidan tarihi inda Takobin Barri take ajiye, bin inda aka halbo abin MalikusSaif  yayi yaga Mutanen Sarki Baidulƙais ne, take suka rabu kashi biyu wasu suka tunkare su da takubba da kibiyoyi wasu kuma suka cigaba da kashe wutar da aka tada masu a gidan adana tarihi na *BARRI* ciki kuwa harda MalikusSaif ake kokarin kashe wutar, suko su Yazid da Lurwan suketa kasar jama'ar Sarki Baidulƙais.......
