Episode 39&40



Haka su MalikusSaif suke ta faman kashe wuta amman kamar ana kara rura ta sai kara hauka takeyi, kamar ana sama ta fetir haka take hauka, danko Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta gama fita hayyacin ta ganin asarar dake shirin samun su, suko su Malik sunyi iyakar yinsu har sun fallawa Allah, ana cikin haka suka ga wani haske ya fito daga cikin ɗakin ya dira ƙasa sai sheƙi yakeyi, danko mamaki ya gama kama kowa, _*Wukar*_ *_Barri ce_* ta keta walauniya, ta kafe cikin ƙasa wani irin dadi ne  ya rufe Sarauniya Zulaiƙa da sauri ta isa wajen takobin Barri, takai hannu zata ɗauke ta hasken Wukar ya haske mata idanu har saida ta rufe idon ta, MalikusSaif ne ya iso wajen ya duka ya kama wukar ahankali hasken ya fara disashewa ɗaukar ta yayi, ya rike yana mamakin yanda akai takobin Barri ta fito daga cikin ɗakin da aka adana ta, wanda ta kwashe sama sa shekaru dubu huɗu a dane,cikin kankanin lokaci wutar ta mutu kamar ta tsafi suko su Yazid sai fafatawa sukeyi da jama'ar Sarki Baidulƙais ganin sun kusa karar dasu hakan yasa mutanen Baidulƙais suka koma bakin layi wanda yai masu iyaka dasu MalikusSaif , cikeda tsawa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace. "Baidulƙais dame kuke takama dashi a cikin Masarautar Daborah in Yaki kukeji yanzun aka fara saidai na haneku da kona mani  wurari masu dinbin daraja agareni!  Baiwa ce ta gagare ka kuma ka karya alkawali inda ka kasa ansar Bahijja yanzun muke da galaba a kanku sai ku kama gaban ku idan kuma baku gaji da artaba damu ba, sai acigaba daga inda aka tsaya ina tsammanin hakan yai maka kaida tawagar ka baki ɗayan ku.!"


Shiru Sarki Baidulƙais yayi yana jin  wani irin bakin ciki a zuciyar shi yana ji yana gani yai asarar farin cikin shi Bahijja sannan wannan shike nuna mashi rabuwar su da Sarrilƙus yazo tunda ya kasa  yima shi abinda ya umurce shi shekara da shekaru zaiyi magana kenan,  sai ga Wazirin Sarki Lahazu yazo gaban Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yace.
"Muna mubaya'a ga wannan Masarautar taki mai dinbin tarihi, Ya Zulaiƙa yanzun muke ganin gangancin da mukayi, muka hada karfi da karfe da makiyan mu, muka yake ku,  yau gashi soyayya ta zama  kiyayya kuma kiyayya ta zama soyayya, ina san kisa aranki Masarautar Waisu ta barranta da kawo maku hari ko Yakar ku yanzun mungane matsalar daga inda take, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ki sani yau zamu koma Masarautar mu cike da bakin ciki a cikin zukatan mu, an kashe mana Sarkin mu! Kuma shugaban mu,  ya kike ganin wannan lamarin zai kasan ce? rikic da ku kuwa ɓata lokaci, akan mutanen da basu damu damu ba, bayan anyi walkiya munga haske ga makiyan mu nan,ashe makiyan mu na tare damu na rantse da Gurfanai  sai mun darkake Masarautar Raifasu koda hakan yana nufin za'a karar da ire iren mu a cikin kasar Gambia dama duniya baki ɗaya.!"

Yana gama faɗar haka ya juya a fusace ya tafi dai dai wajen Sarki Baidulƙais ya tsaya sunai ma juna kallan kallo cikeda tsana marar misaltuwa harya wuce sai kuma ya dawo ya ɗaga takobin shi kamar zai sare wuyan Sarki  Baidulƙais, sai kuma ya ɗaura ta a gefen saman wuyan shi yana huci yace.
"Ba yanzun zamuyi yun kurin kashe kaba Baidulƙais saika gama shakar bakin cikin duniya sannan kasani na rantse da Gurfanai  ran Sarki Lahazu fansa ne a garemu koda zamu kare baki dayan mu kasa wannan a ranka da Masarautar Waisu kake magana.!"
fuszar da iska yayi sannan suka tafi shi ta tawagar su da gawar Sarki Lahazu wasu kuma suka ɗauki Yarima Haishir saman doki suka sashi sai nishi yakeyi sama sama ba kadan yakejin jiki ba.... 


Koda suka tafi Sarki Baidulƙais ya sauke  ajiyar zuciya dan yasan yanzun zasu fara artaba da Yarima Haishir, a zahiri ko cema Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yayi.
"Zulaiƙa kenan Jarumtar ki ta burgeni sannan taurin kanki yana bani mamaki, wato kin anshe Bahijja ko bayan kece kika bani ita, shin bari in tambaye ki, ina tunanin ki ya tafi da har zaki bar mayuwancin zaki a cikin dabbobi lokacin da yake bukatar cin abinci? nasan baki da wannan amsar! 
Ni Baidulƙais bari inbaki amsar da kaina! Kamar haka Bahijja take a wajena kisa aranki Bahijja sai ta dawo kalkashin ikona, sannan karki dinga jin kanki yana kara girma wai Sarki Baidulƙais ya samu  matsala da aminina Sarki Lahazu kinajin dadi gaba da ƙullu tsakani na da zuriar shi, kisani ni Baidulƙais ban yarda maka maina ba, akanki ko wane lokaci takobi na tana sage a kafaɗa ta bazan sauke taba har sai ranar dana cimma burina a cikin wannan Masarautar taki."


Murmushi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi tace.
"Ban shirya jin wannan sakarcin naka ba, danni ba sakara bace, Kamar ka! Dan haka yanzun nan nabaka nan da minti talatin kubar mani Masarauta ta, tunda kun gaza kunji kunya, kuje can kuci gaba da Yakar junan ku, Masarautar Daborah tafi karfin ku, sannan Bahijja tafi karfin ka, kasani duk wani bawa dake cikin wannan Masarautar tawa sunfi karfin ka, dan haka kar in kuskura in sake ganin wani maikama dakai ko mutanen ka a cikin Masarautar Daborah." 


Shiko Sarki Danwar sai jin dadi yakeyi ganin an ɓata da Sarki Baidulƙais dasu Yarima Haishir, ga anci galabar shi ya kasa ansar Bahijja yasan yanzun ba karamin artaba zasu kwasa tsakanin Yarima Haishir da Baidulƙais ba, tahowa yayi ya dafa kafadar Sarki Baidulƙais yace. "Abokina kwantar da hankalin ka, karka damu ya kamata mu tafi dan musan abinyi kaga abinda ke gaban mu ba wannan zancen ba, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa gaskia kin birgeni saidai kisani na barranta da artaba da wannan Masarautar dan lamarin ta abin al'ajbi ne da fatan zaki ƙarɓi kokon barata."

Wani kallo tai mashi ba tare da tace komai ba, shiko Sarki Baidulƙais kallan Sarki Danwar yakeyi cikeda mamakin maganar shi, ke mashi yawo a cikin kwakwalwar shi yace 
"Kokon bara tame kenan mi Sarki Danwar yake nufi? murmushin yake yayi yace. "Shikenan abokina zamu tafi, a sheke ya kalli Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yace zan tafi Zulaiƙa sai dai kisani akwai rina aka ba, saina mallaki Bahijja, dan haka ki saurari zuwa na." murmushi tayi ba tace  komai ba haka suka kwashi inasu inasu suka tafi da mutanen su suka tafi, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce tasa Jaruman ta suka fara gyaran gidn tarihin da aka sama wuta, sannan suka fara ɗaukar gawar Jaruman su sukayi jana'izar su suka gama binnewa sannan suka kwashe sauran gawar wakin Jaruman su Baidulƙais suka kaisu can cikin jeji cikin wani kogi suka juye su, sannan suka dawo wani fili Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta tara Jaruman ta ba laifi suna da yawa tace. "Ina maku godiya mai tarin yawa, da kuka jajirce cikin ikon Allah muka kare martabar Masarautar mu, sai dai kusani ni Sarauniya Zulaiƙa 'ya ga Sarki Abdulhamid daga yau bazan sake karɓar takardar gayyata ta Yaki ba,  na soke shi musamman in daga  wajen Sarki Baidulƙais ya iso, saboda ya karya alkawali da ace ya anshi Bahijja da yaci galaba akan mu, sai dai tunda ya gaza dole ya hakura da Yakar mu kamar yanda sharuɗdan wannan Masarautar ya gin daya a shekaru dubu ukku da suka gabata dan haka ni Zulaiƙa na soke Yaki a dalilin BAIWA, kuma a dalilin ta narasa abubuwa masu yawa musamman ma rayukan Jarumai na, saidai Allah yasa bamu  nasata Sannan bamuyi asarar kayan tarihin muba, da Wukar Barri sai mu godema  Allah, sannan ina san kowane Jarumi na, na basu hutun mako biyu kowa ya huta, inai ma kowa fatan alkhairi, muna roken Allah ya kara kare mana rayukan mu da dukiyoyin mu baki ɗayan mu." da Ameen suka amsa baki ɗayan su, sannan ta sallami kowa ya tafi sabgar gaban shi, itama tafiya tayi sashen ta


Koda Yarima Malik ya koma sashen shi dakin shi ya wuce yai wanka sannan yai sallah, zama yayi saman sallaya ya cigaba da lazimi yana addu'a yana gamawa ya safko dafilo kasa ya kwanta kamar mai tunani rufe ido yayi ba abinda ke mashi yawo a cikin zuciya irin yanda Yarima Haishir ya kamo Bahijja  a wani sashe na zuciyar shi kuwa yana mamakin abinda Baidulƙais ke faɗa, ganin ba abinda tunanin zai mashi juyawa yayi yaci gaba da lazimi


A turakar bayi kuwa Bahijja ce kwance saman cinyar mahaifiyar ta, suna fira da ita cikin kulawa tace ma Bahijja. "Ƴata kigodema Allah daya fiddoki daga hannun waɗan nan mutanen gaskia bakaramin sa'a kikayi ba, da yanzun ba musan  a wane hali zaki kasance ba Allah yasaka ma Yarima Malik da alkhairi  daya jajirce ya ansoki daga hannun su, fata Allah ya kara tsaremu daga kowane sharri ya kara tsarema na  Masarautar mu da dukkan musulmai baki ɗaya." "Ameen Umma, kinsan na ɗauka ankashe Ya Malik na shiga ruɗani Umma." "gaskia ne Bahijja dole ki shiga damuwa Allah dai yakara tsarema na  shi cikin aminci." da ameen Bahijja ta amsa sannan tace. "Umma wai gobe ma sai kinje wajen aiki."? Murmushin girma tayi sannan tace. "Kwarai kuwa ƴata sai naje aiki." "Umma zanje inta yaki  aikin nagaji da zama ni kadai in kika tafi baki dawowa da wuri fa." takarasa maganar kamar mai shirin kuka, itako Binta tarasa mi zata cema Bahijja cikin tattausar murya tace. "Ƴata kikara hutawa ki bari kema zaki samu aikin da zaki dingayi kinji, kinga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ba tasan  taga anyi yawa a sashen ta." tashi tayi ta zauna tace. "Umma kefa ke bada aikin mizaisa nima ki bani nawa." cikin kosawa tace. "Kinga Bahijja nace kibari wani lokaci ki fara naki aikin, waike aiki har dadine dashi sai kace baki sha wahalar bauta ba." marairai cewa tayi tace. "Kiyi hakuri Umma, zan zauna anjima zan baki labarin kalar wahalar da nasha a cikin Masarautar Raifasu, da Waisu." "shikenan ƴata ko kefa, kinga dama kinje wajen Mairo ki zauna kafin anjiman." shiken Umma." tare suka tashi suka tafi suna tafe suna labari har ta shiga gidan Mairo ita kuma Binta ta shiga cikin Masarauta... 


Gimbiya Zahara'u ce ta fito falo sanye da doguwar riga, a jikin ta, tana shigowa ta iske Huzaifa da Mahaifin su zaune da alama fira suke taɓawa inda yace ma  Huzaifa. "Baka ganin maganganun MalikusSaif akwai abin dubawa a cikin su."? Shiru yayi yana kallan Mahaifin nashi sannan yace. "Ni banga wani abun dubawa ba cikin maganganun shi ba Abba."
"Hmm yaro kenan sai inga kamar yarinyar nan Bahijja akwai wani al'amari a tsakanin su." saurin tarar shi Huzaifa yayi yace. "Abba karfa kaman ta hadimar shi ko ince itace zata dinga yimashi hidima wannan shine alaqar kuma fa baiwar sace." cikeda gamsuwa Waziri Dammur ya kaɗa kai yace hakane. Itako gimbiya Zahara'u cewa tayi. "Haba Abba miya hada  Yarima na da baiwa ai sai ƴar sarauta irin shi ba wai baiwa ba ni wlh wannan maganar ma harta sosa mani rai." cikin fushi Huzaifa yace. "Waya saka bakin ki a cikin wannan maganar bansan sakarci da karambani." turo baki tayi cikin shagwaɓa tace. "Kaga yaya Huzaifa dan nasa albarkacin bakina aiba laifi bane." mikewa yayi ya tashi zai kwabdeta Waziri yace. "Haba kai da kanwar ka, ke kuma kin cika surutu ki daina  shiga maganar manya." "toh Abba." shiko Huzaifa tashi yayi ya shiga dakin shi yanajin ranshi na mashi zafi musamman inya tuna da maganar Abban su baiso yaji ana wannan zancen gudun kada wani abun ya kuma faruwa."



A wajen Malik kuwa yana farkawa daga bacci yayi alwallah yafara nafilfili saida yagama sannan ya tashi ya fito falo wata irin yunwa ce yaji ta taso mashi kamar zata halaka shi a daddafe ya zauna gashi ba kowa a sashen nashi duk ya sallami bayin shi ganin dare ya fara, haka ya tashi yaje saman wani table yaga kayan marmari ya dauko wankewa yayi yahauci kamar wanda bai taɓa cin abinci ba haka yake jinshi ci yake kamar yana zubewa kasa ganin basu rika shi yasa shi tashi yana cewa bari inje wajen Abbuh kilan in samu abu mai nauyi inci, wata zuciyar tace mashi kodai kaje kaima Ummu maganar Bahijja, yanzun inda ace yanada sahihiyar hadima da bai zauna har yanzun ba tareda  yaci abinci ba duk da bai zauna ba, hakadai ya isa wajen Saifulislam yana sake sake a ranshi sallama yayi yaji shiru hakan yasa ya gane yana dakin shi ba inda ya wuce sai wajen kulolin abinci, yayi sa'a da tuwon shinkafa, bai wata wata ba ya ɗauka ya zuba yafaraci yana cikin ci Saifulislam ya fito daga dakin shi, mamaki yayi ganin yanda Malik ketacin abinci, zama yayi yana murmushi yace. "Yau Yariman Daborah ne kecin abinci irin haka mike faruwa ɗana."? Ruwa yasha yace. "Abbuh yunwa taimin illah gaskia ya kamata  zuwa gobe kasa Ummu tabani hadima ta." shiru yayi yana kallan Malik da mamaki dan yasan ba lallai bane Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta amince da kudurin Yarima Malik ba, kama hannun Malik yayi yace.......

Episode 41&42 



"Haba Jarumi na farin cikina saurin mi kakeyi har haka baka ganin mahaifiyar ka bata gama hucewa ba akan wannan Yakin ba, kabari sai komai ya lafa sannan saika tunkare ta da wannan maganar."

Aje abincin gaban shi Yarima Malik yayi sannan yace. "Abbuh kaima kasan Ummu bazata saurareni ba kai nikeso kaimata wannan maganar." "hmm Malik kenan kasan abubuwan danai ma mahaifiyar ka kuwa ko kasan da kaina na shiga cikin turakar bayi na kwanto Bahijja wannan wane irin zubda darajane ban mata ba, wannan dalilin shi zaisa bazan kara yimata maganar Bahijja ba zata ga kamar ina anfani da matsayin da nike dashi a wajen ta ina yanke mata hukuncin da nike so, amman ka gwada intaki yarda zan mata magana muga yanda za'ayi sai dai ina jan kunnen ka Malik ka jajirce wajen yima mahaifiyar ka biyayya karka yarda wani abu yasa kace zaka bijire mata kanajina."? Eh Abbuh shikenan zan mata magana da kaina nan da jibi insha Allah." murmushi yayi yana shafa sumar kan MalikusSaif yace. "Ameen ɗana Allah yaimaka albarka." da Ameen ya amsa yanajin dadin kasancewa da mahaifin shi....... 

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A wajen su Yarima Haishir kuwa suna isowa Masarautar su, ba inda suka wuce da gawar Sarki Lahazu sai wajen gimbiya Ƙamariyya tunda aka shigo da gawar jikin ta ke rawa duk tsammanin ta Yarima Haishir ne aka kashe a sanyaye ta iso tana bude mayafin da aka rufeta taga mijin tane kwance, a tsorace ta mike tanaja da baya wani irin kuka ta fashe dashi mai tsuma rai tafada saman gawar shi tana kuka kamar ranta zai fita bata gama kukan da takeyi ba saiga Sarkin Yaki ya shigo da Yarima Haishir rai hannu ga Allah, da sauri ta taro shi a saman jikin ta, kamar ta ɓaɓɓa haka takasa ko motsin kirki sai kallan Haishir takeyi da kyal ta iya cewa. "Haishir karkaimin haka karka mutu kabarni kaga narasa mahaifin ka kada kaima inrasa ka ɗana ka tashi Haishir na rokeka ka bude idonka kaga mahaifiyar ka katashi Haishir.!" sake rushewa da kuka tayi tana haki komawa ta sakeyi jikin Sarki Lahazu ta sake taro shi jikin ta kamar zautatta tace.
"Mijina karka tafi kabarni na shiga ukku wayai maka haka waya kashe min kai na rantse da girman Gurfanai saina ɗauki mataki mai yawan gaske ga duk wanda ya aikata haka akan ku." Waziri ne ya shigo ciki dakin ya ɗauki gawar Lahazu suka tafi dashi zasu birne shi da kyal aka ɓanɓare ta jikin shi tanaji tana gani aka fita da gawar Sarki Lahazu, a gigice ta koma wajen Haishir mai magani ya shigo aka ɗauke shi aka fara yi mashi magani.

********************************

Suko su Baidulƙais koda suka koma Masarautar Raifasu sashen shi ya wuce ya rasa mike mashi dadi a cikin zuciyar shi, tashi yayi baisan ya saki uwar kara ba, da sauri Sarki Danwar ya shigo  ya fara tambayar shi lfy, wasu kwalla yaji suna suntiri a fuskar shi, cikin mutuwar jiki yace. "Danwar ya zanyi yau nine aka ketama rigar mutinci a Masarautar Daborah na rasa abu mai mahimmanci a tareda ni ga ankashe mani Jarumai na ga ɓacin rai yasa da hannuna na kashe aminina ya kakeso inyi da raina."?  Murmushin mugunta yayi yace. "Ka kwantar da hankalin ka gobe inna koma Masarauta ta zanbi hanyar da zanbi dan ganin na sasanta tsakanin ka da Masarautar Waisu ai baku cancani Yakar junan kuba, kuma kasani hatta Bahijja zata dawo gareka." wani sanyi Baidulƙais yaji a zuciyar shi baisan ya rungume Sarki Danwar ba, shi kuwa sai kudire kudire yakeyi a cikin zuciyar shi......

A Masarautar Daborah kuwa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce zaune tana cin abinci kamar bata sonci dan rabin hankalin ta bakan abincin yake ba tunani takeyi kala kala.  sallamar Yarima Malik tayi ɗago kai tayi ta kalle shi sannan ta maida taci gaba dacin abincin ta, zama yayi sannan ya gaida ta amsawa tayi tace. "Gwarzon Daborah ya gajiyar Yaki."?
Murmusawa yayi yace.  "Yabi jiki Ummu." ɗago kai tayi tana nazarin ɗan nata cikin kulawa tace. "Meke damun ka Yarima."? Gyaran murya yayi yace.
"Bakomai kawai dai nazo ne dan innemi alfarma wajen ki." tattare komai tayi tace inajin ka wace alfarma ce. "Ummu maganar Ashir dan Allah kiyafe mashi laifi nane  baida masaniya akan wannan lamarin ni na aike shi Masarautar Raifasu."

A dakile tace. "Naman ta da wani Ashir can kaman ta bansan maci amana duk yanda nike dashi."? Sosa keya yayi yace. "Hakane Ummu saidai wannan karon ɗanki ne ya ha'ince ki ki yafe mani." hannu tasa ta shafi gefen fuskar shi sannan tace. "Badamuwa komai ya wuce kasa a fiddo maka Ashir, sannan zuwa gobe ka zagaya gidan kaso a fiddo masu kananun laifi duk a yafe masu." rungume ta yayi cikin murna yace. "Nagode maki Ummu Allah yakara maki lfy da nisan kwana."  Ameen ya rabbi, atare sukaci gaba da cin abincin yana san yai mata maganar Bahijja yana shakka shiru yayi har suka kammala sannan yai mata sallama ya tafi dan fito da masu laifi.


Ita ko Bahijja tana tashi da rana taga mahaifin ta na shirin tafiya wajen aiki, cikin tausayawa tace. "Abbana inama ace zan iya aikin da kakeyi da naje naimaka ka huta."murmushi yayi yana maijin dadi nuna tausayi da Bahijja tayi agreshi kama hannun ta yayi yana cewa. "Ƴata kinsan aikin da zaki mani a rayuwa ta."?  Wani irin dadi taji a ranta wai yau ita ce zataima iyayen ta aiki tace. "Aa Abba wane aiki ne."?  "Kiyimin alkawalin zaki mani shi."? "Eh Abba zanmaka shi insha Allahu." "yawaa ƴata haka ake so duk abinda mutun zaiyi yasa ikilasi a cikin zuciyar shi, ba wani abu bane inaso ki nisanta kanki ga duk abinda kikasan yafi karfin ki, karki sama ranki shi balle kiji ya burgeki harkiyi shi'awarshi, sannan ki rike mutuncin ki da matsayin ki a cikin wannan Masarautar wannan shine aikin da zakima mahaifin ki kuma shine alfarma ta agreki ƴata."
sake rike hannun Abban ta tayi tana wasa da yatsun hannun shi tace. "Abbana indai wannan ne baka da matsala dani zan tsaya matsayina kuma bazan manta cewa ni baiwa bace zaka sameni mai yawan yimaku biyayya." wani irin dadi yaji yace. "Allah yaimaki albarka ƴata ya kareki daga sharrin zamani." "Ameen Abba."
cewa yayi.
"Kinga idan ina biyema kaunarki agareni tabbas bazan dinga fita wajen aiki da wuriba kinga Umman ki tuni tai tafiyar ta nikam harkin sa na makara."faɗawa tayi jikin shi a shagwaɓe tace. "Abba jinike kamar inbika zanyi kewarku kamar ku zauna inta kallanku."
jamata hanci yayi yana dariya yace. "Kinga tafiya ta ƴar nema kincika surutu kikula da kanki ƴata saina dawo." haka ta dinga dagama mahaifin ta hannu harya fita cikin makimancin gidan su mai ɗauke da daki biyu sai ban daki, wasu kwalla taji sun ciko mata idanu ba wanda ta tuna sai Jakadiya Jamra a zahiri ko cewa tayi. "Baba ina kewar ki, saidai bangan ki kinzo nan ba Allah dai yasa ba kamaki akaiba kina gabatar da addini ba kema insha Allahu sai kinbar azzalumar Masarautar can da izinin Allah Baba inayi maki addu'a kullin Allah yakare mani ke, can kuma ta tuna dasu Zainab da Indo tace Allah Sarki kawaye na shikenan bankara ganin ku kenan wayyo Zainab an rabani dake muna cikin wasan mu ashe rabuwar mu alkhairy ne a gareni rayuwa kenan, da wannan tunanin Bahijja ta shiga dakin su ta bude wata koɗaɗɗiyar tukunya ta iske dumamen tuwo yanka ukku ta dauki ɗaya ta zuba tafaraci ta ajema iyayen ta sauran, tana ɗauko lomar farko zataci Yarima Malik ya faɗo mata arai murmushi tayi ita kanta tayi mamaki a zahiri ko cewa tayi Allah Sarki Ya Malik kaine kafara ciyar dani abinci cikin aminci ba tareda tsoro ko shakkar wani abu ba, Allah yasaka maka da alkhairi yasa kafi haka, da haka dai Bahijja harta gama cin abincin ta hakanan taji tana cikin farin ciki aranta..... 

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Washe gari sa safe Sarki Danwar ne keta shiri zasu koma Masarautar su daga Raifasu saida ya samu ya gama ɗaura Sarki Baidulƙais bisa gadar zare sannan yace zai koma Masarautar shi dan ya huta haka Sarki Baidulƙais yai masu sha tara ta arziki sannan yasa akai masu rakiya suka tafi Masarautar Ƙaisu, shiko Baidulƙais izuwa yanzun baida tunani sai matsalar dake neman kunno mashi kai musamman tsakanin shi da Sarrilƙus baida tunani sai abinda zai faɗama Boka Sarrilƙus a wani sashe na zuciyar shi ko yana bakin cikin rasa hannun shi da yayi yana maijin zafin cin kashin da Yarima Malik yaima shi a cikin dubun nan mutane....


Masarautar Daborah kuwa,  Binta keta wankin kayan Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tin safe take abu guda bata kareba sai marece liqis sannan ta nunkosu ta kawoma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa har daki ta aje sannan taci gaba da yimata gyaran dakin ta tana gamawa ta tafi madafa dan ganin abinda uwar tuwo ta girma Sarauniya, ana gamawa tasa bayi suka ɗauko atare suka kaima Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, koda suka aje cikin gadara tasa Binta ta zuba mata abincin tanaci sannan ta ɗaura kafarta kan Binta kamar kullin tanai mata tausa, can Binta taji Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace. "Ke Binta ina baiwar ƴarki."? Cikin sanyin murya tace. "Ranki shidade nabarota gida." girgiza kai tayi tace. 
"kice kango dai koma dai minene inasan kijama ta kunne karta kuskura inga kafarta ta shigo cikin Masarautar nan ta tsya can turakar bayi ina fata kin fahimta."? "To ranki shidade Bahijja nagodiya da karamci, Allah yakara maki girma da lfy." itako Binta tana mamakin lamarin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yanzun ance mutun da lafiyar shi yaita zama waje ɗaya koda yake aita huta da aikin wahala, ba wanda ya kuma cewa komai saidai kowa da abinda yake sakawa a cikin kokon zuciyar ta ji sukayi ana sanar da zuwan gimbiya Salsabila matar Waziri Dammur Mahaifiyar su Huzaifa, fuska sake Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta tareta a tare suka zauna itako Binta kanta kasa tagaida ta a wulakance ta amsa, gimbiya Salsabila ce tace "Allah yataimaki Sarauniya ta, nazo intayaki murnar kare wannan kadararren Yakin da aka jazamaki." "hmmm kedai bari Umman Zahara'u ai da kike ganin wannan Yakin ba kadai ya sosa mani rai ba Allah dai ya kyauta gaba." "Ameen ai wannan baiwar da kashin tsiya take wlh."cewar gimbiya Salsabila. 
"sosai ma kuwa shiyasa kullin nike neman tsarin Allah kada ta rabeni bare ɗana ko mijina ai yarinyar da kike gani kamar mayya take." da sauri Binta ta kalli Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sannan ta sadda kanta tanaci gaba da danna mata kafarta ga kirjinta nai mata kuna tanaji ana tsinema ƴarta, gimbiya Salsabila ce tace. "Ina ɗana yasha gajiyar Yaki karkiso kiga yanda Zahara'u ta ɗaga hankalin ta da ana Yakin nan sai addu'a take mashi."murmushin jin dadi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi ta fahimci gimbiya Zahara'u tana ji da Yarima Malik cewa tayi. "Allah Sarki ƴata ƴar albarka ai ita da Malik hadin Allah ne, fatadai Allah yakara hada kansu da hankulan su." da Ameen gimbiya Salsabila ta amsa sannan sukaci gaba da firarsu rabi duk akan Yarima Malik sukeyin ta.


➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Dan kuwa Masarautar Waisu akwana atashi har Sarki Lahazu yakai kwana ukku da mutuwa, kuma ba laifi jikin Yarima Haishir yai sauki sosai tinda har yana iya tashi da kanshi ya zauna sai dai tunda ya samu labarin mutuwar mahaifin shi bai kara samun sukuni a cikin zuciyar shi baida buri daya wuce ya ɗauki fansa ga Sarki Baidulƙais dan yafara cire Bahijja a cikin zuciyar shi ya ɗauki dangana damuwar shi, bai wuce Sarki Baidulƙais da Masarautar Raifasu, kullin saiyayi kuka daya inya tuna da mahaifin shi ita kanta gimbiya Ƙamariyya bata hakura ba kullin da irin mugun nufin da take dashi aranta game da gimbiya Yazira acewar ta mijin tane silar rasa mijin ta itama saita ɗauki mataki akan matar shi...wannan kenan. 

 _Masarautar Daborah_ 


Shi ko Yarima Malik yana gama shiryawa zaije wajen Yazid dan yanaso ya mike kafar shi su dan zagaya cikin Masarautar Daborah da kewayen ta dan hutawa saiga wata baiwa tazo ta gaida MalikusSaif sannan ta sanar mashi da kiran da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa take mashi a sashen ta, bai wani ɓata lokaci ba yakama hanya ya tafi yana zuwa ya isketa kishingiɗe cikin wata bakar alqabba, bayi nata yimata fiffita amsa mashi sallama sukayi sannan ya zauna kowace baiwa saida ta kawo gaisuwa wajen Yarima sannan suka basu waje cikin kulawa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta kalli Yarima Malik tace...... 




 _Ƴar Mutan Kankia ce❣️_

"Malik?'' ɗago kyakkyawar fuskar shi yayi mai hade a kwarjini ya kalli mahaifiyar shi cikin nutsuwa yace. "Naam." fuskar ta ɗauke da murmushi tace. "Ya kamata ace zuwa yanzun kayi aure kazama cikakken mutun kamar kowa kaduba kaga kullin kara girma kakeyi mu kuma munaja baya a matsayin kana magajina Sarkin gobe ya dace kayi iyali kaima kaga zuriar ka."
Shiru MalikusSaif yayi yana mai nazarin maganar mahaifiyar tashi, itama da idanu tabishi ta fahimci baisan zancen, dan murmaswa yayi wanda yakara fiddo mashi da kyawun shi sannan yace. "Toh zanyi insha Allah."atakaice ya bata amsar bai kuma cewa komai, koda ta fahimci baisan maganar cikin kulawa ta mahaifiya wadda takeyima ƴayan ta tace. "Shikenan daman maganar kenan zaka iya tafiya." tashi yayi sannan yace. "Kihuta lfy Ummu." tafiya yake tamkar maijin tausayin Ƙasa, sanye yake cikin wani yadi baki sai sheki yakeyi yai bala'in amasar fatar MalikusSaif kasancewar shi farine ga sajen fuskar baki sai shining yakeyi yayi luf dashi gwanin ban shi'awa hulace ya saka a kanshi baka mai sirkin golden kanshi sai ɗaukar ido yakeyi yanda sumar shi ke kyalli, sannan ya ɗaura golden din alqabba wadda takara fiddo da ainihin nasabar shi da tsantsar kyawun shi, duk inda ya gama gifta bayi ne keta kawo gaisuwa cikin ladabi da girmamawa, shiko saidai ya ɗaga masu hannu wasu kuma yai kamar baigan suba, da yake Yarima Malik mutun ne mai kwarjini kuma shi baida girman kan nan da yayan Sarakai keyi, kuma baida ɗagawa da nuna shi wanine mutun ne mai kyakkyawar alaka da talakawan su har zuwa bayi saidai bai fiye san magana ba, kasancewar baisan yawan hayaniya, ta gefen sashen mahaifin shi ya wuce wanda ya gaji da kayatuwa kowane sashe dake cikin Masarautar Daborah zagaye yake da filawowi masu matukar ɗaukar hankali dayake Masarautar tanada girman gaske koda wajen bayin Masarautar ne kaje shima wajene mi matukar kyau da tsaruwa baka cewa bayi ke rayuwa a wajen har kasuwa ke akwai cikin turakar bayi, sannan gida jene jere tunda ga iyayen bayi har sauran bayin kowa yanada nashi masaukin, shiko MalikusSaif ba inda ya wuce sai wani kayataccen lambu mai ɗaukar hankali ba abinda babu a cikin lambun tunda ga kayan marmari da koramu guda ukku ruwa sai gudana yakeyi gwanin ban shi awa,  daga gefen babban lambun Masarautar Daborah, nan ne inda Yarima Malik ke ciwon dabbobi da tsuntsye sai kuma wani babban wajene ba abinda ke ciki sai dawakai kala kala hadimai nata basu abinci wasu kuma anai masu wanka tsakiyar lambu wata irin kerarriyar wukace da akayi aka kafeta a jikin wukar anrubaTakobin Barri wanda wannan taswiyar wukar da aka kera kusan duk inda kayi cikin Masarautar Daborah itace alamar tambarin Masarautar Daborah, kasancewar Wukar Barri wukace mai dinbin tarihi wanda akanta ake yawan kawoma Masarautar tasu farmaki wannan dalilin yasa suke ba takobin barri mahimmancin gaske ta ɗauki shekaru aru aru a cikin wannan Masarautar ta Daborah wannan kenan kadan daga cikin tsarin Masarautar Daborah sannan suna da arziki musamman tarin dukiya da ta shahara a fagen kasuwanci da iya kare martabar ta musamman a wajen abokan gaban basu da tsara kaf a ƙasar Gambia.

Koda MalikusSaif ya isa cikin lambu cikin kankanin lokaci an gama gyara inda yake da zama kishingiɗawa yayi yana nazarin maganar da mahaifiyar shi taimashi duk da yasan shi baida wannan ra'ayin a halin yanzun kuma awajen shi hakan ba wata matsala bane.....

yana cikin tunani ba abinda ya fado mashi arai sai Bahijja samun kanshi yayi da dan murmaswa a zahiri ko cewa yayi "baiwar Allah kina cikin yanayi ga iyayen ki basu da wani yancin kansu fata dai Allah yakara tsareki Bahijja inama Ummu ta amshe ki a matsayin ƴarta, aiko dani zan maki zaɓin miji. bai ida maganar da yakeba yaji ance. "wannan wacece za'aima zaɓin miji har haka Yarima."?  Yazid ne yakara sa maganar tareda zama gefen shimfidar Yarima Malik yana mai sakar mashi murmushi cikin so da kauna na aminnai, dan kauda kanshi MalikusSaif yayi cikin dakewar murya yace. "Haka kaji nace?waima yaushe kazo nan."? "Hmm Yarima kenan najima da zuwa amman ina wajen dawakai ina rangadi ne." "hakane Huzaifa fa.?" cewar Yarima Malik, Yazid ne ya bashi ansa "tun sallar asuba ban kara ganin shiba." cigaba da firar su sukayi saidai a cikin zuciyar Yazid yaso yaji maganar da Malik keyi amman yasan shi da zurfin ciki ba lallai ya faɗi  komai ba..... 
A cikin turakar bayi kuwa Bahijja ce ke wankin kayan ta dana iyayen ta, tanata ba su Mairo labarin Masarautar Raifasu da kalar taimakon da Jakadiyar Masarautar taimata, wani wajen suji tausayin ta wani labarin ma har hawaye suke mata, kamar wadda aka tsikara tace." "Baba Mairo wai yaushe zakije kasuwa.?"
murmushi tayi tana shafa gashin Bahijja da yayi kwance lub tace "ƴata zanje amman kibari Saifulislam ya aikeni sai intafi dake wani irin dadi taji ta rungume Mairo tana ta murna abin ta a rayuwar ta tana so tayi yawo cikin Masarautar Daborah itama ta ganema idon ta kallar kayutuwar da tayi wannan dalilin yasa kullin takeso taga ta shiga cikin Masarauta saidai Umman ta batasan tana shiga cikin ta kuma batasan dalilin hakan ba saɓanin Masarautar Raifasu ba inda bata zuwa amman banda Masarautar su kullin tana zaune waje ɗaya hakadai Bahijja taita sake sake a cikin zuciyar ta, jitayi Mairo tace. "Yata bari inje wajen aikina ki kula da kanki kinji."? "Baba Mairo saikin dawo in kinga Ya Malik ki gaidaman shi." murmushi Mairo tayi aranta ko cewa take yaro kenan ina baiwa ina gaida Yarima kamar Malik, koda yake da sannu zakisan matsayinki na hadima Bahijja, amman a zahiri cewa tayi shikenan zaiji saina dawo, daga mata hannu Bahijja tayi tana kewar Innar tata kasancewar ta kanwa ga mahaifiyar ta, wannan kenan. 


 ~Masarautar Raifasu~ 


Sarki Baidulƙais ne keta burgima cikin dakin shi kamar zai mutu ba abinda ke addabar shi irin son Bahijja maitar shi akan Bahijja harta fara hanashi sukuni da walwala a cikin mutane hakan yasa ko fa'da bai cika zama ba kullun yana cikin daki yanzun ankai fagen dako Jakadiya bai cika bari tana shiga dakin shi ba hakanan, kusan kowane lokaci yana yini ba kaya jikin shi idan shiawar Bahijja takai shi karshe haka zai dinga wasa da dick din shi wani bima saidai ya sume tsabar azaba yauma kusan hakane lamarin yafara bashi tsoro hakan yasa ya shiga wani waje cikin dakin shi ya murzo zobe da habar shi dan yanzun hannu dayane dashi komai na rayuwa yafara jagule mashi, murza zoben yayi tayi amman a banza har ya fidda rai, zai fito daga dakin sai ga wani murgujejen mutun ya bayyana fuskar shi ba kyan gani shi kanshi Baidulƙais ya tsorata dan bashi ya saba gani ba, amman saiya dake yace. "Yana ganka aljani dandukununu ina aljani dan tsitu.?" wata uwar dariya ce ya kece da ita iya yinsa sannan ya sunkuyo ya kalli Baidulƙais da jajjayen idanun shi masu ban tsoro cikin daka tsawa yace. "Mikake tunanin aljani dan tsitu zaimaka bayan kagaza anci galaba kanka kayi sakaki da mulkin ka kakasa tarawa da Bahijja bayan jimawa da tayi a cikin Masarautar ka kasani Sarrilƙus ya barranta agareka sannan aljani dan tsitu bazai kuma zuwa gareka ba, dan baka da wani anfani sako daga Sarrilƙus yace kada kasake neman sa sannan nan da kwana ukku yace ka maido da karamin zoben Sarrilƙus dake hannun ka tunda kazama masaki hahhhhhahhha." haka yaita dariya har hucin wuta ke fita daga dakin aljanin cikin kidimewa Baidulƙais ya duka yafara bada hakuri saidai ina bai saurare shiba wani irin kuka ya saki yana mai rufe idan shi tsabar bakin ciki bai aune ba yaga ba aljanin ya ɓace ɓat, gunjin kuka Sarki Baidulƙais yakeyi kamar zai mutu shikenan hasashen shi ya tabbata gashi Sarrilƙus yayi mashi bore baisan ya zaiyi da bala'in dake tunkaro shiba haka ya rarrafo ya dawo a cikin dakin nashi ya kwanta kamar mai bacci a ranshi ko bakin cikine dankare ga rasa danshi da yayi galabar da akacishi ya rasa Bahijja ga gabar dake shirin kulluwa tsakanin shi da ɗan aminin shi Sarki Lahazu uwa uba kuma  yau ga abin dogaron shi Sarrilƙus ya juya mashi baya, baisan ya sake sakin wani marayan kuka ba wanda shi kanshi yasan raban dayai kuka tun ranar dayabga gawar danshi Yarima Husbarulƙais, haka dai ya kwanta ga yunwa yanaji amman ba damar yaci abinci cikin natsuwa.


➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A wajen Yarima Haishir kuwa kimamin wata ukku kenan da rashin mahaifin shi harya fara dangana yau aka tashi a cikin Masarautar ta Waisu ana bikin nadin sabon Sarki duk da basuyi wata gayya ba amman anyi shagali anci ansha anyi wasanni iri iri sannan aka naɗa sabon Sarkin Waisu fa'da cike take da mutane kowa ya hallara tun daga kan dagaci galadima waziri sarkin fa'da, sarkin gida, sarkin zagi, danbirum dasu majidadi d sauran manya da kananan fa'da, nan Shamaki ya tashi ya naɗa Sarki kowa yaji dadi inda Sarkin shela ke sanar da annaɗa Sarki Haishir Lahazu Humzu a matsayin Sarkin Waisu haka sukaita addu'oin su tareda bokan su na fa'da anata Gurfanai yataimake ka Sarki yabaka nasara, da haka kowa ya watse aka raka Sarki Haishir har cikin turakar shi daya gaji da haduwa da kayan allatu na duniya itama Masarautar Waisu ta hadu iya haduwa saboda tana cikin jerin manyan Masarautu guda ukku da mlnahiyar Gambia ke takama dasu a cikin yankin ta, a wajen gimbiya Ƙamariyya kuma ana nadin ɗan nata tana murna wani ɓangaren na zuciyar ta kuwa cike yake da kewar mijin ta, saidai ba abinda ke ranta irin taga karshen Sarki Baidulƙais da gimbiya Yazira.... 

*********************************

Bayan wata biyu a Masarautar Daborah kuwa Bahijja ce, a cikin makimancin gidan su tana ɗinɗima abincin da mahaifiyar ta tadawo da shi jiya da daddare domin su samu abinda zasuci da yamma tana gamawa ta zubama Abban ta yaci itama ci tayi sannan suka ajema Umman ta nata, tashi tayi taje cikin makimancin botikin su da suke tara ruwa dan bukata taga ba komai ciki ga mahaifin ta na bukatar ruwa kallan shi tayi tace. "Abba babu ruwa a gidan nan." tashi yayi da niyar ya ɗaukar botikin dan shiga cikin Masarauta ya sama masu ruwa, rike botikin tayi tace. "Abbana kabari inje insamo mana kaga daman ban taba zuwa ba yau nima sai inmike kafaɗa." ba tareda Abdulmajid yayi tunanin komai ba yace. "Shikenan ƴata ki kula da kanki saikin dawo kinji.?" cikin jin dadin yau zata shiga cikin Masarauta tafara murna tana mai ɗagama mahaifin nata hannu ta tafi fita tayi daga cikin kofar turakar bayi ta shiga cikin Masarautar sai kalle kalle takeyi da kaganta kasan bakuwa ce a cikin Masarautar Daborah duk layin da tabi saita tsaya tana al'ajabin haduwar wajen musamman gine ginan Masarautar wanda rabi da kwatar shi duk da farar tsakuwa ce akayi shi sai wasu kuma da jan gargari, ga fantin Masarautar Maroon ne da ratsin light brown, tana cikin tafiya dai daina wani waje inda zai sadaka da sashen royal family wani irin zanene aka sassaka na takobi da  wani irin butun butumi na kanki sai mutun agefe rike da takobi ansan Takobin Barri a jikin ta kana gani kasan Masarautar ta shara a fagen yaki da makiya, haka ta dinga tafiya ga yanayi ne na damuna komai shar gwanin banshi'awa ga jerin filawa tabi ko ina musamman iccen inibi da ruman shine kewaye da wajen, murmushi Bahijja ta dinga yi tarasa kona mene tanajin dadi tana mamaki irin tsaruwar Masarautar Daborah a ranta ko cewa take gaskia bantaɓa ganin Masarautar data burgeni ba kamar wannan Masarautar kama hanya tayi tabi wani ɗan lungu saita tsinci kanta wani irin makimancin lambu da wata iriyar korama dayabi ta cikin lambun take iskar wajen ta dinga ratsa dukkan sassan jikin Bahijja ga kamshin kayan marmari iri iri ga tsuntsaye sai shawagi sukeyi a cikin lambun, daga wani waje taga manya manyan maguna da alama suma kiwon su akeyi saijin dadi takeyi a ranta tana cewa gaskia wannan waje akwai dadi ga kayan dadi iri iri ni ko inama zan samu ruwan indiba, cigaba da kutsa kai tayi cikin lambun hankalin ta kwance take tafiyar....shiko Yarima Malik yana fitowa daga wanka ya shirya yaska wani coffen yadi mai ɗankaran kyau sai ya sa hula da takalmi su kuma baki turaruka ya shafa, yana fitowa daga cikin dakin shi kasancewar ba wanda yake bari yana shigar mashi daki a cikin bayi iyakar su falo suna hidima, shiyasa yabi ta hanyar baya yanasan yaje wajen mahaifiyar shi, yana bi ta wani corridor ya shiga cikin lambun dake sashen shi yana shiga ya nufi wajen magunan shi dan Malik yanasan kiwo bai rabuwa da kiwon dabbobi iri iri tun daga nesa ya hangi wata baiwa tana wasa da magen sa, bakaramin mamaki ne yakama Yarima Malik ba a iya sanin shi ba baiwar dake shiga cikin lambun sashen ba tareda wani dalili ba, a hnkali ya dinga takowa kamar baisan tafiyar haka yake takowa cikin nutsuwa, itako ta shagala da wasan d takeyi da mage tana cewa ƴar kyakkyawar mage ta dake zantafi gidan mu ina sonki, jin kamshin daya daki hancin ta shi ya katse mata wasan da takeyi waigowar da takeyi taga kafar mutun daga kafar shi tafara bi da kallo har saman kyakkyawar fuskar shi mai dauke da kwarjini da haiba wani irin faduwar gaba ne ya riske su lokaci guda gaban sune ya dinga halbawa da sauri sauri, itako Bahijja ko motsin kirki takasa kuma takasa sakin magen hannun ta bakin ta na rawa ta sunkuyar da kanta cikin sanyin murya mai hade da kiɗimewa tace. "Ranka shidade barka da yamma, ina tuba bansan nan nazo ba.....ɗaga mata hannu yayi yanaji kirjin shi na halbawa da sauri da sauri ya rasa kona mene, take ya sake haɗe fuskar shi yace. "Mikikeyi nan.?" a rude tace. "Ruwa nazo samu." a dakile ya kara cewa. "Nan wajen dibar ruwane."? dagowa tayi takara kallan shi gani takeyi kamar ba Ya Malik dinta ba aiko suka hada ido cikin ido da sauri ta sauke nata, shi kanshi yasan Bahijja tanada mahimmanci a rayuwar shi jinta yake tamkar jinin shi, da sauri tace. "Bansan wajen ba hanya ne ya biyo dani tanan wajen, ina neman afuwa."  bai kuma cewa komai ba binta kawai yayi da ido saiyaji wani irin tausayin ta a cikin ranshi, yanda yaga duk ta ɗarare, samun kanshi yayi da cewa "Bahijja!" ita kanta saida taji faɗuwar gaba, shima mamaki yayi dan baisan ya ambaci sunan taba, da na'am ta amsa, rasa abin cewa yayi kamar mai tuna wani abu yace......

"Sakara dake jahila bace mani da gani kada in halbaki." koma wa tayi gefe tana kara bata hakuri sai satar kallan Bahijja takeyi tana tsoron zuwan da tayi wajen Sarauniya aran tako cewa tayi Allah dai yasa yarinyar nan ba zuwa tayi nema naba aiko da na shiga ukku na, tunkan ta ida sakar zucin da takeyi taji Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tacema Bahijja......

"daga yau zaki yima ɗana Malik hidima saidai kisani inada sharuɗan da zan gindaya maki."

"Kullin ranar duniya, kitabba ta karfe bakwai kina sashen Malik kuma bance ki fara aiki ba har saiya fito sannan zaki fara gyara mashi dakin shi, sannan ki tabbtar kin kula da abincin ɗana kamar ranki, kuma karki kuskura ki bari doguwar magana ta dinga haɗaki dashi saboda bai san takura, keko da ganin ki zakiyi naci kamar mayya, sannan dole kisan abinda ze taɓa mashi zuciya dan ki kiyaye, sannan kisa aranki duk abinda ya samu MalikusSaif dake zanyi koke saboda kece mutun ta farko da zata fara yima Malik hidima a matsayin baiwar shi, inaga kilan kwakwalwar ki na dauka.?" jinjina kai Bahijja tayi tana mamakin wannan lamari taya zata iya irin wannan hidimar, haɗa ido tayi da Umman ta, taga tanai mata alamar tayi magana, da sauri tace. "Insha Allah zan kiyaye ba zaki sameni da karya sharuɗɗan da kika faɗi mani ba." 
wani shu'umin murmushi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi tana mai jinjina kai, sannan ta kara da cewa. "Kitabbatar duk safiya kafin kije Sashen Yarima sai kin biyo tanan, hakama idan kin tashi daga aiki idan zaki wuce gida." sake rankwafawa Bahijja tayi tace. "Umirnin ki abin tunkaho agareni zan kasance mai biyayya agreki uwar gijiyata." cikeda gadara da izzah tace.
"Kin kyauta ma kanki yarinya, zaki iya tafiya." godiya Bahijja ta kuma yi sannan ta tashi duk ranta ba dadi tana kallan mahaifiyar ta sai dai ba damar suyima junan su magana, a haka ta tafi sai zugin marin da tai mata takeji yana ratsa ta, kamar wadda aka fara mari a ranar haka ta dingaji harta koma gida ta zauna tana tunanin halin da zata shiga a cikin Masarautar data kasan ce abun alfaharin ta kuma mahaifar ta, wasu kwallane taji sun fara bin kuncin ta da sauri ta share, tashi tayi ta ɗauro alwalla tafara sallah.


Shiko Malik tunda ya tashi hakanan yake jin gaban shi na faduwa kamar bashi ba ya rasa abinda ke mashi dadi baki ɗaya jinshi yake kamar bashi ba, kwance yake saman tamfatsetsen gadon shi yana ta juyi, ga kasala da duk ta da baibaye shi, addua'a yafara yi can kuma sai yaji bacci ya fara ɗaukar shi, can cikin bacci yaji sallamar Huzaifa a cikin karamin falon shi, bude idan shi yayi a hankali, tashi yayi zaune kamar marar lakka ya zuro kafar shi kasa, toilet ya shiga ya wanke fuskar da kanshi sannan yafara tsnewa da karamin towel, fitowa yayi zuwa falon ya tsaya bakin kofa ya harde hannu daya saman daya yana kallan Huzaifa, jin kamshin turaren sane yasa Huzaifa ɗagowa ya kalle shi wanda harya zamar mashi jiki kamshi ne yake na musamman ya wanci da haka ake gane MalikusSaif yana waje musamman idan kana mu'amula dashi, murmushi ya sakar ma Malik din juyawa yayi yakara komawa cikin bedroom din shi hakan yasa shima Huzaifa ya shigo ciki suka zauna bakin gado shiru ne ya biyo baya kowa yana sake sake a cikin ranshi, Huzaifa ne yace. "Wai  mike damun ka nagan ka sai a hankali.?" sake ya mutsa fuska Malik yayi kamar baisan maganar yace. "Bakomai." ganin ya bashi amsa a takaice ya fahimci yau baijin yan magana, sake cewa yayi. "Bahijja tafara yi maka hidima kuwa.?" kaɗa kai yayi alamar Aa, sake cewa yayi. "Miyasa kake boyeman damuwar ka Yarima.?" a hankali yace. "Koda baida anfani kaji.?" ɗan ɗaga kafaɗa Huzaifa yayi sannan yace. "Hakan ba damuwa bane abokina." mikewa tsaye MalikusSaif yayi yace. "Koda ace ana neman shiga lamarin ka akan abinda baka da tsarin shi a rayuwar ka.?"
mikewa Huzaifa yayi ya dafa kafaɗar MalikusSaif yace. "Mikenan abokina, ina fahimce akwai abinda akeso ayi maka dole, mike faruwa har haka nasa komai ya wuce."
"hmmm Huzaifa kenan Ummu kesan inyi aure bayan banda wannan tsarin a halin yanzun." cikin jimami Huzaifa yace. "Hakan ya dace sai dai ya kamata ka duba wadda ta dace da rayuwar ka." kallan mamaki MalikusSaif yaima shi sannan yace. "Kaga mubar wannan maganar batada anfani a garemu shiyasa nace zata ɓata  mana lokaci."


➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Washe gari da safe tun karfe shidda da rabi Bahijja tagama shirin ta cikin kayan su na bayin Daborah, ita da Umman ta suka fito sai Abban ta atare suka shigo cikin Masarauta inda Abban ta yai masu sallama sannan ya tafi wajen aikin shi, suma Sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa suka wuce kamar yanda ta umurci Bahijja suna shiga cikin sashen nata lokacin ma Sarauniya bata tashi ba, itako Binta cigaba tayi da aikin da takeyi kmar kullin ita kuma Bahijja samun waje tayi ta zauna tana jiran fitowar Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, ji tayi wani kafcecen mutun ya tsaya bisa kanta a hankali ta ɗago ta kafesa da idanun ta masu matukar haske da sheki, cikin kaushin murya yace. "Kwanta." mamaki ya kama Bahijja tace. "Kamar ya in kwanta?." jitayi ya zabga mata bulala ajikin ta da sauri ta mike tana sosa inda ya duketa, cikin mugun ta yace ta kwanta aiko fir taki daman ita ta tsani duka, sake shauɗa mata yayi cikin zafin rai yace.
"Sarauniya ta bada umurni ke har kin isa kikiyin biyayya."
kallan Umman tayi wanda duk abinda ke faruwa a gaban tane cikin tausayawa taima Bahijja nuni data duka haka kuwa akayi saida yai mata bulala goma, sannan yace taje wajen aikin ta kuma inta taso saitazo nan kafin ta wuce gida, rausayar da kanta tayi alamun toh dan intace zatayi magana tabbas ɓacin rai zaisa ta yin kwalla, haka ta tashi a hankali take tafiya duk damuwa ta dirar mata a cikin zuciya tana cewa haka ake nufi za'a dinga yimin kullin kenan, batai aune ba taji ta banki mutun baya tayi zata faɗi da sauri taga Yazid ne dukawa tayi ta gaida shi sannan tafara bashi hakuri, yalwaccen murmushi yayi mata yana mamakin mi Bahijja zatayi sashen Yarima, saidai bai tambayeta ba, amsa gaisuwar ta yayi sannan yace bakomai, godiya tai mashi cikin sanyin jiki ta isa wajen mai kula da shige da ficen sashen MalikusSaif gaida shi tayi sannan tace.
"Daman Sarauniya ce ta turoni ni zan dinga kulawa da aikin Yarima Malik." kallan ta ya sakeyi sannan yace. "Kin tabbatar da hakan dan shiga sashen Yarima bada dalilin ba zai jazama maki gaggarumar matsala." cikin sanyin murya tace. "Na tabbata daga umurnin Sarauniya ne." cikin gamsuwa ya wage mata kofa ta saka kai tana shiga taji wani irin dausayi mai dadi yana ratsa mata sassen jikin ta tunda ga kafarta har kwakwalwar ta, lumshe idanun ta tayi tana bin falon da take ciki da wani irin kallo ganin kayatuwar wajen da haduwar shi ya gaji dajin kayan alatun more rayuwa ga kilissai na alfarma iya ganin ka, a tsoro ce take tafiya taga wata hanya da alama nan ne hanyar da zata sadaka da dakin Yarima MalikusSaif, cikin sanɗa take tafiya har ta iso taga wasu dakuna guda ukku duk a rufe, tana san ta bude su tana shakka tasan duk inda yake tabbas yana bacci, cikin karfin hali ta tura ɗaya ga mamakin ta ba kowa a cikin dakin hakan yasa ta shiga duk da ba wani datti dakin yayi ba, amman haka tafara kakkaɓe dakin shiga tayi toilet din dakin ta fara wankewa jitayi an bankaɗo dakin a tsorace ta fito daga bathroom din ganin Jakadiya hakan yasa ta duka ta gaida ta, bude wata wardroff tayi da alama bawani anfani ake da itaba, daukar kayan aiki tayi taba Bahijja sannan takara jamata kunne tace.
"Ki nutsu kisan abinda Yarima keso da wanda baiso ina fatan kinji abinda Sarauniya ta faɗamaki.?" da sauri ta rausayar da kanta sannan tace. "Eh naji." taɓe baki Jakadiya tayi ta tafi Sashen Saifulislam domin duba bayin dake sashen nashi ita ko Bahijja cigaba da aikin ta tayi saida ta tabbtar da tagama gyara ko ina na dakin sannan tayi turaren wuta tagama ta rufo dakin haka ta shiga wanda ke kusa dashi nan ma ta gama gyarawa, tana zuwa wanda ke kallan su sai taji faduwar gaba ta tabbata Yarima yana cikin wannan kuma ya zama dole saita gyara shi, a hankali tafara tura kofar gaban ta na dukan tara tara da sauri, rufe idanun ta tayi sannan tayi sallama cikin siriryar murya, ta shiga sai dai bata ga kowa ba, batai wata wata ba tafara gyaro kewaye, tafito ta kwashe wata alqabba da tagani saman kujera ta linke jitayi kamar motsi hakan tasa kara duba gadon still bata ga komai ba saidai wani bargo mai ɗan karen taushi da laushi zuwa tayi tafara janye bargon a hankali idanta na saman glass din madubi tana kallon kanta a ciki, shiko Yarima baccin shi yake mai rai da lafiya jiyayi kamar ana ja mashi bargo, a hankali ya fara bude idon shi cikin gafin nama ya fusgo hannun ta ya janyota da karfi aiko ta kwaɗa ihu jinta jikin mutun shiko jin muryar mace saida ya tsora ta bai san ya rufe mata baki ba da hannun shi a hankali ya ida bude idan shi tan garan sai kan fuskar Bahijja, itako tagama tsurewa da sauri ya janye hannun shi, ita kuwa direwa tayi ƙasa,jikin ta na rawa ta sadda kanta kasa tana kyakkyarwa jitake kamar zai iya dukanta dan har ga Allah bata lura da mutun a kwance ba, sake sunkuyar da kanta tayi cikin zazzakar muryata tace. ''Allah ya huci zuciyar shugabana kayi hakuri bansan da....ɗaga mata hannu yayi ya kara haɗe fuska yaci magani a ranshi kuwa yana mamakin yanda akai har Bahijja tashigo cikin dakin shi ko hakan na nufin Ummu ta amince tai mashi hidima? a kasan zuciyar shi kuwa wani irin dadine ya ratsa kowane sashe na jikin shi yarasa dalilin dayasa idan yaga Bahijja kusa dashi yakejin nishadi a ranshi kodan yana tausanta ne oho? yau burin shi da ya dade dashi shekara da shekaru kenan zai cika yau Bahijja ce zatai mashi hidima, itako ganin yakara ɗaure fuska taji wani shakkar shi ya dirar mata a zuciya ko kallan shi takasa yi ga tsoro ya kama ta, jin shirun yai yawa gashi bai sallame taba balle taje tayi uzurin gaban ta yasa a hankali ta ɗago kyakkyawar fuskarta aiko idanun su suka sarke dana juna, wani irin dam taji gabanta ya buga da sauri ta sake sunkuyar da kan nata shiko karfin hali yayi ya sauko saman gadon yai kamar bai ganta ba,  a jikin shi doguwar jallabiya ce coffe brown, haka ya tako ta gefen ta ya wuce buɗe wardrof dinshi yayi sai kuma ya rufe, itako sake satar kallan shi tayi still suka hada sake haɗa ido, zata sadda kai kenan taga ya nuna mata bathroom da kallo tabi toilet din dan tagane manufar sa, a hankali ta mike ta haɗa mashi ruwan wanka, sannan ta fito ta sake dukawa tace. "Ranka shidade nagama haɗa ruwan." baice mata komai ba ya shige bathroom, itako kamar jira take har sauri takeyi tafara gyaran gadon, shiko Malik bai rufe kofar ba yana kallan ta tana laying bed, murmushi yayi wanda baisan yayi shiba sannan ya rufe kofa ya shiga danyi wanka, danko Bahijja tanaji ya rufe kofa tayi ajiyar zuciya wani irin dadi ne ya mamaye mata cikin zuciya tana mamakin yanda take shakkar Ya Malik dinta har haka,shima ya sauya mata da wannan tunanin ta cigaba da aikin ta a nutse tana gamawa tafita daga dakin duk jikin ta yai sanyi.....

Episode 49&50



Yana fitowa banɗaki ya duba baiga Bahijja ba, ɗan taɓe baki yayi zama yayi inda zai kimtsa jikin sa, tsane ruwan jikin shi yayi da wani lausasan towel daga bisan wuyan shi har kan kirjin shi, sannan ya fara shafa mai a bisa kyakkyawar fatar shi mai tsantsi da tafshi ga sheki tana tayi harya gama mulke jikin shi da mai, mai ɗan karen kamshi, yana gamawa ya ɗauki turaruka ya feshe jikin shi dasu, a hankali ya tashi ya isa wajen wardrofe din shi dake jikin bango kamar baisan budewa cikin nutsuwa ya bude ta, da idanun shi masu haske da sheki yake bin kayan dake ciki, rasa abinda zaisa yayi yakai minti ukku a tsaye shi kanshi yai mamaki yasan ba halin shi bane ruwan ido wajen zaben kayan sawa, ɗan rausayar da kanshi yayi kaɗan yana murmusawa a hankali ya jawo wani dankareren farin yadi mai masifar kyau da santsi sannan ya ɗauko wata farar hula ta Sarakai mai ratsin baki baki jikin ta hakama ya ɗauko takalman Sarauta wanda suka gaji da ado ajikin su ya dawo gefen gado wanda ya kafeshi sa fitinan idanun shi ganin an linde shi yasha gyara aran shi yana mamakin yanda Bahijja ta iya aiki har haka ga kamshi yana ta tashi mai ratsa zuciya da gangar jikin mai shakar shi domin yasha turaren daki sai kuma ya gauraye dana jikin shi cikin nutsuwa ya gama saka kayan jikin shi sannan ya ɗaura hular shi saman tausassar suman kanshi a hankali ya saka takalman shi, daga karshe ya ɗaura wata farar agogo ta alfarma wadda glass dinta yake da duhun baki cikin kankanin lokaci MalikusSaif ya zama tamkar balaraben Saudia dan haduwa da ya gaji da yi, shi kanshi yasan yai kyau, mikewa yayi cikin nutsuwa da niyar fita falo dan yasa mu abinda zaici,Bahijja kuwa tana zaune ita kaɗai a cikin tamfatsetsen falon Malik da yaji kayan alatu irin na gidan Sarauta, sai kallan tsaruwar falon takeyi, ta buga uban tagumi tana son ta koma gida tunda tagama aikin ta sai dai ba dama tunda Sarauniya tace sai ta gama aikin yamma zata koma, ganin Jakadiyar Saifulislam tsaye akanta, cikin girmamawa ta sunkuyar da kanta tana mai gaishe da Jakadiya, ɗan ɗaure fuska tayi tace ma Bahijja.
"Tunanin me kikeyi inata sallama bakyaji? Anya zaki iya kulawa da bukatun Yarima.?" sake sunkuyar da kanta tayi tace. "Allah ya huci zuciyar Jakadiya naɗan....katse ta tayi da cewa. "Ya isa anshi kayan shi kije ki jerama shi su cikin wardrofe dinshi daga nan kije madafa inda ake kula da abincin Yarima ki anso mashi nasan Lokacin cin abincin shi yayi ina fatan kin gane." sake jujjuya kanta tayi tana cewa."eh nagane." juyawa tayi da kayan MalikusSaif a hannun ta da alama daga wanki da guga suke dan sungaji da tsaruwa, a hankali take tafiya dasu a hannuwan ta duka biyun sannan ta rungume su a kirjin ta har ta isa kofar dakin, tsayawa tayi tana shawara taya zata tura kofar dakin ga kaya a hannuwan ta kuma tasan da Yarima yana kusa kilan da ya taimaka ya bude mata kofar, dubara ce ta faɗo mata hakan yasa ta saka kafaɗarta da dukan karfin ta tana turawa da kafaɗar ta, shi kuwa Yarima Malik yunwa ce tafara damun shi duba agogon hannun shi yayi yaga har lokaci ya gota mashi, a hankali yasa hannuwan shi masu taushi ya ja handle din kofar dakin da niyar fitowa falo ita kam Bahijja sai kiciniyar tura kofar takeyi da karfi, yana janyowa yaji ta a jikin shi, kayan hannun ta wasu duk sun zube, a ruɗe ta duka kasa da sauri harda yan kwallan ta a idanun ta, tsoro ya addabi zuciyar ta tana tsoran kada Ya Malik dinta yai zatan da biyu take mashi hakan kamar dazun da yake bacci, shi kanshi ya karanci halin data shiga wanda shima yana jin zuciyar shi tana bugawa da sauri da sauri inaga ita da take zatan kilan ma ya hukunta ta daure wa yayi cikin nutsuwa yace. "Ki kula Bahijja kada kiji ciwo." da sauri ta kalle shi kwalla na shatata a saman kyakkyawar fuskar ta, mamaki ya gama mamaye zuciyar MalikusSaif shi awajen shi baiga abin kuka ba yasan bada manufa hakan ta faru ba, rasa abinyi yayi yana san ya lallashi Bahijjar shi wadda yake jinta tamkar wata tsoka a cikin jikin shi sai dai baisan ta inda zai faraba, a hankali ya zura hannun shi cikin aljihun rigar shi ya fito da wani lallausan handkicif ya mika mata, wani irin sanyayen kamshi turaren dake jikin handkicif dinne ya daki hancin ta lokacin daya miko mata shi dai dai saitin fuskar ta a hankali yace. "Share hawayen fuskar ki Bahijjaaah." yanda yaja sunan nata saida ta lumshe idanun kowane sashe na jikin ta saida ya amsa sunan da Ya Malik dinta ya kira dashi duk da ba wani canza shi yaiba amman ta gama imani ba wanda yakai Ya Malik iya kiran sunan ta kamar  shi ya raɗa mata sunan da kanshi, cikin sanyin jiki ta amsa, ta kalle shi tace. "Ya Malik dan Allah kayi hakuri ban kulaba." rufe idanun shi yayi zuciyar shi na harbawa lokaci guda yarasa dalilin da yasa idan yana tareda Bahijja yake jin wani yanayi a tareda shi musamman idan ta ambace shi da Ya Malik, wanda yakejin hakan a kowane sashe na jikin shi har yake mata kallan kanwar shi kodan baida kanwa ko kani shiyasa yakejin hakan akan Bahijja? rashin ansar tambyar da yaima kanshi ne yasa ya bude idanun shi ya sauke su kanta take idanun su ya sarke dana juna, da sauri ta sauke nata idan, ɗan murmushi yayi sannan yace. "Kije ki aje kayan, ina falo kisamaman abinda zanci."
yana gama faɗar haka ya fita, cikin takunshi na mutunci da kamala atare dashi ita kuma ta ida kwashe kayan da suka zube sannan tafara jerasu a wardrofe dinshi daga bisani ta fito zuwa falo.....

 *Masarautar Waisu* 


Gimbiya Ƙamariyya ce zaune saman kyatattar shimfidar ta wadda ta wadatu da kayan ƙawa na musamman kishingiɗawa tayi hadiman ta nai mata fiffita da wasu irin mafittai da suka kawatu da adon gashin ɗawisu, ɗan tagumi tayi kamar mai nazari, jitayi ana sanar da isowar Sarki Haishir, murmusawa tayi tanajin wani irin dadi aranta jin shigowar ɗan nata, baki ɗaya hadiman dake wajen suka zube suna kwasar gaisuwa,a wajewajen Sarki, daga masu hannu yayi hakan ya basu damar tafiy. 
tankwashe kafar shi yayi cikin kulawa yace. "Barka sa yamma Umma." murmushi ɗauke a fuskar ta tace. "Angaishe da Sarkin Waisu, ɗa ga Sarki Lahazu jika ga Sarki Humzu barka da hutawa ɗana, ya fama da jama'a.?" cikin jin dadi yace. "Ba'acewa komai Umma." zama ta gyara sannan tace.
Mika yanke game da wannan makiyin Sarkin na Raifasu.?" numfashi mai zafi ya furzar sannan yace. "Ina nan ina shiri so nike indarjaza daular shi yanda ko sunan Haishir yaji sai gaban shi ya faɗi daga baya in halaka shi in dirkake shi daga shi har matar shi." wani irin shu'umin murmushi tasaki sannan tace. "Ni kaina bazan taɓa yafe jinin mijina ba dan haka ka ɗauki abin da mahimmanci cikin kankanin lokaci ka wulakan ta Baidulƙais." "kin san yanzun fa ya zama naka sasshe bare ince inyi fito na fito dashi saidai in halaka shi."
yaka rasa maganar yana wata irin dariya cikin mamaki gimbiya Ƙamariyya tace. "Kamar ya nakasasshe.?" "kinsan Yarima Malik ya sauke mashi hannu ɗaya daya kama wannan baiwar Bahijja, gaskia Umma jayyya dasu MalikusSaif ba dadi."
jinjina kai tayi alamar mamaki cikeda gadara tace. "Sarki Haishir kenan mu yanzun bata su muke ba ga wanda zamu darkake nan!  kwara daya datse hannun tsinanne kowa ya huta." matsowa tayi kusa dashi daidai saitin kunnan shi tayi mashi wata magana take ya saki wani irin shu'umin murmushi mai cike da fassararori iri iri itama shi tayi nan sukaci gaba da kudurin su cike da zuciya...... 


_Masarautar Daborah_ 


Koda Bahijja ta isa madafa wani wajene na musamman inda ake girka abincin Yarima Malik da iyayen shi, idan kuma ka ƙara shiga daga ciki nanma wajene inda ake girkama sauran yan fada abinci, tana shiga ta iske wata matashiyar yarinya tana jere abinci cikin wani faranti mai ɗan karen kyau, tana gama shirya abincin  Bahijja tace. "Ina abincin Yarima." nuna mata baiwar tayi, itako Bahijja ɗauka tayi ta tafi, cikin nutsuwa take tafiyar ta harta isa cikin ƙayataccen falon da Malik yake ciki, tunda Bahijja ta shigo Malik ke kallan ta, musamman yanda take komai cikin nutsuwa da kamala harta iso gaban shi ta tsugunna sannan ta'aje abincin, falat ta dauka ta zuba mashi cikin nutsuwa ta'aje mashi, ɗan kallan shi tayi sannan tace. "Ya Malik nifa yanzun baniyin wasa, tunda narabu da kawaye na su Zainab da Indo, nan kullin Umma ke hanani wasa dan Allah kasiyoman yar tsana insamu ƙawa."
ta karashe maganar tana cinno ɗan karamin bakin mai masifar ɗaukar hankali da kyau, shi kanshi bugewa yayi yana kallan bakin nata yanda yake juyawa cikin nutsuwa, jin yayi shiru yasa ta kara marerecewa tace. "Allah yakara maka girma da nasara Allah yatai maki Yariman Daborah Yarima mai adalci nagode da karamci Allah.....sa hannun shi yayi saman lip dinshi alamun tai shiru, suko su Huzaifa tsaye sukayi suna kallan su, kallan kallo suka dinga yima juna, ganin hakane yasa Bahijja tashi, tayi wani corridor bayan ta gaidasu cikin girmamawa, jitayi yace. "ɗauki abincin nan."dukawa tayi ta ɗauka sannan ta tafi, kallan shi sukayi baki ɗayan su cikin halin ko in kula yace......

Kan wannan yarinyar mai alfarma Kadimul islam da kafafun shi ya shiga cikin turakar bayi yasa aka kwance ta, tunda kike kintaɓa ganin jinin Sarauta ya shiga turakar BAYI!?
saita dalilin wannan tsinanniyar yarinyar, yau gashi anwayi gari akan wannan yarinyar tausayinta ya cika zuciyar ɗana harya dauki abu mai mahimmancin gaske 'yan kunnen BARRI yaba BAIWA tasaka ma kunnen ta! ki auna su da takobin BARRI kiga darajar su, baiwa ta sasu, so kike ince ɗana Yarima MALIK son BAIWA yakeyi kuma itace ya zaɓa a matsayin mata!?" 

numfasawa gimbiya Salsabila tayi da takaici ya ishi zuciyar ta babban burin ta shine taga Yarima Malik yaba gimbiya Zahara'u 'yan kunnen Barri ta saka a kunnen ta yau gashi an wayi gari ya bama baiwa ta saka su, amman saita dannen bakin cikin ta tace....

"inajinka ya bashi amsa atakaice, cewa yayi "ina zatan kafaɗa tarkon son Bahijja Yarima sai dai kai har yanzun bakasan kana sonta ba, kadauka tausayin ne kawai kakeyi."

 *_KASUWAR ZURSU_* 


Jama'a ne keta hada hada kamar ba gobe kowa burin shi yasai abu mai mahimmanci wanda zakai shi wata shekarar idan na siyar wa darajar shi da dagu ka siyar kaima dan kaci riba mai yawan gaske, marece ne ke gaba towa inda fataken ke fara kimtsa kayan su, Matawalle ne sai Sarauniya Zulaiƙa da Saifulislam sai Waziri da Dagaci sai Zannan Daborah suke ran gadi a cikin Kasiwar ta Zursu, inda Saifulislam yaje wajen tawwagar shi dan ganin yanda suke gudanar da siye da siyawar su, yana zuwa shida Zulaiƙa duk suka zube suka kawo gaisuwa wani wajene na musamman aka basu suka zauna, dan jim kadan ma'ajin Saifulislam yazo inda yake zaune ya duka harkasa sannan ya bashi makudan kudin da suka samu sanadiyar fatauci da sukeyi kasancewar shi babban dan kasuwa mai faɗa aji a cikin kasar Gambia, lissafi sukayi tabbas yasan mutanen shi nada amana dan dukiyar da suke juyawa akalla ansamu riba kashi ukku cikin hudu, sawa yayi aka kira mashi dan shi MalikusSaif bada jimawa ba saiga shi yazo,zaunawa yayi ya gaida iyayen nashi mahaifin shine yaima Malik bayanin komai, sai dai duk abin nan Malik bai yarda sun ido hudu da mahaifiyar shiba sabda bakarmin haushin shi takeji ba, cigaba da lissafin su sukayi, kashi daya na dukiyar MalikusSaif yaba ma'aji yace ya fidda kason albashin shi, sannan ya rabama sauran jama'ar su, kashi guda kuma ya saka ta cikin jallin su, yace a sake juyawa da uwar kudin kashi guda kuma yaba Saifulislam yace kai kuma wannan itace ribar ka Abbuh, kowa ya gamsu da kasafin Malik daman  Saifulislam ya kira MalikusSaif ne dan ya jarraba shi yaga ko yasan takan kasuwa dan shima yana burin gudan jinin nashi ya gajeshi, dan acewar shi ba abinda yakai fatauci ma'ana (kasuwanci) riba akaf abinda mutun yasaka gaba a wannan duniyar da muke ciki, a gaban kowa Saifulislam ya keta ribar da aka bashi ta kudi masu yawan gaske ya raba gida hudu kashi daya yace ara bama talakawa kashi daya yaba Malik kashi daya yaba matar shi, shima yarike kashi ɗaya, damkawa kowa nashi kudin yayi godiya sukai mashi sannan yaba Malik wadda za'arabama talakawa kamar yanda ya saba ya naɗa Malik a matsayin wakilin shi tako  wane ɓangare, da haka Saifulislam yasa aka kawo ma yaran na shi abinci da ruwa da kayan bukata, nan yaimasu fatan alkhairy sukaci gaba da hada kayan su wanda suka saya a cikin KASUWAR ta ZURSU da sauran kayan su zasu cigaba da bin kasashe fatauci kamar yanda suka saba, da haka suka nutsa cikin kasuwar suna ganin yanda komai yake wakana cikin aminci Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce taji wani bafade yana mata magana yace.

"Ranki shidade Sarki Haishir ya aikoni yace, ingaishe ki sannan in roka mashi gafarar ki da 'yan tuwa amatsayin ɗa a wajen ki." shiru Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi tana kallan shi cikeda mamaki tana nazarin maganar wannan bafaden na Waisu, da yake Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kwararra ce wajen fahimtar dan Adam tun daga gaskiar shi ko akasin hakan, rausayar dakai tayi cikin gamsuwa tace "Na amsa sai dai kace tuni na yafema Masarautar sa da jama'ar shi, amman yanci saina duba yuyuwar hakan nagode." ba haka wannan bafadan yaso jiba dan suna da tasu manufar da sukeso su samu a wajen ta sai dai wannan karon basu da niyar cutar da ita ko yakarta, godiya yaima ta sannan suka kama hanyar tafiya shida tawagar su zuwa Masarautar tasu ta Waisu..... 

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A wajen jama'ar Sarki Danwar kuwa suma sun gama komai nasu sai dai sunsayi kayan makami da yawan gaske haka suka gama duk abinda zasuyi sannan suka kam hanyar komawa gida, atakaice dai ranar KASUWAR ZURSU ta kwashi dan Adam fiye da tunanin mai tunani har yamma liqis sannan kasuwar ta watse kowa ya kama gaban shi sai kuma wata shekara, duk da yan Daborah sukan kasa kayan su na yau da kullin wanda suke bukatar siyarwa na yau da kullin amman ta gefen kasuwar, saboda ita  Kasuwar Zursu tana ɗauke da gate gate sama da shidda tana gama ci, Sarkin kasuwa zaisa kwaɗo a kulleta sai aje makullin cikin kayan adana tarihi na Masarautar Daborah sai kuma wata shekara wannan kenan...... 

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A Masarautar Raifasu kuwa Baidulƙais ne yaje ya dawo haka yaita yi bakarmin tashin hankali ya shiga ba jin Jakadiyar shi wadda take kamar aminya agare shi ta amshi addinin musulunci yasan ba karamin kalubale zai fuskanta ba wajen Sarrilƙus ba, daman gashi yai mashi tawaye, zufa keta tsatsafo mashi kamar an mashi wanka da ruwan sama, ba jimawa saiga Jamra ta shigo dukawa tayi gaban shugaban nata ta sadda kanta tayi kasa, shiko yakai yadawo haka yaita yi yana zuwa ya dan duka kadan a gaban ta yace. "Jamraaah." yanda yaja sunan natane yasa ta dagowa da sauri cikin fushi ya kwade ta da maruka har ukku saida ta fasa uwar kara da kuwa ta faɗi kasa ta saki wata irin  marainiyar kara tana hawaye cikin bacin rai yace. "Jamra kinci amana  ta ke kadai kika ragemin da nike gani matsayin Jakadiya ta, ta amana inji dadi yau gashi an waye gari kema kin juyaman baya na rasa ɗana! na rasa Bahijja, na rasa abu mai mahimmanci a cikin sashe na jikina, uwa uba mulkina yana barazana agareni haba Jamra sai yanzun kema zakice kin gujeni ya kikeso inyi da raina.?" sake fashewa tayi da kuka tace.
"Na rantse da wanda raina ke hannun sa na rantse da darajar wanda ya aiko domin yazama shiriya ga talikan bayi, na rantse da girman addinina tabbas na musulunta, ya shugaba na saidai kasani wannan addinin d nikeyi haskeni kuma shiriya ce ga dukan bani adama inama zaka karbi wannan addinin da hannu bibbiyu tabbas da na zamarma ginshiƙi kuma na tallafeka tamkar mahaifina ko kuma ɗan cikina, kabar wannan addinin na kaka da kakanni bai karaka da komai sai asara bayya nanna tabbas Bahijja haskece agreni shiyasa Allah SWT ya bata ilhama dahar naji addinin ta ya shiga cikin zuciyata wannan itace dangan takata da Bahijja tun tana karkashin ikon ka naki wannan addinin a sirrance, saidai yanzun duk abinda kaka damar zartar min zan dauka amma kasani Jamra bazata iya wofintar da addinin taba ta kama
 Addinin da bazai anfaneta da komai ba!" cikin hasala yace "kimin shiru Jamra kina fadin son ranki akan addinina, dan kinga nabaki muhimmanci arayuwa ta Jamra da ace wanine ya aikatamin haka sa yanzun yari gida y isa barzahu dan haka yau zaki hadu da fushina Jamra!!" 
sunkuyar dakanta tayi kasa tace. "Na yarda da hakan, da ace akn wani abune na daban tabbas kasan Jamra zata bada hakuri saidai kasani ya shugabana idan ka hukunta. ni ka tsaya kayi tunanin addinin da Jamra ta shiga saidai kasani Jamra bata taɓa cutar dakai da komai ba ka duba hakan cikin nazari ina sauraran amsarka ya shugaba na tabbas zansama maka mafitar dake ciki nagode!" yanajin maganganun Jamra har cikin babban yatsar hannun shi saidai baida wani zabi dayawuce hukunta ta, sawa yayi aka akaita gidan kaso yace ko abinci baice abata ba amman kada aduketa, haka akaja Jamra zasu fita da karfi tace. "Kayi nazari mai kyau ya shugaba na, batareda kasanarwa kowa wannan maganar ba.!'' Haka aka tafi da Jamra aka rufeta gidan kaso....

**********************************

Bayan sati ɗaya, a Masarautar Daborah kuwa komai ya dai daita jikin Bahijja ya warke ta koma bakin aikin ta saidai ba kadan taja baya da Yarima Malik ba, da taje tayi aikin ta zata samu waje tai zaman ta, sai inya  sata wani aikin sannan zatayi dan kusan kullin sai Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta aiko ana duba yanda take hudda da uban gidan nata, yau tana zaune tana aikin gayran falo, taji anama gimbiya Zahara'u ison shigowa sashen Yarima Malik, tunda ta shigo take wani yan fisge fisge tana shakat kamshi kamar ba mutun ba, cikeda da gadara ta samun lumbitsetsiyar kujerar ta ta zauna tanama Bahijja wani mungun kallo na kinsan sauran itadai bata damu da ita tunda taje ta gaidata bata koma bi ta kanta ba, dan taga ko amsawar ma a wulakance ta amsa cigaba da yan goge gogen ta tayi cikin isa taji tace. "Ke baiwa." da bazata jeba dan Bahijja ta tsani wulakanci duk da take baiwa tasan darajar da Allah yaimata, juyawa tayi taje ba tace komai ba, hade fuska ta sakeyi tace. "Ina uban gidan naki.?" a dakile itama tanaji da kanta tace. "Yana dakin shi." "kice gimbiya Zahara'u tana sallama." batareda da tace komai ba ta mike zuwa bedroom din Malik sallama tayi ya amsa ta atakaice ba tareda ya kalleta ba, dukawa tayi kasa cikin sanyn rai tace. "Ranka shidade gimbiya Zahara'u ke sallama dakai tana falo." hakanan yaji ranshi ya sosu, ɗago kyawawan idanun shi yayi ya kalleta yace. "Kice mata ina aiki zata iya jira ko kuma wani lokacin ta sake dawowa." magana Bahijja zatayi watsama ta wani matsiyacin kallo ba shiri tayi shiru tashi tayi taje falon jiki sanyaye ta duka tafadama gimbiya Zahara'u sakon Yarima Malik, wani kallo taimata cikin girman kai da gadara tace. "Danna man kafana." tsaye Bahijja tayi kamar bataji me tace mata sake yimata wani watsastsen kallo tayi sannan tace. "Ke wai badake nike ba!" tafiya tayi a nutse ta tunkaro gimbiya Zahara'u harta iso gaban ta, har ta duka zata fara danna mata kafar taji ance. "Tsaya kada ki kuskura kiyi mata danna!" cak Bahijja ta tatsaya jin muryar Yarima Malik wani irin dadine ya rufe ta, itako gimbiya Zahara'u da idanu takebin Malik a ganin ta kamar yaci mata zarafi, yana isowa ya samu waje ya zauna samn kayatattar kujerar shi ya daura kafa ɗaya bisa ɗaya ya harde ya zubamata idanun shi masu firgitar da wanda ake a kallo a hankali gimbiya Zahara'u ta sauke nata idanun kasa, cikin ƙarsashi da muryar sa mai dadin amo yace. "Banyarda wani ko wata a cikin wannan Masarautar yasaka Bahijja wani aiki ba, komai kankantar sa, Bahijja tana a kalkashin ikona, dafatan kin fahimta? Inkuna bukatar tausa kinemi wasu bayin wanda sukayi kama da kalar tausa amman Bahijja ba irin subace!"

Itadai Bahijja gefen shi takoma tana kallan ikon Allah wani matsiyacin kallo take aikama Bahijja, amman saita wayence tace. "Eh daman nagajine shiyasa nace taimani." daga mata hannu yayi cikin isa yace. "Bana magana biyu fatan zaki kiyaye hakan?" gyada kai tayi tace "eh nagane."

Kallan ta yayi yai mata alamar ko lfy, neman me take mashi, tsaf tagane abunda yake nufi saidai yai masifar yimata kwarjini bataji zata iya kwakwaran motsin kirki a gaban shi, a sanyaye tace. "Daman nazone dan igaisheka!" rausayar dakai yayi yace. "Kin kyauta nagod." mikewa yayi yace. "Ina aiki kigaida Ummi." kai ta gyada tace. "Toh." komawa yayi cikin dakin shi duk ranshi ya sosu wai Bahijja zatace taimata tausa,cigaba da hidimar gaban shi yayi ya watsar da zancen. 

Itako gimbiya Zahara'u tashi tayi hadimanta suka maye mata baya, saida tazo gabda Bahijja ta tsaya cikin gadara tace. "Ke watsastsa ko, harkin isa ince kiyi abu Yarima ya hanaki ko, ke yar lelen sa ko? Saina wulakanta ki." wucewa tayi nniyar ingije Bahijja da sauri ta kwace ta bata wuri, haka ta fita rai ɓace... 

A sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuwa zaune take bisa kujerar ta ta alfarma wadda ta gaji da ado na duwatsun lu'u lu'u, gefen fa kuma Waziri Dammur ne zaune da alama suna magana mai mahimmanci ne a tsakanin su, a hankali Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace. "Kaji yanda za'ayi inajiran inji abinda Matawalle zaice gameda Malik, idan ya tsaya mana wasa sai mu zaba mashi ra'ayin kanmu." murmushi yayi mai ɗauke da ma'anoni cikin kulawa yace. "Angaishe da Sarauniyar da tagagari rauwuna a cikin dokar daji, angaishe da Sarauniyar da take gilgiza kirjin maza, koda mazan Saraki ne, wannan giramnki ne anbuga dake anbarki mace mai kamar maza kwarine kawai babu, angaishe da matar Kadimulislam ƴar uwar Matawalle mahaifiya ga jarumi haziki MalikusSaif, yanda kikace haka zamuyi Dammur nagodiya."  a hankali ta rausayar da kanta tanajin dadin kirarin da Wazirin ta yaimata wanda ya yaye mata kaso biyu cikin ukku na damuwar ta, haka yaimata sallama ya tafi ranshi fas


Itako Binta dake aiki tunda dazun takan juyo kadan daga cikin abunda suke tattaunawa, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce taimata wani irin kallo abinka da ta saba harta gane manufar uwar gijiyar tata, da sauri ta iso zuwa gareta, ta miko mata ruwa a kofi, sannan ta rankwafa ita kuma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta ɗaura kafarta a kafadar Binta taci gaba da yimata tausa itakuma ta kai kofin ruwa abakin ta ta surba da sake sake kala kala a cakin ranta, lokacin marece yayi gaf ake da kiran sallar magrib, hakan yasa Bahijja ta gama aikin ta da takeyi taima uban gidan nata sallama, baice da ita komai ba, ya fahimci ta tsorata da lamarin abinda mahaifiyar shi taimata shiyasa baisan yana janta ajiki gudun kada wani abun yakara samun ta duk da kullin ruruwar tausanta ke ɗawainiya da Yarima Malik a cikin zuciyar shi, haka takama hanya ta tafi sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kamar yanda ta umurce ta, wannan karon ma a gaban Binta akaci gaba da shidema Bahijja bulalai a jikin ta, kamar yanda akai mata da safe, haka sarkin bulala yaita wanke Bahijja da bulala, itako Sarauniya da kiyayyar Bahijja ke kara tasiri a cikin zuciyar ta haka ta ɗauki ruwa daga saman kan Bahijja ta dinga kwarara mata, ana labta mata bulalai ga kafar Sarauniya a saman Binta tana danna mata, ba abinda Binta kecewa sai. "Tuba take uwar dakina wannan girmanki ne an gaishe da mai dole bin umurnin ki wajibi ne Bahijja na tuba Allah yakara girma." itako Bahijja takasa furta uffan sai ambaliyar kwalla da suke ɗawainiya da ita, sallamar da sukaji itace tasa kowa ya maida hankalin shi don ganin mai shigowa, cikin kamun kai na marassa gaskia Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta mike tsaye tace......
