Episode 61&62



"Daman yanzun nike shirin zuwa sashen ka Abu Malik." baice komai ba saima karasowa ciki da yayi, cikin nutsuwa ya kalli Bahijja wadda idanun ta sukai jajir dasu yace. "Binta kamata kutafi gida." gaisheshi sukayi sannan takama ɗiyar ta suka tafi, wani kallo ta bankama su kama Bahijja tayi a sanyaye suka fice ya rage dashi sai matar tashi, zama yayi baice komai ba, itama zama tayi kusa dashi tana mai rike hannun shi cikin kula tace. "Abu Malik kayi magana mana bansan wannan shirun naka agareni." zame hannun shi yayi anata ya kalleta yace. "Yanzun naga kina cikin damuwa, kuma inada abinyi, zan koma sashina, domin yau inada baki masu mahimmanci." baijra cewar taba ya mike, itama mikewar tayi cikin rashin gaskia tace. "Anman inzakai baki ana sauran kwana ukku kake sanar dani miya canza hakan.?" "bakomai sabo da ni suka shafa, sai anjima."
jitayi zuciyar ta ta tsinke ta tabbata Saifulislam fushi yake da ita, sai dai dole taimashi uxuri zuwa wani lokaci.

Bayan sati biyu a Masarautar  Raifasu kuwa Baidulƙais ne zaune a falon shi ya rasa inda zai saka kanshi yaji sanyi komai na rayuwa ya game mashi yana cikin tunani kawai yaga aljani ɗan tsitu ya bayyana agare shi cikin wata iriyar murya marar dadin sauraro yace "dama ka daina damun kanka ba abinda zai sauya dan haka yau dinnan wa'adin da shugaba Sarrilƙus ya dibar maka ya cika dole kabada zoben dake hannun ka, sannan zamu naɗa sabon Sarki daga cikin jama'ar mu dan cigaba da mulkar wannan daular tamu tunda kai kagaza."

Zaiyi magana kenan yaji kamar an shake mashi makoshi ga wani irin zugi da hannun shi kema shi sai kakkarwa yakeyi cikin tashin hankali yaji kamar anfisgar mashi hannu faɗuwa kasa yayi yana furzar da wani uban nishi kamar wanda yayi artaba da bijimin zaki haka ya dinga kakkarwa yana fidda wata irin kumfa abakin shi, yakai minti talatin yana fama da abu, ɗaya a hankali ya fara dawowa cikin hayyacin shi sai dai abin mamaki ya nemi ajani ɗan tsitu babu shi sama ko kasa, bai kula da hannun shi babu zobe ba, saida yaji zugi ya isheshi ya dubawa yaga ba zoben hannun shi ga wani irin sahun azaba ya dame shi yatsan shi yayi kore dashi, yana ganin haka ya fadi kasa dabas yasaki wani azababban kuka mai sosa rai kamar wani zautacce haka ya tashi da gudu ya faɗa cikin wani ɗaki na tsafin shi, yana neman wani abu da alama abune mai mahimmanci saida bai samu komai ba sai tarin kayan su na surkulle, ya cigaba da gwada sa'ar shi ko zai dace aljani dan tsitu ya bayyana amman ina yana ganin haka yasan baida sa'a Sarrilƙus ya datse duk wata alaka dake tsakanin su yanzun rayuwar shi itace abu na gaba da zasu bukata, anan ya zube yana gunjin kuka mai tsuma zuciya.

**************************************

A dajin Gamki kuwa koda aljani dan tsitu ya dawo daga aikin da uban gidan nashi ya sashi saka zoben akayi cikin wata kwallabar tsafi ba abinda ke cikin ta sai tarin jini da wasu irin halittu take zoben ya sauya kala, boka Sarrilƙus ne yasa aka rataye zoben saman wani hannun kuka wanda yake ɗauke da kayan tsafe tsafe iri iri cikin wata iriyar murya ya saki wata irin dariya wanda saida wani haske na tsafi ya dinga tartsatsi a cikin dajin gamki, yace. "Angaishe ka aljani dan tsitu aikin ka yana kyau yanzun abinda ya rage shine rayuwar Baidulƙais tunda ya gaza shayar da dodon gamki daga jinin Bahijja ya gaza ya bamu kunya baida anfani zamu kashe shi, mu tura cikin jama'ar mu su cigaba da mulkin Masarautar Raifasu, hhhhhahhhhh!!!  Komai na dajin gamki gilgiza yake jin dariyar da Sarrilƙus keyi wanda yana kwashe sama da shekara kafin yayi irin ta ko makamanciyar ta alamu ya nuna ranshi ya ɓaci matuka kuma zai iya aikata komai akan Baidulƙais dama Masarautar Raifasu baki ɗayan ta


 ~Aidaman haka rayuwa take duk abinda ba  hasken addini a cikin shi lallai bazai ɗaure ba yake watsewa, Allah ya dauwamar damu bisa addinin mu~

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Tunda Bahijja taje aiki wajen Malik take ganin yanda yana yin shi ya sauya da alama yana cikin damuwa marar misaltuwa, hakanan taji itama ta shiga cikin damuwa, saidai bata da hurumin da zata tambayi uban gidan nata damuwar shi, cigaba da aikin ta tayi, shiko MalikusSaif yana kishingide bisa tattausar kujerar shi mai masifar kyau da ado yana tunanin yanda zai bullowa lamarin mahaifiyar shi akan Bahijja, a hankali tazo tana gyara tsakiyar falon dan batasan tai motsi mai karfi da zai jagulama uban gidan nata lissafi dan taga tarin damuwa a cikin kwayar idanun shi dukawa tayi ta wanko wani karamin towel tana goge wani table dake tsakiyr falon, shiko a hankali ya bude idan shi jin zuciyar shi ta buga ranshi ya bashi tabbas Bahijja na kusa dashi dan yafara fahimtar duk sanda Bahijja zata kasance dashi yana shiga wani yanayi ko na shauki ko kuma na son ganin ta akoda yaushe a tare dashi, sai dai yarasa dalilin haka kuma kullin lamarin kara gaba yake ba baya ba, maganar Huzaifa ce ta dawo mashi sabuwa a cikin kunnuwan shi girgiza kai yayi alamun bata yuyuwa sai dai kawai tausayn tane yai tasiri a cikin zuciyar shi kamar yanda mahaifiyar shi take cewa a hankali ya bude baki zaiyi magana sai kuma ya fasa, cigaba da kallan ta yayi ganin yanda take aikin ta cikin nutsuwa da sanin ya kamata, haka ta ida goge ko ina sannan ta tafi.

Bayan wasu awanni MalikusSaif ne ya gama wanka ya shirya cikin wasu kaya masu masifar kyau da daukar hankali na gidan Sarauta wanda ya wanci ba masu amfani dasu sai Yarima, shima Yariman wanda ya ansa sunan sa ma'ana Yarima mai jiran gado a hausan ce magajin Sarki, ba karamin kyau da karbuwa kayan sukai ma MalikusSaif ba Maroon color ne sai ratsin golden yasha ado da zaiba itama golden sai takalman shi suma golden sai agogon hannun shi masu asirkar golden haka dai gayama kimtsawa ya fito sak a MalikusSaif dinshi, fitowa yayi falo ya zauna, iske Bahijja yayi ta jinjina jikin bango da alama ta gaji ga ɓarawo bacci na neman ɗauketa, shiko murmushi yayi a ranshi ko cewa yayi kuruciya kenan jibi yanda take gyangyadi daga zaune maimakon ta koma gida ta huta, komawa yayi saman kafat dake linde a gyare yasha kayan alatu iri iri ɗan gyaran murya yayi a firgice Bahijja ta ware idanun ta, ganin shi tayi zaune yadan kishin giɗa tashi tayi a nutse taje ta duka ta gaida shi, fuska a sake ya amsa, tashi tayi taje tafara kawo mashi kayan abincin shi a nutse ta aje, cikin kulawa ta ɗauki flat tace. "Ranka shidade mikake bukatar ci.?" girgiza mata kanshi yayi alamun ya koshi, cikeda da damuwa tace. "Ya Malik daga gani akwai abinda ke damunka dan Allah miyasa meka.?"
yaji dadin yanda Bahijja harta fara gane yanayin shi, cikin kulawa yace. "Bakomai kanwata karki damu, ke kinci abinci.?" da zatace aa sai kuma ta tuno da abinda Sarauniya tai mata, a hankali tace eh naci, sai kuma takara cewa. "Dan Allah indai ba abinda ke damunka kaci abincin?" badan yana son cin komai ba sai dai baisan tashiga cikin damuwa, gyada kai yayi, hakan yasa tace. "Mikakeson ci?" a atakaice yace. "Duk abunda yai maki ina son shi." bude farfesun yan ciki tayi sai farar shinkafa ta zuba mashi ɗan kima sannan ta zuba mashi ruwa a kofi, a hankali ta miko mashi, murmushi ya sakar mata, yasa hannu zai amsa kenan sai yaga hannun ta wani irin sahu ga jini ya kwata sosai, baisan sadda ya rike hannun ba, cikin damuwa yace. "Bahijja miya sameki a hannu?" da sauri ta girgiza kai alamun ba komai, itako yanda ya rike mata hannu cikin tattausan hannun shi saida taji wani iri har cikin kwakwalwar ta, da sauri ya sake ta ganin ta zubama hannun nashi ido, hakanan ya samu kanshi dajin haushin kanshi, daya riketa, still yana tambayar kanshi abinda ya samu Bahijja a saman hannun ta, a hankali yafara cin abincin badan yanajin ddin shi ba, itako gefe ta koma tanajirn uban gidan nata yagama cikeda da tunani a cikin ranta,shima sake saken zuci ya dingayi.

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

jin ana sanar da shigowar mai girma Matawalle gyara zaman shi yayi Yarima Malik yayi, koda yazo zama yayi kusa da ɗan na shi, cikin sakin fuska ya gaishe da kawun nashi cikin girmamawa, Matawalle  yace.
"ɗana gani nazo da kaina, naga lokaci ya nata kurewa abubuwa suna karaja baya, kuma kai bakace komai ba, har zuwa yanzun ya ake ciki akan maganar fidda mata?"
da sauri Bahijja dake can gefe ta kalli Matawalle samun kanta tayi dajin faɗuwar gaba, shima Malik ita ya kalla wadda ta kasa ɗauke idanun ta akan shi, kallan Matawalle yayi ya sadda kanshi kasa cikin ladabi yace. "Allah yataimaki Matawalle daman ina son nan da kwana ukku inzo maka labarin da kaina inba dam....katse shi Matawalle yayi yace. "Wane irin kwana ukku Malik? Dafa sati nabaka, shine kaki maida hankalin ka akan lamarin nan ya kake so ayi yanzun?" gyara zaman shi Malik yayi yace. "Eh na fidda Kawu kawai dai inajiran nagama tantance wani abune shiyasa." "Aaa Malik ya isa haka ka shirya jibi zamuje wajen Kawun mu Masarautar da tasan kima da daraja ta dan Adam daular musulunci  sai ka zaba matar aure a can hakan zaifi." Bahijja dake jin duk abinda ake faɗa tashi tayi ta shiga ciki, jitayi wani irin kasala da ciwon kai ya dirar mata, zuwa tayi ta zauna wajen wani corridor tanajin zafin maganar da Matawalle kema Yarima Malik.
"Dan haka ka shirya bansan musu, nasan nan ba wadda zaka fidda amman nasan can muddin kaga zuri'ar shi akwai addini zasu shiga cikin zuciyar ka sosai, fatan Allah yai mana jagoranci." da ameen Malik ya amsa dan baisan yana musu da Matawalle kodan so da kaunar da yake nuna mashi kamar dan cikin shi, bai jima ba yaima MalikusSaif sallama ya tafi kasancewar yana sauri akwai wani taro na yan kasuwa da zai halatta, yana tafiya Malik ya tashi yaga ba Bahijja a tunanin shi ta tafi gida tafiya yayi zai shig lambu dan hutawa, can ya hangi Bahijja ta zauna kamar mai tunani cikin kulawa yace. "Mikikeyi nan?" a daburce tace. "Bakomai, daman inasan zanje gida Ya Malik banjin dadi." cikin tausayawa yace. "Miya sameki?" "kaina ke ciwo."  dan shiru yayi sai kuma yace. "Allah yabaki lfy kije ki huta." godiya tai mashi sannan ta tafi jitayi baki daya sashen na Malik ya fitar mata arai haka ta koma gida ta kwanta lokacin bata tadda kowa cikin gidan ba, sake sake ta dinga yi a cikin zuciyar ta tana tambayar kanta batasan tanayi a zahiri ba tace. "Wai shi wannan mutumin mi ruwan shi da wadda Ya Malik  zai aura, wannan wane irin abune, shi ba wadda,  zai aura amman andami mutun mtsw, sai kuma tace keko Bahijja mi ruwanki da wadda Ya Malik zai aura ba Abba yace kidaina shiga sabgar da ruwanki ba? abin haushi ma......jitayi Mairo tace. "Ke Bahijja mi ruwanki da wadda iyayen Malik zasuyi mashi zabi, ba ruwanki 'yata kidaina damuwa da duk abinda bai shafeki ba." murmushin karfin hali tayi tace. "Inna ba haka bane inaga kamar dole sukeso suyi mashi." "keji beki dan Allah da karam bani ba ruwanki da wadda ta dace da rayuwar shi kibarma wannan maganar kada Abbanvki yaji ki." dan taɓe baki Bahijja tayi sannan suka kama wani labarin ita da Mairo sunajin dadin su, take ta nemi ciwon kan da take fama dashi ta rasa.

〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️

A Masarautar Raifasu kuwa Jakadiya ce a  cikin gidan yari, sai dai ba abinda ya sauya dangane da addinin ta, kullin sai tayi sallolin ta da duk abinda takeyi a boye yanzun kuwa a bayyane takeyin shi hakan ba karamin sosa masu rai yakeyi ba, saidai basu da wani zabi da yawuce su samata ido tunda Sarki Baidulƙais ya hana abugeta ko musguna mata, a wajen Sarki Baidulƙais kuwa tashi yayi ya shirya cikin kayan shi na Sarakai ya doshi dajin Gamki wajen Sarrilƙus dan nemama kanshi masalaha a wajen uban gidan nashi yana shiga uban dajin na Gamki bai ganin komai sai duhu sai dai zaka iya ganin gaban ka yana cikin tafiya a cikin shi yaji wata irin kara a wajen da yake, juyawar da zaiyi yaga wani abu ya tunkaro shi a guje da sauri yai.....

Episode 63&64




yai wani uban tsalle ya koma gefe yana fidda wani uban gumi ga tsoro daya gama addabar rayuwar shi dandanan numfashin shi ya fara daukewa, jiyayi anyi wurgi dashi bisa wani dutsi, yunkurawa yai zai tashi yaga wata bakar guguwa ta tunkaro shi bai kuma sanin inda kanshi yake ba, sai dai ya ganshi gurfane a gaban Sarrilƙus ga wasu irin tafkatafkan macizai da kunamai kamar na karfe tsabar bakin da suke dashi daga gefe kuma ga wata halitta nan rabin kanta na mutun rabi kuma na dabba, sai bindin ta na dabba amman kafarta ta mutunce, a tsorace ya kalli Sarrilƙus wanda ko kyan gani baida shi, yayi bakikkirin da kagan shi kasan  baida digon imani ko kadan, cikin wata muguwar murya wanda duk wanda ya saurareta yasan ba sauki cikin lamarin yace.
"Kai Baidulƙais waya baka ikon shigowa dajin Gamki na fahimci yanzun ka manta matsayin ka a wajen mu ko? yanzun zaka banbance tsakanin aya da tsakuwa." kallan aljani dan tsitu yayi, yace. "Koya mashi hankali."
buga tsalle yayi ya ɗane saman jikin Baidulƙais ya kafa kanshi jikin wuyan shi yafara sha mashi jini shiko cikiniyar anshewa yafara amman ya kasa sai kakkarwa jikin shi keyi, ba abinda ya fado mashi arai sai maganar Jakadiya, sannan ya tuna da Bahijja lokacin da yaji ta fadi wata kalma, daya tambaye ta sai tace ba komai, jikin shi na tsuma ya furta kalmar da yaji Bahijja ta ambata yace. *"A'uzubillahi minasshatanir rajim."* 
da sauri aljani dan tsitu ya fasa uwar kara ya sauka saman Baidulƙais shima Sarrilƙus jiyayi kujerar shi ta gilgiza tsoro da fargaba suka mamaye su cikin kankanin lokaci, cikeda mamaki ya kalli Baidulƙais yace. "A haka kake so mu yafe maka bayan ka bar addinin mu?"
shi kanshi Baidulƙais din mamaki yake dan ya fadi wannan kalmar duk bala'in aljani dan tsitu amman ya gudu, cikin dakewar murya yace.
"Ya kake so inyi bayan na baku hakuri na nemi afuwa agreku kun juyaman baya nazo dan inyi mubaya'a ku maido mani da zoben mulkina amman kunki nema kuke ku kasheni kenan?." wata uwar tsawa Sarrilƙus ya kwaɗama Baidulƙais har wata tarwatsin wuta ke tashi a cikin bakin shi ga idanuwan shi sunkoma tamkar garwashin wuta ba kyan gani yace.
"Yau saina kashe ka tunda harka rage karfin alkadarin tsafina ta hanyar ambatar wannan kalma kasa kwatan duhun dajin nan na Gamki ya rage ka tozartani kaci amana ta ya zama dole yau din nan ka bakunci barzahu." hannu yasa ya nuna macizan nan da sauri suka kaima Baidulƙais wata irin cafka, saida ya tsorata har wani sauti suke fiddawa suna kiran shu shu shu, haka suka biyo shi ga kunamu suna ta halbin iska sai ja yake da baya baya, tunawa yayi sadda suka kama Sarkin Burga na Ƙaisu yaga yanda wa'annan kunamun da macizan sukai mashi raga raga, wani irin tsoro ya sake rufe shi ga wata zufa dake tsattsafo mashi ganin sun kusa kama shi ya rufe idanun shi yana kiran.
 *A'uzubillahi minasshatanir rajim!*" Abinda yake ta fada kenan, wata uwar tsawa Sarrilƙus ya saki macizan suka dinga komawa baya suna bacewa da kunamai, shi ko Sarrilƙus sai gabza ihu yake ganin alkadarin shi na neman lalacewa ya fasa wani irin sauti saiga wani bakin aljani ya baiyana nuna mashi Baidulƙais yayi wanda zuwa yanzun idanun shi abude yake yana ganin abin mamaki yanda suke ihu duk sun fita cikin hayyacin su, wata bakar guguwa ce ta figeshi gani yai anyi wurgi dashi cikin cibjin yayi kusa da dokin shi cikin tashin hankali wannan aljani yace.
"Kul karka sake shigowa wannan dajin mun barrantaka a cikin mu, inba hakaba zamu halaka, huhhhhhahh!" ya bace shima a sanyaye ya hau bisa dokin shi ya nufi hanyar Masarautar shi yana mamakin yanda a da baijin tsoro ko shakkar dajin Gamki amman yanzun ya razana ko dan baida zoben Sarrilƙus a hannun shine ashe haka mutane keji idan suka shiga cikin dajin Gamki? da wannan tambayar ya kama hanyar komawa Masarautar Raifasu cikeda al'ajabi mai tarin yawa a cikin zuciyar shi.

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

Cikin Daborah kuwa Yarima Malik ne wajen mahaifin shi suna tattaunawa yana mashi tambayoyi cewa yayi.
"Malik yaka mata ka fidda matar aure kamar yanda muke bukata ka tsaya ka fidda wadda kasan kana so, ɗana kada ka bari lokaci ya kure maka, inkana ganin baka iya fada mana wadda kake so ka sanarma Huzaifa mana." sadda kanshi MalikusSaif yayi yana saka abubuwa a cikin ranshi cikin girmamawa yace.
"Abbuh inaji kamar akwai abinda ke bibiyata dan ina narasa sukuni lokacin da wani abu mai mahimmanci ke tare dani sai insamu kaina cikin fargaba da yai nisa dani kuma Abbuh sai inji ina tausayi da kewar abun sai dai har yanzun zuciya ta tana karyata hakan duba da rashin kima ko darajar abin a idanun mutane masu daraja, saidai Abbuh kullin ina nafilfili ina mikama Allah kukana yaimani zabi da mafita akan wannan al'amarin wanda wasu kema wata fassarar ta daban."

Murmushin manya Saifilislam yayi yana maijin dadin abinda ɗan nashi ya fada duk da shima yana fargabar al'amarin cikin kulawa yace.
"ɗana Malik ka rufe sirrin zuciyar ka gudun matsala duk da har yanzun bakasan matsayin lamarin nan a cikin zuciyar kaba, saidai mubarma ikon Allah komai, namu addu'a saidai duk da haka ka duba mata a cikin jama'ar mu na daga yan uwa abokan arziki da saran su." "toh Abbuh insha Allah, saidai Matawalle yasake yimin maganar da kanshi ni kuma ina jin nauyin Matawalle."
"Karka damu Yusuf baida matsala, kuma zai zama jigonka a cikin al'amarin ka yana da saukin hali karka damu, saidai duk abinda zakayi ka duba yanayin mahaifiyar ka, ka kara yimata biyayya." rausayar da kanshi yayi yace. "Toh Abbuh nagode." itako Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tunda suke maganar tanajin su a yanzun ne takaraso da sallamar ta saidai tana mamakin al'amarin da ɗan nata yake boyewa ko kuma shige mashi duhu da yake ikirarin yayi a nutse tace. "Ɗana karabi da zuwa sashena ko lfy?" "bakomai Ummu zancen Matawalle ne ya shamin kai." murmushi tayi cikeda jin dadi tace. "Yaka mata ai kasan yaya, na son yaga kayi auren nan, shiyasa."
shima murmushin karfin hali yayi yace "insha Allah ina kokari." da haka kowa yai shiru na sakanni, nan MalikusSaif yaima iyayen nashi sallam ya fita cikin nutsuwa yake tafiya 

〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️

Koda Baidulƙais ya koma gida direct kewaye ya shiga yayi wanka ya dawo yarasa abin yi ga wani zazzabi da yagama rufe shi lokaci kalilan cikin ranshi ko yana mamakin addinin su Bahijja gaskia akwai abu mai girman gaske a cikin wannan addini, mikewa yayi ya tuna da maganar Jakadiya tai mashi da sauri ya saka riga fitowa yayi ya kalli mai kula da shige da ficen shi yace. "Zanje gidan yari yanzun nan."
take mashi baya yayi shida wasu dogarawa suka nufi cikin yarin Masarautar Raifasu.

suna isa cikin gidan Yari mai kula da gidan Yarin ne ya rugo da gudu, ya tari Sarki Baidulƙais kujera ya kawo ya aje mashi yana mashi sannu da zuwa, Sarkin Zagi ne ya fara koda Sarki Baidulƙais, yana cewa. "Gyara zaki, gyara zinki ranka shidade Sarkin Raifasu barka da zuwa gidan Yari mai tarin tarihi, gurfanai ya taimakeka."
wani mugun kallo ya bankama Sarkin Zagi cikin dakewa yace a fiddo mashi da Jakadiya, koda aka fiddo da Jakadiya wani irin dadi taji ya kama ta, dukawa tayi a gaban Sarki Baidulƙais tace. "Ranka shidade barka da zuwa Jamra na gaisuwa." gyada kai yayi cikin kulawa yace "Jamra ina neman afuwarki akan abinda naimaki tabbas Jamra na tabbata kece kadai wadda zata kawo mani haske a cikin rayuwata sanadiyar Bahijja, anyi walkiya naga haske Jamra kowa ya gujeni harta Sarrilƙus, ya juyaman baya Jamra ina cikin tashin hankali marar misaltuwa."
cikin jin dadi da samun cikakkiyar kwarin guiwa tace. "Tabbas Bahijja tayi gaskia addinin musulunci addinine na gaskia kuma yana tareda nasarori iri iri tabbas naji dadi da Allah ya tashi daukaka addinin shi sai yafara ta wajen ka, a matsayin ka na shugaba, kasani daman tsakanin gaskia da karya akwai shamaki mai karfi da nisa mai yawa kamar yanda gabas da yamma sukeda nisa da juna ta yanda bazasu taɓa hadewa ba to hakan take ya shugaba na." murmushi yayi yace. "Hakane Jamra gaskia naga banbancin dake tsakanin gaskia da karya a lokacin da naje dajin Gamki, boka Sarrilƙus yana son ya kashe ni amman dana fadi wata kalma da naji Bahijja ta fada lokacin da takawo mani abinci nima nayita lokacin ina cikin tashin hankali, ba wata kalma bace face, *A'uzubillahi minasshatanir rajim!* tabbas naga alfanun wannan kalma ta ceceni Jamra, dan haka na barranta akan abinda muke bautamawa aikin banzane Jamra nayi imani da ubangijin dakike bauta mawa Jamra."
duk wadan da ke wajen kallan juna suka dingayi sunaji Sarkin su na wani yare ko kuma ince kurman yare a wajen su, sannan Jakadiya tace. "Tabbas ya shugaba na, kalmar da kafada ba karamar kalma bace domin Bahijja ta fada mani ma'anarta tana nufin ina neman tsarin Allah daga shaidan la'ananne abin korarwa." cikin gamsuwa yace. "Gashi ta zama hijaba a tsakanina da shaidanun da suka baibayeni Jamra naji dadi da gaskia ta bayyana a cikin wannan Masarautar tawa ta Raifasu, dan haka Jamra ki sakani cikin wannan addinin naki." wani irin sanyi Jamra taji da dadi cikin sakin fuska tace duk abinda na fada kaima kafada ya shugaba na, tace kace. 


 _*Asshahadu alla ilaha'ilallahu, wa'ashhadu anna Muhammadur rasulillahi."*_
 tana fada Baidulƙais yana furtawa hakama makarraban da suka rako shi suma suna furta wannan kalma harda Sarkin gidan yari wani irin dadi Sarki Baidulƙais yaji ganin mabiyan shi basu mashi bore ba akan abinda yake tafe dashi, itako Jamra wani irin dadine ya baibaye ta cikin kulawa tace. "Wannan kalma tana nufin na shaida babu abin bautawa da gaskia sai Allah kuma annabi Muhammadu bawan Allah ne kuma manzon sane."
Sarkin Zagi ne yace. "Jakadiya waye *Annabi* *Muhammadu* kuma?" murmushi Jamra tayi tace. *"Annabi Muhammadu* mutun ne kamar kowa sai dai yafi kowa daraja domin duk abinda muke samu na rayuwa albarkacin shi mukeci, Allah ya aiko shi da wannan addinin na musulunci domin ya zama rahama ga talikai, ma'ana mu bayin Allah, *Annabi Muhammadu* ya horemu damu bautama Allah shi kadai kada muhada shi da wani a wajen bauta, sannan *Annabi Muhammadu* yazo mana da haske kuma waraka baiyanan na yazo mana da littafin gaskia wato *Alqur'ani* sannan  a cikin sa ko wane waraka yake, a cikin sane aka sanar damu yanda zamu bautama ubangijin mu *Allah SWT* wanda ya halicce ni ya halicce ku da sammai da kassai da komai da kuke gani, sannan ya wallafa mana sallah shine abinda zamu dingayi wajen bauta masa, wannan kuma ta hanyar *Annabi* *Muhammadu* ya iso zuwa garemu, shine manzon da babu wani bayan shi sai dai kafin shi anyi mazon ni, suma akan abu ɗaya suke magana shine bautama Allah shi daya kada ahada shi da wani a wajen bauta, saidai idan mutun ya yarda da *Allah* amma bai yarda da *Annabi Muhammadu* ba ko kuma ya yarda da *Annabi* *Muhammadu* bai yarda *Allah* tabbas imanin mutun bai cika ba,kuma bai cikin musulmai da musulunci sai kayarda da dukkan su da sauran annabawa da kuma mala'ikun sa, wannan shine cikar *IMANI* da shiga cikin addinin musulunci, kaji waye *Annabi Muhammadu*, farin jakkada farin wata sha kallo mai haskake duniya da abinda ke cikin ta." baki ɗayan su suka saki wani irin sanyayyen numfashi, Sarki Baidulƙais ne yace......

Episode 65&66




"Lallai Jamra wannan addini akwai abubuwan al'ajabi a cikin shi ke duk ina kikaji wannan abubuwan?" dariya tayi mai dan sauti tace. "Wajen Bahijja duk anan naji komai danma yarinya ce batai zurfi ba wajen sanin addinin nata da hukunce hukuncan sa saidai akwai wasu bayi daka rufe a cikin wannan gidan yarin su Tasi'u tabbas sunayin addinin su duk da kasancewar suna karkashin daular wannan Masarautar saidai sun barranta da abinda muke bautamawa, sunayin addinin su a sirrince kamar yanda wasu daga cikin bayinmu suma suka anshi wannan addinin cikin sirri, inaga kaimasu hakuri a fiddo su, sucigaba da koyar damu wannan addinin dan musamu haske mai tarin yawa da waraka a cikin al'amuran mu." dan nazari Sarki Baidulƙais yayi yace. "Tabbas Jamra kingani kuwa harna manta da rayuwar bayin Allahn nan ancutar dasu, saidai mun nemi afuwar su, Sarkin Yari a fiddo mani yaran nan." da toh ya amsa ya tafi, sannan Jakadiya tace. "Ya shugaba na zanso insanar dakai saban sunana da na dade ina sirrintawa." murmushi yayi yace. "Jamra kenan aikece shugaba a wannan fannin, sannan harkina da wani suna da kika boye sama da shekaru arba'in ban sanki dashi ba?" cewa tayi ai sunan bai dadeba saida na shiga wannan addinin mai haske sannan na samu wannan suna." "inajinki wane sunane wannan tace. "Sunana Aisha shine sunan dana ansa lokacin da Bahijja ta lakana mani addinin ta." murmushi Baidulƙais yayi yace. "Sunan kuwa da dadi yake Jamra daga yau zamuna kiran ki hakan." cikin jin dadi tace. "Godiya nike ya shugaba na." cikin zolaya yace. "Nifa dami zaki dinga kirana?" murmushi tayi ta lissafa mashi sunayen musulmai tace. " a cikin su zaka zabi wanda yai maka ya shugana." murmushin ya sake yimta yace. "Na zabi suna nai daraja na farin jakada Annabi Muhammadu." Jakadiya ce ta ida da (SAW) sannan tace."yana daya daga cikin ladabin kiran sunan shi, ku ida sa Sallahu alaihi wasallam, kamar yanda ya fadakar Allah zai aminta da mutun sannan ya saka albarka a cikin lamarin mutun." kowa ya zabi sunan da yake so inda Sarkin zagi yace, Aliyu galadima yace Abubakar, Sarkin yari yace Umar, Sarkin fada yace Usman, sai dogarawan Sarki wani yace Abdullahi, wani yace Ahmad da haka suka gama zabar sunaye masu daraja da kima a duniyar musulunci, koda Sarkin yari ya dawo dasu Tasi'u haka Sarki Baidulƙais ko ince Sarki Muhammad a halin yanzun yasa aka kaisu cikin sashen shi wani bangare anaci gaba da basu kulawa ta musamman, wannan kenan




Bayan wata biyu a Masarautar Daborah kuwa tsakanin Bahijja da MalikusSaif bakaramin shakuwa bace ta kara shiga tsakanin su, saidai duk da hakan Malik na ganin tausayin tane ke dawainiya dashi da zallar son da ɗan uwa kema   yar uwar sa, wanda hakan yasa Huzaifa yai bin kwakwaf amman Malik yace sam ba sonta yake ba, hakan yasa ya bullo da wata hanya ta kula Bahijja a matsayin masoyiyar shi, shiko Matawalle yayi wata tafiya kuma akalla zaiyi wata ukku shiyasa yabar zancen maganar zabama Malik matar aure, sabida tafiyar gaggawa ne da yayita ta yan kasuwa a kasar Togo, a wajen gimbiya Zahara'u kuwa harta gaza ta gayama mahaifin Malik tana son shi hakan yasa ya fadama Sarauniya Zulaiƙa itama tayi amanna sa hakan saida Saifulislam ne yace, abarshi yai zabin kanshi saidai inya amince da gimbiya Zahara'un shikenan, cigaba da shigema Yarima Malik tayi tana bibiyar al'amuran sa

Bayan sati biyu, Bahijja ce a sashen MalikusSaif tunda gari ya waye taga yanata shiri sannan yana cikin annashuwa duk da tana shakkar Yarima Malik saidai akwai kyakkyawar alaka a tsakanin su, cewa tayi. "Ya Malik ko unguwa zakaje ne naga janata shiri mike faruwa ne.?" murmushi yayi yace. "Kanwata kenan ba inda zanje yau ranace wadda bazan taɓa mantawa dda ita ba." cikeda zakuwa tace. "Allah ya taimaki shugaba na wannan wace irin rana ce.?" murmushi yayi yace. "Yakamata ki ajeni a matsayi daya Bahijja ko yayanki ko kuma uban gidan ki, ciki wane yayi maki?" wani dadi taji a kunyace ta rufe idanun ta sannan cikin sirriyar muryar ta tace. "Yayana ne kai a haka zanci gaba da yimaka kallo Ya Malik." wani iri dadi yaji ya rasa yanda akai yake shiga wannan yanayin na farin ciki inyana tareda Bahijja cewa yayi. "Hakan yayi kanwata saidai kinsan ko wace irin ranace wannan." girgiza kanta tayi sannan tace. "Aaaa Yaya na sai kafaɗa mani." cikin jin dadi yace. "Rufe idanunki." murmushi tayi tana fiddo idanun ta waje masu saka Malik nutsuwa ya rufe, shiko ɗauko wata leda yayi ya bude ya fiddo wata sarka da jawhar da lu'u lu'u da yan kunne yace miko hannun ki." budesu tayi duk da tana baiwa amman hannun ta gwanin ban shi'awa daura mata sarkai yayi yace. "Toh kanwata bude." budewa tayi ta zuba ma hannun ta idanun ta tana mai ware idanin ta tace. "Masha Allah Yayana sunyi kyau katuka saidai mizanyi da wannan.?" murmushin ya sakeyi yace. "Nakine knwata, ina tayaki murnar shekarar zagayowar haihuwar ki Bahijja.!" sake fiddo idanun ta tayi tace. "Ya Malik daman irin wannan ranar ce aka haifeni?" gyada mata kai yay yace. "Kwarai kuwa kanwata irin wannan ranar ce na samu yar uwa kuma kanwata Bahijja yau gashi kanwata ta girma harta kai shekara sha biyar aduniya kinga dole infi kowa murna da kiyaye wannan rana wajn lissafawa kanwata inai mai murna Allah yakaro shekaru masu albarka." da ameen ta amsa sannan tace. " Yayana wannan sarkai ta girmi darajar baiwa taya zansaka wannan bayan daraja ta bata kai nan ba." hade fuska yayi yace. "Ke mai daraja ce Bahijja mutane ke maki kallan baiwa, saidai ni yar uwa kuma kanwa ta na daukeki dan haka daga kar insake jin kalmar marar daraja abakinki ke mai darajace kanwata kuma kinfi karfin komai a wajena ki aje sarkar ki wata rana zatai maki anfani" cikin jin dadi tace. "Shikenan Yayana nagode Allah yabarmin kai, amman fa kaimani wayo." hmmm yace cikin kulawa yace. "Kamar ya nai maki wayo.?" "ehmana kasan shakaruna amman ni bansan naka ba." takarsa maganar a shagwabe, samun kanshi yayi da murmusawa sannan yace. "Kwarai kuwa naima wata yarinya wayau, saidai ki canka da kanki shakarata nawa?" diddira kafar ta fara sannan tace. "Shekarka ishirin da shidda." makale kafada yai alamin aaa, ta sake cewa da bakwai sake dage kafada tayi, naji da takwas Yayana."murmushi yayi sannan yace. "Baki canka ba kanwata shakaran Yayanki talatin a duniya, Zaro ido tayi tace. "Shekara sha biyar fa kabani." murmusawa yayi yace. "Natsufa ko?" girgiza kai tayi, zatayi magana kenan saiga Huzaifa ya shigo hakan yasa tai shiru tabar wajen ta koma baban falo wani irin kallo yake masu sannan suka zauna saman kujera suna fuskantar junan su, Huzaifa ne yace. "Yarima baka ganin abinda nike fada maka akan wannan yarinyar anya ba sonta kake ba, kafito fili kafadamani dan musan minene mafita." wani bahagon kallo Malik ya aikama Huzaifa a dakile/yace. "Nataɓa boyemaka wani abu? da ace son Bahijja nike tabbas zan sanar dakai, kuma kasan matsayin yarinyar nan." dariya yayi marar sauti sannan yace. "Shikenan daman ina tsoron kada inyi abun kunya tunda ba abinda ke tsakaninka da Bahijja a gaskia ina sonta kuma auren ta zanyi." wani irin daram daram MalikusSaif yaji dan da nan zuciyar shi ta sauya condition tana bugawa da sauri sauri, zuface ta keto mashi, shiko Huzaifa a dage yake kallan Malik yakai sakan talatin yakasa furta ko kalma daya karfin hali yayi yace. "So fa kace?" "Kwarai kuwa." kana ganin Abba zai lamunce, cewar Malik.  "Mizai hana zan yan tata ne, karfa kamanta kasha fadar wannan kalmar ta Bayima 'Yayane." samun kanshi yayi da sarawa da sauri ya dafe goshin shi, cikin jin haushin maganar Huzaifa yace. "Shikenan yanzun ina bukatar hutu anjima mun hadu." cewa yayi. "Haba Yayan Bahijja kodai bazaka bani kanwar taka ba?" murmushin karfin hali yayi yace. "Kafiye surutu Huzaifa zan shiga ciki banjin dadi ne." yana gama fadar haka yai ciki shiko Huzaifa dariar mugun ta yayi a ranshi ko cewa yayi yanzun wasan zai fara.... 


 *Toh fa komai Huzaifa ke shirin aikatawa muje zuwa my real fans, inajin dadin sakon ninku fa🥰*


Bayan kwana bakwai, a cikin Masarautar Raifasu abubuwa sun kankama su Tasi'u zuwa yanzun sun dawo cikin hayyacin su har Sarki Muhammad ya yanta su, wanda yayi hakan ne dan yaye masu bakin cikin da suke ciki a cewar shi an cutar da rayuwar su akan abinda basuji ba basu gani ba, yau kam kusan mutun sama araba'in suka amsji addinin islama, saidai duk wannan abin gimbiya Yazira taki tayima mijin nata mubaya'a tana adawa dashi hakan yasa ya fita shirgin ta ya cigaba da rayuwar shi cikin tsafta dan a halin yanzun yafara mantawa da wata rayuwar tsafi da sukayi da Sarrilƙus sannan duk ya kone kayan tsafin su, kuma zuwa yanzun su Tasi'u suke basu ilimi na addinin musulinci tundaga sallah da hukun hukuncen ta hakama azumi, da zakka da dai sauran su, a hankali suke basu hukunce hukunce kasancewar su bakine a cikin addinin, zuwa yanzun bakaramim mutunta Jakadiya Sarki Muhammad keyi ba acewar shi tazama abun koyi a garesu, wannan kenan


A wajen Huzaifa kuwa yana lambu yasa aka kira mashi Bahijja tana zuwa ta gaidashi cikin kulawa yace. "Bahijja niko inasan intambayeki wani abu.?" fuska a sake tace. "Inajinka ranka shidade." rausayar da kanshi yayi sannan yace. "Yama sunan wannan saurayin naki?" da sauri Bahijja ta kalle shi cikin inkina tace. "Aibanda wani saurayi ranka shidade." "aaa Bahijja miyasa waya hanaki?kodai Malik ne?" girgiza kanta tayi cikin ladabi tace. "Aaa Abba nane, kuma ina baiwa ina kula samari." dai dai nan da Yazid da Lurwan sai Yarima Malik sun shigo cikin tafkeken lambun nasu dan shakatawa suka hangi Huzaifa, Yazid ne yace. "Jibi Huzaifa sai dariya yake da alama soyayya yakeyi nifa ina zargin shi kamar ya fada cikin tarkon so?" wani mummunan faduwar gaba ta riski MalikusSaif har saida ya dafe kirjin shi, ji yayi kamar ya juya ya koma dan baiji zai juri ganin Bahijja da Huzaifa a wannan yanayin, cikin kula Yazid yace. "Yadai Yarima naga ka dafe kirji ko baka lafiya ne?" girgiza kanshi yayi alamun aaa, shiko Huzaifa da tun shigowar su ya gansu yana sane ya fadada dariyar shi irin wanda duniya taima dadin nan, itama Bahijja jin maganar da Huzaifa yai mata yasata yin murmushi mai dan sauti, lokacin su Yarima Malik sun iso cikin fara'a Huzaifa yace.....

Yau ina mai bakin cikin ganin wani bisa mata ta kuma bafade na yana zina da matata da idanuna na gan su, yanzun nasan abinda na shukane nike girba na lalata 'yayan mutane da dama wanda bazan iya tunawa ba, hakama ɗana ya ketama yara haddi, yau ga wani da matata, ni kadai nasan yanda nikeji a cikin zuciya ta, tabbas Bahijja haske ce a garemu baki daya,mun godema Allah daya ƙaddara zaman ta a tare damu, akanta na daina bin matan banza sai ita kadai nike kwaɗai tuwa da ita, wanda ubangijin ta Sarki gagara misali ya dinga kubutar da ita daga kaidina, Aisha ta yaya zan tuba akan wannan dauɗar dana tara a jiki na?" ya karashe maganar fa raunanniyar murya cike da nadama.

dan karamin tsaki yayi ji yayi anturo kofar dakin nashi, da kallo yabi kofar bakin ta dauke da sallama, a cikin zuciya ya amsa ta dan laɓɓan sane kawai suka motsa kaɗan tana zuwa gaban shi ta zube bisa guiwowin ta tace.

"Ya Malik dan Allah minai maka kake mani haka, kayi hakuri banjin dadin yanda kake bata ranka a kaina, karfa kaman ta  kai ne ɗan uwana kuma kace in rikeka a matsayin yaya na majibincin lamari na amman kasauya mani dan Allah idan akwai abinda nike maka wanda bakaso ka yafemani ka gaya mani wlh ko minene zan daina, ina cikin mawuyacin hali."
wata irin tsawa ya daka mata yace.

"Ya Ma..lik... zan mutuhh." ararrabe tayi maganar kuma tana jan kalmomin karshe, ganin Bahijja kasa tana birgima ba karamin tsora ta MalikusSaif yayi ba, da sauri yai kanta ya dagota cikin tashin hankalin da ba'asa mashi rana yace......

"Kitashi Bahijja dan Allah karda ki tafi ki barni sannu Bahijja ta!, mikikaci yai maki illa kanwata."? 
baki ɗaya jikin Bahijja yai sanyi numfashin ta ne yafara daukewa idanun ta na kakkafewa, baƙin cikin idanun tane suka juye ɗib baka ganin alamar su, zuciyar ta kuwa ta daina halbawa, a ruɗe MalikusSaif yasa hannun shi bisa hancin ta yaji bata numfashi, agigice ya girgiza ta da karfi yace.

"Samo mani ruwa Bahijja ta zata mutu dan Allah  kitai makamin wlh ina sonta ki taimaki rayuwar Bahijja!"
tsoro ne yaka ma Jakadiya ganin yanda Yarima Malik ke kwalla wanda baima san suna zubowa ba a cikin idon shi, da gudu ta dauko ruwa tafara yayyafa ma Bahijja shi kuma wani mafeci ne ya dauko yana fiffita mata, tun lokacin da Jakadiya ta shigo cikin falon Huzaifa da Yazid suka shigo jin kalaman da Malik ke furtawa yasa sukayi cirko cirko suna kallan ikon Allah, anshe ruwan da Jakadiya ta dauko yayi bai san sadda ya sharama Bahijja shi ba,  wata irin ajiyar zuciya ta sauke, tana kuka a hankali maicin zuciya, shiko a kidime ya dinga cewa.

ya ida maganar da raunanniyar zuciya. 
ita ko bishi bishi take kallan MalikusSaif, maganganun shi sama sama take jinsu, suko su Huzaifa kallon junan su sukayi sannan sukayi ma juna  murmushi shida Yazid, sai lokacin suka iso wajen suka tsaya, ganin Bahijja na neman sake rufe idanun ta, cikeda tsoro ga tarin fargaba daua addabi Yarima Malik da sauri ya ɗago ta, ya sake kwantar da ita kasa, Jakadiya ce tace.
"Yarima ka daina damuwa aita samu sauki tunda komai ya dai dai ta."
a rude ya kalli Jakadiya idan shi duk sun rine sunyi kamar gar washi yace.

"tasamu sauki Yarima kaje ka gyara jikin ka." mamaki ne ya kama MalikusSaif daya kafe Huzaifa da kallon tuhuma, a ranshi ko cewa yayai kamar ya  in gyara jikin na?, kallan Jakadiyar su yayi ganin ya jinjin mashi sannan tace.

Washe gari da safe ya kama Juma'atu babbar ran, ranar da kowa ne musulmi yake ta shirin tafiya masallaci dakin Allah, a cikin Masarautar Raifasu ma Sarki Muhammad ne ya fito wanka da alama harda wankan tsarki yayi na juma'a dan zuwa yanzun komai ansar masu hatta wankan tsarki an koya masu shi mazansu da matan su, kuma kowa saida yayi na shiga addinin musulunci hakan yasa Sarki Muhammad ya shirya cikin fararen kayan shi sai kamshi yake bazawa, ya kama hanyar tafiya masallaci shida jama'ar shi.

Koda sukaje Masallaci Tasi'u ne ke huɗuba, saboda Allah yaima Tasi'u tarin ilimin addini ko a Daborah yana cikin limamai masu jan salla a babban Masallacin na Daborah, haka ya dinga huɗuba kan ridda da hukunci wanda yayi ta, hikimar yin wannan hudubar kuwa saboda yasa zukatan mutanen da suka musulun ta su kara rike addinin su da mahimmanci su manta da addinin da suka gada kaka da kakanni da haka aka kabbara Sallah Sarki Muhammad ne a sahun gaba da sauran tawagar shi, danko kafaɗa da kafaɗa yake da wani bawa, wanda in ahanya ne ko cewa akai yabi hanyar da Sarki Muhammad yabi ada bazai iya ba saboda kaskancin wannan bawan amman da yake shi addinin musulunci ba ruwan shi da Sarki ko gwamna ko shugaban kasa ko talaka da attajiri ko kuma wani mai yanci ko bawa duk daya suke wajen wahidir ƙahar Sarki buwayi gagara misali, haka suka cakuɗe a cikin Masallacin nan domin ganawa d ubangijin talikai, suna gamawa Sarki Muhammad ya mikama wannan bawan kusa dashi hannu sukayi musabaha sannan ya mika Sarkin fada dake gafen haggun shi hannu suka sakeyin musaba kowa ya tafi gida cikin aminci. 


 ```Allah Sarki rayuwa haka addinin musulunci yake addini mai karamci baida kyama ko nuna fifiko akan wani cikin dan Adam sai dai wanda yafi wani tsoron Allah shine yafi dan uwan sa, addinin musulunci addini ne na zaman lafiya da numana ga riko amana musulmai basu kansance maciya amana ba ko ta'addanci, saboda addinin ya horemu da zaman lafiya da yan uwan mu, harma  da sauran mabiyan addinai saboda farin jakada Annabi Muhammad (SAW) yace,mu zauna dasu karmu cutar dasu, da haka kadai duniya ta tabbatar da cewa addinin Musulunci addinine mai aminci kuma na gaskia, Allah yasa mudace🙏```


Koda Sarki Muhammad ya koma, fa'da ya wuce anata fadanci, basu san hawa ba basu sauka ba kawai sukaji saukar mashi ya kafe ta gefen kan Sarki Muhammad dake saman kujerar shi ta mulki bakaramin tsorata sukayi ba, haka magatakarda Usman ya 
zare takardar da aka halbo sannan Sarki ya bada ikon karanta wannan wasikar kamar haka. 


 _Tabbas kafadi jarabawar mu Baidulƙais yau kaine kaima makiyan mu mubaya'a ka anshi addinin su sannan ka kone kayan tsafin mu tabbas ka tsammaci gamuwa dani bada jimawa ba maci amana Sarrilƙus ke magana, hhhhuuhhh!!."_


Kallan yan fa'dar shi yayi yace.
"Sakarai dashi marar imani mun riga da munce Allah kuma insha Allah mune da nasara, limamin fada yasa yayi musu addu'a kowa ya tashi, kiran Tasi'u yayi yace ya same shi sashen shi wanda yanzun ya kasance babba a cikin Masarautar Raifasu, har Sarkin malaman Raifasu ya naɗa Tasi'u cikin girmamawa yace. "Angama ranka shidade Allah yataimake ka." wani irin dadi yaji da yaji ance Allah yataimake ka inda dane saidai a hada da wani katan icce wanda tuni yasa aka kone shi, kuma bai tsinana ma kanshi komai, lallai kam ya tabbata sunyi shirme yanzun suke akan addinin gaskia, shi yasa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa suka dinga cinsu nasara a wajen yaki a she riko sukayi da igiya mai karfin gaske tunda Tasi'u yace Allah yataimake shi sai yanemi damuwar shi ya rasa gaba daya haka ya koma cikin sashen zuciyar fas da ita.

**********************************

Masarautar Waisu koda Sarki Haishir ya koma gida ba karamin ta'ajjabi ya shiga ba ganin Sarki Baidulƙais ya amshi addinin musulunci duk yanda yake tsanar shi yau gashi ya karbi addinin musulunci gaskia ya zama dole su dakilar da Sarki Baidulƙais tunda wuri tunkan daular musulunci tai karfi a cikin Masarautar Raifasu, da haka yaita sake sake sannan ya kira Sarkin Yaki yace. "Akashe sati biyu ana hada gangamin Yaki dan darkake Sarki Baidulƙais da tawagar shi baki dayan ta
〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️

Bayan kwana bakwai, Bahijja ce takoma bakin aikin ta kamar yanda tasaba, yau dinma ba wani aikine zatayi ba, sai yan goge gogen da ba arasa ba, tana cikin goge center table Saifulislam ya shigo shida Jakadiyar shi dukawa tayi ta gaida su cikin kulawa suka amsa ta, Jakadiya ce ta tambaye ta karfin jikin ta, a kunyace tace da sauki, dan bakaramin kunyar su da nauyi su takeji ba, hatta Malik wasan boya take da shi duk da yasan kunyar shi takeji sai dai yace kunya mirinɗa bazaiso ta takura kanta ba, Jakadiya ce taima MalikusSaif magana, ba da daɗewa ba ya fito sai farin ciki yakeyi rungume mahaifin nashi yayi suka gaisa cikin so da kauna, Bahijja ce taba su waje dan ganawa da junan su, saidai taki yarda su hada ido da Yarima Malik din, haka ta fita waje dan mike kafarta, Saifulislam ne ya kalli MalikusSaif cikin kulawa yace. "Yarima nafahimci kafara maida iyayen ka abokan wasan ka, ko?" cikin nutsuwa yace. "Abbuh kayi hakuri zaka sameni mai maku biyayya zan fidda."
"daka ta Yarima bawai fiddawar ka muke buka ta ba bansan karamar magana dan haka nan da kwana ukku kafin Matawalle  ya dawo ka tabbata kasan abinyi ina fatan ka fahimta."
"toh Abbuh insha Allah bazan baka kunya ba." "Allah yaimaka albarka, ina Bahijjar ta tafi ne?" sunkuyar da kanshi yayi yace. "Inaga tafita da kashigo." "shikenan bari inje inada bakin da zan gani."
"sai anjima." haka suka tafi. 
itako Bahijja tana ta yawan ta taji wata baiwa  tace mata gimbiya Zahara'u na kiran ta, batace komai ba ta maye mata baya suka tafi sai dai ta rasa dalilin da yasa gimbiya Zahara'u zata kirata, suna isa ta isketa kishin giɗe bisa wata kujera sai cika take tana batsawa wani matsiyacin kallo ne ta watsama Bahijja dukawa tayi ta gaida ta, karkada kafarta tayi cikin gadara gimbiya Zahara'u tace.


"Ke baiwa wai mike tsakanin ki da Yarima na?" da sauri Bahijja ta kalleta tace. "Bangane ba wakenan?" tagama maganar tana watsama ta wani mugun kallo wanda batama san tanayin shi ba, bakaramin baci ran gimbiya Zahara'u yayi ba ganin wulakantaccen kallan da Bahijja ke aika mata amatsayin ta na baiwa, rai bace ta mike ta wanke Bahijja da gigitaccen mari cikin fushi tace. "Ke harkin isa kicemani baki gane ba, Yariman ne zakice baki gane ba kin gane mani matsiyaciyar yarinya." batace mata komai ba dan takaici sai dai dafe kuncin ta da tayi, cikin isa tace. "Badake nikeba.?" a dakile Bahijja tace. "Bansan inda yake ba nima." cikin bacin rai takira wata baiwar ta tasa ta dukan Bahijja, haka taita zab gama mata bulala itako cewa tayi batasan inda yake, jin bugun yafara wuce gona da iri yasa Bahijja rike bulalar da baiwar ke dukan ta ita tace.

cikin kuka tace. "Haba Umma, taya zan samu sukuni, ace yarinyar nan tagayaman magana, itafa baiwa ce inda bai son ta, harta isa ta gaya mani wannan maganar Umma? Kinjifa abinda Ya Huzaifa yake cewa." wani irin bakin cikine yakara turnike ta, tace. "Kibar wannan kukan kada kisama kanki damuwa, yau zanje insamu mahaifiyar shi." haka taitaba gimbiya Zahara'u hakuri.

"Am ina daga waje, ba guduwa naiba." "shikenan tunda haka kika fada." komawa yayi saman kujera ya zauna ita kuma ta tafi kitchen dan kawo mashi abinci.

"Aisha ya kike ganin zamuyi da wannan matsalar dan gaskia abin nan yana damu na." dan murmushi tayi cikin kulawa tace. "Hakane Aisha, gaskia saidai duk da haka sai munkara duba lamarin nan." 

Sallamar da Tasi'u da yayi ce ta katse masu maganar su, samun waje yayi ya zauna ya gaishe su cikeda girmamawa, Sarki Muhammad ne yace. "Tasi'u kaji abinda ya faru yanzun minene masalaha a cikin wannan lamarin.?"


"Eh hakane ya shugaba na saidai akwai wata masalaha da nike ganin zata fishemu." cikin zumudi Sarki Muhammad yace "wace masalaha ce wannan.?" "zamu rubuta wasika zuwa ga Kadimulislam munasar mashi mun karbi addinin islama sannan muna fuskantar barazana daga wajajen abokan gaba, ya sama mana mafita, a kalkashin wannan addinin da muke ciki mai tarin alfarma sai  dai kada mu sake sakon namu ya sauka ta hannun wani ba ta Saifulislam ba."

"Damu fa kace.?" "kwarai kuwa musamman ma kai, kaga wannan Masarautar taku ce kamar gidane zaka koma, dan haka idan kukaje ba za'asamu matsalar komai takardar mu zataje hannun Saifulislam ba tareda ansamu miskila ba, ke kuma Aisha, za'aje da kene dan ki kara yima Saifulislam gamsasshen bayanin da zai fahimta dan susan muma mun tuba mun zama 'yan tattu  kuma 'yaya garesu." 


Baki dayan su sun gamsu da zancen shugaban nasu, haka suka yanke shawara sati mai kamawa zasu tafi Masarautar Daborah, wanda Tasi'u kejin dadi zaiga dangin shi daya kwashe sama da shekaru goma bai kara ganin suba

A Masarautar Daborah kuwa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce da gimbiya Salsabila ta kwashe komai ta gaya mata abinda ke faruwa tsakanin Bahijja da Yarima Malik da badakalar da ta wakana tsakanin  Bahijja da gimbiya Zahara'u, wata uwar zuface ke dawainiya da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa harbata ganin gaban ta zuciyar ke duka da sauri da sauri jirine ya dibeta da sauri gimbiya Salsabila ta tarota jikin ta, daidai nan Saifulislam ya shigo sashen da sauri ya iso ganin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa a sume, ruwa suka dinga shafa mata, wani irin numfashi ne tadawo dashi mai rikitarwa sannan ta fashe da wani irin malalacin kuka, shi kanshi Saifulislam ya tsora ta dan ba karamin abu bane kesaka Zulaiƙa kwalla ba a tsorace yace. "Umman Huzaifa miya samu Ummu Malik.?" kame kame tafara a darare tace. "tasamu labarin Yarima Malik na soyayya da Bahijja kuma....."kuma me? Ke waya gayamaki? Kin tabbatar.?" duk lokaci guda yake jeromata wannan tambayar saidai takasa bashi amsa tsabar kwarjini da yake mata,ganin kallan tsanr dayake watsa mata ba shiri ta bar wajen ta tafi gida a kunyace, tallabo Zulaiƙa yayi wanda takasa furta ko uffan saidai kwallan dake dawainiya da ita, tana girgiza kai alamun Aaa, saman gado yakaita ya dnga lallashin ta, Yarima Malik ne ya shigo sashen saidai jin kamar shasshekar kuka yasa shi banka dakin ya shiga, wani irin tsoro ne yakama shi ganin yanda mahaifiyar shi ke kuka, da sauri ya karaso yakai hannu zai kamata, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta nunashi da yatsa da kaga fuskarta tabbas kasan tana cikin tashin hankali bayya nanne saidai takasa magana, ganin yanda take ta nuna Malik da hannu hakan yasa Saifulislam,  yace. "Yarimana mike damunka har haka, dan Allah kadaina damuwa inkana cikin damuwa ina shiga cikin mawuyacin hali." shiko MalikusSaif ko kallan ta bayi ba, da sauri Bahijja ta koma kitchen tamanta da kayan marmarin da MalikusSaif yace ta kawo mashi, hankalin ta yai masifar tashi ganin Malik cikin wani hali. 

Cigaba dacewa tayi. "Dan Allah masoyina kaimin magana wlh inason ka ina kaunarka Yarima na tunbansan kaina ba nike kaunarka kaima nasan kana sona." dagowa yayi da jajayen idanun shi kamar garwashi ya watsa mata wani irin mugun kallo mai cikeda tsana yace. "Ke fitarmin daga gida, tashi kibani waje." dukawa kasa gimbiya Zahara'u tayi tace. "Dan Allah Yarima na wlh bazan iya rayuwa ba muddin kace baka sona ina sonka ina son ka." ya bude baki zaiyi magana kenan sukaji karar faranti kasa, Bahijja ce tasaki farantin kayan marmari jikin sai kyarma yakeyi bata san ta saki wani irin kuka ba, shi kanshi mamaki yakeyi miyasa Bahijja kuka har haka, itako gimbiya Zahara'u cikin ɓacin rai tace. "Ke dan uwarki miyakawo ki nan masoya na magana zakiso ki fasa mana kunnuwa da kara wai ke waye ubanki dami kike takama dashi ne eyeh.?" 


Shiko MalikusSaif ran shine yasake baci jin yanda gimbiya Zahara'u take wulakanta Bahijja, juyowa yayi da niyar wanke ta da mari sai ya tuna tarayyar dake tsakanin shi da Huzaifa cikin tsananin bacin rai yace. 
"Ba kowa bace face baiwar Allah mai kamala, nutsuwa, kamun kai, dan haka karki kuskura kisake zagin Bahijja musamman a gaban idona!"
ya ida maganar ta kakkausar murya.
"yayi Yarima dole kace haka akan wannan shegiyar kuma wlh kai nikeso kuma kai zan aure saina illata wannan matsiyaciyar kasa a ranka ni matarka kace.?" wani irin abune ya dira cikin kunnuwan Bahijja jin kalaman da Zahara'u ke fada da gudu ta fita ta baya tana kuka mai sosa rai, shiko MalikusSaif da ido yabi Bahijja yasan ko wannan wulakancin da Zahara'u ke mata dole tayi kuka, bai kuma cewa gimbiya Zahara'u komai ba dan kanshi yafara sara mashi, itako ganin yaki magana, yasa ta kwashi kafarta tana kuka ta fita, abakin kofa ta hadu da Huzaifa yana kallan abinda ke faruwa, raɓashi tayi ta wuce tana watsama shi wani mugun kallo, shigowa yayi yace.
"Kaga abinda ke faruwa ko Yarima sai dai ina baka hakuri akan abinda Zahara'u taimaka Malik." cikin karfin hali Yarima Malik ya dafa kafadar abokin nashi yace. "Wannan ba damuwa bane Huzaifa ai Zahara'u kanwata ce kuma naimata uzuri sai dai ina cikin mawuyacin hali abokina Ummu bata magana saidai zubar hawaye kawai takeyi."


"Kayi hakuri abokina insha Allah zamuji abinda ke damunta kadaina damun kanka." gyada kai yayi alamun toh, sannan Huzaifa yace. "Bakomai sai anjima zandawo."fita yayi shi kuma Malik bin hanyar da yaga Bahijja tabi yayi abin mamaki bata cikin gidan fita yayi ta baya, can ya hango Bahijja ta game kai da guiwa tanata kuka mai sosa zuciya, zama yayi saman wata kujera ta silba, ita kuma tana kasan green carpet din ciyawar dake kwance a cikin lambun yayi kore shar dashi gwanin ban shi'awa, maida  hankali yayi kanta yace.......

"Bahijja kuka kuma? mike damunki kiketa kuka har haka?" jitayi numfashin ta ya tsaya na wucin gadi, a hankali ta ɗago rinannun idanun ta ta kalle shi, sai dai tabbas kasan yana cikin yanayi, cewa tayi.

Minene laifin Bahijja dan tace Ya Malik dinta take so.!?"
wani irin mummunar faduwar gaba yaji ta ratsa shi duk da ya daɗe cikin kogin kaunar Bahijja sai dai yana fargabar hatsarin da zasu afka a ciki!  Murmushi tayi mai ciwo taci gaba da cewa. "Tabbas Ya Malik kanai mani kallan sakarai mahaukaciya wadda batasan abinda take ba ko? a matsayina na baiwa marar 'yanci zan kalli mutun mai daraja kamar ka Yariman Daborah ince shi nike so, lallai ni kaina da kaina na kira da kaina mahaukaciya! Ya Malik ban san so ba, bansan abinda ake kira so ba, amman Bahijja na sonka, Ya Malik ina sonka, duk da nasan bazan taba kasancewa dakai ba sai dai kasani ni Bahijja kaine amintacce na akoda yaushe kazamo mani fitila mai haska mani gaba na Ya Malik!"

Jiyayi zuciyar shi tagama karaya tabbas yana son Bahijja so na hakika, wanda tun tana yar fitsitsiyar ta yake son ta, har xuciyar shi ta gazgata mashi hakan sai dai baiji zai furta kalmar so ga Bahijja kodan mahaifiyar shi, cewa yayi.
"Kanwar Malik kidaina kuka, kin san mahimmacin dana baki a rayuwa ta? kinsan yanda zuciya ta ke zafi duk sanda naga saukar kwallan ki, a bisa kyakkyawar fuskar ki? kukan ki na daga mani hankali kanwata keta musamman ce a cikin zuciya ta, ni nakine Bahijja ke ta Ya Malik din ce, kibar damuwa akan wannan lamarin ina tareda ke kanwata."
wasu hawayen ne suka sake wanke mata fuska a dasisashar murya ta sake kallan shi tace. "Hakane Ya Malik sai dai naga tsantsar kina a idanun ka, nasan baka sona, Zahara'u kake so, tabbas kunfi dacewa da juna tunda ita 'yar mai mulki ce kamar kai, Bahijja kuma baiwa ce dan haka baiwa sai bawa, na fahimta Ya Malik kullin bazan gajiba wajen yimaka hidima ba saboda kai alkhairi ne arayuwa ta kuma bazan taba manta halascin da kaimin ba Ya Malik.!"
goge zazzafan kwallan da suke shatata bisa kuncin ta tayi,  sannan ta tashi da gudu ta fada cikin sashen shi sannan ta fita ta tafi gida. 

Malik kuwa ko motsi yaka sayi yana mamakin yanda akai Bahijja itama takeyi mashi irin wannan son,da yake tunanin bakai kwatankwacin wanda yake mata ba, lallai Allah shi ne ya haɗa jinin su har haka tun batasan wace itaba, shima tun tana karamar ta, cikin zanin goyo Allah yadasa mashi so da kaunar Bahijja ashe sonta ne yai mashi illah harya ɗauka tausayin ta yake,  da kyal yaja kafar shi ya koma cikin sashen nashi dakin shi ya shiga, wani bangare na zuciyar shi kuwa Ummun shi ce yake tunani, dan baisan halin da take ciki ba a halin yanzun. 

*************************************

Masarautar Waisu, Sarki Haishir ne zaune bisa karagar mulki, suna ta shawarar yanda zasu dirkake daular Masarautar Raifasu, gani sukayi wani irin guguwa ta turnike cikin fa'dar baka ganin komai sai kura ko na kusa dakai baka gani kurar takai tsawan mintuna goma kafin talafa, kowa ido yai nauyi bayan kamar mintuna biyar suka fara ganin gaban su, a firgice kowa ya zabura zai gudu dan tsoron halittar da suka gani, aljani dan tsitu ne tsaye tsakiyar fa'da, cikin wata irin murya ya fara cewa.
"Kai Haishir sako daga shugaban Gamki yace insanar daku kuyi mashi mubaya'a dan dirkake Masarautar Raifasu da duk abinda ke hannun su, basu tareda mu, sannan sun barranta daga abinda muke bautamawa!"
wani irin daɗi Haishir yaji ganin Sarrilƙus ya dawo cikin Masarautar su, duk da  yanajin tsoro cewa yayi. "Mun aminta da wannan kudurin naku, muma zaman da mukeyi kenan taya zamu bullowa wannan lamarin na Baidulƙais ashe faduwa tazo dai dai da zama." dariya yaita shekawa mai hhhhhhuuhhh, ya bace har zasu gudu Haishir yace.
"Kutsaya ai mun samu shiga dan haka yanzun burina zai cika wajen darkake kaf ahalin RAIFASU, na rantse da Gurfanai fansa ga jinin mahaifina Sarki Lahazu.!"


➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿


Bayan kwna ukku, ba laifi jikin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yai sauki dan ba karamin kulawa mijin ta ke bata ba sai dai kullin idanun ta suna zirarar da hawaye, na bakin ciki da fargabar abinda gimbiya Salsabila ta gaya mata,  duk lokacin da Yarima Malik zaizo gaida ta takan nuna shi da yatsa alamun bata son ganin shi, wannan dalilin yasa Safulislam ya hana MalikusSaif zuwa duba ta, shikam zuwa yanzun har ya rame kamar mai ciwon hawan jini duk yayi duhu tsabar tunanin halin da Ummun shi ke ciki yakeyi da yanda bata son ganin shi ko kadan, gashi yana kokarin cire Bahijja a cikin zuciyar shi amman kullin kamar ana kara dasa mashi so da kaunar ta, yana san ya daina son ta dan farin cikin mahaifiyar shi amman abu yaki tura maimakon ya ragu saima karuwa da yakeyi, zaune yake tun safe yake sa ran ganin Bahijja amman ba alamin ba, har sha biyun rana bata shigo ba, wani irin kuna zuciyar shi ke mashi ta azazzale shi da son ganin kyakkyawar fuskar ta, zugum yayi yana nazarin rayuwa maganar zuci yafara yace.
"Bahijja karki ga banbaki amsaba, kisani inayin hakane dan mahaifiya ta, sai yanzun nagane dalilin dayasa mahaifiya ta taki yarda kika sance hadima ta Bahijja ashe wannan alakar take gudu, sai dai ni nadauka tausayin ki nikeyi Bahijja a matsayin ki na yar uwata, ashe sonki yaimani illah Bahijja inaji a jikina son da nike maki bakiman kwatan kwacin shi Bahijja, amman ba yanda na iya dole in girmama ra'ayin mahaifiya akan komai Bahijja saidai kisani ina sonki ina kaunarki."

Jiyayi andafa shi, da sauri ya waigo ganin Huzaifa da Yazid akan shi, ido ya zuba masu, hannu Huzaifa yasa yana goge kwallan da suke shatata a cikin kwayar idanun shi, yace. "Kayarda ko Malik son Bahijja ke dawai niya dakai ko.?"
murmushin karfin hali yayi, mai ciwo yace. "tabbas Huzaifa  na farka daga nauyayyen baccin da nikeyi ashe haka so yake Huzaifa ina son Bahijja sai dai ra'ayin mahaifiya yafi karfin in juya mata baya, na kauda kaina akan son Bahijja amman na gaza ya zanyi Huzaifa.?" ya ida maganar tare da wasu irin zafafan hawaye wanda baisan suna sauka a bisa kuncin shi ba. 


Share mashi kwallan fuskar shi yayi yace. "Kayi hakuri insha Allah komai zaizo da sauki, zaka samu Ummu da sanyin hali, kuma ka yawai ta addu'a  insha Allah soyayyar dake tsakanin ka da Bahijja zata zama alkhairi  a cikin wannan Masarautar kayi hakuri Yarima."
ji sukayi ance.
"tabbas Huzaifa hakane duk abinda kukace akan kunne na, Yarima Malik na son Bahijja sai dai baza muyi jayayya da lamarin ubangiji ba saidai kasani Abdulmalik mahaifiyar ka tana cikin yanayi wannan lalurar da kaga tana ciki, labarin soyayyar dake tsakanin ka da Bahijja taji shi, har yana neman saka mata ciwon zuciya,  sai dai kaje kasamu mahaifiyar ka ta yafe maka."
da sauri ya iso wajen Kangiwa ya rungume shi yace.
"Abbuh kayafeman ba daga gareni bane bansan  haka ta faruba Abbuh." bubbuga bayan shi yayi yace.
"Nasani Yarima dan Adam bai wuce kaddarar shi kadauki taraiyarka da Bahijja daga Allah, ka daina damun kanka ɗana."
haka  suka dinga bashi baki jiyayi zuciyar shi ta sauko ya samu sukuni, tafiya sukayi shi kuma ya shiga cikin daki.


A wajen Bahijja kuwa kwance take tana bacci, juye juye tafara, tana cewa. "Ya Malik ina sonka kada kagujeni ina kaunar ka Ya Malik dina kaine jigon rayuwa ta." cikin bacin rai Binta ta tafkama Bahijja uban bugu tace.
"tashi sakara dake baki da hankali ko Bahijja.?" a firgice ta mike tana murtsuka ido cikin magagin bacci take kallan iyayen nata, Abdulmajid ne yace. "Mikeke cewa, Yarima kike so ko?"
kame kame tafara tayi raurau da fuska tace.
"aa Abba bakomai."
wani wawan kallo ya banka mata yace. 
"kinci gidan ku, nace dan dibar albarka ni zakima tijara, Yarima Malik zaki so uban gidan naki, kinsan fitinar da kikeson sakamu a ciki kuwa.?"
"Abba kayi hakuri bansan sadda hakan tafaru dani ba." kwashe ta da wani irin lalataccen mari yayi yace.
"Zan ballaki baki san sadda kika fara son MalikusSaif ba ko?  Bakisan akan  Yarima Malik ba Sarauniya Zulaiƙa zata iya halakaki ba? Ko kin haukace ne  zakice kina son Yarima Malik? toh ki bude kunnuwanki da kyau kiji wlh blh duk tsuntsun da ya janyo ruwa shi ruwa ka doka, bazan iya jure ukubar da za'a gana maki ba, sai dai banda zabi tunda ke kika jefa kanki a halaka, wannan rayuwar ma ka tsaya matsayin da Allah ya ajeka ma kana shan wahalar mutanen karshen zamani bare ka wuka iyakar ka, kina baiwa inake ina Yarima, gaskia Bahijja baki mamu adalci ba, amatsayin mu na bayi zaki jamana wulakanci duk gargadin da nike maki ya tashi a banza a wofi kenan kinmin halacci nagode kin kyauta."
rike hannun mahaifin nata tayi tana kuka mai sosa zuciya, fisgewa yayi ya fita yana kwallah, gamuwa yayi da Mairo da takasa karasowa, da kyal itama ta shigo tana kwalla, dan ta san halin da Bahijja ta jefa kanta, a ciki na ukubar rayuwa zuwa tayi tacigaba da yima Bahijja faɗa har kanta ke juyama mata dan kuka, gashi ji take kamar ana kara rura wutar son Yarima Malik a cikin zuciyar ta, itako Binta cewa tayi
"bazan maki baki ba Bahijja sai dai kisani duk kalar cin kashin da akayi mana dake zamuyi koke, shiyasa Zulaiƙa taki yarda ki rabi danta ashe ta hango abinda mu bamu gani ba, ashe soyayya zaku kulla keda Yarima, dan haka in barci kike ki farka,  gwara koda zaki mutu ki rabu da son Yarima a cikin zuciyar ki." ita dai Bahijja takasa magana sai aikin kukan da take yi.

〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️〰️

A Masarautar Raifasu kuwa su Jakadiya da Tasi'u ne suka gama shirin su tsaf, a sashen Sarki Muhammad ban kwana yai masu sannan ya hada su da hadimai hudu maza biyu mata biyu da dawakai shida kowa yahau guda, guda suka kama hanyar tafiya nahiyar Daborah

***********************************

Da yammacin ranar alhamis ranar ne Allah yasa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa bakin ta ya bude suna zaune da Saifulislam ta saki wani irin marayan kuka mai tsuma zuciya cikin disasshar muryar ta tace.
"Ya zanyi ina zansaka raina, dama mutuwa nayi da ganin wannan ranar yau Yarima ne zaiyi soyayya da baiwa!?  daman itace matar da yaitai mana wasa da tunani wajen fitarwa ya batama dan uwana lokaci! Saifulislam kaga abinda ɗanka zai mani?  tabbas Abdulmalik ya zama butulu ya zama korarre, kuma barrantacce a wajena wlh saina.....

Episode 77&78




Dakatar da ita Saifulislam yayi ranshi ya sosu ya gama ɓaci a fusace yace.
"Karki kuskura kima ɗana baki! kawai dan yaso baiwa, ita baiwar ba mutun bace da zaki dinga wulakanta bayi kina cin zarafin su?"

Itama a fusace take kallan Saifulislam da rinanun idanun ta masu kama da garwa shin wuta tace. 
"Kaga Saifulislam karka gaya mani ba dadi baiwa ba mutun bace kuma matsawar Yarima Malik ɗana ne, kuma cikina ya kwanta da ya auri wannan makirar baiwar gwara inga gawar shi zai fiye mani sauki, ni za'a wulakanta a tozar ta, ace kamar ni Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ace ɗana magajin mulkin Daborah  Yarima kamar Malik ya auri baiwa! hakan bazai taɓa yuyuwa ba saidai in ban raye.!"
karasowa yayi gaban ta yace.
"Saime dan Malik ya auri baiwa? Nace maki saime Zulaiƙa.?" cikin ɗaga murya ta nuna Saifulislam da ɗan yatsa manuniya tace.
"Badai jinin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ba sai dai in dana haifi Abdulmalik an masanya mani sh, ba dai jinin Sarki Abdulkadir ba ɗa ga Sarauniya Yahanazu, jika ga Sarauniya Balkisu, jini ga Sarki Khalid ba, ba dai jinin Sarki Jabbar, dan uwan Sarauniya Maimoon uwar Sarki Jumal ba, wlh ba daini Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yar Sarki Abdulhamid ba, za'a ce magajina kamar MalikusSaif zai auri BAIWA yar wahala kamar wannan watsatsiyar yarinyar ba, sai nayi ajalin wannan yarinyar, ace magajin mulkina ya auri BAIWA!?"


Murmushi Saifulislam yayi cike da gadara yace. "Ki bude kunnuwan ki kijin da kyau Abdulmalik Saifullahilislam bai gaji Sarauta ba, kasuwanci ya gada, tun kaka da kakanni dan haka ɗana ni zai gada tunda da UBA ake ado ba UWA ba kuma uba ake gado! dan haka kijini da kyau Ya Zulaiƙa  inhar Allah ya kadara MalikusSaif sai ya auri Bahijja ba makawa sai anyi, sannan idan akan wannan Sarautar zaki dinga yin kumfar baki kina tsinema yarinya dan kawai tana baiw, zaki hana ɗanki magajin mulkin ki auren ta, to ki rike mulkin ki ba abinda Abdulmalik zaiyi da mulki ki rike Sarautar ki kibar shi da son Bahijja da kuma gadon fatauci da yayi a wajen mahaifin  shi saboda shine igiyar da mahaifin shi ya rike tun kaka da kakanni, kuma kowa yasan waye Saifulislam ba matsiyaci ban, kasuwanci ya rike dan haka ɗana bazai yi  mulki ba kasuwan ci zai rike,  inafatan kin fahimta Ya Zulaiƙa!?"


Jitayi zuciyar ta ta tsinke yau ita Saifulislam ke fadawa wadan nan maganganun akan BAIWA? Zaice danshi bazai gajeta ba, bayan ta gama dora buri kanshi shi daya tal, takawa tayi har gaban Saifulislam tace.
"Karya ne sai dai bada tsatsan Sarauniya Yahanazu yake ba, dole ya zama Sarki na *ɗari da* *casa'in da tara* a cikin jerin  Sarakunan Daborah, sannan kuma ya zama *na dari  biyu da* *hamsin da tara* a cikin jerin mulkin kama karya na mulkin kujarar alfarma ta Daborah, sai dai inbai numfashi wannan kuma daga Allah ne amman ba makawa MalikusSaif *Sarauta* ya gada ba *Fatauci* ba kuma ba *SARKI* ba auren *BAIWA*.!"
tana gama fadar haka ta fita a fusace shiko MalikusSaif  yazo shigowa yaji artabar da iyayen nashi keyi akan shi baisan ya koma baya ba, duk abinda ya wakana ba abinda baijiba saidai baida zabi, addu'a  yake Allah ya kaddara mashi tsanar Bahijja ko ya huta da wannan bala'in dake shirin tunkaro su,  a cikin zuciyar shi ji yake kamar ta fashe dan takaici.


Washe gari da safe Binta na zuwa wajen aiki iske ta tayi harɗe a falon ta dukawa tayi ta gaida Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kamar jira ta kira Binta tana zuwa  gaban ta ta dinga kwaɗa ma Binta mari abu kamar wasa saida taima Binta mari yakai huɗu take kuncin ta ya kumbura ga jini na zuba a saman bakin Binta, amman Sarauniya Zulaiƙa bata daina marin Binta ba, su Huzaifa ne suka shigo shida MalikusSaif  dan basu ba Sarauniya Zulaiƙa hakuri suka iske wannan danyen aikin, itako Binta sai shara kuka takeyi ji take kamar ta suma dan azaba, Yazid ne ya fara bata hakri tana ganin MalikusSaif  ta koma kan shi dukawa yayi yafara neman afuwar mahaifiyar tashi, tunkan ya ida dukawa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta wanke Yarima Malik da zazzafan marika har guda ukku a fusace tace.
"Allah yawadaran wannan tsinannan halin naka Malik dan ɗibar albarka kai karasa wadda zakaso sai baiwa, kasani kuma ka saka a ranka ni dakai munyi hannun riga daga yau sai yau bani bakai na yafeka! 
sannan yau zan nuna maka karshen so badai baiwa kake so ba? ke Binta maza kikarawo mani Bahijja kika bari dakika ukku takara saina halaka ki da ita kanta sakarai jahila jaka."
ita dai Binta ta tashi ta tafi kiran 'yar tata saidai tana cikin fargaba da bacin rai, haka ta isa har turakar bayi ta iske Bahijja zaune ta buga uban tagumi tana kuka mai sosa rai, Binta na zuwa ta watsa mata wani irin matsiyacin kallo da sauri ta mike saboda  yanda taga mahaifiyar ta ta tana kallan ta bakaramin firgita taiba, cikin tsoro tace.
"Umma lafiya na ganki a wannan lokacin." batasan sadda ta kifawa Bahijja maruka har guda biyu ba tace.
"Uban kine! dan ubanki ke harkin isa kiyi mani wannan tambayar bayan kin gama haɗa gadar zarenki yanxun kice zaki tambayeni, kingane mani yarinya dan uban ki! toh hankalin ki ta kwanta yau kin shiga tsakanin ɗa da uwa yau ga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta sa hannun ta ta mari Yarima duk a dalilin ki, duk irin so da kaunar da take mashi, yau gashi kin sa kama Yarima Malik da alkhairi yaron da yake kyauta ta maki tin kina cikin zanin goyo, yau gashi kin saka shi cikin tashin hankali,  yanzun sai kije ki girbi abinda kika shuka, dan ni kaina uwarki ban tsiraba daga ukuba ko azabar da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa zatai mani ba, tayimin marar dalili bare yanzun da take da hujja inake baiwa ina son Yarima! wue mutafi ja'ira kika tsareni da kallan munafunci kinbani kunya Bahijja!."
kuka mai tsuma zuciya ta sake yi, ita kanta tasan son Ya Malik daga Allah ne,  da zata iya da ta hana kanta, cewa tayi. "Umma kiyafemani nasan na jefa duk wani ahalina cikin musifa." "yimin shiru baki fara kuka ba Bahijja sai sadda kikaga a gaban idanun ki, ankama mahaifin ki an wulakan ta shi sannan zaki fara kuka, wuce mutafi, haihuwa ce ta jawo mana wannan bala'in kuma bamu da abinda zamuce sai mu godema Allah."
haka suka tafi duk inda zasu wuce tunda daga turakar bayi sai nuna su ake ana kus kus, a darare suka isa har sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, lokacin Yarima Malik yana can guiwa bibbiyu yana neman afuwar mahaifiyar shi dan ba karamin tsorata yaiba ganin hankali da tunani mahaifiyar sun rabu da ita sai kwallan azaba sa fargaba takeyi, suna shigowa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta figi wata jibgegiyar bulalar fatar rakumi da ta jiku da jikon gidan Sarauta tunkan Bahijja ta duka Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tafara yimata ruwan bulalai da kanta, haka taita zubawa Bahijja bulala tako ina har a fuska, ita kuwa dukewa tayi tana kare kyakkywar fuskar ta gudun kartai mata illah, amman ina abun yafi karfin tunanin duk wanda ke falon itako Bahijja hartakai kasa haka Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tai binta da  bugu har harbin ta takeyi tana tsine mata albarka, Binta kuwa dukewa tayi tafasa uban kara ganin Bahijja na tumurmusa ga bakin ta ya ɗaɗe jini na kwaranya, da sauri Yarima Malik yayi kan mahaifiyar tashi ganin zatayi kisan kai, saibdai a fusace ta nuna shi da yatsa tace.
"ka kuskura kace zaka taɓani dan ceton wannan wulakantar tar BAIWAR  saina tsine maka albarka MalikusSaif, baka da anfani a cikin wannan zuriar tamu ka wulakanta a halin Sarki Abdurrazak na ɗaya da har kake soyayya da baiwa!"
cak Yarima Malik ya tsaya yana dafe kanshi da yake ji tamkar ya fashe, cigaba da halba Bahijja tayi itako ta dafe ciki tana kwalla dan kuka mai sauti ya gagari Bahijja. 
itako Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ji tayi anrike mata hannu a fusace ta juyo da niyar taki fama wanda ya riketa da mari sai taga Matawalle dan Sarauniya Zulaiƙa Allah ya horema ta tarin zuciya Matawalle ne rike da ita yana girgiza mata kai, tana ganin shi batasan sadda ta faɗa saman kirjin Matawalle ba ta saki marayan kuka, cigaba da dan bubbuga bayan kanwar tashi yayi, yana kallan Yarima Malik da yagama fita tunanin shi tsabar bacin rai da takaici, shi kanshi jin wannan labarin ya sosa mashi rai matuka amman ance inrai ya baci hankali baya gushewa, duk abinda ke wakana aminin nashi Saifulislam yai mashi bayanin komai, zaunar da ita yayi yana lallasar ta, itako Bahijja da kyal ta zauna jikin ta duk shatin bulalai ga jini na zuba a lips dinta, Binta ta rarrafa zata kama yar tata a tsawace Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace. 
"kika kuskura kika taɓata saina sauyamaki kamanni!."
Kallan wani hadimin ta tayi tace.
"kai Laminu kaimin wannan wulakantattar baiwar gidan Yari aita dukan ta har buzun ta, tabbas hankalin MalikusSaif  yai masifar tashi, har zaiyi magana sai dai Matawalle yaima shi nuni da karyace zaiyi magana, shima shiru yai baice komai ba dan ya fahimci a wannan yanayin ba abinda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa bazata iya aikatawa ba, itako Bahijja tashi tayi aka tisa keyarta kamar barauniya aka garkame ta,  koda aka rufeta zama tayi kasa tana kuka mai sosa rai, ba abinda ya bata mata rai irin kalaman da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ke dan gantata dasu, Allah yasani tana son Ya Malik sai dai kodan mahaifiyar shi dolen ta, ta hakura dashi,  kodan kada aci gaba da wulakanta mata iyaye.

Itako Zulaiƙa cigaba da kukan ta tayi tana cewa "Yaya nashiga ukkuna kasan abinda Yarima ya aikata kuwa? Yaya inama mutuwa nayi na huta Yaya....rufe mata baki yayi da tafin hannun shi yace.
"Naji komai Zulaiƙa, kidaina wannan kukan naki kema kinsan ganinki cikin wannan damuwar zai sa ingilgiza kece jinina Zulaiƙa, mubi ɗanmu a masala dan samun saukin wannan al'amarin."
"aa Yaya ba wannan maganar dole yau din nan ai baikon Yarima da gimbiya Zahara'u." a dimauce MalikusSaif ya kalli mahaifiyar tashi.

Cikin hikima Matawalle yace. "Naji muje ciki ki kwanta anjima duk wannan maganar munyita haka yakaita har bedroom dinta shiko MalikusSaif  sashen shi ya wuce yana kwalla baisan abinyi ba a halin yanzun koda Matawalle ya fito baiga MalikusSaif ba sashen shi ya bishi iske shi yai yaje ya dawo ya rasa mafita, yana ganin Matawalle ya rungume shi yace.
"Kawu tawa ta kare muddin akace Zahara'u za'a auraman,ban son ta wlh na tsaneta Kawu!"

bubbuga bayan shi Matawalle yayi cikin tausayin ɗan nasa yace. "Karka damu  kai dai kabi abinda iyayen ka suka umurceka duk da mahaifin ka baisan aimaka auren dole saidai baka da wani zabi kacigaba da addu'a  Abdulmalik,sannan  kasani duk wani ahalin mu kaf kasosa masu zuciya da ka zabi baiwa a matsayin matar da zaka aura, duk da ilimi ya kori abubuwa da dama a cikin wannan Masarautar, amma kasani bamu da makiya maciya amana sama da bayi, yanzun gashi an wayi gari magajin wannan Masarautar shike son baiwa, kasanya wannan lamarin bisa mizani Abdulmalik?"


Shi kanshi ya rasa abin cewa saidai kwalla dake zarya a saman fuskar shi ba abinda yake tausayi irin halin da mahaifiyar shi ta jefa kanta akan bayi da yanda take nuna musu kiyayya karara a cikin idanun ta da zuciyar ta, Matawalle ne yace. "Dan haka kaima kaje ka kwanta dan hutawa zuwa anjima zan nemeka dan asamu ayi sulhu a cikin wannan lamarin mai rikitarwa." shi dai MalikusSaif sake rungume Kawun nashi yayi sannan ya shiga cikin bedroom dinshi ya kwanta

A gidan Yari Bahijja ce ke ta kuka tarasa abinda ke mata dadi tarasa dalilin dayasa ta gayama Ya Malik shi takeso bayan shi ba tsaran tabane ita kuma kaskan tattace marar galihu, yau gashi ta jefa mahaifan ta cikin kunci da fargaba, tana cikin kuka taji mai kula da ita yace tayi bakuwa, budemata kofa yayi, da kamar bazata fito ba, sai kuma ta fito abin mamaki gimbiya Zahara'u ce cikin shigar alfarma tasha alqabba, cikin gadara da nuna isa tacema Bahijja.
"Baiwa baiwa yai bayi jikar bayi tattaɓa kunnen bayi wadda ta gaji bauta da wahala marar yanci da galihu, ko zakiso jin wannan labarin mai dadin sauraro?"
rufe idanun ta Bahijja tayi tana karajin tsanar Zahara'u a cikin ranta, jitayi tace.
"Yanzun haka kwarson ki yana can nasa anata dukan shi kamar jaki ke kwarama jaki dashi tunda bai gaji komai ba sai tarin bauta." da sauri Bahijja ta bude rinannun idanun ta tana kallan gimbiya Zahara'u da take ta murmushin ƙeta, takowa Bahijja tayi tana zagaye gimbiya Zahra'u cikeda gadara Bahijja tace....
