"Banyi mamakin jin wnnan maganar ba, ga wajen wadda batasan darajar kanta ba bare na iyayen ta, dan haka kijini da kau kuma ki fahimta amman idan kwakwal taki tana ja, daga yau kika kuskura kika kara shiga cikin gonata ba gimbiya ko Sarauniya kike sainayi kaca kaca dake, yar Waziri ko? Toh yar Sarki kike sainayi kasa kasa dake sakara dake!." a fusace Zahara'u takawo wani mugun mari a kuncin Bahijja ta rike hannun kam sannan ta wullar dashi, da yatsa ta nuna Zahara'u dashi tace. "Karki kuskara kice hannunki zai tafaɓa wannan fuskar tawa, koda take fuskar Baiwa saidai mai daraja ce, tunda mutun mafi mahimmanci da matsayi yace baisan komai sai wannan fuskar da kike ikirarin mari, dan haka ba haneki kuma na kiyayeki Zahara'u, Bahijja tafi karfin duk wani tunanin ki Bahijja tafi karfin daukar wulakancin kaskantatta irinki, masu iya hukunta Bahijja sai mutane masu mahimmanci da kima da daraja da girma, ba irin kiba marar hankali da tunani!" wani irin bakin cikine ya tokare zuciyar Zahara'u tana mamakin yanda Bahijja bata tsoranta bare shakkar ta take gayamata maganganu mararsa dadin ji da sauraro, duk da kasancewar ta Baiwa, harta ɗisa mata shakka da tsoranta a cikin zuciyar ra dan gani take kamar mai jinnu dakewa tayi tace. "Haka kikace ko? Kisani dani kike zancen saikin kwashi kashin ki a hannun ki, sakara Baiwa yar bayi sainayi ajalinki, keda Yarimana saidai kallo wlh yafi karfin ki." itadai Bahijja bata kuma cewa komai ba, saima shigewa da tayi dakin da aka killace ta haka tabar Zahara'u bude da baki tana mamakin karfin hali irin na Bahijja...... 


Saifulislam da Matawalle sai Malik da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kowa ya nutsu Matawalle ne yace. "Kangiwa?" kallan shi Saifulislam yayi yace. "Na'am." sannan ya waiga gafen haggun shi yace. "Zulaiƙa.?"itama amsawa tayi tana murza zoben gold dake jikin yatsun hannun ta, kallan kasa yayi inda Malik ke zaune bisa lallausan kafat da yake shimfide a cikin falon Saifulislam yace. "Abdulmalik.?" kanshi ya kara saddawa kasa yanaji zuciyar shi nata duka fat fat amsawa yayi yace. "Na'am Kawu." cigaba da magana Matawalle yace. "Inasan kowa yabani aran hankalin shi akan wannan lamari, kaidai Malik yanada kyau ka nemi afuwa da gafarar mahaifiyar ka, sannan kaimata biyayya ka aje son wannan yarinyar da kakeyi, ka dauki kaddara maganar gaskia kasan ance kowace kwarya da abokin gurbin ta kuma kaga yarinyar baiwa ce mahaifiyar batason alaka ta shiga a tsakanin ku, nafison wannan gidan yazama gida mai tarin albarka da lumana kaga da ayi kwara kada  afara, kai kanka bazakaso ace ka auri mata ba, amman tana cikin matsala da tashin hankali ba."


Shidai Malik bugun da zuciyar shi keyi sai karuwa takeyi ya rasa dalilin dayasa yake shiga cikin wannan yanayin lokuta da dama, dakewa yayi yace. "Kawu yanda kace haka za'ayi dan Allah Ummu kiyi hakuri, naji na hakura, saidai banda wani zabi da zanyi dakaina kowace ku zabamin farin cikin ki shine nawa Ummu." duk da taji dadin furucin dan nata saidai ta daukar ma kanta saita hana su Bahijja da iyayen ta shan ruwa cikin Daborah, Matawalle ne ya kalleta yace. "Kinji abinda dan naki yace amman kinyi shiru.?" murmushin karfin hali tayi tace. "Badamuwa Allah ya tabbatar da alkhairi kuma na yafemaka." godiya yaima mahaifiyar tashi saidai shi kadai yasan mawuyacin halin da yashiga cikin kankanin lokaci wani mugun jiri yakeji yana dawainiya dashi, Matawalle yace. "Kangiwa bakace komai ba.?" kallan Malik yayi yadan girgiza kai dan yafahimci danshi yana cikin yanayi amman zaisa ido yaga iyakar su, cewa yayi "Alhmdullh tunda ansamu sasanci naji dadin hakan saidai inada nawa sharadin.!" kallan tuhuma Sarauniya Zulaiƙa taima mijin nata ko kallan arxiki bata isheshi ba dan mugun haushin ta yakeji a halin yanzun cewa yayi "Bahijja zataci gaba da aikin ta kamar yanda aka alkawalta sama da shekuru shabiyar, wannan shine nawa sharadin." girgiza kai Zulaiƙa tafara, Matawalle ne yaimata wani irin kallo sannan tace. "Naji tunda haka ka zaba saidai bata ba dana, iyakar ta gyaran falon shi." Matawalle ne yace. "Komai zatayi abarshi a haka Zulaiƙa." bata kuma cewa komai ba, shiru ne ya mamaye wajen na dakiku sannan tace."anjima kaje kugana da Zahara'u." wani irin murmushin yake yayi wanda yafi kuka zafi yace. "Toh Ummu hakan za'ayi." shidai Saifulislam yana kallan ikon Allah yau Malik akema dole, saidai nashi ido... 


Matawalle ne yace. "Abdulmalik tashi kaje Allah yaimaka albarka. " da ameen MalikusSaif ya amsa yatafi ko gaban shi bai gani sosai, Matawalle ne yace. "Yakamata kisa a saki yarinyar daga gidan kaso tunda ansamu matsaya." kallan tuhuma Saifulislam yashiga yima Sarauniya Zulaiƙa a ranshi ko yana mamakin yanda ta tsani Bahijja harhaka da zata kaita gidan kaso, lallai lamarin Zulaiƙa akwai gyara sosai....

Cewa tayi. "Shikenan badamuwa, sallama taimasu ta tafi, suko su Matawalle da Kangiwa labari sukaci gaba dayi saidai kowa da abinda yake sakawa da yanda yake kallan al'amrin Malik da Bahijja.......



Koda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa takoma sashen ta sawa tayi Binta takira mata Abdulmajid har cikin sashen ta, hakanan Binta ta tafi wajen aikin mijin ta yana cikin ba dawakai ruwa, yana ganin matar tashi saida gaban shi ya fadi dan shakka da abinda da take tafe dashi, da sauri ya tare ta yace. "Ummu Bahijja lafiyarki naganki haka?" girgiza kai tayi tace. "Ba lafiya Sarauniya ke nemanka a sashen ta, baice mata komai ba, sukatafi har cikin sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, isketa sukayi kishingiɗe tasha gawala gwalai asaman wuyanta ga alqabba tada ta alfarma, dukawa sukayi su dikansu, basujima da zamaba saiga wani katan bawa ya shigo da Bahijja agaban Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yai wurgi da Bahijja, zubewa tayi gaban tana facinga mahaifan ta, dukar da kanta tayi dan ba kadan mahaifin nata yaimata kwarjini ba, jitayi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace "Abdulmajid uban bayi dan gadan gado, shin bakaga abun kunyar da yarka tayi ba? Shin bakaji kunyar abinda ta aikata ba? ace kamar yarka baiwa tace tana son dana mai daraja magajina Yariman Daborah, kaico kunyi asara aidaman ku kungaji asara da taɓacewa maciya amana, yan gadan bauta, kaiko cemaka akai daba maka akayi ɗana Malik zaiso yarka baiwa zaka amince, koda yake zaka iya amincewa kasancewar ku jahilai mararsa ilimi masu dakikiyar kwakwala maciya amana.!" wani irin kallo Abdulmajid ke aikama Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, yarinyar da yaima bauta tuntana kankanuwar ta, duk wani wankin ta shine tun mahaifin tana da rai yau shi take wulakantawa yar cikin shi, dan dai ya dade baisamu haihuwa ba, murmushin karfin karfin hali yayi yace. "Allah ya huci zuciyar Sarauniya uwa ga magajin gobe Yarima mai adalci, saidai kisani dan yau ka haifeshi baka haifi halinsa ba, tabbas Malik yafi karfin Bahijja kuma koni kaina bazan taba bari 'yata ta auri Yarima aiko ba'afada Malik yafi karfin baiwa kamar Bahijja, dan haka amadadina da duk wani ahalina na bayi muna neman afuwa akan abin kunyar da yarmu ta aikata."


Tashi zaune Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi ta mike tana taku cikeda kasaita, tana tafiya tana zagaye su suko sai binta da idanu sukeyi, wani mummunan mari ta wanke Abdulmajid dashi har sau ukku, lokacin su Huzaifa da Yazid sun rako Malik kara ba mahaifiyar tashi hakuri, baki dayan su saida sukaji jikin su yayi sanyi, saboda Abdulmajid koda yake bawa mutun ne da Allah yaima kamala, wanda mutanen Masarautar tundaga bayi har masu mulki suke mutuntawa, dattijo ne dayakai shekaru tamanin da bakwai a duniya, rike kuncin shi yayi yana mamakin karfin hali na Zulaiƙa, koda ya zauna da mahaifin ta wanda shine tsaransa bai wulaknta shi kamar haka ba sai yar cikin shi cikin gadara tace. "Kai harka isa ka kalli kwayar idona kace amadadin ahalin ku, ku harwani ahaline daku, dahar zaka fadamani hakan?" itako Bahijja batasan ta kafce da wani malalacin kuka ba, ganin irin bala'in da ta saka iyayen nata a ciki, da sauri su Huzaifa suka karaso sunaba Sarauniya hakuri, daga masu hannu tayi alamun suyi mata shiru haka kuwa akayi danko Malik yakasa furta komai dan al'ajabi gaskia lamarin mahaifiyar shi sai ita, cewa tayi. "Kai Baru zonan yimasa bulala hamsin." Malik ne yace. "Ummu kiyi hakuri ninajaza masu wannan abun ni yakamata ki hukunta ba Abba ba."da sauri ta waigo ta matso kusa da shi tace. "Wato Abba har ankai wani matsayi da zaka kira Abdulmajid da Abba ashe ya haifeka, bansani ba, toh wancan matsiyacin ba ubanka bane, bawan kane wanda bai wuci kasaida shiba, ko ka salwantar da rayuwar shi, sannan kajini da kyau Malik bawa ba dan uwanka bane bakai ba hada jinin taka da bawa, dan haka inma mafarki kake kafarka Abdulmalik." muryar shi na rawa yace. "Ummu ba haka bane karfa kimanta Bayima 'Yayane, suma mutane....


Jin karar saukan bulalan da Baru ke zabgama Abdulmajid ne ya katsema Malik zancen da yakeyi, a fusace yai kan wannan bawan da niyar dakatar dashi, jin munanan kalaman da mahaifiyar shi tayi yasa shi tsayawa. "Ka kuskara ka isa wajen nan Malik bani bakai." haka akaita zabgama Abdulmajid bulalai su Binta da Bahijja sai kuka sukeyi, Allah Sarki Abdulmajid tun yana iya daurewa har yakai ga yafara kara dan zafi ga jikin tsufa daya taso mashi, haka aka zube mashi bulalai sunfi sittin jikin shi duk yai jini dan azaba, sannan takoma kan Binta itama saida akaimata bulala talatin hakama Bahijja sannan taci gaba da cewa..... 



'Dan haka kujama tsinanniyar 'yarku kunne bata ba ɗana inba haka nan ba, bada jimawa zaku bakunci al'amarin da baku taba tsammani ba, ina fatan kun fahimta."? 

Binta tace. "Zamu kiyaye, kuma komai agaban idanta ya wakana nasan bazai fatan hakan ya sake aukuwa ba, muntuba uwar dakina Allah yabaki nasara." dan jijjiga kai ta danyi sannan taimasu nuni da subata waje, haka suka tafi dan Abdulmajid yakasa furta komai dan bacin rai har bai ganin gaban shi, haka suka koma cikin taskar bayi rai bace kowa da abinda yake sakawa a cikin zuciyar shi.... 


Itako Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tana waigowa taga basu Malik ba alamun su, bakin ciki yasa sun fita, ba inda Malik ya sauka sai sashen Kangiwa har cikin ɗakin shi ya same shi yagama karatun alqur'ani mai girma, kamar karamin Yaro haka Malik ya fada saman mahaifin nashi yace. "Abbuh kataimaki iyayen Bahijja yau Ummu ta wulakanta su taci zarafin su, har Abdulmajid mahaifin Bahijja da mahaifiyar ta da ita kanta Bahijjar ta buga Abbuh Ummu na neman sakamani ciwon zuciya."


Cikin tausayin dan nashi yace. "Abdulmalik karka damu, har yanzun Zulaiƙa batasan mike mata ciwoba saidai akwai wata rana da nike jiye mata ranar da zatayi dana sani marar anfani, dan haka kadaina damuwar kanka duk abinda ke faruwa ina sane da komai, Malik bazan yi magana ba, amman akwai ranar kin dillanci kaje kaci gaba da addu'a Abdulmalik in Bahijja alkhairi ce arayuwar ka Allah ya tabbatar hakama in Zahara'u ce itama Allah yatabbatar saidai duk da Bahijja ke baiwa inasan ta saboda kwawawan dabiun ta da kamala saidai mumika lamarin wajen lillahi wahidir kahhar." wani sanyi yaji jin kalaman mahaifin nashi da haka Malik ya kwanta bisa gadon Saifulislam da tunani iri iri a cikin zuciyar shi har bacci barawo yai awan gaba dashi, yana ganin ɗan nashi samu bacci ya sake rufeshi da wani tattausan blanketa yai mashi addu'a ya fita zuwa falorn shi da bai rabuwa da baki masu zuwa naiman alfarma wajen Kadimulislam...... 


Koda Abdulmajid suka koma cikin madaidaicin gidan su na bayi zama yayi bisa tabarmar su takaba, yana mai aikama Bahijja kallo mai dauke da sakonni iri iri wani mugun bakin cikine ya turnike shi, cikin fada yace. "Kingani ko Bahijja baki godema Allah da ni'imar da yaimaki ba, kin jazamana wulakanci da gori awajen yar danai haihuwa da kamar ta, yau an duke ubanki a gaban idon ki, an duke uwarki agaban idonki anci zarafin duk akan dan ta, Allah yasani inason Abdulmalik saidai wajibine ko kinki ko kinso tunda ba ubanki bane ki rabu dashi daga yau indai ba cika ɗa ba shegeba kuma na haihu daga tsatson Jafar dan Abdullahi baki ba MalikusSaif koda hakan yana nufin ajalinki Bahijja, dan haka kisaka wannan aranki.!"


Wani mummunan faduwar gaba ya mamaye ta saidai kwarjini da jinn nauyin wulakancin da ta zajama mahaifan ta ya girmi tai jayayya akan duk wani hukunci da suka zartar akanta, sadda kanta tayi tace.......

Episode 81&82




"Abba kayafe mani nasan nayi babban kuskuren dangan ta rayuwa da ta Yarima saidai zaka sameni mai yawan kauda kai aduk abinda bai shafeni ba kamar yanda kake bani shawara a matsayin ka na mahaifina.!"
takarasa maganar kwalla na sintiri a saman kuncin ta, Binta ce ta dungureta cikin bacin rai tace. "Yimana shiru kina magana kamar mutuniyar arziki da ace kinsan ciwon kanki ai dabaki kai kanki matsayin da Allah bai kaiki ba."
"Umma kiyiman aikin afuwa....Abdulmajid ne ya katseta ta hanyar daka mata mummunar tsawa yace.
"Karya kike Bahijja baki saduda ba, dan a zahiri ga tarin kaunar Yarima nan a fuskar ki, kina kuka ne kawai dan ancima iyayen ki zarafi, amman ba abinda ya ragu cikin idanunki, dan haka ki sani ni Abdulmajid koda nike bawa, ni ba raggo bane kowa yasani a cikin wannan Masarautar ni Jarumi ne kuma ban tsoran abokan gaba, koda afagen fama ne, kowa ya shaida hakan, hawan Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ne daga mulki ya kassara martabar bayi sabanin mulkin Sarki Abdulhamid, itama kanta tasan ubanki ba lusari bane kuma ni inada wadatar zuci, kisa aranki indai daga tsatson Jafar kike wlh Bahijja ya zama dole ki tsaya matsayin ki baki ba Yarima Malik, kema 'yace koda kike baiwa haifarki akai ba daga sama muka tashi muka ganki ba, zan kara maimaitaki kalma ta karshe badan kaunar da muke maki ba Bahijja a matsayin ki na 'yar mu wadda tazo da kalubale iri iri a cikin wannan Masarautar wlh da saina saba maki kamanni dan haka fidda Yarima a cikin ranki shi zaisa kiguji fadawa a cikin fushina, sannan baki ba ɗa mai kima da daraja ke baiwa ce daga yau baki ba Abdulmalik Bahijja.!"

Kinsan dinbin darajar ta da kimar ta da kuma martabar ta a wajena, ko kuwa kinsan mahimmancin ta, a wajena? Wannan fuskar da kike wulakan tawa tafimin komai a gareni, kuma jigoce a wajena haske ce kuma tauraro ce mai haskeke rayuwa ta, kuma ita ke haska cikin birnin zuciya ta, dan haka kijini da kyau Zahara'u, Bahijja itace farin cikina kuma ita nikeso kuma ita zan aura itace uwar 'yayane, dan haka kifita a cikin rayuwata Zahara'u natsaneki!" itako Zahara'u ta rike kirji da takeji tamkar zuciyar ta zata kubto ta fado kasa, dan fargaba, itako Bahijja tabbas taji dadi yanda har Yarima kamar Malik ya bayyana darajar ta agaban Zahara'u saidai bataji zata iya tarayya da Malik kodan kimarta, jitayi yace. "Bahijjaaah!"yanda yaja sunan ya kirarshi da kakkausar murya tabbas tasan ba wasa hakan yasa ta kalleshi sannan tace "Na'am Ya Malik." sake cewa yayi. "Bahijja inasan ki sanarwa Zahara'u wayeni a wajen ki.!" yanda yakafeta da idanin shi saitaji yakara mata kwarjini, sannan bataji zata iya badashi a gaban gimbiya Zahara'u kodan yanda take wulakantata akan Malik cikin dakewa tace. "Tabbas duniya ta shaida an halicci Bahijja dan MalikusSaif dan haka Ya Malik masoyina ne kuma uban 'yayana da izinin Allah inason Ya Malik so na hakika kamar yanda kikaji yana sona, Bahijja batayin son maso wani koshin wahala, koda nike baiwa, inaso ana sona, kinga ko Bahijja tafi karfin wulakanci da kaskanci, tunda tafi mai yanci komai da tarin so da kauna a wajen mutun mai daraja, kinga kenan baiwa tafi yar masu daraja, tunda ta taka inda ke baki isa ki takaba, dan haka kidawo cikin hayyacin ki Zahara'u MalikusSaif na Bahijja kuma shine zabina." buga hannun ta tayi saman table tace. "Karyane yar matsiya ta, wlh Malik nawane kuma shine mijina, kisa aranki saina watsa sihirin da kikaima shi yar wulakantattu baiwa yar gadon bauta, wadda tsiya ta kare kanku, yar matsaya t......."Ke!!! karda ki kuskura wannan kaskantaccen harshen naki ya sake aibta iyayena inba hakanan ba saina datse wannan tsinanan harshen naki wanda baisan darajar iyaye ba, ni zan iya komai akan iyayena inafatan kin fahimta?" 

Zatayi magana Yarim Malik yace.
"Kikiyaye dan haka ɓaceman dagani karki saman ciwon kai." da sauri Zahara'u ta duka tace.
"Yarima karkamin haka kafadama ta nice zabinka kadawo cikin hayyacin ka, kai nikeso kaima kace kana sona Yarima na." tabbas baiso takaisu haka da Zahara'u ba saidai yazama dole ya farkar da ita daga nauyayyen baccin da tayi kodan mahaifiyar shi tasan cewa Allah shike haɗa zukatan mutane, dan haka susan kaskantattar da suke ikirari ita yake so kuma ita ya zaba, a kaskance yace.
"Nagama magana kuma bazan ha'inceki ba, koba komai ke yar uwatace dan haka ki tsaya matsayun ki, amman kisa aranki Bahijja nikeso kuma ita nike kauna." tanajin haka ta fita da gudu tana kuka.


 _Allah Sarki Zahara'u ai haka abin yake son maso wani koshin wahala, Allah yasa muso masu sonmu dan Allah 🙏_

Kamar jira tana fita Bahijja tasa kai zata fita, baisan ya riko hannun taba da sauri yace. "Bahijja kisani kece gubar da kika dade kina wahalar da zuciyar MalikusSaif, saida taimin illah sannan na farga, yau gashi akanki MalikusSaif da duniya tagama yarda da cewa Jarumine kuma mai nagarta yau gashi ya susuce ya zama raggo ashe ba kowa bangare mutun ke kasancewa ba jajirtattace ba kuma Jarumi, sai gashi a fagen sonki na zama raggo mafi muni nakasa takuba komai akan sonki Bahijja dan Allah kisoni ko rabin son da nike maki ne.!"


Ita kanta sassan jikin ta sun karbi kalaman Malik kuma tana son shi tana kaunar shi, amman a halin yanzun bataji zata iya furta kalmar so a gare shi tayi hakan ne dazun saboda gimbiya Zahara'u, kuma yanzun zata kishine dan daukaka darajar iyayen ta da ake wulakantawa kullin ba dare ba rana wasu kwalla ne suka ziraro mata a hankali ta goge sannan ta fuskanci MalikusSaif tace.
"Kayi hakuri Ya Malik tabbas naso inkasance dakai, saidai a halin yanzun kasani ba sonka a cikin zuciyar Bahijja na hakura dakai kaje ka cika burin mahaifiyar ka, nima incika burin nawa iyayen ko sun huta da ukubar da suke fuskanta, dan haka Ya Malik ka fidda Bahijja a cikin zuciyar ka, sannan kamanta da rayuwar Bahijja, dan a halin yanzun Bahijja bata sonka.!"
wani daram yaji a cikin zuciyar shi bakin shi na kyakyarwa yana so yayi magana amman wani kululu ya tokare mashi wuya, itako bata jira cewar shiba ta fita da sassarfa tana share kwallan dake zirarowa a saman fuskar ta masu ɗumi, shiko dabas ya zauna bisa kujera da kyal ya furta kalmar Bahi-jj-aaah...in breaking word yake rabasu jiyayi kanshi yana sarama shi da karfi da karfi, baisan hawaye sun fara sintiri ba saman kyakkyawar fuskar shib mai yalwa da kwarjini uwa uba haiba da kyau da sauri yai.......

Episode 85&86





Yun kurawa yayi ya mike ya fita daga sashen nashi ba inda ya wuce sai wajen Matawalle akayi sa'a ya iskeshi bisa shimfidar wani tausassan kafat na alfarma ga hadiman shi kewaye dashi sunata yima shi hidima ahankali ya maida duban shi kan Malik yanda yaga damuwa kwance a fuskar shi hakan ba karamin daga hankalin Matawalle yai ba, koda ya iso da sallama abakin shi wuri ya samu ya zauna gefen Kawun nashi, yana zama Matawalle yaba hadiman shi umurni dasu basu waje, kowa ya watse bisa umurnin Matawalle, tashi yayi daga kishingidan da yayi sannan ya kalli dan nashi cike da kulawa yace. 
"Yarima koban tambaye kaba kana cikin damuwa gayaman damuwar ka ɗana.?" dan rausayar dakai MalikusSaif yayi sannan yace.
"Kawu ina cikin damuwa tabbas, kataimaka mani kaba Ummu umurni tabari in auri Bahijja Kawu zan.....ɗaga mashi hannu yayi rai bace yace. "Miyasa ka nace saika auri baiwa?" cikeda mamaki Malik ya kali Matawalle yace. "Kaima harda kai Kawu.?'' 

"Kwarai kuwa Yarima wannan wulakanta nasaba ne da martabar wannan Masarautar da watsama tsatson Sarki Abduljabbar kasa a ido, bare a ce a zamanin Sarauniya Yahanasu ne kai wannan katobarar da lamarin bazai dadi, kasan yanda wannan ahalin namu suka tsani bayi musamman tsatson Jafar kuma wannan baiwar dakake ikirari 'yace a cikin zuriar Jafar take kakan Abdulmajid, shi kuma Abdulmajid ai shine mahaifin Bahijja taya hakan zai yuyuwa, dan haka kabar wannan zancen ka shirya gobe iwar haka inje dakai Masarautar Shugaban jagoran musulunci ka zabi mata daga cikin 'yayan ɗiyan kakan ka."

Mamaki yagama rufe Yarima ganin yanda Matawalle ya sauya lokaci guda ya koma bayan mahaifiyar shi,lallai dole yasan abin yi saida bazai iya gardama da Matawalle ba duba da darajar da yake dashi a wajen shi, sake rausayar dakai MalikusSaif yayi yace. "Shikenan Kawu sai dai kasani ba wadda nikeso sai Bahijja ina laifin bawan d aka 'yanta shi dan wata masalaha, ka duba wannan lamarin kudaina daka ta Sarauniya Yahanasu da ra'ayinsu shekaru dari nawa da shuɗewar su yaka mata ace izuwa yanzun mun canza wasu tsare tsaren mubar riko da abinda kaka da kakan ni sukayi akwai cigaba yanzun musamman wajen addini amman Kawu kace zaka biye tsare tsaren wannan Masarautar akwai damu...."kaga Abdulmalik Saifulislam ban tambaye ka wannan zancen ba kuma inkace zaka wulakanta Sarauniya Yahanasu tabbas tamkar kakan ka Abdulhamid ne kai mawa domin kaka ce a wajen mu ka kiyaye, sannan umurni nike baka ka shirya gobe ne zamu tafi inyaso tsakanin Yazid da Huzaifa ko Lurwan kasamu wani yaimaka rakiya mutafi tare zaka iya tafiya."

Cikin girmamawa Yarima Malik ya tashi ya tafi sashen shi yana sake sake dan nemawa kanshi mafita.....


A wajen Bahijja kuwa tana komawa gida ta faɗa bisa tabarmar kabar dakin su tafara rusar kuka kamar ranta zai fita tace.
"Kayi hakuri Ya Malik ban maka adalci ba nazama butulu dana furta kalmar ki ga wanda yaimani rana ya fanshi ni lokacin da rayuwa ke mani barazana ka kwaceni daga makiyana lokacin da mutuncina keneman kubuce mani sannan ka gwadani a cikin dubban jama'a kace ni 'yace yau da bakina na furta wannan kalma gareka Ya Malik, banda wani anfani kayafe mani Yayana.!"


Jitayi ance. "Tabbas ba kunya kikaji ba, koda zaki mutu dolenki ki rabu da Yarima ki tsaya matsayin ki, tunkan duniya taimaka daurin goro ko kuma ni in barranta dake dan haka wajibinki ne ki zabi daya a ciki ko rabuwa damu ko rabuwa da Abdulmalik."

A firgice ta kalli kofa Abdulmajid ne da alama daga wajen aiki ya dawo dan a gajiye yake, ta gefen ta yabi ya wuce yana watsa mata wani mugun kallo, wani makimancin daki ya shiga da alama dakin sane, itako Bahijja game kai da guiwa tayi ta cigaba da kukan ta ahankali tana mai tausayin halin da zata kasance saidai bata da zabi daya wuce tabi umurnin iyayen ta wa'anda suka fuskanci wahala da kalubale a dalilin ta, ganin kukan bazai amfaneta da komai ba hakan yasa ta tashi taje banɗaki sannan tayi alwallah ta kabbara sallah, shima Abdulmajid alwallai yayi jin antada ikima ya tafi masallaci...... 


Washe gari da safe Matawalle da MalikusSaif suka shirya kamar yanda ya umurce shi, zasuyi tafiya biyawa sukayi ta sahen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sukayi mata sallama, addu'a tayi musu da fatan dacewa dan tafi so ɗanta yayi aure a cikin ahalin su, haka suka tafi wajen Saifulislam, lokacin hadiman shi nanan waje suka samu suka zauna cikin kulawa Saifulislam yace. "Matawalle da ɗansa sai ina har haka.?"

Sunkuyar da kanshi Yarima Malik yayi yana gaida mahaifin nashi, cikin so da kauna da uba kema danshi ya amsa yana mai jin tausayin ɗan nashi na ratsa shi har kasan zuciyar shi, Matawalle ne yace. "Zamuje wajen Baffan namu dan yagana da jikan nasa, daga nan saiya fidda matar aure." murmushin girma Saifulislam yayi yace. "Hakan yai kyau, kullin alkhairi muke fata, Allah ya tsare hanya agaidaman sa Kawun nawa, Abdulmalik  a dawo lfy Allah yatsare." "Ameen Abbuh." da haka sukayi sallama suna fitowa ya hadu da Lurwan shima ya shirya a tare suka isa dawaki, kowa ya hau dawakan su, daman already an gyara masu dawakan nasu, sunsha kayan alfarma da ado kamar zasuyi hawan da'ba, haka suka tafi kowa da abinda yake sakawa a cikin zuciyar shi.

Bayan awa biyar lokacin garin yayi sanyi bakajin komai sai kukan tsuntsaye da suketa shawagi a cikin Masarautar Daborah, da yake Masarautar Allah ya albarkace su da abubuwan kiwo musamman jinsin tsuntsaye iri iri, ba kalar da basu dashi, wannan dalilin yasa ake zuwa kasashe daban daban ana siyan iri, musamman central area suketa yawo suna shawagi a saman ginin wajen dole abin ya burgeka, Sarkin gida ne da wasu mutane daga nesa sun shigo cikin Masarautar hanyar sashen Saifulislam ya nufa dasu, jin ya ambaci sunan Tasi'u suna yar fira a hanya hakan yasa nagane ashe su Jakadiyar Masarautar Raifasu da jama'ar su, shiko Tasi'u sai farin ciki yakeyi ganin shi cikin Masarautar su, wanda raban daya takata harya manta sama da shekara sha biyar kenan, sai kalle kalle yakeyi gani yake kamar ansauya komai na Masarautar komai ya koma mashi sabo, ita Jakadiya Aisha tana mamakin kyau da tsaruwa irin na Masarautar Daborah aranta ko cewa tayi kodan lokacin da mukazo Yaki bamuyi yawo cikin Masarautar nan ba, gaskia taimani kyau, lallai komai a tsare yake, haka suka karasa cikin tankameman sashen Saifulislam mai kyau da tasaruwar sashen ga yaji kaya na alatu musamman na gidan Sarauta haka suka shiga cikin falon shi akai masauki a wajen da baki ke zama sannan Jakadiyar Saifulislam ta je sanar mashi da yayi baki, haka kowa ya zauna ya kwance wannan ya saka wannan a cikin ransu, sanyayyar muryar shi ce mai aminci ta karade kunnuwan su, da sallama ya karaso cikin falon, Sarkin gidane ya duka har kasa cikin girmamawa yace.
"Allah yataimaki Kangiwa Khadimulislam, kayi baki masu mahimmanci daga Masatautar Raifasu, sunce kai kadai sukeson sugani, kallan Sarkin gida yayi yace.
"Ka kyauta Mubarak aikin ka na kyau, zaka iya tafiya, zaunawa yayi bisa kujerar shi ta alfarma sannan ya kalle su cikin mutuntuwa, yana maida duban shi wajen matashin daya duka yana bashi hannu ga mamakin shi, yaga Tasi'u cikin jin dadi yace.
"Tasi'u yau kaine a mahaifa, ashe da rabon rai kanga rai ina su Nulwa.?"sunkuyar dakan shi Tasiu yayi yana mai jin radadin rasa ɗan uwan shi da yayi yace. "Allah yaima Nulwa rasuwa." cikin jimami Saifulislam yace. "Allah yaimashi rahama." baki dayan su suka amsa da Ameen, Tasiu ne yai gyaran murya yace. "Allah yataimaki Kangiwa muna tafe da babban al'amari da farko kaga wannan sunan ta Aisha itace Jakadiya a Masarautar mu, muna tafe da wani kokan bara agareku amman ance waka a bakin mai ita tafi dadi ga sakonan daga Sarkin Raifasu yace kada muba kowa sai kai wannan sakon nakane, Allah yataimaki uban gidana Kadimulislam."

Mika mashi yai ya ansa cike da alhini a cikin zuciyar Saifulislam, yana mamakin dalilin da zaisa  Sarki Baidulƙais ya aiko mashi da wasika ba Zulaiƙa ba, budewa yayi yafara karan tawa..... 


 _Bayan gaisuwa irin ta addinin musulunci, Assalamu-alaikum waharahamatullahi, wabarakatuhu, daga Sarki Muhammad Raifasu zuwa da Kadimulislam inamai sanar dakai cewa Masarauta ta da al'umma ta mun karɓi addinin islama dan haka munyi mubaya'a a kalkashin tutar musulunci ta hanyar 'yarku Bahijja lallai hudda da mutanen ku ya zama alkhairi agaremu baki, daya fatan zaka anshi kokon barata, saidai akwai kalubale da muke fuskanta a wajen Sarrilƙus muna fatan zaku kawo mana ɗauki cikin gaggawa, bissalam daga Masarautar Raifasu zuwa ga Saifulislam._ 


Sauke sanyayyar ajiyar zuciya yayi yana mai sauka bisa kujerar da yake, yayi sujuda ya gadema Allah harda kwallan dadi yayi yace "tabbas godiya ta tabbata ga Allah da ya nuna mana wannan lokaci mai dinbin daraja ga al'ummar musulunci tabbas ta hanyar wani wani ke shiryuwa yau gashi Bahijja tazama haske a cikin Raifasu da wannan addinin namu baki ɗaya, inamai jin dadi yanda kuka musulunta yau Sarki Baidulƙais ne ke ansa sunan Sarki Muhammad suna mafi daraja wanda yafi komai tabbas wannan abin alfaharine a garemu, Jakadiya mun anshi kokon bararku, darajar ku a cikin wannan addinin yafi karfin bara domin ku masu darajane, dan haka yanzun yaka mata kuje ku huta, kai kuma Tasiu kaje kaga dangi, bari inkira Hajara tabaki masauki,  Mairo kiraman Jakadiya, haka Mairo taje ta kira Jakadiyar Saifulislam tana zuwa ta duka ta gaida shi, cikeda sakin fuska yace.
"Ka kawa kuma Jakadiyar Raifasu kije kibata masauki su huta saidai minene sunan ki baiwar Allah.?" murmushi tayi tana mai jin so da kaunar Saifulislam na ratsata tace. "Aisha sunana." wani irin dadi yaji yace. "Kinsamu suna mai daraja sunan uwar mumunai, Allah yabaki ikon yin koyo da halayen ta." Ameen Jakadiya tace, sannan suka tafi da Hajara har gidan ta dan bata daki domin ta samu ta huta.

➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿➿

A wajen su MalikusSaif kuwa sun shigo cikin babban birnin Gambia inda nanne Masarautar da Kawun Sarauniya Zulaiƙa yake Mulki suna isa cikin Masarautar da ta gaji da kayatuwa iya haduwa ga hadimai da bayi nata gittaya da alama suna aikine kasancewar yau kamar ranar aiki take a wajen su, suna shiga Sarkin gida yafara fadanci ganin su Matawalle har cikin tsakiyar fadar yakai su inda suka shiga wajene dayake tankam da fadawa kama daga Dagaci, Dan biram, Kangiwa Ɗan zagi, Sarkin Yaki, Mai yaki, Magatakarda, Limamin Fa'da, Sarkin Fa'da, Kangiwa, Galadima, Majidadi, Ɗan isa, da dai sauran manyan ƴan Fa'da sai dogarawa na gefen Sarki suna mashi fiffita, koda aka shigo dasu Matawalle Sarki yana ganin su ya saki wani irin kayataccen murmushi mai ɗauke da ma'anoni iri iri Sarkin Fa'da ne yace, barkan ku da zuwa Masarautar Musulunci ta Gambia, angaishe da Matawalle barkanku da zuwa, zama sukayi gefen su, Matawalle ne yace. "Ranka shidade angaishe da Sarkin Musulunci Matawalle na gaisuwa da ɗanka MalikusSaif muna fatan munsameku cikin aminci.?" ɗan zagine yace.
"Takawa ya amsa Matawalle yana gaisheku yanai maku barka da zuwa sannan yasa albarka ga Yarima MalikusSaif, jika ga Sarki Abduljabbar na III, _*Masarautar Runo*_ tanai maku harhaban."
wani murmushi Sarkin Runo ya saki yana mai ɗaga ma Sarkin zagi hannu alamun ya isa cikin kasaita ta Sarakai ya bude baki a hankali yace......

Episode 87&88




"Ina mai farin ciki dajin dadin wannan ziyarar da kukawo mani musamman da kazo mani da jikan nawa, mafi soyuwa agreni, lallai kam Abduljabbar dole jinjina maka,domin inka biye ta Zulaiƙa abubuwa sun sha mata kai bazata iya nuna mashi dangi ba, ga Kangiwa ba mazaunin gida bane, ɗana matso kusa da kakan ka, nan Masarautar kuce baka da shamaki da komai Abdulmalik."

SARKI ABU-JALAL kenan shugaba mai adalci da sanin darajar ɗan adam ga kaunar talakawa da kimanta bayi komai kaskancin bawa, bai yarda ya wulakanta shiba dan ainahin tutar musuluncin ta kasar Gambia a cikin Masarautar Runo aka kafata shiyasa Masarautar ta zama ta musulunci, ananne Kangiwa wato Saifulislam ya kara ɗabbaka addinin musulunci a cikin Masarautar Daborah har suka rage riko da addinin kaka da kakanni, shiyasa mutanen Masarautar Daborah da ke wayenta suke mashi inkiya da Kadimulislam...
shiko Sarki Abu-Jalal shine babban ɗan Sarki Abu-Dawud, wanda ya gaji Sarauta daga kakansu Abu-Kawwas na II har zuwa asalin wanda ya kafa tutar musuluncin a cikin Masarautar Runo wato Abu-Jabbar na I shine wa ga kakan su Sarauniya Yahanasu wato Sarki Abduljabbar duk iyayen su ɗaya da Sarki Abu-Jabbar, shiyasa Masarautar Daborah da Masarautar Runo duk daga tsatso ɗaya suke, wannan dalilin yasa duk abinda ABU-JALAL zai aiwatar a cikin Daborah basu iya yimashi musu, domin ubane agare su, wannan kadan daga cikin tarihin Masarautar Runo.


Sunkuyar da kanshi MalikusSaif yayi yana mai yaba tsari na Masarautar Runo, dan yaji ABU-JALAL ya shiga cikin zuciyar shi kamar mahaifin shi haka yakejin shi, cikin girmamawa yace.
"Godiya nike ranka shidade Allah yakara girma da ɗaukaka." hannun shi Abu-Jalal yasa bisa kan MalikusSaif yace.
"Ɗana insha Allah saika zama jigo ga makaskanta mutane a cikin Masarautar ka dama kewayen ta, sannan zaka zama haske tsakanin duhu, zaka zama silar warwarewa tsakanin karya da gaskia Allah yaimaka albarka ya kareka daga makiyanka ɗana inaji a jikina akwai babban al'amari a tare dakai Abdulmalik, dan haka yanzun zakuje ku huta zuwa safiya zamu sake ganawa, Sarkin gida akaimin ɗana cikin sashena abashi masauki na musamman, Matawalle kuje ku huta, ya sunan abokin tafiyar taku.?"
ɗan taɓe fuska Matawalle yayi yace "Lurwan, sannnan ya kuma cewa. "Ranka shidade dan kaga ɗan ka shine zaka yada Matawalle ina laifin kabari inkai shi Masaukina tunda inada shashena."
murmushi ABU-JALAL yayi yace. "Aa a sashena zai zauna kafin agyara mashi nashi masaukin kai dai kaje naka,kaida bakon ka."
mikewa sukayi suka tafi Sarki Abu-Jalal yana karajin son Yarima Malik na kara ratsashi ta kowane sashe na jikin shi, saidai rabi tausayin sane yafi rinjayar shi, dan yasan yana fuskantar kalubale musamman a magauta da suka saka Masarautar Daborah a gaba dan cimma burukan su akanta.

Koda MalikusSaif ya shiga sashen SARKI ABU-JALAL wani irin sanyi yaji yana ratsa shi hakanan yaji wani irin aminci ya dabaibaye shi ya samu nustuwa cikin zuciyar shi, Yarima Dawud ne yakai shi cikin wani katafaren daki daya ƙayatu da kayan alfarma na SARAKAI wani irin kafcecen royal din gado ne fari kyal yanata ɗaukar ido yana sheki, cikin sakin fuska Yarima Dawud yace.
"Abokina ga ɗakin ka, ka huta yanzun ka shiga kayi wanka duk abinda zaka bukata akwai shi a cikin wardrofe." murmushi MalikusSaif yayi duk da yau yafara ganin Dawud sai yaji tamkar ya shekara suna tare, sai dai yai mashi kama da Matawalle kwabo da kwabo musamman yanayin maganar su iri ɗayane, fuska sake Yarima Malik yace.
"Nagode Kawu na, sannu da kokari." dafa kafadar Malik yayi yace. "Kacancanta Abdulmalik, bari inbarka ka huta." tafiya yayi shiko MalikusSaif rage kayan jikin shi yayi sannan ya shiga wanka.

A wajen Sarki Abu-Jalal kuwa yana tasowa da daga fa'da lokacin yamma yayi sashen shi ya wuce da zugar fadawan shi Sarkin zagi sai koda shi yakeyi, yana zuwa bakin shiga part din nashi suka dakata, sannan yai masu sallama Sarkin zagine ke cewa. 
"Shigar ka lfy,Allah ya sadaka, da mafificin alkhairin wannan daren, ya kare damarka da haggun ka, angaishe da shugaba adali SARKIN RUNO."
haka ya shiga cikin ni'imtaccen sashen nashi ɗauke da sallama a bakin shi, ba kowa cikin sashen hakan yasa ya shiga cikin kayataccen ɗakin shi danyin wanka ya huta. 

Shiko MalikusSaif fargaba yaji lokaci guda ya dirar mashi a cikin zuciya musamman daya tuna dalilin shi na zuwa wannan Masarautar, komawa yayi bisa gadon dake gafen damar shi ya zauna dauke da bisimillah a bakin shi, tunanin Bahijja ne fal a cikin ranshi yai mashi katutu duk motsin da zaiyi saita fado mashi a cikin rai musamman da ya tuna kalaman da tagaya mashi na bata *SON* shi, a hankali ya rufe idanun shi, a bangare ɗaya kuma nauyin Huzaifa ne ya rufe shi nakin ansar soyayyar kanwar shi, jin sallamar da akayine yasa shi maida kallan shi wajen mai shigowa ga mamaki yaga Sarki Abu-Jalal, cikin ƙimantawa da girmamawa MalikusSaif ya dan rankwafa yana gaida kakan nashi, zama gefen gadon SARKI ABU-JALAL yayi sannan yace.
"Ɗana tashi zauna kusa da Abi dinka, tashi Yarima Malik yayi ya zauna, gefen kakan nashi, kallan shi yayi cikin kulawa yace. "Abdulmalik inafatan bakada wata matsala ko.?"
ɗan shiru yayi kamar bazaiyi magana ba, sai kuma yace.
"Eh Abi banda wata matsala." nazarin yanayin Malik ya shiga yi na dakikai sannan yace. "Shikenan Abdulmalik yanda kace saidai kasani karka ɓoyeman komai ɗana rabona dakai sama da shekara ishirin kenan raban da inganka Abdulmalik saidai kasani bantaɓa kwana ba na tashi ba tareda nayi begenka ba a cikin zuciya taba, tareda tausayin ka, kazama jajirrtacce ɗana, bangaren Jarumta kayi koyi da halin Sarauniya Yahanasu, bangaren daddako da sanin yaka mata kaikoyi da SARKI Abdulhamid, sannan bangaren ilimi kayi koyi da SARKI Abu-jabbar na II haka zalika wajen aiki da ilimi kayi koyi da Kangiwa mutumina mutumin kirki masanin addini mai hakuri da sanin ya kamata Kadimulislam bawan Allah, kaga waɗan mutanen ba kananan mutane bane, kasan misaya nike maka wannan maganar?" girgizar kanshi yayi alamun aaa, sanin halin rashin yin maganar Yarima Malik tun yana Yaro yasa baidamu ba dan baiyi magana ba danma yanzun da alama ya sauya cewa yayi. "Saboda rayuwar da zaka fuskanta nan gaba kadan Abdulmalik."sauke ajiyar zuciya yayi yace. "Insha Allah Abi zanyi duk yanda kace sai dai Abdulmalik zaiso yayi koyi da irin halin SARKI ABU-JALAL shine tauraro na dan na gamsu da kalar mulki da adalci dayake gabatarwa akan talakawan sa lallai wannan mutumin shine abin koyi na, domin yana koyi da koyawar ma'aiki Annabi Muhammad (SAW) duk wanda yairiko da ma'aiki tabbas yayi riko da igiya mai kwarin gaske, fatana a duk lokacin da Abdulmalik yayi kuskure yana neman afuwa sannan a nuna MalikusSaif hanyar tsira da zaibi dan kyautata rayuwar sa."

Murmushi mai faɗi Abu-Jalal yayi yana mai son ɗan nashi jiyayi inama zuri'arsu su amince tabbas da MalikusSaif ya gaje shi sai dai zasuce a ɗan mace yazo kuma Masarautar Runo ba Masarauta bace da ake mulkin kama karya ba kamar Masarautar Daborah, su Sarukana ne garesu basu da Sarauniya wannan dalilin shine ya dakile kudirin Abu-Jalal akan ɗansa Malik tsawan shekaru ashirin da biyar, sauke nauyayyen ajiyar zuciya yayi sannan yace.
"Allah yaimaka albarka Abdulmalik, tashi muje falo an shirya mana wajen cin abinci, kaji nasan halinka da kawaici ka dauki kanka tamkar Abu-Jalal." murmushi yayi cikin jin dadi sai yaji inama ace ya dawwama a cikin Masarautar Runo zaifi mashi kwanciyar hankali, ba kamar inyana tare da Ummun shiba tana ɗagama shi hankali, idanun shi suka kawo ruwa yace.
"Tabbas Abi samun kaka kamar ka abune mai dadin gaske MalikusSaif yana godiya."
murmushin manya yayi yace. "Abdulmalik bazan matsamaka akan ka faɗa mani abinda ke damunka ba, saidai kasani nasan kana cikin damuwa, ba wannan ba muci abinci ɗana." da kanshi ya zuba ma MalikusSaif abinci, farin tuwon shinkafane miyar agushi da miyan ƴan ciki a gefe guda kuma farfesun 'kaji ne, haka aka ya zuba masu a flat daya suka fara cin abinci kowa da abinda  yake sakawa a cikin zuciyar shi.

Washe gari da safe a Masarautar Daborah Saifulislam ne zaune a falon shi dayake karɓar baki dasu Tasi'u sai Jakadiya Aisha a gefen damar shi kuwa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce sai Waziri Dammur, magana Saifulislam yafara yace. 

"Assalamu-alaikum."
Baki ɗayan su suka da "Wa'alaikums-salam." numfasawa yayi sannan yace.
"Dalilin dayasa na taraku nan wajen ba dan wani abuba saidan muhimmin lamari daya tunkaromu inamai farin cikin sanar daku cewa cikin manyan Masarautun mu na ƙasar Gambia, ansamu Masarautar data karbi addinin musulunci wannan ba wata Masarauta bace face Masarautar Raifasu,  Sarki Muhammad wanda kowa yafi sani da Sarki Baidulƙais ya anshi  addini musulunci da dukkan jama'ar shi, dan haka nikeson su zama daga cikin mu kamar yanda addini ya haɗamu yan uwantaka, dole mukasance majibantan junanmu domin hadisi ingantacce mazan Allah SAW yace, Musulmi da musulmi yan uwan junane domin sashen su yana taimakawa sashe,musulmi yataimaka ma ɗan uwansa kada yaci zarafin sa ko ha'intar shi ko kuma cin zarafin sa, kunga da wannan hadisin kadai zaku san girman addinin musulunci, da darajar yan uwan taka, da haka nike cewa zamuyi haɗaka da Masarautar Raifasu domin Yakar Sarrilƙus domin yanzun shine kadai damuwar Sarki Muhammad, shi keso yai kawoma Masarautar nakasu, to bazamu laminta ba dole muɗauki mataki sosai wajen darkake wannan mutumin mushiriki da karfin ikon Allah."

Nauyayyen numfashi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi tana al'ajabin lamarin fuska a sake tace. "Alhmdullh wannan labarin yafi kowane labari daɗin sauraro tabbas nida jama'a ta a kalkashin tutar musulunci ta jagoranci shugaban mu Kadimulislam munyi mubaya'a zamuyi duk wani kokarin ganin ankawo karshen wannan mutumin da ikon Allah." kallan Tasi'u tayi tace. "Naji dadi kwarai Tasi'u da Allah yasa Sarki Muhammad ya zama daga cikin mu, sannan ya maganar addinin nasu da ilimin su." a cikin zuciyar Saifulislam kuwa cewa yayi. "Hmmm dubeta sai kace mai aiki da ilimin ta, tana aiki da ilimi zata kyamaci yar uwar ta musulma dan kawai ta fita fifiko a idan mutane, kilan ma tafita daraja a wajen uban gijin ta, mtsw Zulaiƙa baki gane yare mai tsafta da sannu zaki hankalta."

Tasi'u ne yace. "Ranki shidade muna basu ilimin addini a cikin abinda mukasani, saidai muna barar malamai daga cikin wannan Masarautar tamu mai albarka ta Daborah."

Murmushi tayi tace. "ta hannun wa kuka karɓi wannan addinin mai daraja.?" Aisha ce tace. "Ranki shidade munkarɓi wannan addinin ta hannun kankanuwa saidai tafi komai daraja a garemu gata baiwa amman aikin bauta bai hanata aikata addinin ta, a sirrance ba, kyawawan dabi'un ta da hakurin ta da girmama na gaba da ita, shine yasa mukayi kwadayin shiga cikin wannan addinin na musulunci, ba wata bace sai Bahijja hadimar Baidulƙais a da, wannan shine asalin ansar wannan addini na musulunci, Allah ya azirtani da shiga cikin sa, daga bisani kuma shugaban mu, ya anshi addinin musulunci har kashi ukku cikin hudu na Masarautar mu suka anshi wannan addinin sannan Tasi'u da sauran bayin ku da kuka bamu su sukaci gaba da koyar damu addini dai dai gwalgwado kinji asalin musuluntar mu." duk da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa taji dadi yanda suka musulunta sai tasamu kanta cikin hassada wa Bahijja da tazama jigo a cikin wannan tafiyar domin itace mafari, Saifulislm ne yace. 

"Yanzun zakuje kuci abinci ku huta,kafin ku wuce zuwa gobe kamar yanda kuka bukata, saidai inaso kusani idan ɗana Malik ya dawo zamuzo Masarautar taku, sannan duk wani motsi da kukaji daga wannan matsafin kuyi gaggawar sanar damu, zamu sameku cikin aminci da karfin izzar Allah SWT, infatan kowa zaije dan hutawa." haka suka tafi suna maijin dadin yanda aka anshesu cikin mutuntawa..... 

Daga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sai Saifulislam da kuma Waziri Dammur, wani irin kallo Saifulislam ya watsa masu sannan yace.
"Kunga yanda Allah yake ɗaukaka darajar dan Adam wanda kake ganin matsiyaci ko kaskantacce sai kaga Allah ya daga darajar shi, ta inda ba'ai tsammani ba, yau ga baiwa yar bawa jikar bayi tattaɓa kunnen bayi wadda akema inkiya da kaskantacciya ta zama silar shiriyar dubun nan mutane, wannan wace irin daukaka ce da tafi wannan a idan duniya da wajen Allah SWT, yau Allah ya fara nuna darajar baiwa, tabbas haihuwar baiwa yai rana, wanda Allah yasa sai ya rayu ba wanda ya isa yai ajalinsa yau ga jaririyar nan da akaso a halaka saboda son zuciya Allah yasa ta rayu har tayi silarta mutane masu ƙima masuji da mulki ga taurin zuciya sun musulinta aiko bawa ba abin wulakantawa bane sannan *bayima 'ya'yane* kamar kowa tunda suma haihuwar su akayi ya kikaji wannan labarin Ummu Malik?"

Mikewa tayi cikin gadara tace. "Abu Malik kenan inasa ita baiwar ta silata taje Masarautar da har ta musulintar da wasu, da kake ikirari, kuma ai Allah ya kaddara zasu anshi addinin musulunci ta kowace hanya."

Murmushi yayi mai ciwo ganin uwar ɗanshi naima kankanuwar yarinya hassada yace.
"Kigyara zancen ki Zulaiƙa, a dalilin Abdulmalik dai tunda shine silar zuwan ta Raifasu  bake ba, dan haka kisa aranki Zulaiƙa wlh bakin da Allah ya nufa da cara ko ana mazuru ana shaho wlh sai yayi, kai kuma kabiyema son zuciya kana zigata kujuri zuwa rafi indai rayuwa ce.....

tashi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi rai ɓace  ta tafi tana kara tsanar Bahijja aranta dan akan tane kaɗai Saifulislam yake iya gaya mata magana son ranshi hakama akantane kadai ɗanta yafara bijirema umurnin ta.

Washe gari da safe,a ɓangaren Jakadiyar Saifulislam wato Hajara, zaune suke tareda Aisha, suna ɗan zantawa Aisha ce tace.......

 toh Jakadiya Hajara tace, sannan ta fita, itako Aisha saijin dadi takeyi yau zataga Bahijja, bada jimawaba kuwa Hajara ta dawo ta zauna gefen Aisha cikin kulawa tace. "Yawwa nasa akiramin ita, insha Allah yanzun kuwa zaki ganta." takarasa maganar fuska a sake sunaci gaba da firan su.

 _MASARAUTAR RUNO_

Sarki Abu-Jalal zaune a cikin katafaren falon shi dake tsakiyar sashen shi wanda ya kawatu da kayan more rayuwa ta yau da gobe, gefen daman shi 'yayan shine mata dana 'yan uwan shi kyawawan gaske, a gefen shi na haggu kuwa 'yayan shine maza kama dasu Yarima maijiran gado dasu dagaci da sauran yayan dangi sai saman kujerar dake gefe n hannun damar shi Yarima Malik ne sai a haggu kuma Matawalle ne sauran kujerun da sukaima falon zagaye matan sa ne sai mahaifiyar shi har yanzun tana raye wadda itace matsayin kaka agaresu, kowa yayi shiru yana jiran yaji abunda Sarki Abu-Jalal zaice ɗan gyaran murya yayi ya maida hankalin kan su bayan yai masu sallama, duk suka amsa, cikin dattijan taka yace. 

" ina ma kowa barka da zuwa wannan taron kamar yanda kukaji ance ina neman ku,haka abin yake nasa akiraman ku dan ingabatar maku da babban ɗa, ko kuma ince jikana Abdulmalik da baffan shi yakawo shi dan yaimani ziyara wannan dalilin yasa nace akiraman ku don in nuna maku ɗan uwan naku ya ganku kuma ku ganshi, kunsan girma da darajar dake cikin *zumunci* dan haka kunga Abdulmalik ina san duk kugabatar mashi da kanku, kuma ɗa ne ga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ƴar Sarki Abdulhamid nasan kunada labarin ta da _MASARAUTAR DABORAH_ baki ɗayan ta."
 baki ɗayan su,duk suka amsa da eh.

Jin nasabar MalikusSaif sai yasa duk sauran matan suka dinga kus kus da baki ga sai kallan shi sukeyi shiko kanshi kasa yanajin yanda kakan nashi keta jawabi, yana murza zoben azirfar dake sake a hannun shi jin ankuma magana ne yasa ya ɗago kyakyawar fuskar shi ya kalli mai magana, Yarima Dawud ne yace. "Kamar yanda kasani nine Yarima Dawud, inaimaka barka da zuwa cikin dangi a Masarautar Runo lafiya." gyada kai yayi tareda yin smile alamun ya amsa, haka kowa ya dinga fadan sunan shi har zuwa "Abdulbasir wanda shine karami a cikin jerin maza na yayan Sarki Abu-Jalal, a bangaren mata kuwa cikin isa da kasaita wata kyakkawar budurwa tace.
"Sunana gimbiya Hafsat, sannan munji dadin kasancewa a cikin mu."shidai da ido ya bita ganin tana ta wannan yatsina da gani dai ba ragi a wajen ta kauda kanshi yayi take yaji batai mashi ba, baisan wuce wuri,haka dai akai ta gabatarma junan su kansu har zuwa karshe inda wata matashiyar yarinya tace.
"Sunana gimbiya Maimoon munaimak barka d zuwa." samun kanshi yayi da murmusawa yanda tai maganar sai yaga taimashi yanayi da Bahijja duk da kana ganin ta kaga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa dan kamar copying din tace, haka kawai yaji ta kwanta mashi arai duk da bazata wuce shekara sha biyu ba a duniya, bayan sungama Sarki Abu-Jalal ya nuna mahaifiyar shi yace.
"Ga Hajjanan mamana kenan sunanta gimbiya Yahanasu, sai wannan babbar matata ce sunan ta gimbiya Mulaika, sai wannan ita kebin ta ita kuma gimbiya Marawiyya, sai ɗayar itace gimbiya Hamdiya, sune kakan ninka Abdulmalik."

Murmushi yayi cikin girmama kakan nashi yace. "Nagode Abi da girmamawar ku a gareni ina fatan Allah yasa albarka da aminci agaremu baki ɗaya." shafa sumar kanshi Abu-Jalal yayi suka ya amsa da Ameen sannan ya sallami kowa baki ɗayan su suka fita, Yarima Dawud ne ya riko hannun YarimaMalik suka tafi wanda yake nan danan da Malik tamkar sun dade tare sai yawo yakeyi dashi sashe sashe na *MASARAUTAR* yana kai shi gidajen yan uwa da wuraren tarihi na cikin Masarautar, koda kowa yagama fita ya rage daga Matawalle sai Sarki Abu-Jalal, sunkuyar da kanshi Matawalle yayi yace.
"Baffa daman inada muhimmiyar magana data kawoni a cikin wannan Masarautar kuma zancen nan nakane." ɗan rausayar dakan shi Abu-Jalal yayi yana mai nazartar ɗan nashi cikeda nitsuwa yace. "Inajinka Abduljabbar." saukowa yayi kasa ya tankwashe kafar shi sannan yace. "Daman zuwan nan danayi nazone da Abdulmalik domin ya duba cikin 'yayan dangi ya zaɓi matar da zai aura yaka mata ace zuwa yanzun Malik yana da iyali." 

Murmushi Abu-Jalal yayi irin nasu na manyan Sarakai, shi kanshi yaji dadin hakan saidai yana fatan Allah yasa a ciki a samu wadda tayima MalikusSaif dan irin son dayake mashi bazai laminci aimashi auren haɗi ba,  cikeda dattako irin na mutanen kirki masu kamala da sanin yaka mata yace.
"Kunyi tunani mai kyau saidai kasani inada nawa sharadin Abduljabbar." jiyayi gaban shi ya tsinke dan bai cika son Baffan nasu na saka sharadi ba inzaiyi magana yasan halin shi kaifi ɗaya ne, cewa yayi. "Nimai biyayya ne ga duk wani sharadin ka Baffa"cikin jin dadi yace.
"Inhar kasan akwai wadda Abdulmalik keso bansan ka boyeman kuma abishi da zabin shi kar atankwashe shi, sannan idan har ba wadda taima Abdulmalik a cikin yaran nan shikenan nidai ban yarda ba kuma ban laminta ba aima Abdulmalik auren dole bs, abar shi da aikin magauta da suka tisa Masarautar Daborah a gaba, yaji da wannan tashin hankalin ina fatan kagane Abduljabbar." da sauri yace.
"Allah yataimaki Sarkin Runo Abdulmalik ya gode da wannan adalci, saidai zamuji ta bakin shi." cikeda gamsuwa ya rausayar dakai yana mai matsa yatsun hannun sa a hankali suna bada sautin kara, duk da ya tsufa sabida Abu-Jalal zaikai kimami shekara casa'in da bakwai a duniya, cikin zuriar su daga shi sai dagaci kanin shi sai kanwar gimbiya Murjana sukadai suka rage sauran duk sun rasu saidai sun bar tarin zuriar wannan dalilin yasa su Sarauniya Zulaiƙa basu iya ketare umurnin Abu-Jalal, sai mahaifiyar shi gimbiya Yahanasu da take da kimamin shekara ɗari da goma sha biyu a duniya ta tsufa damma hutu ke dannne tsufan da shekarun.......

~DABORAH~ 


Koda baiwar da Jakadiya Hajara ta aika kiran Bahijja tana isa gidan su Bahijjar ta isketa  tana yin sikola saidai azahiri take sikolar amman zuciyar cike yake da damuwa mai tarin yawa, gashi yau ta tashi tana matsanancin ciwon ciki kasancewar  watan ta yaka mata na period din ta shiyasa take abubuwa a sukuku ba wani hanzari a tattare da ita, jin nataɓata yasata juyowa a tsorace kuma take takarajin cikin nata yakara kullewa dan ta firfita ko sallama batajiba, ganin wanda ke kantane yasata sakin ajiyar zuciya lokaci guda, a daddafe tace.
"Salame lfy kuwa.?" murmushi tayi tace. "Kedai Bahijja narasa mike damunki tun ɗazun nike rafka uwar sallama amman kamar matatta wlh ki kiyayi kanki kinada karancin shekarunki kike damuwa irin wannan.?" murmushi kawai tayi tareda rausayar da kanta, bata kuma cewa komai, Salame ce tace. "Ina Kawu yake inasan ingan shi." ɗan taune lips din ta Bahijja tayi alamun tanajin jiki tace.
"Yaje gidan Baba idi kinsan dai naji ance Ya Tasi'u yazo saidai ban tabbatar da hakan ba, shine yafita." numfasawa Salame tayi ɗiyar kanwar Abdulmajid ce Ladidi, cikin kulawa tace. "Kinga idan nabiye wannan inuwar mangoran zan iya shafa'a da aikina sannan in mance sakon da aka aikoni gareki." jitayi gabanta ya tsinke bugun zuciyar yana lunkuwa Allah yasa harbata son taji ance ana kiran ta, tasan ukuba da azaba zata sha tafahimci ba wani alkhairy ga kiran da ake mata, wani bangaren na zuciyar ta kuwa tan tausan yanda dangin ta suketa bauta, abin yazamar masu gado, amman haka Allah ya tsara, a sanyaye tace. "Wake kirana Salame." numfasawa tayi tace. "Jakadiya ke nemanki a sashn ta." ɗan rufe idanun ta tayi sannan ta wanke hannun ta dake cikin botikin wanki da takeyi ta mike da kyal tace. Wani sanyi MalikusSaif yaji ya lullube zuciyar shi, yanaji a jikin shi zai mallaki Bahijja, maganar da Abu-Jalal yayi shiya dawo dashi a cikin duniyar tunanin daya tafi, Abu-Jalal ne yace. " masha Allah kasaki ranka Abdulmalik kaji ni mahaifinka ne, duk abinda bai gimsheka ka aikomin da kaina zanzo." kwantar dakanshi Malik yayi gefen kafadar nashi, yanajin so da kaunar shi na ratsa shi yace. "Nagode Abi Allah yakara girma." da ameen ya amsa, nan sukaci gaba da zantawa

Washe gari da safe ranar ne su MalikusSaif zasu dawo gida, tunda suka gama shiryawa suke zaune cikin falon Sarki Abu-Jalal basujima ba sosai ya fito cikin kayan alfarma na Sarakai kallansu yayi yana mai mikoma Abdulmalik hannu, tashi yayi yaje wajen kakan nasu rungume shi yayi yanajin kewar shi na ratsa shi ta kowane kofan gashi da yake cikin jikin shi, atare suka zauna, Matawalle ne da Lurwan suka gaishe da Sarki Abu-Jalal, cikin sakin fuska yace. "Umurnina ne ba shawara ba Abduljabbar, inafatan Allah yakaiku lfy." "Ameen ya rabbi." cewar Matawalle, kanshi yagama kullewa dan kamar gargaɗi Baffan nasu kemasu alamin yasan komai, to ta yaya?  baida amsa tambayar shi jiyayi ya kuma cewa. "Abdulmalik kakulaman da kanka zanyi kewar ka ɗana." murmushi yayi yace "insha Allah Abi nima ina kewarka." da haka suka gama abinda zasuyi sannan kowa ya hau dawakan su, sukai masu rakiya zuwa iyakar gari sannan suka tafi Sarki Abu-Jalal yana ɗaga masu hannu, jiyake inama Abdulmalik yadawo wajen shi baki daya saidai suka ɓacema ganin su sannan suka koma cikin Masarautar Runo...

"Kayi hakuri Huzaifa wlh mugun nauyinka nikeji kaima kasan in lfy ya zanyi tafiya baku da labari, kunsan dole inyi tafiyar nan daku, gaskia bansan da wane ido zan kalleku ba, dubi yanda na guji kanwar ka Zahara'u kuma 'yar uwata taya zan iya gaya maku zanyi tafiya."
sauke ajiyar zuciya Huzaifa yayi yace. "Wlh Malik banrike da komai tabbas innace banji dadi na nayi karya, dan inna ga Zahara'u na kuka nakanji tamkar in taya ta, saidai nasan baka da maganin damuwar ta, saboda kaima irin wannan yanayin kake ciki, ko nine abinda kayi shine zanyi Abdulmalik kada kadamu." murmushi yayi yace. "Naji dadi daka fahimceni saidai nayi abin kunya na guji kwanwata yanzun haka so nike inhana kaina son Bahijja wlh nakasa Huzaifa." cikin tausayawa sukace. "Addu'a takobin mumuni itace mafita Yarima." kallan Yazid yayi yace. "Kayi hakuri Yazid tuna abinda naima Zahara'u gabanka shiya hana ingaya maka zanyi tafiya duk kunyar ku dajin nauyin ku ya addabeni."
"Haba Yarima mai adalci da sanyin hali karka damu insha Allah lamarinka da Bahijja alkhairi ne." rausayar dakai yayi nan sukaci gaba da yar firar su, kiran sallar magrib ne yasa suka tashi kowa yai alwalla suka tafi masallaci

Haka rayuwa ta cigaba da tafiya a cikin Daborah ba dadi musamman wajen Bahijja da iyeyen ta, sai Yarima Malik  da yake cikin matsanan ciyar damuwa

Bayan kwana goma da wowar su, MalikusSaif kuma yai dai dai da kwanan Bahijja shabiyu a gidan kaso, Yarima Malik ne zaune bisa sallaya da alama yagama sallar walaha, a cikin falon shi yanata lazimi, jin anyi sallama yasa ya jinjina jikin bangon da yake a gefen hannun damar shi, Mairo ce ta shigo hannun ta ɗauke da kwaryar fura ta duka tana gaida MalikusSaif cikin girmamawa sannan tace. "Allah yataimaki magajin gobe furane Mai girma Kangiwa yace inkawo maka." murmushi yayi ɗan shi Malik mutun ne mai fara'a duk da bai fiyasan hayaniya ba, kuma shi baida girman kai, ba ruwan shi da matsayin ka ko kaskancin ka, zai iya sakarma kowa fuska cikeda annuri baijin komai, hannu yasa ya anshi furar yana cewa. "Sannun ku da kokari kice Abdulmalik ya gode." 

Cikin jin dadi tace. "Kahuta lfy magajin gobe, har zata fita sai kuma ya kirawo ta dawowa tayi ta duka tace. "Ranka shidade gani."

A nutse yace."Wai ina Bahijja tunda na dawo bangan taba, ko bata lfy.?"
Shiru tayi kamar ba zatayi magana ba sai kuma tace. "A gaskia Yarima yau kimamin kwana shabiyu kenan Bahijja na gida Kaso a kulle."

Wani irin daram haka yaji gaban shi ya yanke ya faɗi, inalillahi wa'inna ilaihir raji'un yace sannan yace. "Shine baku faɗaman ba?" "ranka shidade tayaya kasan ba wanda ya isa ya shigo sashen ka saida babban dalili." mikewa yayi yai gaba, bai kuma cewa komai ba, bayan shi tabi, ga wata iriyar yunwa yana ji, amman saiyaji ta tafi baki ɗayan ta, dan raban da yaci abinci mai nauyi harya manta saboda fargaba, direct gidan yari ya wuce masu kula da wajen ne suka zube suka kwashi gaisuwa, baiko ansaba ya shige ciki tareda sa mai kula da gidan yakai shi gun Bahijja, duk da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta hana kowa yaje gunta, amman kwarjini da haiba irin ba Malik yasa sun kasa yagama shi sharaɗin uwar gijiyar tasu, har bakin ɗakin ta da take kulle aka kaishi sawa yayi aka fiddo ta, a hankali ta fito idanuwan sune suka sarke dana juna da sauri ta juya mashi baya jin wani abu ya dira cikin zuciyar ta, matsowa yayi muryar shi na breaking yace.....

Episode 95&96




"Kanwarr Ma-li-kk mikikeyi nan!?" yanda yayi maganar take saida tsikar jikin Bahijja ta tamike tsaye wani yarrr yarr, sannan bataji zata iya kallan kwayar idon shi dan a halin yanzun jitake ta tsane shi a ranta ita kuma bata fatan taji tsanar mutumin da bai cancanci haka daga gareta ba. 

Jin taki yin magana kuma  da alamu kuka take dan yanajin sheshshekar kukan ta hakan yasa ya zagaya ta gaban ta yanda zaiyi facing ɗin face dinta, saidai yana komawa gaban ta, ta sake bashi baya gaban ta na duka fat fat fat da sauri da sauri wani irin abu yaji ya soki zuciyar shi data sake juyawa mi hakan yake nufi?  bai sake kokarin sake binta ba saidai yace.
"Bahijjaah." yakira sunan ta yanajan kalmomin karshe girgiza kai tayi cikin muryar kuka tace. "Dan Allah Ya Malik katafi kabar wajen nan banson ganin fuskarka katafi ban bukatar wani taimako daga gareka wanda akayimin a rayuwa ta ma nagode Allah yabiyaka da aljannah."

Wani kara maganganun nata suka zame mashi a cikin kunnuwan shi sannan baiji zai iya nisanta kanshi da Bahijja duk da fatan shi kenan a halin yanzun, cewa yayi. "Kanwar Malik kada kice haka, kada ki hukunta Yayan ki akan laifin da ba nasa bane, ki daina wannan kukan Bahijja nasan koma miye daga Ummu ne, kiyafema mahaifiya ta."

Sai a lokacin Bahijja ta waigo tana kallan kwayar idanun MalikusSaif, wanda sun kada sunyi jajir, ita kanta saida taji wani iri haɗa idanun su waje ɗaya, sadda nata idanun tayi kasa still tears dinta na zuba a saman kyakkyawar fuskarta muryarta na breaking tace. "Ya Malik ina neman alfarma agreka." 

Cikin tausayin kanwar tashi yace. "Faɗi inajinki kanwar Malik."

Murmushi tayi mai ciwo sannan ta duka kasa guiwowin ta biyu tana haɗe hannuwan ta alamun roko tace.
"Dan Allah Ya Malik kataimaki rayuwar Bahijja ka rabu dani, nayafe so da kaunar da kake mani, dan haka dan Allah katsaneni arayuwar ka, karabu dani."

Rufe idanun shi yayi saida yai kamar minti ukku ya bude su sun sake kaɗawa cikin kulawa da tausayin ta yace. "Saboda baki sona kin tsaneni ko Bahijja.?''

Sunkuyar da kanta tayi kasa tanajin girman tambayar da yaimata, sai dai bata da zaɓi dole su hakura da juna kamar yanda take tursasa tata zuciyar, cewa tayi. "Ya Malik banso takaimu a wannan fagen ba sai dai ko shakka babu a halin yanzun Bahijja ta hakura dakai banson k!... 

Ɗaga mata hannu yayi yace. "Nafahimta kanwar Malik, naji zanyu yanda kikeso, sai dai kisani Bahijja tun kina yar jinjirarki nake furta kalmar so agareki har zuwa yau da nike fidda wannan numfashin a gabab ki, amman farin cikin ki shine nawa, zan nisan ta kaina dake tunda hakan kikeso amman kalmar ki bazata iya fitowa daga bakin Abdulmalik ba zuwa ga Bahijja, sannan har yanzun ina rokonki daki yafema Ummu, kuma bazan barki cikin wannan halin ba dole kibar wannan wajen.!"

Jitayi zuciyar kamar tafaso kirjin ta ta fito cikin karfin hali tace. "Rayuwar Bahijja tafi daɗi a nan gidan dan Allah Ya Malik karabu dani nan zaifiye mani daɗi da aminci."

Juyawa tayi tana nufar ɗakin da aka rufeta tana hawaye ga tarin kaunar MalikusSaif a cikin zuciyar ta tarasa mike mata daɗi, jitayi yace. 

''Indai Abdulmalik yana numfashi bazai taɓa barin rayuwar Bahijja ta wulakanta ba, dan haka kidaina zubda hawayenki kanwar Malik, hakan na taɓa zuciyar MalikusSaif."

Batareda ta waigoba ta ida shiga cikin ɗaki wanda gwara cell dashi saidai taki bari su hada idanun su, garkameta akayi, yanajin hakan har tsakiyar kwanyar shi, juyawa yayi wanda inka kalli idan Malik baka fatan ku sake haɗa idanun ku a karo na biyu, ba inda ya wuce sai sashen Kangiwa.

Yana isa ya tadda shi zaune da wasu mutane suna sallama da alama baƙi yayi zasu tafi, gaisawa sukayi bayan sun tafi ya dawo gafen mahaifin nashi ya zauna yace.
"Abbuh kataimaki rayuwar Bahij.....hannun shi da ya ɗaura bisa bakin Malik shiyasa bai karasa mganar ba, cikin tausayawa yace. "Mahaifiyar ka ta rufe Bahijja gidan kaso yau kimamin kwna sha biyu ko.?" cikeda mamaki yace. "Abbuh daman kasani.?"

Murmushi yayi mai zafi yace. "tabbas koda zata kashe Bahijja bazan hanata ba, sai dai akwai ranar da wlh sai Zulaiƙa ta zubda kwalla da idanun ta."
"Abbuh kadaina faɗan haka kodan ni."

tabbas yasan irin so da kaunar da Malik kema mahaifiyar sa da yanda take kaunar MalikusSaif bazaiji dadi ba, duk da son zuciyane yasa tarufe idanta ta ɗauki zalinci yazama ado a cikin zuciyar ta kallan Yarima Malik yayi yace.
"Kada ka kasance mai son zuciyar ka Abdulmalik dan kawai son da kake ma mahaifiyar ka, gaskia na faɗa, dan haka kada ka kuma zuwar man da zancen Bahijja dan bani a cikin wannan sabgar, kuma bance kace mani komai ba, kasa aranka umurni nike baka.!"

Haka Malik yadafe kanshi na yan sakanni zuciyar shi na kuna tashi yayi ya tafi har zai wuce sashen shi sai kuma ya wuce sashen Matawalle yanda yaga MalikusSaif kadai ya nuna mashi ba lafiya, zama yayi bayan sungaisa, hankalin Matawalle yai kololuwa wajen tashi ganin Malik rai ɓace yace. "Ɗana miyafaru.?"girgiza kanshi yayi yace "Kawu kataimaki rayuwar Bahijja Ummu takaita gidan kaso."
rai ɓace yace. "Wato Zulaiƙa bataji abinda nace mataba kenan, tafiya taurin kai ko, rabu da ita tunda bata da jin magana sainayi maganin ta, da ban niyar shiga wannan sabgar ba tunda nima banson ka da baiwa, amma take jayayya da ikon Allah, sannan har Baffa Abu-Jalal yai magana amman Zulaiƙa takijin umurnin sa ya tabbata bata da mutunci." ya ida maganar rai ɓace, Malik ne yace. "Kawu kayi hakuri kuyima Ummu uzuri."
"ymin shiru Abdulmalik nida itane kuma dole yau sai Bahijja tabar gidan kaso din, sannan in matarka ce kotanaso ko bataso saika auri Bahijja."
yana ida faɗar haka ya mike ya fice haka yabar Malik jiki a mace, shima a sanyaye ya wuce sashen shi ya kwanta jikin shi yai ringis tamkar garwashi. 

Koda Matawalle yaje wajen Zulaiƙa bai duba hadiman daketa aiki ba, daga gefe kuma Binta ce duke Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta ɗaura kafarta bisa kafadar ta tana mata tausa, rai ɓace yace

"Ashe baki da mutunci ban saniba? Ashe kin raina mutane har haka? Ashe bakisan kima ba? Kintabbata marar mutunci Zulaiƙa."
duk hadiman dake cikin falon jin yanda Matawalle ke magana sun san ba lafiya a hankali duk suka fice hatta Binta wani corridor ta shiga ta tsaya gudun kada ta tafi gida kuma tayi wani laifin.

Jiki mace Sarauniya  Zulaiƙa ta matso kusa da yayan nata tace.
"Haba Yaya miyafaru kake faɗan waɗan nan kalaman akaina.?" 

Rai ɓace yayo kan Zulaiƙa yace. "Kisake yimin wata magana saina saɓamaki sha shasha sha harkin isa Baffan Runo ya gindaya sharuɗɗa keki bijirema umurnin sa wacece ke!?"

"Haba Yaya kabi asannu taya zansan abinda na aikata." wani wawan kallo ya aikama Sarauniya Zulaiƙa dolen ta,ta sadda kanta ƙasa duk jikin ta yai sanyi cikin fushi yace.
"Tunda kin kama makiyiyarki kin garkame dole kice bakiyi komai ba."

Wani kululune ya tokare kirjin Zulaiƙa daman akan baiwa ɗan uwanta zaizo yana ihu rai ɓace, cukune fuska tayi tace. 

"Haba Baffan Malik akan baiwa zaka dinga yimin faɗa haka wannan matsiya ciyar yarinyar. "

''Kifita idanuna in rufe ke kike mata kallan matsiyaciya amman mu a wajen cikkakkar 'yace tunda ɗan mu na sonta, kuma kikiyayi kanki kada alhakin ta ya hanaki gamawa da duniya lafiya nagaya maki, sannan inna fiddota ki sake maidata gidan yarin kiga yanda zan ɓata maki rai, wadda batasan ciwon kanta ba saikace ba uwa ba mtsw." yagama maganar yanajan tsaki ya fita, faɗawa tayi bisa kujera tana maida numfashi tana mamakin yanda Matawalle yaji wannan zancen kodai Malik zai sanar masa take tace aaa sai dai in Saifulislam ne dafe kanta tayi tanajin kuna a cikin zuciyar ta, itako Binta duk abinda akayi tanajin ta, duk mamaki ya isheta ashe akwai wanda ya isa ya gayama Zulaiƙa taji bayan mijin ta a fadin duniyar nan, rawa jikin ta yafara tana son ta fita tana shakka kada ta huce kanta, itako Zulaiƙa ganin tanajin juwa dan bakin ciki dakinta ta shiga ta kwanta.

Bayan sati ɗaya Bahijja ce kwance a cikin ɗakin su, itada Salame tana dan dannama Bahijja kafarta yau kwanan ta bakwai da fitowa gidan kaso ba kadan taji jikin ta yayi mata daɗi ba, takara samun karfin jikin ta, Salame ce tace.
"wai Bahijja yaushe zaki koma aikin ki.?" yitayi kamar bataji Salame jin yanda gaban ta ke faɗuwa tunanin Ya Malik ya dawo mata fil sabo, ta tabbata duk inda yake yana cikin damuwa, sannan koya yake da abin da zaici, ɗan karamin tsoki tayi tace. "Ni ina ruwana da zandamu kaina a kan halin da zai shiga." sake jifomata tambayar tayi, cikin kosawa tace. "Nadaina zuwa." sake jefamata wata tambayar tayi tace. "Saboda mi?" wani kallo tai mata tace. "Saboda abinda idonki ya gane maki." rai ɓace Salame tace.
"Dan na damu da damuwar ki shine zaki gaya mani bakar magana." taɓe baki Bahijja tayi tace.
"Bakida maganin da zakimin dan haka ba damuwar ki bace, kinga dan Allah kirabu dani inji da damuwa ta." tashi Salame tayi tana faɗa ta tafi, itako Bahijja tashi tayi ta dauki buta ta shiga kewaye bada jimawa ba ta fito ta fara alwallah.

A masallaci kuwa anagama jam'i dayake Kangiwa shike jansu sallah yafara nasihohi kamar dai yanda ya saba, akan darajar ɗan Adam wannan karan yayi magana cikin ilimi da sanyaya murya yace. 

"Yakama ta muji tsoron Allah mu mutunta junan saboda Allah da kanshi a cikin alqur'ani mai girma yace. *Walaqadi karamna* *bani adama.* " ma'ana kuwa yace, *hakika munkarrama ɗan* *Adam*, da wannan ayar kadai ya ishi mutun yaji tsoron Allah yasan cewa mutum ba abin wulakantarwa bane tinda har Allah da kansa yace ya karrama ɗan Adam, sai kai saini zamuce zamu dinga wulakanta yan uwanmu dan kawai kana ganin kafi wani daraja da matsayi kayi anfani da wannan damar kana cun zarafin sa, toh wlh muji tsoron Allah duk wanda kagani a doran kasa yanada tasa darajar, kuma inka bibiyama yafika daraja a wajen Allah, dan haka muji tsoran haɗuwa da Allah, mu dinga ƙimanta 'yan uwan mu da darajar su mu taimaki junan mu sannan kada mubari shaiɗan ya samana son zuciyar a rayuwar mu, dafatan zamuyi anfani d wannan tunatarwa Allah yasa mudace." ameen duk suka amsa.

Nan sukayi addu'a kowa ya shafa anata musabaha duk suka fito masallacin nan MalikusSaif ya tafi wajen dawakai dan yaga Abban Bahijja ya nufi can daga masallaci... 

Itako Sarauniya tana gama sallah tace.
"Kaji Kangiwa nasan wannan abun da biyu yakeyin shi, hmmm nidai bazan bari ɗana ya kasance da baiwa ba."

 _Ikon Allah anya Zulaiƙa baki fara wuce iyaka ba?kodai son zuciyar taki tafara komawa jahilci_ 🤔


Koda MalikusSaif ya isa gidan dawakai ya iske Abdulmajid har yafara share garken dawakai, yana zuwa Sarkin dawaki ya taso yakawo gaisuwa sannan ya aje mashi kujera ya zauna, shima Abdulmajid dake aiki aje aikin shi yayi yazo zai duka kenan MalikusSaif ya mike cikin girmamawa yace.
"Barka dA rana Abba ya aikin." tsayawa Abdulmajid yayi yana mamakin sanyin hali irin na MalikusSaif bai ɗauki duniya da faɗiba sannan bai kyamar bawa saɓanin mahaifiyar sa, koda yake halin mahaifin sane, wannan dalilin yasa Abdulmajid ke kaunar Malik yakejin shi tamkar ɗan da ya haifa, cikin sakin fuska yace. "Lfy lau Yarima, ya fama da jama'a."

"Lfy lau MalikusSaif yace, cikin girmamawa Malik yace. "Daman inasan zanyi wata magana dakai inba damuwa." cikeda gamsuwa yace. "Badamuwa Yarima."
zama sukayi bisa wata shimfida yace. "Abba daman akan Bahijja ne abubuwa na faruwa, shine nazo dan inbaku hakuri akan abun da Ummu ta aikata dan Allah kuyi...  Katse shi Abdulmajid yayi ta hanyar hade hannayen sa yace. "Dan Allah yarima karkace zaka bani wani hakuri bakai komai ba, kuma kai ɗana ne, duk laifin Bahijja ne da batayi hakuri ba ta zauna matsayin da Allah ya ajeta ba, amman baku da wani laifi, na rokeka kada kasake cewa zaka bada wani hakuri Abdulmalik." 

Rausayar dakai yayi yace. "Ya Bahijja Allah yasa ba abinda ya same ta." cikin jin dadi yace "bakomai mungode da kulawa Allah ya biya yasaka da alkhairy." "Ameen Yarima yace, sannan ya mike yaima Abdulmajid sallama ya tafi, sai dai ba haka ya soba, yana isa side ɗinshi bathroom ya wuce ya fara wanka

Haka rayuwa taci gaba da kasancewa a cikin Daborah tsakanin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa da bayin nata, inyau bata wulakanta suba, gobe zata wulakanta su, saidai suyi jimamin a cikin zuciyar su suyi hakuri

Bayan kwana ukku, Yarima Malik ne kwance saman tafkeken gadon shi ya kudundune sai kyakyarwa yakeyi da kagan shi kasan baida lafiya dan jikin shi ya tsananta sosai, sallama Huzaifa ya dinga dokawa amman shiru bakowa tunda ga falo yafara cewa Yarima kana ina, jin shirun ne yasa ya nufi bedroom ɗin shi, jin numfashi nafita yasa shi shiga da sauri ya iske MalikusSaif kwance yana fidda numfashi da kyar, hayewa yayi saman gadon ya taɓa goshin shi yaji shi kamar wuta dan zafi, murya na breaking yace. "Yarima baka lfy shine baka sanarwa kowaba, sannu." baice komai ba, sai kara jan blanket da yayi yakara rufe jikin shi yana rawar sanyi, da sauri Huzaifa ya fita ya shige sashen Matawalle yana shiga ya iske matar shi gimbiya Abida zaune tana hutawa, yanda taga Huzaifa yatabbatar da ba lafiya, cikin kulawa tace. "Lafiya Huzaifa mike faruwa?" da ɗimauce yace. "Matawalle nanan." batace komai saita shi da tayi ta shiga cikin wani ɗaki, badajimawa ba suka fito tare, sanye yake cikin doguwar jallabiya, yace. "Huzaifa bissmillah zauna." "aaa ranka shidade, ba lafiya, Yarima baida lafiya yana kwance yanzun haka." kasa magana yayi da sauri ya fita, har gudu gudu yakeyi, yana shiga sashen shi ya wuce dakin MalikusSaif, tundaga bakin kofa zaka fara jiyo kyakkyarwar da hakoran sa keyi suna dokuwa da junan su,  yana hawa bisa gadon ya tallabo shi, murya na rawa yace. "Abdulmalik sannu kaji sannu ɗana." baisan komai akecewa ba, yana ganin dai mutane sai dai bazai iya gane wake kanshi ba, ga zuciyar shi dake bugawa ba daidai ba, shigowar gimbiya Abida, yasa Matawalle yace. "Kije kutaho da mai magani maza kutafi Huzaifa, baki ɗayan su,sun rasa abin yi, shiko Matawalle sake rufe MalikusSaif yayi. 

Haka Huzaifa yaje ya sanarwa mai magani sakon Matawalle, akan hanya ya hadu da Saifulislam ya dawo daga masallaci, ganin Huzaifa ya wuce shi, yasan ba lafiya, kiran shi yayi hakan yasa Huzaifa dawowa yana ɗan sosa kai yace.
"Ranka shidade aimin afuwa ban kula ba." murmushi yayi yace. "Nasani Huzaifa, mike faruwa daganin ka baka cikin nutsuwar ka." sadda kanshi kasa yayi yace. "Eh Yarima ne bai lfy a gaskia yana cikin hali."

tausayin Malik ne ya rufe Saifulislam, girgiza kai yayi yace. "Allah yabashi lfy, mutafi inga yanda jikin nasa yake."

Haka suka dunguma har cikin dakin MalikusSaif, sai dai yana ganin halin da ɗan nashi yake ciki, ranshi ya bashi damuwa ce taimashi yawa, cikeda karfin hali yace.
"Ya mai jikin.?" sai a lokacin Matawalle yaga zuwan Kangiwa, da sauki gimbiya Abida ta amsa, lokacin mai magani yazo ana bashi magani a cikin ƙoƙo yana sha amman idanun shi  a rufe, da kyal ya fidda numfashi yace. "Bahi-jja-aah." a rarrabe yayi maganar duk da bakowa zai iyajin abinda yake faɗa ba sai kana kusa dashi sosai daga Matawalle sai Saifulislam sukaji abinda MalikusSaif yace, kallan junan su sukayi hakan yasa Matawalle ya tashi ya fita, sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ya wuce, sai dai batann tana fa'da bai isketaba, girgiza kai yayi yace. "Wannan wace irin uwace da batasan darajar ɗanta ba, wato mulki yafi ɗanta kenan, batasan halin da yake ciki ba kenan, Binta yagani yace....

Masarautar Raifasu, Jakadiya Aisha ce da Sarki Muhammad, suke zaune a falon shi, yanda suke magana kamar akwai abu mai mahimmanci da suke tattaunawa akai, ɗan gyaran murya Sarki Muhammad yayi yace. 

"Aisha kina ganin hakan shine mafita.?" rausayar da kanta tayi alamun eh, sannan takara da cewa. "Shine mafita dan haka a shawara ta ranka shidade mu aikama Sarki Haishir da wasika akan ya kiyayi Masarautar mu, tunda ɗaukar fansa yake ikirarin zaiyi ai yazo ya kashe gimbiya Yazira, kaga ba kare bin damo kenan, komai ya wuce idan kuma baijiba sai muyi anfani da karfin mu iya gwalgwado mu yake shi."

Wani irin dadi Jakadiya taji yanda Allah yake kara haskama uban gidan nata addinin cikin sauki, sauke ajiyar zuciya tayi tace. 

"Kwarai kuwa wannan dalilin yasa idan muka aikawa su Yarima Malik da takardar Yaki, sukekin amincewa sabida addinin su ba addini bane maison rikici ba, sannan basu taɓa kawo mana hari ba saidai mu ke kaimasu, kaga ko anan zaka gane girman addinin mu na musulunci, saidai su kare kansu dan kar mu cutar  dasu, karshe kuma sune da nasara tunda muke tsokanar su, to muma haka zamuyi ma Sarki Haishir, ranka shidade."

Ɗan murmusawa yayi cikin jin dadi yace. "Tabbas hakane, Aisha."

Washe gari da safe Masarautar Waisu Sarki Haishir ne zaune a fadar shi tareda Sarki Danwar na Ƙaisu, suna tattaunawa suda wasu fadawan su, ƙayyadaddu, Sarki Haishir ne yace. Haka dai kowa yaita tofa albarkacin bakin shi inda Sarki Danwar ke kara ruruwa gabar dake tsakanin Sarki Haishir da Sarki Muhammad, inda suke kiran shi da (Baidulƙais) ɗin shi har yanzun saboda girman sunan dake gare shi yanzun ya girme harshen su saboda kwarjinin sunan da haibar shi, wannan dalilin yasa basu son kiran shi da suna Muhammad, sai dai Baidulƙais..... 

Da yamma kuwa Sarki Haishir a ɗakin gimbiya Ƙamariyya sunata aikata alfasha, abin ba kyaun gani sai dai su ko ajikin su da alama sunsaba tazame mashi tamkar matar shi haka ya maida uwar shi, wa'iyazubillah.

ya ida maganar yana jan dogon tsoki ya fice,ita kuwa kuka ta dinga yi tana kiran Matawalle amman yaki dawowa, zuwa tayi ta duka kusa da Yarima Malik da yake kwance idan shi a rufe amman ba bacci yake ba, kwalla na zuba a idanun shi tace.

Kara runtse idanun shi yana jin maganar Ummun shi na taɓa mashi zuciya, yayi iya kokarin shi amman yakasa cire son Bahijja a zuciyar shi amman yakasa har ya kwanta wannan ciwon ya yarda, da son Bahijja  ajinin shi ne tun randa yasata idanun shi tana jinjirarta Allah ya dasa mashi kaunar Bahijja ta hanyar jin tausayin rayuwar Bahijja.

ganin yaki magana ne yasa ta komawa gefe tanajin ƙuna a cikin zuciyar shi, a falo Lurwan ya iske su Yazid suna gaisawa yace.

 _Tofa ko ina Lurwan zai tafi a sirrin ce muje zuwa dai, yanzun wasan zai soma_


A sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuwa zaune take bisa kujerar ta ta mulki wadda bisan ta take wulakancin ta a cikin sashen ta, asawa tayi aka kirama ta Abdulmajid da Binta, cikin sanyin murya wadda take a sarke tace.

Wani abune ya soki zuciyar Abdulmajid har saida ya rufe idanun shi sannan ya buɗe su, sun kaɗa sunyi jajir yace....

Ajiyar zuciya ta sauke tana jin wani wasai a cikin zuciyar ta.

ya ida magabar yana kallan Galadima cewa yayi.

Haka Matawalle ya tashi yaje shida Sarkin gida sai Sarkin fa'da mahaifin Yazid kenan sai Waiziri Dammur haka suka ɗunguma aka kai kaya kamar yanda suka alkawalta, bakaramin dadi iyayen Bahijja sukaji ba.

"Abokina ashe ka kusan angwan cewa, wayaga Yarima MalikusSaif anzama ango."

Baki ɗayan su suka saka dariya, shidai nashi ido yana karajin kaunar Bahijja na ratsa jini da ɓargon jikin shi... 

A cikin Masarautar kuwa a turakar bayi labari yagama karaɗe ko ina ansaka ranar bikin Yarima Malik da Bahijja kowa na fadin albarkacin bakin shi wasu najin daɗi wasu kuma na bakin ciki, inda masu Sarauta ke ganin Yarima Malik ya auri baiwa hakan kamar zubda kimane da darajar Masarautar Daborah, inda ta ɓangaren bayi ke ganin hakan tamkar ɗaukaka darajar sune a idon duniya yau ga ƴarsu zata zama gimbiya kuma cikakar 'ya. 

Itako Bahijja tana tsakar gida tana wanke kayan ta, kawai taji anfado mata a jiki, a tsoro ce ta waigo sai taga Salame, cikin zolaya tace.
"inkika karyani fa, kin fiye ganganci da yawa Allah kuwa."

"Uhmm kinji dan kar inma Yarima asara dai zakice, kaga masoya amaryar Malik sai dubu ta taru Allah ya nuna mana sati mai zuwa musha shagalin bikin Yarima MalikusSaif da amaryar sa gimbiya Bahijja."

Ɗan duka takaima Salame a baya cikin bugun zuciyar ta da taji yana hauhawa a lokaci ɗaya jin kalaman Salame, hakan yasa tace......

"Angaishe da Jarumai abokan ango, kunyi kokari, yanzun za'a gabatar da kyautuka ga Jarumai, nan aka fara raba kyauta da kayan saƙi da takubba sai kuma kuɗi duk cikin kowace kyauta saidai wa'anda sukaci wasan nasu na musamman ne, ana gama ba wa'anda sukayi wasan tsere aka kira MalikusSaif shine yai na farko na wasan zoben Barri nan akabashi kyautar zoben azurfa mai masifar kyau da tsada haka akaci akasha danko naman kaji ba abin nema bane, kowa yayi nahi'an ba bayi ba masu mulki saidai kowa da nasu ɓangaren haka kowa ya koma gida cikin farin ciki da anna shuwa. 

▪️▪️▪️▪️▪️▪️▪️▪️▪️▪️▪️

Masarautar Raifasu kuwa labarin auren Yarima Malik da Bahijja ya gauraye cikin Masarautar, bakaramin farin ciki Jakadiya tayi ba, da kanta taje ta sakarwa Sarki Muhammad, duk da yaji wani iri musamman kewar Bahijja saidai a halin yanzun tamkar 'yar cikin sa haka ya ɗauki Bahijja cikin kankanin lokaci yasa Jakadiya tafara haɗa kaya wanda uba kema ƴarsa lokacin aure yace su shirya a ranar zasu isa Daborah kasancewar ba'ajima dayin sallar la'asar ba, wannan karan dashi da Jakadiya sai Tasi'u da sauran ainahin bayin Daborah sai jama'ar fadar shi kama da Galadima dagaci sai kuma Sarkin dawaki, cikin kankanin lokaci suka kama hanyar tafiya Daborah.

Wajen Sarki Haishir kuwa kafurci sai abinda yayi gaba dan basu daina kudurin halaka Sarkin Raifasu ba, kusan kullin yana  tareda aljanin dutse ko wajen Sarrilƙus suna tsafin yanda zasu darkake Masarautar Raifasu da komai nata, danma riko da addinin sune yasa har yanzun basu cimma burin suba akan su.

"Kasan Yarima MalikusSaif zaiyi aure?"

Numfashi mai zafi ya furzar dan shi kanshi yasan ya ɗaura buri akan Bahijja saidai abinda yafi karfin ka dole kasa ido, cikin hushi yace "Bahijja."

tashi zaune Sarki Haishir yayi yace. "Aikuwa Yanzun yakama ta kaje Masarautar Daborah kaida amintaccen bawana, ku gane mana wace irin alaƙa da kusanci ke tsakanin mutanen Masarautar Daborah da jama'ar Masarautar Raifasu, tashi kutafi nan akwai duk kayan buƙata."
Bai mashi musuba dan daman shima so yake kashe kwalkwatar idanun shi, haka suka tashi cikin kankanin lokaci suka shirya da bayi ukku masu yi masu hidima suka kama hanyar tafiya Daborah.

Wajen Bahijja kuwa dilka tai dilka dan tasha gyara ta kowane fanni inba cikakken sani kaima Bahijja lallai bazaka iya ganeta ba dan samun nutsuwa da tayi ga kula da tattali Sarauniya Zulaiƙa naima ta sosai ta canja, duk yanda MalikusSaif yakai da kwakwar ganin Bahijja, Sarauniya ta hana shi, haka dai kullin yana neman alfarma amman abu ya faskara hakan yasa yasama ranshi hakuri, saidai zuwa gobe ake ɗaura masu aure, a ranar kuma aka kai lefen Bahijja turakar bayi kowa yazo ya gani murna wajen bayi ba magana, harta iyayen ta saida Sarauniya ta haɗa musu kaya nagani na fada, sannan wani sashene tasa aka gyara, aka zuba kayan duniya a cikin sa nanne Yarima MalikusSaif zai tare da amaryar tasa komai ya haɗu dan duk Masarautar Daborah ba sashen daya gaji da kayatuwa irin wannan sashen daman ta tanaje shine dan in Yarima Malik yai aure ya zauna da iyalin sa. 

Haka rayuwa ta kasance suma iyayen ta sunkai iyakar kayan da sukai mata musamman kayan ma'aikaci da anklƙi ansa Abu-Jalal yace akarba, ai da kayan iyayen ta zatayi gadara haka kuwa akayi. 

Karfe goma na dare kuwa Sarki Muhammad dasu Jakadiya suka iso cikin Masarautar Daborah ba karamin tarba akai masu ba, a sashen saukar da baki na musamman aka ajesu, 
Haka baki tako ina na nesa nesa sukai ta zuwa Daborah dan halarta auren Yarima Malik, harta Sarki Danwar cikin daren suka iso, abu dai ba'a magana suko yan Masarautar sai karrama baƙin su sukeyi suna basu abinci da abubuwan buƙata, wannan kenan. 

Washe gari da safe Yarima Malik ne dasu Huzaifa suketa shiri kamar ba gobe saboda za'a ɗaura auren Yarima Malik da Bahijja da misalin karfe biyu na rana,kowa da irin shirin da yakeyi shiko Yarima baki yaki rufuwa, Yazid ne ya shigo da baƙin Yarima Malik na Masarautar Runo duk sunzo dan halarta auren sai 'yayan abokan Saifulislam, wanda duk suke harkar Kasuwanci a tare, da dai sauran jama'ar su, sai zolayar Yarima sukeyi shiko sai murmushi kawai yake masu, karfe goma daidai Yarima ya shiga bedroom ɗin shi kamar yanda ya saba, yana shiga yayi wanka wani ɗanyen yadine ya saka a jikin shi mai ɗan karen kyau saidai ash color ne, wankan turare yafara yima jikin nashi dan shima akwai son harkar kamshi.
