Haka ya gama shirin shi tsaf sannan ya shimfiɗa kafat yafara sallar nafila, haka ya wuni yana addu'oi samun nasara da zaman lafiya, a cikin auren shi da zaiyi karatun alqur'ani ya hau yi, kamar kullin bashi ya tashi ba sai wajen karfe sha biyu, sake wanka yayi wannan karan kau shigar wasu fakistan yayi irin na india maroon color, Yarima Dawud ne ya shigo baki ɗayan su suka ɗunguma suka tafi masallaci danyin sallah. 

A cikin sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa kuwa mai gyaran jiki ce keta gyare amarya, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce ta kira Jakadiya Hajara tareda Jakadiya Aisha sukazo nan suka gaisa da Sarauniya bakaramin karrama Jakadiya taiba, nan ta ɗauko wani dankareren leshi royal blue da ratsin pitch color a jikin shi, sai wata masifaffar alqabba da taji stone na alfarma ita kuma fari ce amman tanada adon royal blue a jiki, hakama takalman ta masu rufi daga sama shima royal blue sai tabata sarkar ɗanyen gold mai kyau haka ta haɗa tabama Jakadiya Hajara tace. "Gashi aje a taya ƴar tawa shiryawa, ida angama ɗaurin aure zan kaita wajen Baffana ta saka wannan kayan a jikin ta."

"Ummi na yaushe kikazo waya gamaki."
duk lokaci ɗaya ta jefo mata waɗan nan tambayoyin,hawayen farin ciki ne ya lullube Jakadiya,zama sukayi bisa kujera har yanzun Bahijja na jikinta sai shagwaɓa take mata, itako kallan shi'awar yarta takeyi, cikin sanyin murya tace. 
"Ƴata daga yau na haneki kada ki sake yin irin wannan tsallan kinaji na.?" rausayar dakai tayi alamun eh.
dafata tayi cikin kulawa tace. "Yawwa ƴar albarka inyeh Bahijja na angirma yau kece za'aima aure."

Cikeda kunya ta sadda kanta ƙasa sai kamshi takeyi ga wani uban shining and glowing da skin ɗinta keyi taji gyara, sake cewa tayi.

A wajen su Kangiwa kuwa sun gama shiri tsaf cikin kayan alfarma na Sarakai shida Matawalle iri ɗaya suka saka, sai shima Abu-Jalal ya gaji da haɗuwa duk wanda kagani baki har wuya dan farin ciki, a wajen Abdulmajid shima Saifulislam ya aika mashi dana shi kayan saidai kowa da kalar nashi shida Idris yai masu, hakama Binta ta cancaɗa ado cikin kayan alfarma kamar ba ita, hakama su Mairo da Ladidi sunsha ado, abinci kuwa shigowa aketayi dashi cikin kattin kuloli daga ko ina suma sunyi nasu iya karfi,danko kaji kamar a cikin sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa suke komai tasa ankawo masu na bukata ba abinda suka nema suka rasa, hidima kam saidai muce Alhmdullh anata hidimar arziƙi, kamar ba gobe.

Waliyin  ango wato Matawalle sai waliyin Bahijja Idris duk sun hallara duk da sunba Saifulislam walicin auren Bahijja, mai shela ne keta shela kowa ya saurara, aiko wajen yai tsit, limamin fa'da wanda shine imam na biyu idan Saifulislam bai nan har jam'i yake jan su,kallan shi ya maida ga jama'ar wajen sannan yace.

Da ameen suka amsa, riko hannun Bahijja tayi tanajin so da kaunar ta. 
Sallamar Hajia Kubra ce ta katse masu firar su, cikin girmamawa aka tareta nan ta gayama Abdulmajid cewar za'aki Bahijja wajen iyayen Malik, bai musaba yace Allah yatsare, sake feshe ta da turaruka tayi sannan ya riko hannun da Saude suka tafi rakiya sai Jakadiya Hajara, bayine suka rufama Bahijja baya wa'anda zasuyi mata hidima saman kayataccen dokine na alfarma aka sa ta hau a hankali aka tafi da ita sashen Kangiwa.

Suna tsayawa da sauri wani dogari yazo ya rikema Bahijja sirdi a hankali ta sauka bisa dokin Jakadiya ta rike hannun ta har cikin katafaren falon Saifulislam rike da hannun Bahijja itako ta sadda kanta cikin alkabba da taimata rufa baka ganin fuskarta sosai, jitayi  Jakadiya ta zaunar da ita bisa wani lallausan kafat saidai a hankali takeji gabanta naɗan faduwa kaɗan kaɗan, shiko Abu-Jalal baki yaki rufuwa dan ganin anshigo da ƴar tashi, wani farin ciki yakeji yau na musamman, basu jima da zama ba saiga Yarima Malik dasu Huzaifa cikin shiga ta alfarma suma zama sukayi fuskar fal da annuri, itako Bahijja tanajin kanshin turaren daya daki hancin ta tasan Yariman tane yazo bata ida sakankancewa da hakan ba saida taji yace "barka da rana Abi."

Amsawa yayi cikin girmamawa. 
Jakadiya Hajara ce tace. "Ranka shidade ga amaryar Abdulmalik tazo kusa mata albarka."
Shiko MalikusSaif ta wutsiyar ido yake kallan Bahijjar yanda take sakin asirtaccen kamshi ga wani so da kaunar ta duk sun dabaibaye shi, duk da baiga fuskar taba tana rufe da albarka. 

Shiko Sarki Abu-Jalal murmushi ya saki yana kallan Kangiwa yace. "Alhmdullhi Saifulislam yau kaga ƴar muko? Abdulmalik ne da yin aure Allah yaimaki albarka ƴata, Allah yasa ki zama alkhairi a cikin wannan zuriyar tamu Bahijja." da ameen suka amsa kowa yanajin daɗi, Kangiwa ne yace "gaskia kam Kawu ai Bahijja yarinyar kirkice insha Allah kowa zaiji daɗin zama da ita."

"Allah yasa ya bada zaman lafiya." cewar Matawalle. 
"Gaskia kam ni kaina zaman da tayi a wajena nasan ta da hakuri ga mutunta na gaba da ita."
Cewar Sarki Muhammad wato (Baidulƙais). 
Hakanan Bahijja taji zuciyar ta ta karye danko a mafarki bata mance mai wannan muryar ba. 
Cikin sigar zolaya Sarki Muhammad yace. "A bude ma iyaye muga ƴar tamu ko."

Jakadiya Aisha ce ta saka hannu a hankali ta ɗage hular alqabbar fuskar Bahijja ce ta bayyana, a tare kowa yace. "Masha Allah tubarakallah, musamman Sarki Abu-Jalal, danko Sarki Muhammad faɗuwar gaba yaji Allah yasani ya kaunaci Bahijja duk da a jahilce ya sota amman yasan tana da mahimmanci a rauwar shi baki ɗaya, saidai kuma yanzun kaunar ta juye jin ta yake kamar yar cikin shi. 

MalikusSaif kuwa ko kaftawa baiyi akan Bahijja tun yana kallan ta a boye har yakasa boyewa cewa yayi. 
Aranshi Allah na godemaka da kaimani baiwar auren Bahijja, kasa ta zama alkhairi ga rayuwa ta.

Sarki Abu-Jalal ne yace. "Masha Allah sannu ko ƴata Allah yaimaki albarka."
A hankali ta buɗe labban ta masu kyau da sheki tace. "Ameen ." ba kowa zaiji tace ba. 

Sake kallan Jakadiya yayi  ya miko mata wasu kuɗi yace "ga wannan Hajara na gaisuwar iyayene taje ta huta kinji."
Haka kowa yaita bada kuɗi, inda Sarki Muhammad ya bada sarkar azurfa ta tambarin Masarautar Raifasu yace. "Ga wannan takice ƴata sarkace mai matukar anfani a rayuwar Masarautar Raifasu na sadaukar maki da ita, don ke alkhairi ce arayuwar mu Allah yaima aurenki albarka Bahijja."
Sai a lokacin ta kalli fuskar Baidulƙais tabbas ta gasgata cewa shine saidai yanakara manyan ta kuma ya kara zama kamili, a hankali tace. "Nagode Abba."
Sunan da rakirashi dashi baisan hawaye sun ziraro mashi  ba, yan nasihohi akai masu kamar yanda suka saba akan aure daga bisani akace amaida Bahijja gida, wajen tashi ne sukayi ido cikin ido da sahibin nata, murmushin so da kauna ya sakar mata itama ta maida martani suna cikeda da so da shauƙin junan su,wannan kenan.

Koda aka maida Bahijja, a turakar bayi suka wuce da ita, anan Jakadiya Hajara ta kawo mata kayan bukata, wanka ta shiga ta sake shiryawa wannan karan cikin wani matsiyacin material ne tasaka milk sai ratsin mint green, ba karamin karɓarta shigar tayi ba, Bayan sallar la'asar daga kowane ɓangare sai shiri akeyi domin kowa yasan ya halacci naɗin Sarautar da za'aima Yarima MalikusSaif da kuma kallan wasan Barri, cikin kankanin lokaci kowa ya gama shirin sa hakama a wajen Yarima Malik shirye yake cikin wasu dakakkun kaya na saki kirar pakistan lemon green sai ratsin kwalliyar orange color a jikin su kaɗan, hula shi ya murza itama ta Sarauta tasha ado da kwalliyar zaiba ruwan gold, sai takalman sa suma golden color ne sai baza kamshi yakeyi haɗuwa iya haɗuwa kam Yarima MalikusSaif ya haɗu gashi sai wani murmushi yake saki abin dai kam ba'a magana. 

A wajen Bahijja kuwa har turakar bayi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta aika mata mai gyaran jiki taci gaba da aikin ta kamar yanda ta saba, itama sanye take cikin wani dakeken lace lemon green da ratsin fari a jikin shi, sai alkabba itama, lemon green da ratsin orange da takalman ta masu cover suma lemon green, tsayawa faɗin haduwar da Bahijja tayi ba karamin kyau tayi ba, haka aka dinga fesheta da turaruka masu sanyin kamshi, ana gama shiryata wasu bayi ne na musamman daga cikin hadiman Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sai Jakadiya Hajara sukazo ɗaukar Bahijja, haka suka tafi da Mairo sai Jakadiya Aisha saman wani kayataccen doki fari sol na alfarma  ba'inda aka wuce da ita sai sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa cikin kayataccen falon ta na alfarma, a gaban Sarauniya aka ajeta, itama ta gaji da haɗuwa ga gwala gwalai a jikin Sarauniya ba abin nema bane, kallan ƴar tata ta dingayi cikin shauƙi da kauna, cikin kulawa tace. "Yata inafatan kinci abinci.?"
Dan rausayar dakan ta tayi sannan tace. "Eh naci."
Badan ta yarda ba tace. "Hajara ki kaita ɗakina ba kowa a ciki abata abinci taci inta gama za'aje filin Barri." da toh Jakadiya ta amsa, sannan suka tafi. 

Haka aka kawoma Bahijja abinci mai rai da lafiya, sai wani kula a cikin shi farfeson yan shilane na tantabaru sun dafu sosai, sai turirin kamshi sukeyi, duk da ba wata yunwa bace ta addabi Bahijja sosai ba, amman taji sun burgeta, zuba mata Jakadiya Hajara tayi ta aje mata tace. "Yawwa 'yata kici, kinga wannan haɗin yanada matukar anfani a cikin wannan Masarautar, kici sosai kinji, gyaɗa kai Bahijja tayi, sannan a hankali tafara ci, hakan yasa suka bata wuri, saida taci sosai, bakaɗan naman yan shilar nan ba sukai mata dadi ba, daukar dafaffiyar madarar da aka zuba mata a kofi tayi tasha markaɗaɗɗiyar aya sai kuma nikakken dabino da kwakwa, cikin madarar sai kamshi takeyi, a hankali ta surɓa baki ɗaya jitayi daɗin madarar ya gauraye mata bakin ta, batasan tasha fin rabi ba, sannan tayi gyatsa, Alhmdullh tace, dan raban da taci abinci irin haka harta manta. 

Jin sallamar Jakadiya, tayi tareda hadiman Sarauniya, haka suka kimtsa kayan da taci abinci, sannan aka kara gyara mata kwalliyar ta, kamota Mairo tayi suka fito, lokacin Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sungama shiryawa ita da yan uwanta da abokan ta sai matan abokan Saifulislam, duk sun gama kimtsawa kowa ya hadu iya haduwa saman dawakai na alfarma suka hau sauran hadiman su na binsu a kafa, haka suka ɗunguma sai katan filin Barri, lokacin kuwa su Yarima Malik sun isa bada jimawa sai yabawa akeyi da irin kyau da angon yayi tareda abokan sa, baifi minti biyar ba afara wasan Barri ba, su Bahijja suka iso wannan karan hannun Bahijja na cikin na Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, tinda suka tinkaro filin  Sarkin zagi yafara koɗa ta, yana cewa barka da zuwa gimbiya Bahijja, ƴa ga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa angaishe ki, gimbiyar Daborah jinin Abdulmajid ƴar lelen Binta, barka da zuwa filin Barri amaryar Yarima MalikusSaif gaba lafiya baya alkhairi takawarki lfy bango majinjinar marayu buhun sikari mai dadin ɗandano zamanki lafiya gimbiya Bahijja."

Wani ƴar yar haka takejin tsikar jikin ta na tashi a hankali duk taji idanuwan mutane sun mata yawa, ga wani kirari da takeji, ta cikin alqabba ta hango Ya Malik ɗinta yana ta kallanta sai murmushi yakeyi a zuciyar ta kuwa cewa tayi "lallai Ya Malik da anganka ansan kafi kowa murna itama murmushin ta saki, ji tayi Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace. 
"Yata karki buɗe fuskar ki, sai in ankiraki kinji ko?"
Gyada kai tayi tace."toh Ummu."

Gefen haggun ta ta kalla ta cikin alqabba ta hango wani waje ya hadu iya gwargwado Umman tane ciki sai Abban ta da sauran yan uwanta ba laifi shaƙi kantane irin su Mairo Ladidi da Saude, sai Baffa Idris dinta da sauran yan uwanta su Tasiu da sauran bayin su na Raifasu. 

A wajen su Abu-Jalal kuwa zaune suke da sauran Sarakai da sukazo murnar naɗin Sarautar da za'aima Yarima MalikusSaif sai sun Kangiwa, Matawalle da jama'ar su da sauran masu ruwa da tsaki na Masarautar Daborah da Runo shiru ya kewaye wajen, mai gabatar da wasan Barri wato Dawud shugaban mai kula gidan tarihin Barri ne ya fito yace. 
"Batareda bata lokaci ba yanzun za'afara wasan Barri duba da lokaci na tafiya ga munada naɗin Sarauta, shiyasa zamu takaita wasan cikin Jaruman mu, muna bukatar mutun ukku a cikin ku duk da Yarima kunzama huɗu kenan."

Haka suka bada Yarima Yazid da Huzaifa sai Lurwan, duk suka fito suma sunsha kyau iya kyau, daga bayane Yarima Malik ya fito kamar jira makaɗa da mabusa suka fara busa suna koɗa Yarima suna cewa. 

"Tashin ka lafiya Yariman Daborah angaishe ka, ɗa ga Sarauniya Zulaiƙa jinin Kangiwa Saifulislam Allah yakara girma da daukaka angon gimbiya Bahijja."

Duk kirarin da akema shi ba abinda yasa shi jin daɗi da yaji ance angon gimbiya Bahijja. 

Da murmushi saman fuskar shi, ya tsaya gefen Huzaifa, yana wani kayataccen murmushi a ranshi ko cewa yayi. "Lallai kuwa su Huzaifa nasan anajin karfi kamar bijimin doki, wasan Barri, ni ko zan iya kuwa?"
Jiyayi wani bawa ya duƙa kasa cikin girmamawa yace. 
"Ranka shidade ga takobin ka."
Murmushi yayi ya rike takobin sai walauniya takeyi yace. " *Sun'u* barka da zuwa wajen uban gidan ki." sunan takobin Yarima Malik kenan cikin kankanin lokaci aka buga kuge, kafin kaftawar ido Jaruman sun fara ba junan su wuta da takubban su ga kowa yanaji da karfi da Jarumta, Yarima Malik da Yazid sai kuma Lurwan da Huzaifa haka akaita artaba kowa yana nuna iyakar bajintar shi yakeyi. 

Ba abinda kakeji sai karar wukake da Jaruman ke dukan takobban yan uwan su, a ka'idar wasan Barri wasane da idan anayin shi duk wanda ya bari ɗan uwan shi ya kaɓe mashi wuka ta faɗi ƙasa Shikenan anfidda mutun ko kuma wanda abokin karawar shi yakai shi kasa wanwar shima anci shi wasa, wannan dalilin yasa kowane Jarumi ya bada kaimi da nuna kwarewa a harkar Yaki dan kowa yanaji da karfin shi ga kuma dubarar Yaki, haka akai ta fafatawa saidai gogan naku hankalin shi nakan Bahijja dan ba kadan ta tafi da imanin shiba, ji yayi Yazid ya dage sai kawo mashi sara yake har tarwatsin wuta ke fita a jikin takubban lokaci na tafiya saboda a cikin minti shabiyar ake son a fidda gwani a cikin su, cikin gafin nama Yazid ya buga tsalle ya buge takobin hannun MalikusSaif da sauri ya dawo cikin hayyacin shi da idanu yabi takobin wanda rabi da kwatar wajen duk an mike ana sallallami ita kanta Bahijja ji take kirjin ta na duka da sauri da sauri fatan ta gwarzon ta yaci wasan, shiko Malik jikin shi ba karamin sanyin yaiba ganin takobin shi tay kololuwa sannan ta taho zuwa kasa, danko Kangiwa dafe kai kwai yayi Sarki Abu-Jalal kuwa ko motsi yakasa yi, waigowa yai cikin zama da kwarewa da bajinta ya buga wani irin tsalle iya karfin shi sadda takobin zata dira kasa, Yarima MalikusSaif ya cafkota a  hannun shi ya rike gam, sannan ya doro kasa har saida kura ta tashi wajen, sannan zuciyar shi na bugawa da saurin gaske, wani uban ihu da aka saki ya dawo dashi cikin nutsuwar shi, ita kanta Bahijja wani sanyayyen numfashi ta saki, shiko Lurwan jin ihun ne ya janye mashi hankali dan shima ba kadan ya jigata Huzaifa ba, duk yanda yaso ya wullar da takobin hannun Lurwan yakasa, ganin hankalin shi bai tareda shine yasa Huzaifa yai tsalle ya wullar da takobin hannun Lurwan, wani irin shakku da mamaki ya dira cikin zuciyar Lurwan yaso ya caɓe takobin shi saidai ta riga da tausaka ƙasa ta cake da kasa, wani irin murna magoya bayan Huzaifa sukayi ganin yayi wining Lurwan Jarumi kuma haziƙi mai takama da Jarumta a cikin Jaruman Daborah. 

A wajen Yazid da Yarima Malik kuwa fafatawa akeyi wani sabon karfi Yarima keji, suna cikin fafatawa cikin azama Yazid ya kawo wata sara aiko MalikusSaif ya zille, ya wurwura takobin shi ya sake caɓeta cikeda dubarar Yaki dan yaga Yazid da gaske yake kuma inbai wasa ba shike da nasara, cikin azama yasa kafadar shi ya bangaji Yazid da karfin gaske aiko Yazid ya tafi tangal tangal, yanasan ya rike kasa da kafufun shi ganin haka yasa Yarima Malik ya buge takobin Yazid sannan ya kara kwashe shi da kafar shi take ya faɗi kasa wanwar yana faɗuwa takobin shi itama tana isowa kasa wani razanannan ihu aka saki Yarima Malik yaci gasa, yanzun shida Huzaifa za'a fafata, kowa  yaji dadi dan raban da ayi irin wannan cin har anmanta tun zamanin Sarki Khamil da Sarauniya Maimoon ace an kada abokin karawa sannan an wullar da takobi a lokaci ɗaya, hannun MalikusSaif yasa ya dago Yazid suka rungume junan su, baki dayan su suko koma wajen zaman su,  aka fara basu kulawa da dafaffiyar madara kowa yasha, daga bisa shugaban gidan tarihin Barri yace. 
"Anasan ganin Yarima MalikusSaif da abokin wasan shi Yarima Huzaifa."

Cikin kankanin lokaci suka fito waje kowa yana yabawa Jaruman dan kowa gwanine kuma yasan kanshi, ji sukayi yace. 
"Cikin minti goma akeson cikin ku a fidda gwani."

Sake kwashewa da ihu akayi wasu na bayan Huzaifa wasu kuma na bayan ango Yarima Malik. 
Ana buga kuge suka game suka fara fafatawa cicin karfin su, haka akaita artaba tsakanin Yarima Malik da Huzaifa kowa jinin shi kan hakaifa yake musamman gimbiya Zahara'u dake bayan ɗan uwan ta dan tunda aka ɗaura auren Yarima Malik takarajin tsanar Bahijja aranta harda Yarima Malik din acewar ta ya cimata mutunci ya zabi baiwa kan ta, a wajen su Huzaifa kuwa ana cikin fafatawa Huzaifa yasa kafa ya taɗe Yarima saura kiris yakai kasa dan kusan mutanen wajen duk an mike tsaye harda Sarauniya Zulaiƙa can hannun MalikusSaif ya dira kasa ya dafe kasa da karfi baikai kasa ba, hakan yasa Huzaifa cikin gafin nama yazo zaisa kafa ya ingiza Yarima shiko ya rike kafar Huzaifa ya kwashe shi sai ga Huzaifa ƙasa wanwar takobin MalikusSaif wato Sun'u itace ya cake gefen fuskar Huzaifa, ihun daɗi kowa yasaki aka shigo cikin fili Jaruman suka daga Yarima Malik sama anata jin daɗi shima Huzaifa mikewa yayi ya daga hannun yarima Malik anata murna kowa ya koma ya zauna.

Shiru ne ya biyo baya Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce ta mike tsaye, hakan yasa aka nutsu fuskar ta cikeda annuri da farin ciki wanda takasa boye hakan a zahiri magana tafara. 
"Alhmdullhi anyi wasan Barri cikin aminci Jarumai kowa yayi bajin tar shi kuma kowa ya gamsu da yanda aka gabatar da wannan wasa dan haka batareda baɓata lokaci yanzun za'a gabatar da kyautuka kamar yanda aka saba, wata kyauta ta dauko aka fara daga Lurwan ta sowa yayi yana ta murmushi, wajen Matawalle yaje suka gaisa sannan ya bashi kyauta, sai aka kira Yazid shi kuma Waiziri Dammur ne ya bashi tashi kyautar da kuɗi, sai Huzaifa shi kuma Saifulislam ne ya karrama shi saida ga karshe aka kira MalikusSaif wajen baki ɗaya aka ɗauki kabbara ana murna zuwa yayi ya tsaya gefen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, wani irin kallon so da kauna tareda alfahari da ɗan nata take mashi mikawa Sarki Abu-Jalal kyautar tayi shima, mikewa yayi yana sakin kayataccen murmushi yayi cikin dattako yace. "Ina gimbiya Bahijja."

tana zaune taji gabanta ya yanke dan bata tsammaci kiran ba, a hankali ta ɗago kanta dake cikin alqabba ta kalli Jakadiya ta gefe, ji tayi ta rike mata hannu a hankali ta mike suka isa wajen Sarki Abu-Jalal, kanta sunkuye, Jakadiya Aisha ce ta buɗe fuskar Bahijja daketa ɗaukar ido amman still idanta na kallan kasa, wani irin suman tsaye Yarima yayi na ɗan lokaci yana kallan kyakyawar fuskar ta mai kara mashi kaimi da kwarin guiwa Sarki Abu-Jalal ne yace. 

"Anshi wannan kyautar 'yata ba mijin ki."
Cikin girmamawa ta mika hannu biyu ta karɓa sannan ta ɗan saci kallan fuskar Yarima, da sauri ta jenye nata idon tana murmushi ganin yanda yake kallan ta, yana mata wani sanyayyen murmushi daya kashe mata jiki, a hankali take taku wanda batasan tanayin shiba  harta iso gaban shi, wani irin abu yaji tsikar jikin shi ta wani tashi yar yar ga kanshin ta daya gama kashe mashi illahirin jikin shi, Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ce ta riko hannun shi, ita kuma ta bashi kyautar shi ta musamman, ɗago kanta tayi a tare suka sakarwa junan su smile mai kayatarwa. 

Wajen ne ya karaɗe da gunjin ihu da murna na mutane dan yanda suka kayatar abin saidai ashe Masha Allah. 

Sai kyauta ta karshe da aka ba Yarima wani ingarman dokine na alfarma daya kawatu da haɗuwa iya haduwa wannan karan kuwa Sarki Muhammad Raifasu shine ya gabatarwa Yarima da kyautar dokin, haka akaita farin ciki kowa yaci yasha aka tafi zuwa fa'dar Daborah domin yima Yarima Malik naɗi, kowa ya tinkari katuwar fadar su cikin wani fili inda nanne ake naɗin Sarakuna a cikin Daborah shiko Malik shi dasu Huzaifa sashen shi suka wuce dan bakaramin zafi yakeji ba, wanka yayi ya fito ya shafa mai, mai matukar kamshi, da turaruka masu daɗin gaske, wasu fararen kayane ya saka masu laushi da kayau sun bala'in karɓar jikin shi sosai, sai digon baki a jikin yadi, a can wajen naɗin kuwa sai jiran Yarima Malik akeyi shiru hakan yasa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tace, Sarkin gida yaje ya kira Yarima shi ake jira, haka kuwa akayi yana zuwa lokacin yagama kimtsawa ya saka bakaken takalman da bakin silver azurfar agogon shi daya makala a hannun shi komai yai mashi kyau iya haɗuwa, fitowa sukayi shida su Dawud nan Sarkin gida ya sanar mashi da kiran da ake mashi, baice komai ba har suka isa cikin filin wani fitinannan kamshi ne ya gauraye wajen kallan mamaki Abu-Jalal kema Yarima dan baisan ya wuce sashen shi ba, wuri akaba shi ya zauna ba tareda ɓata lokaci ba, Shamaki ya fara magana
Yace. 
"Limamin fada a bude mana taro da addu'a."

Cikin farin ciki yafara, karanta suratul fatiha da sallatin annabi kowa yana yi sannan yafara addu'a Allah yasa naɗin da za'aima Yarima MalikusSaif yazama alkhairi agareshi ya kareshi daga sharrin makiya mahassada da duk wata halitta mai cutarwa haka kowa yaita amsawa da Ameen Ameen, nan aka shafa. 

Shiko MalikusSaif jiyake kamar ya kurma ihu ganin za'a ɗaura mashi wani nauyin da bai shirya ba, yasan mulkin ba abu bane mai sauki ba, amman yasan baida zabi dole shine zai gaji Sarautar, maganar da Shamaki yayi itace ta dawo dashi cikin hayyacin shi. 

"A yau ɗinnan Allah ya kawo mu wannan rana mai dinbin daraja da dinbin daraja inda aka ɗaura ma Yariman mu Abdulmalik aure, kuma a wannan ranar ce ake naɗin Yariman Daborah gatan talakawa,Sarautar daborah, shine Sarki na sittin a cikin wannan Masarautar mai ɗinbin tarihi da daraja."
Kabbara akayi, shiko Shamaki ciktausayawa yace. 

"Abdulmalik.?"
Jiki sanyaye ya amsa da. "Na'am."

"Wato shi dai Abdulmalik komi zaiyi sai ya nuna mu iyayen shi bamu iyaba ko? Wannan ai karya dokar Masarauta ce, jibi kiga dangin mu na nesa shaidin nan fa suka tsaya jira ga Baffana, ni bansan mi zance ba, ohni ɗiyar Abdulhamid jikar Maimoon ya zanyi da lamarin Abdulmalik."

''Insha Allah gimbiya Bahijja zataji."

Daga karshe Sarki Muhammad ne ya dauko wasu dakakkun kaya na kirar Masarautar Raifasu da sarkar murjani yace. 
"Wannan kyautace daga iyayen gidan gimbiya Bahijja, muna mata fatan alkhairi."
Bakin Jakadiya yaki rufuwa dan murna tace.

Fita tayi bada jimawa ba, ta kirawo hadimai guda hudu suka ɗauki kayan, suka tafi har sashen waziri Dammur nan suka iske gimbiya Zahra'u da gimbiya Mulaika sai maman Huzaifa gimbiya Salsabila haka aka nuna masu shaidin Bahijja, Mulaika sai murna takeyi itako Zahara'u kamar ta mutu dan baƙin ciki, da kyal gimbiya Salsabila ta yunkura taje ta dauko kudi a dakile ta daura bisa kyautukan Bahijja, taga tashin hankali ganin uwar dukiyar da aka jibgama Bahijja, na gani na faɗa, aranta ko cewa tayi inama Zahara'u ce tasami gata irin na Bahijja, yau ga baiwa ita shugaba a garesu.
Haka suka dinga shiga gidan dangi duk wanda yakama ta akaimawa ankai mashi kuma sun bada tukwici daga nan suka wuce sashen  Sarauniya Zulaiƙa, akan hanyar su suka iske Sarkin shela yanata shelar shaidin mutuncin gimbiya Bahijja, bayi sai murna sukeyi, snnan ya sanar da walimar da za'a gudanar bayan sallar la'asar kai kace wani biki za'a sakeyi, itako Zahara'u tanajin shelar ta faɗa bisa gadon ɗakin ta ta rushe da kuka, itako Binta sakon nan zuwa kunnen ta sujudur shukur tayi tana godema Allah, ta ɗago da rinannun idanun ta ta kalli yar uwar ta Saude tace.

Ranar haka Sarki MalikusSaif ya yini jiki a sanyaye sai yakeji tamkar ya rasa wani muhimmin abune daga cikin jikin shi. 


Bayan sati ɗaya Sarki MalikusSaif ne zaune a fa'da anata fadanci, Sarkin fa'da ne ya shigo tareda wani mutun aka gurfanar dashi gaban Sarki, kallan tsaf Sarki MalikusSaif yayima wannan mutumin sannan ya maida kallan shi ga Sarkin fa'da, cikin girmamawa Sarki fa'da yace.

Itadai Bahijja murmushi kawai tayi tanajin dadin yanda surukan nata ke bata kulawa. 

Haka kuwa Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta kawo masu abincin da kanta, Mansura ta shigo masu da tiredin kayan marmari ta ajeye a gaban su. 

Haka kowa yaci abincin cikin jin dadi musamman Bahijja dakeji kamar ta cinye dashishin dukkan shi ga cikin ta ya cika amman har yanzun tanajin shi'awar cin dashishin ture flat dinta tayi tana kallan Umman ta, murya a narke tace. 

"Umma zansha madarar."

Itako Binta tana mamakin yanda Bahijja ke kwasar abinci sai kace wadda cikin ta ya kai wata biyar dinnan, duk da bazai wuce wata na biyu ba, miko mata tayi cikin wani cup din silver, amsa tayi ta kurba ta lumshe ido tana sha, sadda zatayi kurba ta ukku, batasan sadda ta matse hancin taba wani masifaffan amaine ya taho mata da gudu tayi toilet din falo haka ta dinga kyara amai kamar hanjin ta zasu fito, maye mata baya Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tayi ta taimaka mata ta kuskure bakin ta sannan suka dawo falon, sai sannu suke jera mata musamman MalikusSaif dakeji kamar ya hadiye ga wani irin tausayin ta
 da suka rufeshi, kwantawa tayi kasan kafat din hawaye taji sun cika mata ido, ji tayi Ummu ta janyota jikin ta, tace. 

"Sannu Yata Allah yabaki lafiya."

Hawayen sukai narasar zoboma ta tace. 
"Yawwa Ummu na worke kinga kuma yau aman nan ya kuma dawo mani, dan Allah Ummuna ki bani magani ya tafi karya kuma dawowa."

Dariyace ke cin Zulaiƙa ta hadeta aranta kuwa cewa tayi. 

"Su Bahijja badai yarinta ba, ke dake da karamin ciki ai laulauyi sai hakuri, azahiri kuwa cewa tayi. 

"To Bahijja na yar Ummun ta, zan baki magani."

Takarasa maganar tana kallan MalikusSaif da yake zaune kamar andasashi tace. 
"Kama ta taje daki tayi bacci kaga ta gaji da yawa."

Mikewa yayi kamar mai jiraya dagata ta mike tsaye suka tafi sashen su. 

Shiko Saifulislam ajiyar  zuciya ya sauke yace. 

"Kinga rabo ko Sarauniya ta da raban muga jinin Abdulmalik.?"

Murmushin tayi tace  

"Gaskia kam Allah dai yakara mata lfy ya raba lfy."

"Ameen ya rabbi, saidai kamar batasan cikine da ita ba ko?"

"Eh batasani ba, amman mijin ta ai yasani ina mamakin kodai bai sanar mata bane."

"Kila ina tunanin hakan nima."

Murmushi sukayi nan suka dinga labarin yanda komai na Daborah ya sauya, haka suka dinga jin dadi.


Koda su MalikusSaif suka koma gida suna shiga falo ya dagata sai bedroom, kwantar da ita yayi sannan ya rage mata kayan jikin ta, wani irin tausayin yaji bathroom ya wuce da ita yadan watsa mata ruwa masu dan sanyi sannan ya saka mata riga da sicket marar sa nauyi a tare suka kwanta bisa gado yasa hannun shi yana shafa lafaffan cikin ta, cikin so da begen abinda ke kwance a  cikin nata yace. 

"Sannu Norul Hayat babyn Ya Malik na baki wahala ko?"

Bari in maki addua zaki samu sauki."
"To tace mashi haka ya dage rigar tata ta dinga yimata addua bisa fatar cikin nata har wani irin bacci mai dadi yai gaba da ita, a hankali ya zame jikin shi a nata ya sake lullube ta da blanket ya tofa mata addua sannan ya nufi fada cikin tsantsar tausayin hasken rayuwar tashi, haka aka dinga fadanci amman kaf hankalin MalikusSaif na kan gimbiyar tashi.


Haka rayuwa taci gaba da tafiya cikin aminci komai yana tafiya yanda ya kamata. 

Bayan wata ɗaya cikin Bahijja ya shiga wata ukku kenan, zuwa yanzun kam laulayin ya rage sosai, bakaramin kyau cikin yaimata ba, tayi fresh takara haske gwanin burgewa, zaune take falon ta tareda Manaura hadimar ta, suna yar fira jefi jefi ita da uwar dakin tata, Bahijja ce ta kalli Mansura tace. 

"Mansura wai nikam ina labarin Maimuna."

Murmushi Mansura tayi tace. 

"Ranki shidade tana turakar bayi yanzun ta daina aiki."

"Allah Sarki, ya kamata kam."
"Mansura dauki kular abincin nan kije dashi gida kunci."

Godiya ta hauyima uwar dakin tata, cikin kulawa tace. 

"Ki godewa Allah ai wannan niimar ubangijine."

"Hakane, Allah yakara lfy yasa ki haihu lfy uwar gijiya ta."

Murmushi mai fadi tayi dan taji adduar da Mansura taimata. 

Sallama tayi ta dauki abincin ta tafi. 


A Masarautar Raifasu kuwa Sarki Muhammad ne da ciroma sai ɗan buram da galadima sai dagaci suna tattaunawa akan tattalin arzikin Masarautar, sai sukaji wata iriyar kara ta karade falon Sarki Muhammad ga wani irin guguwa da ta addabi wajen duk da kasancewa falon rufe yake ko alamun kura baka gani komai tsaf yake, amman cikin kankanin lokaci falon ya gama hargitsewa, wata kibiyace aka halbo ta soke bisa kushin din da Sarki Muhammad ke zaune, baki daya wajen suka fara addua a hankali wannan guguwar ta lafa, sannan Sarki Muhammad ya dauki wasikar ya mikama ciroma ita, dake kusa dashi ansa yayi yafara karantawa. 


 _Baidulƙais kenan kana tunanin ni Sarrilƙus na manta dakaine inko har haka ne kayi kuskure dan haka kajini da kyau nan da mako daya zan darkake duk wani abu da kuke ikirari dashi maci amana, daga Sarkin Gamki."_

Murmushi yayi yace. "Hmmm kunji ko na fada maku Sarrilƙus baisan tausayi ba, kuma bai yafiya saidai ta Allah batasu ba, insha Allah mukeda nasara."

"Gaskia kam yacika azzalumi."
Cewar galadima. 

Murmushin manya yayi yace. "Asa magatakarda ya rubuta ma Sarki MalikusSaif da Kangiwa wasika akai masu yanzun nan kar abata lokaci."


Bayan kwana biyu, Sarki MalikusSaif ne zaune a fa'da shida jama'arshi sunata bojet din shekara inda fa'da ta cika da mutane kama dasu Dagaci, Ciroma, Majidadi, Sarkin Taska, Sarkin Rumbu, Galadima, Matawalle, Kangiwa, Sarkin fa'da, Ɗan iya Ɗan buren, da dai sauran jama'ar fa'da, shiru ne ya karade wajen kowa yana jiran yaji hukuncin da Sarki ya yanke akan rabon da akayi, gyara alqabbar shi ya ɗanyi nan  Sarkin zagi yafara cewa. 

"Gyara zaki gyara gimtsi Allah yakara lfy da nisan kwana."

Shiko Sarki MalikusSaif cewa. 

"Alhmdullh anyi budget yanda yakama ta saidai a cikin wannan bojet din da akayi inasan Sarkin Rumbu, a dibi abinci kama dasu shinkafa alqama, gero, masara, dawa, wake, da sauran kayan masaruhi na yau da gobe a rarrabawa talakawa na, da sauran bayi kowa ne abashi isashshen abinci, gida gida bansan a nuna banbanci kuma ba lallai sai wanda ke zaune a cikin Masarautar nan ba, aaa duk jama'ata dake kalkashin ikon mulkin Masarautar Daborah."

Kara rusunar da kai Sarkin Rumbu yayi yace.
"Umurnin ka abin tunkaho agareni Allah yataimaki Sarki mai adalci."

Sake waigowa yayi ya kalli Sarkin Taska yace. 

"Kai kuma Sarkin taska, duk inda aka raba abinci, za'aba kowa kudi a kalla foam ashirin."

Kallan juna Kangiwa da Matawalle sukayi suna hango girman kudin dayace a bada bayan kayan abincin, gaskia MalikusSaif mutun ne mao tausayi kuma bai tsoron talauci, maganar shice ta sake katsemasu tunanin da sukeyi cewa yayi. 

Ina Majidadi?"
"Allah yakara lfy gani nan biyayya ga umurnin ka dole ne."

Jinjina kai ya danyi yace. 

"Idan umurnin bai saɓama dokokin ubangiji ba Majidadi, sannan wannan tafiyar tana kalkashin kulawar ka, ka tabbatar ko ina an raba, anbada akai, kuma sauran kananan Masarautun mu a aika da kayan abincin ga kowane hakimi ya tabbatar sakon ya isa ga al'ummar annabi."

"Insha Allah wannan hakkin yana wuyana zamu kiyaye."

"Masha Allah, saidai nasan daga cikin ku wasu zasuce ai wannan dokar bata a cikin wannan Masarautar, daga yau inasan a rubuta wannan dokar a cikin tsare tsare wannan Masarauta, za'adinga rabawa bayi da sauran jama'ar mu kayan abinci da kudin cefane, fa'da taba Sarkin kasuwa iko adinga barin bayi suna cin kasuwar Zursu akalla sau ukku a sati, duk da babbancin da takeyi a karshen sati, sannan ina gargaɗar mai kula da abincin bayi a madafa, za'a dakatar da bawa bayi abinci kullun, kamar yanda aka saba. 
Saboda yanzun anbasu abincin da zasu dinga sarrfawa, amman za'a dinga basu abinci sau biyu a sati, ranar Juma'a da ranar litinin, kuma inasan Majidadi ya tabbatar a cikin abincin a saka masu wadatattan nama, da kuma kifi."

Kowa na fa'dar nan saida yai mamaki gaskia komai na Masarautar Daborah ya sauya, ada bawa baida wannan gatan, abincin da ake basu ko dadin kirki baida shi, ga wulakancin yau daban na gobe daban. 

Inda wasu kecewa dan ya auri baiwa shiyasa ya canza tsarin, inda wasu ke ganin daman can MalikusSaif mutun ne mai tausayi da sanyin zuciya, cikin masu wannan tunanin kuwa harda Matawalle da Kangiwa, shiko Abdulmajid mataimakin limamin fa'da ne a halin yanzun, zaune yake amman kwalla na zirara a bisa kunci shi, ganin yanda bayi suka samu yanci suka samu shugaba adali mai son talakawa da bayi, ashe daman da gaske ne akwai ranar da bayi zasu zama cikakkun 'yaya kamar kowa? lallai inkam harba mafarki yake ba, a zahiri ne hakan ke faruwa lallai ya tabbata, cewa Bayima 'Ya'yane. 


Jin Sarki MalikusSaif yaci gaba da cewa. 
"Ina mai kara tunawa yan uwa masu arziki da ku fidda zakka kada ku shafa'a domin ita zakka tana tsarkake dukiya, kuma tana kawo buɗi ta kowane fanni, sannan ita zakka ya kamata in zaka fidda ta kafara ba makusantan ka, idan suna da bukata, in kuma sun wadatu, kabawa makotan ka, idan ba bukatar hakan agaresu, to kabawa talakawa masu bukata, sannan ita zakka anfison a dinga badata a dunkule ga mabukata, kada kudinga rarraba ta kuna rowar fidda ta, idan kuka badata a dunkule tana iya yuyuwar wanda aka ba, Allah yasama wannan zakkar albarka shima zuwa shekara ya fidda yabawa wani, kunga ansamu albarkar ubangijin talikai, inafatan za'a daure a dinga fidda zakka yanda ya kamata, kuma kuje ga malamai sukara yi maku cikkaken bayani akan zakka, Allah yasa mudace."

Baki ɗayan su suka amsa da Ameen. 

Sarkin aiken Daborah ne ya shigo ya zube ya kawo gaisuwa wajen Sarki, ɗan Zagi yace. 

"Sarki ya amsa meke tafe dakai.?"
"Ranka shidade kayi bako daga Masarautar Raifasu."

Cikin kulawa Sarki MalikusSaif yace. 
"Yimashi iso."

Mikewa yayi ya fita jim kadan suka dawo tare, suka duka, sake kai gaisuwa sukayi, aka ansa masu, sannan Sarkin aike ya tashi ya tafi, shi kuma Sarkin zagi ya kalli bakon yace.

Wani irin dariya suka saki baki ɗayan su daganan Aljani ɗantsitu ya ɓace.

Washe gari da safe Bahijja ce da baiwar ta Mansura a kitchen tana hadama sahibin nata kayan buɗa baki, jajjagen kayan miya Mansura tagama na tarigu da wadatattar albasa, wata tukunya ce ta silba kan wuta keta fidda daddan kamshi sai siraci ke fita a cikin ta, bude tukunyar tayi zabbine a ciki dankwala dankwala guda ukku sun dafu tagama tafasasu, saukewa tayi ta ta tsamesu cikin wani kwano, saida suka tsane sannan ta ɗaura kasko tasa mai da wadatattar albasa, bayan yayi zafi tafara soya naman zabbi.

Wucewa tayi tafara Fara gyara mangwaron ta ta wanke shi fes sannan tayi slide dinshi ta hada mango juice ta zuba suger kadan da flavor, ta juge a jug ajeshi gefe tayi.

"Ayyah Ya Malik bama tani kake ba ko?"

Dafe kanshi yayi yace.

Gyada kai tayi alamun gamsuwa. 

Shima Sarki MalikusSaif jiyake kamar karya tafi, haka sukaita satar kallan junan su, kowa yana turawa junan su sakwanni, d haka dai sukayi bankwana, nan Binta da Abdulmajid sukayi masu rakiya, suna fita kowa ya hadu wadan da za'ayi tafiyar dasu. 

Matawalle, Kangiwa, Galadima, sai Yazid da Huzaifa, da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa haka kowa yahau dokin shi suka kama hanyar tafiya Masarautar Runo dake cikin birnin Gambia. 

 _Masarautar Waisu_ 

Baki daya tagama karadewa da maganar Sarki Haishir inda wasu ke ganin suyi mashi bore su tsige shi bisa mulki wasu naganin aje a kashe su shida mabiya bayan shi, kasancewar sunfi su yawa, saidai duk lalacewar sunsan Sarki Haishir Jarumi ne zai iyaja da kowa a cikin su. 

Shiko ganin rabi da kwatar manyan fa'da duk sun juya mashi baya yasa ya kalli Galadima yace. 

"Mi zakace akan mutanen da suka kasa yima shugaban su biyayya?"
Cikin girmamawa yace. 
"Ranka shidade inaga tinda basu fahimci manufar muba mi zai hana kasa a taramaka su, muje wajen Gurfanai kace ya kare kansa daga cutarwar d mukeso muyi mashi, kaga inya kare kansa sai mubarsu da addinin su shine na gaskia."

Jinjina kai yayi yace 
"Tabbas Galadima kayi hikima haka za'ayi. 
Bai kasa aguiwa ba ya tada dan aike zuwa wajen Waziri Juru kamar yanda suka shawarta. 

Koda sakon Sarki Haishir ya iske Waziri Juru ba karamin mamaki yaiba, yasan abinda bai yuyuwa dan bai taba ganin Gurfanai yayima kanshi komai b, saidai wata zuciyar na nuna mashi cewa zai iya. 
Cikeda gadara yace. 
"Kace mashi mun amince da marece a hadu wajen Gurfanai."


_Masarautar Raifasu_ 

Sarki Muhammad da amaryar shi gimbiya Aisha suna zauna a katafaren falon shi, sunacin kayan itatuwa, hankali kwance, cikin kaunar junan su, wanda yanzun yasan ya zama cikakken mutun kuma ya tababtar da yai aure, yana godema Allah da ni'imar da yaimashi cikin kulawa yace. 

"Gimbiya ta baki ganin munyima Saifulislam laifi har muyi aure bamu gayama Sarki MalikusSaif ba."

Murmushi tayi tace 
"Allah yataimake ka, ba dadi kam amman ai lokacin ne ya kure kuma kaga sunsha gaganiya damu kada abun yaimasu yawa."
"Kema kinyi magana, amman yakamata watara mukai masu ziyara."
"Gaskia kam, saidai mubari idan yarmu Bahijja ta haihu sai muje kamar zaifi."

"Kwarai kuwa Allah ya sauke ta lfy."
"Ameen ya Allah."
Cigaba da cin kayan itatuwan su sukayi sai kuma yace. 
"Yawwa gimbiya kinsa Jakadiya sun raba kayan abincin da za'a rabama bayi.?"
"Eh ranka shidade tunjiya anbi kowane bawa da kayan masarufi sunata godiya Allah yakara sutura."

"Ameen ya rabbil alameen."cewar Sarki Muhammad. 
 A cikin taskar bayi kuwa duk inda kaje ba abinda akeyi sai sam barka d mulkin Sarki Muhammad, musamman ma gimbiya Aisha, da suke ganin ita takawo wannan tsarin na tallafawa kowane bawa na Masarautar wanda zuwa yanzun suke kara ganin lallai kam *BAYIMA **YA'YANE.* 

Haka kuwa akayi ita kesa Sarki Muhammad yin aikin alkhairi tun tana Jakadiyar shi har zuwa yanzun da Allah yasa tazama matar shi. 

 _Haka akeson mutun ya kasance mai sa aikin alkhairi bana sharri ba. Hausawa nacewa ba'a mugun Sarki sai mugun bafade Allah yasa mudace🙏_


A cikin Masarautar Daborah kuwa ba kadan Wazirin Sarki MalikusSaif ba ke kulawa da nauyin da aka barmashi ba komai yana tafiya yanda ya kamata. 

Hakama wajen Binta da Abdulmajid ba karamin kula suke ba yarsu ba dana abinda ke cikin ta, musamman Mansura hadimar itama tana iya kokarin ta, ba karamin kyau Bahijja tayiba duk da tana kewar Ya Malik dinta, amman tana samun kulawa wajen iyayen ta hakama wajen kanwar mahaifiar ta Saude.....

Nan Tasi'u yaci gaba da yimasu bayani daki daki dai dai gwargwado, haka ya zauna cikin Masarautar Waisu."

A wajen su Sarki MalikusSaif sun sauka cikin Masarautar Runo bakaramin farin ciki bane ya mamaye Sarki Abu-Jalal ba, musamman dayaga ɗan lelen nashi haka akaita kawo gaisuwa wajen su MalikusSaif daga fa'da ba inda suka nufa sai katafaren falon Sarki Abu-Jalal daya gaji da ƙayatuwa da kayan alatu na more rayuwa tayau da kullin, kowa ya samu waje ya zauna cikeda farin ciki marar iyaka, Sarki Abu-Jalal ne yace. 

"Naji daɗin wannan zuwan da kukayi yauga 'yata cikin Masarautar Runo gaskia bansan irin farin cikin da nikeji ba, Allah yaimaku albarka."
Baki ɗayan su suka amsa da ameen. 

Haka hadimai sukaita shigowa da abinci iri iri da kayan marmari kala kala haka sukaci suka sha kowa yana mai farin ciki a cikin zuciyar shi. 
Haka Yarima Dawud yazo yaimasu barka da zuwa nan sukaita firar zumunci da yaushe gamo, wannan kenan 


 _Masarautar Daborah_ 

Kwana biyun nan da Sarki MalikusSaif yayi baki ɗayan Masarautar ji suke kamar ya shekara ba karamin kewar shi sukeyi ba duk da Wazirin shi yana iyakar kokarin shi. 
A wajen gimbiya Bahijja kuwa ba kaɗan take samun kulawa a wajen iyayen taba, da hadiman ta. 
Saidai duk da haka kullin hankalin ta nakan Ya Malik dinta. 

*************************************

 *WAISU*

Rayuwa tafara sauya masu komai yana tafiya yanda yakama ta domin kuwa suna fahimta addinin musulunci dai dai gwargwado tundaga tsarki sallah da abubuwan da ba'a rasaba, domin kuwa har anfara kiran sallah a cikin Masarautar ta Waisu.

a ruɗe ya janyota jikin yana murza hannun ta a hankali, wani irin tausayin tane yaji ya mamaye mashi zuciya, haɗe kanshi da nata yayi yana buso mata sanyayyen iskan bakin shi yace.

Yau take sunan gimbiya Bahijja baki daga ko ina duk sun hallara anata shagalin suna kai kace wani gagarumin biki ne sukeyi musamman wajen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa dake jin farin ciki marar misaltuwa a cikin zuciyar ta danko jariran Abduljabbar (Hassan)kenan da abokiyar tagwaicin shi Fatima (Hussaina) suke a sashen Sarauniya Zulaiƙa tun da safe inna Mairo da gimbiya Aisha (Jakadiyar Baidulƙais) a da, suka kawo mata yan jikokin nata cikin shiga ta alfarma da suka ƙawatu gwanin ban shi'awa.

Wajen Sarki MalikusSaif kuwa kwarya kwaryar walima ya haɗa tagani da faɗa kowa ya hallara tun daga manyan fa'da da hakiman shi da sauran al'ummar dake kalkashin ikon Masarautar Daborah,haka akaci aka sha kayan abinci iri irina alatu da more rayuwar duniya haka sukaci sukai hani'an danko bayyana farin cikin su Kangiwa da Matawalle bata lokaci ne musamman MalikusSaif dake jin shi ya zama Baba haka yaita jin dadi har kunne.

A wajen gimbiya Bahijja kuwa sanye take cikin wani irin dakakken leshi na gani na faɗa pitch color ta sha kyau iya kyau ga sarkar gold dake sanye a bisa kyakkyawan wuyan ta sai yan hannu da zabba kana ganin ta zaka san tana cikin farin ciki mai tarin yawa a cikin zuciyar ta, dangin tane keta shiri zasuje wajen Walimar da Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta haɗa ma jikokin nata tagani ta faɗa, ɗunguma zuwa babban Hall na sukaBarri nan ne zasu yi walimar,gimbiya Aisha ce rike da hannun yar tata har cikin katon hall wanda yake cikeda mutane kowa yana ta farin ciki tun daga bayi har masu Sarauta, wajen gimbiya Salsabila taba gimbiya Bahijja waje ta zauna bisa wata ƙayatattar kujera ta gani ta faɗa,haka Sarauniya Zulaiƙa ta shigo da aminiyar ta Hajia Kubra sai gimbiya Rukayya yar Sarki Abu-Jalal wadda ita kaɗai ce tazo a cikin yan Masarautar Runo sai gimbiya Abida ɗauke da kyawawan jarirran nasu,haka suka zazzzauna duk wanda kagani kasan yana cikin annashuwa da farin ciki,haka kowa ya hallara hatta gimbiya Zahara'u da gimbiya Bilkisu duk sunzo kowa yasha kaya na alfarma bada jimawa ba aka fara gabatar da Walima bayan buɗe taro da addu'a dayima yaran da aka haifa kyakkyawar Addu'a wanda Saude ce ta gama gabatar da addu'ar sannan ta koma gefen Binta ta zauna haka akaci abinci marai da lafiya iri iri.

Bayan sati ɗaya a cikin fa'dar Masarautar Daborah kuwa tamkam take da ɗan Adam daka gansu kasan ana gabatar da muhimmin abu ne, kowa yasha ado na alfarma a jikin su gwanin burgewa Sarki MalikusSaif ne zaune bisa karagar mulkin shi da sauran yan fa'da inda Shamaki yafara naɗin mukarraban fa'da ba tareda bata lokaci ba yace.

 *WAISU*

Mutane ne zaune duk wanda kagani fuskar shi cike take da alhini da bakin ciki,musamman Sarki Abdullahi da idanun shi sukayi jajir dan halin daya tsinkayi kanshi a ciki,Sarki Muhammd ne keta tausar shi yana bashi baki,haka akaita zuwa ana mashi gaisuwar rashin mahaifiyar shi da yayi gimbiya Kursiyya wadda ciwon ciki yai ajalin da asubar safiyar yau alhamis,saida marece likis sannan Sarki Muhammad yaima Sarki Abdullahi sallama shida Wazirin shi suka kama hanyar kowama Masarautar tasu.

 *RUNO*

*RUNO*

Jama'ar annabi ne tamkam kamar ba gobe inda aka gama ɗaura auren Huzaifa Abdullatib da Amaryar shi Hafsat Abu-Jalal haka aka gama ɗaurin auren Sarki Abu-Jalal ne keta hidima da manyan bakin su kowa najin daɗi musamman su Sarki MalikusSaif dake tsokar Ango Huzaifa shiko baki har kunne yakasa rufe shi.

Bayan sati ukku Yarima Yazid ne da amaryar shi gimbiya Zahara'u sai Yarima Huzaifa da gimbiya Hafsat sai Yarima Lurwan da amaryar shi gimbiya Bilkisu suka tafi sashen Sarki MalikusSaif suna shiga suka iske shi tareda iyalin nashi,cikeda farin ciki ya tarbi abokan nashi suka zauna aka hau fira ta abokai hakama matan nasu suma waje suka samu cikin falon Gimbiya Bahijja suka wuce bayan sun gaisa aka hau fira cikin jin daɗi da kaunar junan su,kai kace ba wata matsala data taba shiga tsakanin su,musamman Bahijja da gimbiya Zahara'u sai fira suke tamkar yan uwan juna dan kan matan su a haɗe yake kowa nasan ɗan uwan shi cikin aminci.
Hakama wajen mazajen nasu sai fira suke suna nishaɗi,daga bisani matayen nasu suka gyara masu wajen cin abinci, haka sukaci suka sha kowa na farin ciki,basu sukabar gidan Sarki Malik ba saida akayi isha'i sannan sukayi sallama kowa ya koma sashen shi cikin farin ciki.
Haka rayuwa ta kasance a cikin Daborah cikin aminci komai yana tafiya dai dai yanda ya kamata.

Bayan Shekara biyar zuwa lokacin ya'yan Sarki MalikusSaif sun girma sunyi wayau sosai,danko gimbiya Fatima sashen kakarta Binta can take rayuwar ta, tayau da kullin saidai takaima iyayen ta da kakarta ziyara danko itada ɗan uwanta Yarima Abduljabbar ba karamin shakuwa ce ta shiga tsakanin su,kansu a haɗe yake.
Yau kamar kullin gimbiya Fatima ce a sashen kakarta Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sai zuba take mata tana shagwaba  itako  Sarauniya sai ririta yar lelen tata takeyi sallamar Yarima Hassan suka tsinkaya ya shigo hannun rike da Zainab yar Yarima Yazid gudan hannun shi kuma Jalal ne ɗan Yarima Huzaifa atare suka zauna wajen kakar tasu suka fara fira, itako Sarauniya Zulaiƙa sai farin ciki takeyi tana ganin jikokin nata, hadiman Sarauniya ne suka kawo masu kayan marmari suka aje agaban su, haka sukaita yima Sarauniya fira,tana ta biye su suna cikin firar sai ga Saifulislam ya shigo shima zama yayi akaci gaba da firar dashi,cikin aminci.
Haka rayuwa tai ta wanzuwa a cikin Daborah komai yana tafiya yanda yaka mata ta kowa ne fanni komai ya daidai ta musamman rayuwar bayi da suka gama yarda cewa Bayima 'Ya'yane zuwa yanzun sun samu cikakken ƴanci a cikin Masarautar dan ba kaɗan sukejin daɗin mulkin Sarki MalikusSaif da adalar matar shi Gimbiya Bahijja wadda tazama fitila mai haskawa a cikin zukatan bayin Daborah da sauran talakawa harma da masu mulki.
